## File: `openturath_ai/pubspec.yaml`

```yaml
name: openturath_ai
description: "OpenTurath AI - الذكاء الاصطناعي للعلوم الإسلامية"
publish_to: 'none'
version: 1.0.66+67

environment:
  sdk: '>=3.0.0 <4.0.0'

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter

  flutter_localizations:
    sdk: flutter

  # Firebase
  firebase_core: ^3.2.0
  firebase_auth: ^5.1.0
  cloud_firestore: ^5.2.0
  cloud_functions: ^5.0.3

  # Google Sign In
  google_sign_in: ^6.2.1

  # WebView with JS Injection support
  flutter_inappwebview: ^6.0.0

  # UI & UX
  flutter_svg: ^2.0.10+1

  # Utils
  http: ^1.6.0
  path: ^1.9.1
  shared_preferences: ^2.2.3
  url_launcher: ^6.3.0
  package_info_plus: ^8.0.2
  flutter_markdown: ^0.7.7+1
  crypto: ^3.0.7
  intl: ^0.20.2
  path_provider: ^2.1.6
  open_filex: ^4.7.0
  device_info_plus: ^12.4.0

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^4.0.0

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true
  fonts:
    - family: NativeInter
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeInter.ttf
    - family: NativeOutfit
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeOutfit.ttf
          weight: 400
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeOutfit-600.ttf
          weight: 600
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeOutfit-700.ttf
          weight: 700
    - family: NativeNewsreader
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeNewsreader-400.ttf
          weight: 400
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeNewsreader.ttf
          weight: 600
    - family: NativeArabic
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeArabic.ttf
          weight: 400
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/NativeArabic-700.ttf
          weight: 700
    - family: NativeArabicUI
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/Cairo-400.ttf
          weight: 400
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/Cairo-600.ttf
          weight: 600
        - asset: assets/native_fonts/Cairo-700.ttf
          weight: 700
  assets:
    - assets/native_fonts/Cairo-OFL.txt
    - assets/images/
    - assets/data/

```

<a name="file-openturath_ai-macos-podfile"></a>
## File: `openturath_ai/macos/Podfile`

```
platform :osx, '12.0'

# CocoaPods analytics sends network stats synchronously affecting flutter build latency.
ENV['COCOAPODS_DISABLE_STATS'] = 'true'

project 'Runner', {
  'Debug' => :debug,
  'Profile' => :release,
  'Release' => :release,
}

def flutter_root
  generated_xcode_build_settings_path = File.expand_path(File.join('..', 'Flutter', 'ephemeral', 'Flutter-Generated.xcconfig'), __FILE__)
  unless File.exist?(generated_xcode_build_settings_path)
    raise "#{generated_xcode_build_settings_path} must exist. If you're running pod install manually, make sure \"flutter pub get\" is executed first"
  end

  File.foreach(generated_xcode_build_settings_path) do |line|
    matches = line.match(/FLUTTER_ROOT\=(.*)/)
    return matches[1].strip if matches
  end
  raise "FLUTTER_ROOT not found in #{generated_xcode_build_settings_path}. Try deleting Flutter-Generated.xcconfig, then run \"flutter pub get\""
end

  target 'RunnerTests' do
```

```typescript
// Ordered most-specific first. A title matching nothing is NOT guessed:
// callers must quarantine it for operator review.

  [/sultan|all[- ]access|semua (24 )?ai|paket semua/, SULTAN_SCOPES],
  [/tahaww?ulat/, ["fiqh_tahawwulat"]],
  [/syafi/, ["fiqh_syafii"]],
  [/hanafi/, ["fiqh_hanafi"]],
  [/maliki/, ["fiqh_maliki"]],
  [/han[bm]ali/, ["fiqh_hanbali"]],
  [/muqaran|perbandingan mazhab/, ["fiqh_muqaran"]],
  [/fatawa|masail/, ["fiqh"]],
  [/a[qk]idah|ushuluddin/, ["aqidah"]],
  [/qawaid|ushul fi[kq]/, ["ushul_fiqh"]],
  [/hadi[ts]|musthalah/, ["hadits"]],
  [/tafsir|tajwid|qiraat/, ["tafsir"]],
  [/bahasa arab|nahwu|sharaf/, ["nahwu"]],
  [/tasaww?uf|adzkar/, ["tasawwuf"]],
  [/tarikh|sirah|thabaqat|tarajim|rijal/, ["tarikh"]],
  [/bibliografi|faharis/, ["bibliografi_faharis"]],
];

export function resolveAkalScopes(serviceTitle: unknown): string[] {
  const title = typeof serviceTitle === "string" ? serviceTitle.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  if (!title) return [];
  const exact = AKAL_SERVICES.find(s => s.name.toLowerCase() === title);
  if (exact) return [...exact.scopes];
  const label = Object.entries(SCOPE_LABELS).find(([, name]) => name.toLowerCase() === title);
  if (label) return label[0] === "all_access" ? [...SULTAN_SCOPES] : [label[0]];
  for (const [pattern, scopes] of SERVICE_KEYWORDS) if (pattern.test(title)) return [...scopes];
  return [];
}

// Every scope that maps to at least one notebook entity can be provisioned.
export const PROVISIONABLE_SCOPES: string[] = [...new Set(Object.values(ENTITY_SCOPES))].sort();
for (const service of AKAL_SERVICES) for (const scope of service.scopes) {
  if (scope !== "all_access" && !PROVISIONABLE_SCOPES.includes(scope)) throw new Error(`Unprovisionable GoAkal scope ${scope}`);
}

// Serialized for the Python automation (ecosystem/openturath_subscription/shared).
export function sharedCatalog(): any {
  const scopes: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const scope of PROVISIONABLE_SCOPES) {
    scopes[scope] = {label: SCOPE_LABELS[scope] || scope, notebooks: Object.entries(ENTITY_SCOPES)
      .filter(([, s]) => s === scope).map(([entity]) => entity).sort()
      .map(entity => ({entity, master: NOTEBOOK_ENTITIES[entity].masterId, legacy: NOTEBOOK_ENTITIES[entity].legacyIds || []}))};
  }
  return {scopes, all_access_scopes: SULTAN_SCOPES.filter(s => s !== "all_access"),
    akal_services: AKAL_SERVICES, keywords: SERVICE_KEYWORDS.map(([pattern, s]) => [pattern.source, s])};
}
```

```typescript
export const normalEmail = (s: unknown): string => typeof s === "string" ? s.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
export const keyOf = (...parts: string[]): string => crypto.createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(parts)).digest("hex");
export const millis = (v: any): number => v?.toMillis?.() ?? (v?.toDate ? v.toDate().getTime() : typeof v === "number" ? v : Date.parse(v || ""));
// A verified provider receipt does not supersede an owner's later bonus,
// transfer, or manual correction. Ambiguous adjustments block revocation;
// they do not automatically create or extend a payment grant.
export function hasLegacyAccessAdjustment(tx: any): boolean {
  const source = String(tx.source || "").toLowerCase();
  return Boolean(tx.bonus_reason || tx.bonus_applied_at || tx.original_transaction_id ||
    tx.admin_verified || tx.admin_approved || source.includes("manual") || source.includes("transfer") ||
    tx.access_override || tx.override_reason);
}
export const REVOCATION_POLICY = 3;
export function evidenceHash(value: any): string {
  const canonical = (v: any): any => {
    if (v?.toMillis || v?.toDate) return millis(v);
    if (v instanceof Date) return v.getTime();
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(canonical);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(v).sort().map(k=>[k,canonical(v[k])]));
    return v ?? null;
  };
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(canonical(value))).digest("hex");
}
export function legacyTransactionScopes(tx: any): string[] {
  const explicit = [tx.entitlement_key, tx.scope, ...(Array.isArray(tx.modules)?tx.modules:[])].filter(Boolean);
  if (explicit.length) return explicit;
  const label = String(tx.service_name || tx.serviceTitle || "").toLowerCase();
  if (/tahawwulat|tahawulat/.test(label)) return ["fiqh_tahawwulat"];
  if (/syafi|syafii/.test(label)) return ["fiqh_syafii"];
  if (/bahasa arab/.test(label)) return ["nahwu"];

}
export function billingExpiry(baseMs: number, months: number): number {
  if (!Number.isInteger(months) || months < 1 || months > 120) throw new Error("Invalid product duration");
  if (months === 1) return baseMs + 30 * 86400000;
  const date = new Date(baseMs), day = date.getUTCDate();
  date.setUTCDate(1); date.setUTCMonth(date.getUTCMonth() + months);
  const last = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth() + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
  date.setUTCDate(Math.min(day, last)); return date.getTime();
}
export function akalDurationMonths(priceSchemeTitle: unknown, serviceTitle: unknown = ""): number {
  const s = `${priceSchemeTitle || ""} ${serviceTitle || ""}`.toLowerCase();
  if (["12 bulan", "12m", "tahun", "1y", "year", "annual"].some(k => s.includes(k))) return 12;
  if (s.includes("6 bulan") || s.includes("6m")) return 6;
  return 1;
}
// Decides what the VPS worker may do with one authenticated GoAkal webhook
// event queued in access_legacy_events. Anything short of complete, positive
// billing evidence for a known product goes to the operator, never to a grant;
// negative events are only recorded because expiry is driven by the ledger.
export function classifyLegacyEvent(event: any, resolveScopes: (service: unknown) => string[]): any {
  const status = String(event?.payment_status || "").toUpperCase();
  if (["EXPIRED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED"].includes(status)) return {action: "noted", reason: "negative_event_ledger_decides"};
  if (!["PAID", "SETTLED"].includes(status)) return {action: "review", reason: "unknown_payment_status"};
  const email = normalEmail(event.email), id = typeof event.transaction_id === "string" ? event.transaction_id.trim() : "";
  const amount = Number(event.amount), paidMs = millis(event.paid_at), scopes = resolveScopes(event.service);
  if (event.reason) return {action: "review", reason: String(event.reason)};
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) return {action: "review", reason: "invalid_email"};
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(id)) return {action: "review", reason: "invalid_transaction_id"};
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return {action: "review", reason: "non_positive_amount"};
  if (!scopes.length) return {action: "review", reason: "unknown_service"};
  if (!Number.isFinite(paidMs)) return {action: "review", reason: "missing_payment_time"};
  const months = akalDurationMonths(event.plan, event.service);
  return {action: "grant", email, transactionId: id, amount, scopes, months, paidMs, expiresMs: billingExpiry(paidMs, months)};
}
export function verifiedAkalPeriods(rows: any[]): any[] {
  const scopes: Record<string,string> = {"AI Fikih Tahawwulat":"fiqh_tahawwulat",
    "SUPER AI FIKIH SYAFI'I":"fiqh_syafii", "SUPER AI BAHASA ARAB":"nahwu"};
  const durations: Record<string,number> = {"1 Bulan":1,"6 Bulan":6,"12 Bulan":12};
  const valid = rows.filter(r=>r.status === "PAID" && Number(r.incomingAmount)>0 && scopes[r.serviceTitle] &&
    durations[r.priceSchemeTitle] && normalEmail(r.payerEmail) && r.paymentId && Number.isFinite(millis(r.paidAt)));
  valid.sort((a,b)=>millis(a.paidAt)-millis(b.paidAt));
  const seen = new Map<string,string>(), ends = new Map<string,number>(), periods = [];
  for (const row of valid) {
    const scope=scopes[row.serviceTitle], months=durations[row.priceSchemeTitle], paid=millis(row.paidAt);
    const email=normalEmail(row.payerEmail), payment=String(row.paymentId), id=keyOf("goakal_verified",payment,scope);
    if (seen.has(id)) {
      if (seen.get(id) !== email) throw new Error("Provider payment identity collision");
      continue;
    }
    seen.set(id,email);
    const chain=keyOf(email,scope), starts=Math.max(paid,ends.get(chain)||0), expires=billingExpiry(starts,months);
    ends.set(chain,expires);
    periods.push({id,email,scope,payment,amount:Number(row.incomingAmount),paid,months,starts,expires});
  }
  return periods;
}
export const isVip = (u: any, grants: any[] = []): boolean => VIP_EMAILS.has(normalEmail(u?.email)) ||
  u?.is_vip === true || ["vip", "admin", "guru", "special"].includes(String(u?.role || "").toLowerCase()) ||
  grants.some(g => g.kind === "VIP_PERMANENT");
export function rights(u: any, grants: any[], scope: string, now = Date.now()): boolean {
  if (isVip(u, grants)) return true;
  if (!u || u.account_deleted || u.pending_deletion) return false;
  return grants.some(g => g.status === "active" && [scope, "all_access", "all_ai"].includes(g.scope) &&
    Number.isFinite(g.expires_ms) && g.expires_ms > now &&
    (g.kind === "payment" && g.amount > 0 || g.kind === "admin" && g.admin_verified === true || g.kind === "voucher"));
}
export class AccessFault extends Error {
  constructor(public code: string, message: string) { super(message); }
}
export interface Entity { code: string; legacyIds?: string[]; masterId: string; masterUrl: string; name: string; clones: Array<{id: string; url: string; name: string}>; }
export interface ShareObservation { notebookId: string; isPublic: boolean; emails: string[]; complete: boolean; }
export interface Provider { observe(id: string): Promise<ShareObservation>; apply(id: string, email: string, desired: boolean): Promise<ShareObservation>; }

export class AccessControl {
  constructor(public db: any, public entities: Record<string, Entity>, public scopes: Record<string, string>,

  assignmentRef(uid: string, entity: string): any { return this.db.collection("access_assignments").doc(keyOf(uid, entity)); }
  async grants(uid: string): Promise<any[]> {
    const s = await this.db.collection("access_grants").where("uid", "==", uid).get();
    return s.docs.map((d: any) => ({id: d.id, ...d.data()}));
  }
  async owner(uid: string): Promise<{user: any; grants: any[]}> {
    const [u, grants] = await Promise.all([this.db.collection("users").doc(uid).get(), this.grants(uid)]);
    const legacy = !u.exists ? await this.db.collection("access_legacy_owners").doc(uid).get() : null;
    let user = u.data() || legacy?.data();
    if (user?.adopted_by) user = {...user, account_deleted: true};
    if (user?.email) {
      const protectedOwner = await this.db.collection("access_vip_registry").doc(keyOf(normalEmail(user.email))).get();
      if (protectedOwner.exists) user = {...user, is_vip: true};
    }
    return {user, grants};
  }
  async assessRevocation(uid: string, scope: string, targetEmail?: string): Promise<any> {
    const {user, grants} = await this.owner(uid);

    const runtime = (await this.db.collection("access_control").doc("runtime").get()).data() || {};
    if (runtime.revocations_paused === true) return {allowed:false,reason:"incident_pause"};
    if (!user || !email || normalEmail(user.email) !== email) return {allowed:false,reason:"identity_unresolved"};
    const permanent = await this.db.collection("access_vip_registry").doc(keyOf(email)).get();
    if (isVip({...user,email},grants) || permanent.exists) return {allowed:false,reason:"permanent_vip"};
    if (user.access_revocation_hold) return {allowed:false,reason:"owner_hold"};
    if (user.account_deleted || user.pending_deletion) return {allowed:false,reason:"deletion_requires_separate_review"};
    if (rights(user,grants,scope,this.clock())) return {allowed:false,reason:"active_scope"};
    const selected = grants.filter(g=>[scope,"all_access","all_ai"].includes(g.scope));
    // Absence of evidence is not proof of expiry. Deletion requires its own
    // reviewed path; an absent user document never authorizes removal.
    if (!selected.length) return {allowed:false,reason:"missing_scope_evidence"};
    if (selected.some(g=>!Number.isFinite(g.expires_ms) ||
      !["active","revoked"].includes(g.status) ||
      !(g.kind === "payment" && g.amount>0 || g.kind === "admin" && g.admin_verified === true || g.kind === "voucher")))
      return {allowed:false,reason:"invalid_scope_evidence"};
    const txs = new Map<string,any>();
    for (const [field,value] of [["uid",uid],["customer_email",email],["payer_email",email],["email",email]]) {
      const s = await this.db.collection("transactions").where(field,"==",value).get();
      for (const d of s.docs) {
        const scopes = legacyTransactionScopes(d.data());
        if (!scopes.length || scopes.some(s=>[scope,"all_access","all_ai"].includes(s))) txs.set(d.id,{id:d.id,...d.data()});
      }
    }
    const legacy = user.legacy_revoke_only || user.access_legacy_audit_required || selected.some(g=>g.provider === "goakal" || g.imported) ||
      [...txs.values()].some(t=>hasLegacyAccessAdjustment(t) || !["midtrans","doku"].includes(String(t.gateway || "").toLowerCase()));
    const fingerprint = evidenceHash({policy:REVOCATION_POLICY,uid,email,scope,
      owner:{account_deleted:!!user.account_deleted,pending_deletion:!!user.pending_deletion,
        adopted_by:user.adopted_by || null,entitlement:user.entitlements?.[scope] || null},
      grants:[...selected].sort((a,b)=>String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))),
      transactions:[...txs.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.id.localeCompare(b.id))});
    if (legacy) {
      const certificate = (await this.db.collection("access_legacy_audits").doc(keyOf(uid,scope)).get()).data();
      if (certificate?.status !== "approved" || certificate.policy !== REVOCATION_POLICY ||

        certificate.email !== email || certificate.owner_approved !== true)

        const decision = certificate.adjustments?.[tx.id];
        const explicit = millis(tx.subscription_expires_at || tx.access_expires_at || tx.expires_at);
        const honored = selected.find(g=>g.id === decision?.grant_id && g.kind === "admin" && g.admin_verified === true &&
          g.source_transaction === tx.id && Number.isFinite(explicit) && g.expires_ms >= explicit);
        const resolved = decision?.action === "honor" && honored ||
          decision?.action === "expired_owner_confirmed" && Number.isFinite(explicit) && explicit <= this.clock() ||
          decision?.action === "void_owner_confirmed" && decision.owner_approved === true && typeof decision.reason === "string" && decision.reason.length>0;
        if (!resolved) return {allowed:false,reason:"manual_adjustment_unresolved",fingerprint,legacy:true};
        if (honored?.status === "active" && honored.expires_ms > this.clock())

  async adoptLegacy(uid: string, legacyUid: string): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
    const legacyRef = this.db.collection("access_legacy_owners").doc(legacyUid);
    const legacy = await legacyRef.get();
    if (!current.exists || !legacy.exists || legacy.data().adopted_by ||
        normalEmail(current.data().email) !== normalEmail(legacy.data().email)) return;
    const oldAssignments = await this.db.collection("access_assignments").where("uid", "==", legacyUid).get();
    const oldGrants = await this.db.collection("access_grants").where("uid", "==", legacyUid).get();
    await this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
      const user = (await t.get(current.ref)).data();
      const prior = (await t.get(legacyRef)).data();
      if (!user || !prior || prior.adopted_by || normalEmail(user.email) !== normalEmail(prior.email)) return;
      const assignments = [], grants = [];
      for (const d of oldAssignments.docs) {
        const a = (await t.get(d.ref)).data();
        const target = this.assignmentRef(uid, a.entity);
        const existing = (await t.get(target)).data();
        const identity = this.db.collection("access_identities").doc(keyOf(a.email, a.entity));
        const bound = (await t.get(identity)).data();
        if (existing || bound?.uid !== legacyUid) throw new AccessFault("failed-precondition", "Identity adoption conflict");
        assignments.push({ref:d.ref, a, target, identity});
      }
      for (const d of oldGrants.docs) {const g = (await t.get(d.ref)).data(); if (g?.uid === legacyUid) grants.push(d);}
      for (const a of assignments) {
        const revision = a.a.revision + 1;
        const adopted = {...a.a, uid, revision};
        t.set(a.target, adopted);
        // Jobs belonging to the old UID become stale after ownership transfer.
        // Recreate in-flight work under the verified new owner and revision.
        if (["provisioning", "revoking"].includes(a.a.status)) {
          const desired = a.a.status === "provisioning";
          for (const id of desired ? [a.a.notebook_id] : (a.a.history || [a.a.notebook_id])) {
            t.set(this.db.collection("access_jobs").doc(keyOf(uid, a.a.entity, String(revision), id)),
              {...adopted, notebook_id:id, desired, status:"pending", attempts:0, queued_ms:this.clock(), due_ms:this.clock()});
          }
        }
        t.update(a.ref, {status:"adopted", adopted_by:uid});
        t.set(a.identity, {uid, entity:a.a.entity, email:a.a.email});
        for (const id of a.a.history || [a.a.notebook_id]) t.set(this.db.collection("access_memberships").doc(keyOf(id,a.a.email)), {uid}, {merge:true});
      }

  async resolve(uid: string, entity: string): Promise<any> {

      !user.account_deleted && !user.pending_deletion) {
      // A migration hold preserves the exact existing physical registration;
      // it never allocates a new notebook or invents a financial entitlement.
      const registered = await this.resolveObservedLegacy(uid,user.email,entity);
      const assignment = (await this.assignmentRef(uid,entity).get()).data();
      return {...registered,status:"ready",revision:assignment?.revision || 1,legacyReview:true,
        validUntil:new Date(this.clock()+60000).toISOString()};
    }
    if (!rights(user, grants, this.scopes[entity], this.clock())) throw new AccessFault("permission-denied", "Hak akses kajian ini sudah tidak aktif.");
    const a = (await this.assignmentRef(uid, entity).get()).data();
    if (!a || a.status !== "ready" || a.email !== normalEmail(user.email)) {
      throw new AccessFault("failed-precondition", "Pembayaran/hak akses tercatat. Akses notebook sedang disiapkan; Anda tidak perlu membeli ulang.");
    }
    const n = (await this.db.collection("access_notebooks").doc(a.notebook_id).get()).data();
    if (!n || n.entity !== entity || !["active", "draining"].includes(n.status) || n.is_public !== false || !a.verified_ms) {
      throw new AccessFault("unavailable", "Notebook sedang diperiksa. Silakan coba lagi.");
    }
    return {status: "ready", url: `https://notebook.google.com/notebook/${a.notebook_id}`, notebookId: a.notebook_id,
      entityCode: entity, revision: a.revision, isMaster: a.notebook_id === this.entities[entity].masterId,
      cloneName: n.name, validUntil: new Date(this.clock() + 60000).toISOString()};
  }
  async resolveObservedLegacy(uid: string, email: string, entity: string): Promise<any> {
    // During migration, preserve proven physical registrations for legacy
    // manual rights. Never invent an assignment from a UID hash or free slot.
    const members=await this.db.collection("access_memberships").where("email","==",normalEmail(email)).get();
    const assignment=(await this.assignmentRef(uid,entity).get()).data();
    const e=this.entities[entity];
    const preferred=[assignment?.notebook_id,...(e.legacyIds || []),e.masterId,...e.clones.map(c=>c.id)];
    const candidates=members.docs.map((d:any)=>d.data()).filter((m:any)=>m.entity===entity && m.present && m.verified_ms)
      .sort((a:any,b:any)=>preferred.indexOf(a.notebook_id)-preferred.indexOf(b.notebook_id));
    for (const member of candidates) {
      const n=(await this.db.collection("access_notebooks").doc(member.notebook_id).get()).data();
      if (n?.entity===entity && n.is_public===false && ["active","draining"].includes(n.status))
        return {url:`https://notebook.google.com/notebook/${member.notebook_id}`,notebookId:member.notebook_id,
          entityCode:entity,isMaster:member.notebook_id===e.masterId,cloneName:n.name};
    }

  async reserve(uid: string, entity: string): Promise<any> {
    const {user, grants} = await this.owner(uid);
    if (!rights(user, grants, this.scopes[entity], this.clock())) throw new AccessFault("permission-denied", "No current grant");
    if (user.legacy_revoke_only) {
      const existing = (await this.assignmentRef(uid, entity).get()).data();
      if (existing) return existing;
      throw new AccessFault("failed-precondition", "Legacy payment identity awaits application signup");
    }
    const email = normalEmail(user.email);
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) throw new AccessFault("failed-precondition", "Verified owner email required");
    const e = this.entities[entity];
    if (!e) throw new AccessFault("invalid-argument", "Unknown entity");
    const ids = [e.masterId, ...e.clones.map(c => c.id), ...(e.legacyIds || [])];
    const ar = this.assignmentRef(uid, entity);
    const identity = this.db.collection("access_identities").doc(keyOf(email, entity));
    return this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
      const existing = (await t.get(ar)).data();
      const bound = (await t.get(identity)).data();
      if (bound && bound.uid !== uid) throw new AccessFault("failed-precondition", "Google identity requires ownership recovery");
      if (existing && existing.email !== email) throw new AccessFault("failed-precondition", "Email change requires verified migration");
      if (existing && ["ready", "provisioning"].includes(existing.status)) return existing;
      const candidates = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const nr = this.db.collection("access_notebooks").doc(id);
        const mr = this.db.collection("access_memberships").doc(keyOf(id, email));
        candidates.push({id, nr, mr, n: (await t.get(nr)).data(), m: (await t.get(mr)).data()});
      }
      // Reuse observed registration before waterfall: imports retain the real
      // notebook and do not consume a second seat, including legacy notebooks.
      const found = candidates.find(c => c.m?.present === true && c.n?.is_public === false && ["active", "draining"].includes(c.n?.status)) ||
        candidates.find(c => !e.legacyIds?.includes(c.id) && c.n?.status === "active" && c.n?.is_public === false &&
          c.n?.healthy_until_ms > this.clock() && c.n.occupied < Math.min(2000, c.n.admission_limit || 1995));
      if (!found) throw new AccessFault("resource-exhausted", "paid_waiting_capacity");
      const revision = (existing?.revision || 0) + 1;
      const assignment = {uid, entity, scope: this.scopes[entity], email, notebook_id: found.id,
        status: "provisioning", revision, created_ms: existing?.created_ms || this.clock(),
        history: [...new Set([...(existing?.history || []), found.id])], updated_ms: this.clock()};
      if (!found.m?.present) t.update(found.nr, {occupied: found.n.occupied + 1});
      t.set(found.mr, {uid, entity, email, notebook_id: found.id, present: found.m?.present === true,
        counted: true, revision, reserved_ms: this.clock()}, {merge: true});
      t.set(identity, {uid, email, entity});
      t.set(ar, assignment);
      t.set(this.db.collection("access_jobs").doc(keyOf(uid, entity, String(revision))), {
        ...assignment, desired: true, status: "pending", attempts: 0, queued_ms:this.clock(), due_ms: this.clock()});
      return assignment;
    });
  }
  async importObserved(uid: string, entity: string, observedMembers?: any[]): Promise<void> {
    const {user} = await this.owner(uid);
    const email = normalEmail(user?.email);
    if (!email) return;
    const observed = observedMembers || (await this.db.collection("access_memberships").where("email", "==", email).get()).docs;
    const members = observed.map((d: any) => ({ref: d.ref, ...d.data()}))
      .filter((m: any) => m.entity === entity && m.present && m.verified_ms);
    if (!members.length) return;
    const ar = this.assignmentRef(uid, entity);
    const identity = this.db.collection("access_identities").doc(keyOf(email, entity));
    await this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
      const existing = (await t.get(ar)).data();
      const bound = (await t.get(identity)).data();
      if (existing) return;
      if (bound && bound.uid !== uid) throw new AccessFault("failed-precondition", "Google identity requires ownership recovery");
      const e = this.entities[entity];
      const preferred = [...(e.legacyIds || []), e.masterId, ...e.clones.map(c => c.id)];
      const ids = members.map((m: any) => m.notebook_id).sort((a: string, b: string) => preferred.indexOf(a) - preferred.indexOf(b));
      t.set(ar, {uid, email, entity, scope: this.scopes[entity], notebook_id: ids[0], history: ids,
        status: "ready", revision: 1, verified_ms: Math.min(...members.map((m: any) => m.verified_ms)),
        created_ms: this.clock(), updated_ms: this.clock(), imported: true});
      t.set(identity, {uid, email, entity});
      for (const m of members) t.set(m.ref, {uid}, {merge: true});
    });
  }
  async revoke(uid: string, entity: string): Promise<void> {
    const assessment = await this.assessRevocation(uid,this.scopes[entity]);
    if (!assessment.allowed) {
      if (!["active_scope","permanent_vip","incident_pause"].includes(assessment.reason))
        await this.db.collection("access_reviews").doc(keyOf(uid,entity,"revocation_gate")).set({uid,entity,scope:this.scopes[entity],
          code:assessment.reason,fingerprint:assessment.fingerprint || null,status:"blocked",updated_ms:this.clock()});
      return;
    }
    const {user, grants} = await this.owner(uid);
    if (user?.access_revocation_hold || rights(user, grants, this.scopes[entity], this.clock())) return;
    const ar = this.assignmentRef(uid, entity);
    await this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
      const a = (await t.get(ar)).data();
      if (!a || ["revoked", "revoking"].includes(a.status)) return;
      const permanent = await t.get(this.db.collection("access_vip_registry").doc(keyOf(a.email)));
      if (isVip({email:a.email}, grants) || permanent.exists) return;
      const revision = a.revision + 1;
      t.update(ar, {status: "revoking", revision, updated_ms: this.clock()});
      for (const notebook of a.history || [a.notebook_id]) {
        t.set(this.db.collection("access_jobs").doc(keyOf(uid, entity, String(revision), notebook)), {
          ...a, notebook_id: notebook, revision, desired: false, decision_fingerprint:assessment.fingerprint,
          decision_policy:REVOCATION_POLICY,status: "pending", attempts: 0, queued_ms:this.clock(), due_ms: this.clock()});
      }
    });
  }
  async repair(uid: string, entity: string): Promise<void> {
    const owner = await this.owner(uid);
    if (!rights(owner.user, owner.grants, this.scopes[entity], this.clock())) return this.revoke(uid, entity);
    const ar = this.assignmentRef(uid, entity);
    await this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
      const a = (await t.get(ar)).data();
      if (!a || a.status !== "ready") return;
      const revision = a.revision + 1;
      t.update(ar, {status: "provisioning", revision, updated_ms: this.clock()});
      t.set(this.db.collection("access_jobs").doc(keyOf(uid, entity, String(revision))), {
        ...a, revision, desired: true, status: "pending", attempts: 0, queued_ms:this.clock(), due_ms: this.clock()});
    });
  }
  async restoreOriginalMembership(ref:any, job:any): Promise<void> {

    const restored = await this.provider.apply(job.notebook_id,job.email,true);
    this.validateObservation(restored,job.notebook_id);
    if (!restored.emails.map(normalEmail).includes(job.email)) throw new Error("Safety restoration not verified");
    const owner = await this.owner(job.uid);
    await this.db.runTransaction(async(t:any)=>{
      const ar=this.assignmentRef(job.uid,job.entity),mr=this.db.collection("access_memberships").doc(keyOf(job.notebook_id,job.email));
      const nr=this.db.collection("access_notebooks").doc(job.notebook_id);
      const a=(await t.get(ar)).data(),m=(await t.get(mr)).data(),n=(await t.get(nr)).data();
      const identity=(await t.get(this.db.collection("access_identities").doc(keyOf(job.email,job.entity)))).data();
      t.set(mr,{uid:identity?.uid || m?.uid || job.uid,email:job.email,entity:job.entity,notebook_id:job.notebook_id,
        present:true,counted:true,verified_ms:this.clock()},{merge:true});
      if(n)t.update(nr,{occupied:Math.max(n.occupied+(m && !m.counted?1:0),restored.emails.length)});
      if(a?.revision === job.revision)t.update(ar,{status:rights(owner.user,owner.grants,job.scope,this.clock())?"ready":"revocation_review",
        verified_ms:this.clock()});

        due_ms:8640000000000000,review_reason:"incomplete_or_invalidated_removal_restored"});

  }
  async blockRemovalJob(ref:any,job:any,reason:string): Promise<void> {
    await this.db.runTransaction(async(t:any)=>{
      const ar=this.assignmentRef(job.uid,job.entity),current=(await t.get(ar)).data();
      t.update(ref,{status:"review_required",due_ms:8640000000000000,review_reason:reason,updated_ms:this.clock()});
      if(current?.revision === job.revision)t.update(ar,{status:"revocation_review"});
    });

  }
  async runJob(ref: any): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.provider) throw new Error("Sharing provider is not configured");
    const token = crypto.randomUUID(), now = this.clock();
    const job = await this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
      const j = (await t.get(ref)).data();

      const lock = (await t.get(lr)).data();

      t.set(lr, {token, until_ms: now + 600000});
      t.update(ref, {status: "processing", lease: token, due_ms: now + 600000, attempts: (j.attempts || 0) + 1});

    try {

      // Google removed access must first restore the previously observed state.
      if (job.safety_restore_required === true) {
        await this.restoreOriginalMembership(ref,job);return;
      }
      let owner = await this.owner(job.uid);
      const a = (await this.assignmentRef(job.uid, job.entity).get()).data();
      const bound = (await this.db.collection("access_identities").doc(keyOf(job.email, job.entity)).get()).data();
      if (!a || bound?.uid !== job.uid || a.revision !== job.revision || job.desired !== rights(owner.user, owner.grants, job.scope, this.clock())) {
        await ref.update({status: "superseded", due_ms: 8640000000000000}); return;
      }
      let assessment:any;
      if (!job.desired) {
        assessment = await this.assessRevocation(job.uid,job.scope,job.email);
        if (!assessment.allowed || job.decision_policy !== REVOCATION_POLICY || job.decision_fingerprint !== assessment.fingerprint) {
          await this.blockRemovalJob(ref,job,assessment.allowed?"stale_decision":assessment.reason);
          return;
        }
      }
      let observation:ShareObservation;
      if (!job.desired) {
        const before = await this.provider.observe(job.notebook_id);
        this.validateObservation(before,job.notebook_id);
        const preMutation = await this.assessRevocation(job.uid,job.scope,job.email);
        if(!preMutation.allowed || preMutation.fingerprint !== assessment.fingerprint) {
          await this.blockRemovalJob(ref,job,preMutation.allowed?"stale_decision":preMutation.reason);return;
        }
        job.original_present = before.emails.map(normalEmail).includes(job.email);
        if (job.original_present) {
          // Persist intent before the external side effect. The flag is only
          // cleared with verified completion or verified safety restoration.
          await ref.update({original_present:true,safety_restore_required:true,mutation_started_ms:this.clock()});
          removalAttempted = true;
          observation = await this.provider.apply(job.notebook_id,job.email,false);
        } else observation = before;
      } else observation = await this.provider.apply(job.notebook_id, job.email,true);
      this.validateObservation(observation, job.notebook_id);
      const present = observation.emails.map(normalEmail).includes(job.email);
      if (present !== job.desired) throw new Error("Target membership not verified");
      owner = await this.owner(job.uid);
      const desiredNow = rights(owner.user, owner.grants, job.scope, this.clock());
      if (!job.desired) {
        const after = await this.assessRevocation(job.uid,job.scope,job.email);
        if (!after.allowed || after.fingerprint !== assessment.fingerprint) {
          // A hold, manual change, renewal or pause arriving while Google was
          // running invalidates the removal even when expiry still looks old.
          if(job.original_present) {
            await this.restoreOriginalMembership(ref,job);restorationCompleted=true;
          } else await this.blockRemovalJob(ref,job,"decision_changed_without_original_membership");
          return;
        }
      }
      if (desiredNow !== job.desired) {
        if (!desiredNow) {
          // Grant jobs are never authorized to remove access. Require a new
          // removal job with its own scope proof and policy fingerprint.
          throw new Error("Grant changed; a separately assessed revocation is required");
        }
        // Database and Google are not atomic. Repair a concurrent renewal or
        // expiry before declaring the stale operation complete.
        await this.provider.apply(job.notebook_id, job.email, desiredNow);
        throw new Error("Grant changed during external operation; repair queued");
      }
      await this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
        const current = (await t.get(this.assignmentRef(job.uid, job.entity))).data();
        const lock = (await t.get(job.lockRef)).data();
        const mr = this.db.collection("access_memberships").doc(keyOf(job.notebook_id, job.email));
        const member = (await t.get(mr)).data();
        const nr = this.db.collection("access_notebooks").doc(job.notebook_id);
        const notebook = (await t.get(nr)).data();
        if (lock?.token !== token || current?.revision !== job.revision) throw new Error("Lease/revision changed after sharing");
        t.set(mr, {present, verified_ms: this.clock()}, {merge: true});
        if (!present && member?.counted && notebook) {
          t.update(nr, {occupied: Math.max(0, notebook.occupied - 1)});
          t.set(mr, {counted: false}, {merge: true});
        }
        t.update(ref, {status: "completed", safety_restore_required:false,due_ms: 8640000000000000, verified_ms: this.clock()});

        // reconciliation marks the overall assignment revoked once all finish.
        if (job.desired) t.update(this.assignmentRef(job.uid, job.entity), {status: "ready", verified_ms: this.clock()});

    } catch (e: any) {
      if (removalAttempted && !restorationCompleted) {
        try {await this.restoreOriginalMembership(ref,job);return;}
        catch (_) { /* Keep the durable recovery flag for the next attempt. */ }
      }
      await ref.update({status: "retry", last_error: String(e.message).slice(0, 240),
        due_ms: this.clock() + Math.min(300000, 1000 * 2 ** Math.min(job.attempts, 8)), updated_ms: this.clock()});
    } finally {
      await this.db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
        if ((await t.get(job.lockRef)).data()?.token === token) t.delete(job.lockRef);
      });
    }
  }
  validateObservation(s: ShareObservation, id: string): void {
    if (s.notebookId !== id || !s.complete || s.isPublic || !Array.isArray(s.emails) || s.emails.some(e => !normalEmail(e).includes("@"))) {
      throw new Error("Notebook is public or sharing evidence is incomplete");
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
  let cursor: any;

    let q = db.collection(collection).orderBy(admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId()).limit(100);

async function importVerifiedAkalEvidence(path: string): Promise<void> {

  let imported=0, excluded=rows.length-periods.length;
  for (const period of periods) {
    const {id:gid, email, scope, payment, amount, starts, expires, paid, months}=period;
    const matches=users.docs.filter(d=>normalEmail(d.data().email)===email);
    if (matches.length>1) {excluded++;continue;}
    const uid=matches[0]?.id || `legacy_${keyOf(email)}`;
    if (!matches.length) await db.collection("access_legacy_owners").doc(uid).set({email,legacy_revoke_only:true,access_due_ms:Date.now()}, {merge:true});
    const ref=db.collection("access_grants").doc(gid);
    await db.runTransaction(async t=>{
      const previous=await t.get(ref);
      if (previous.exists) return;
      t.create(ref,{uid,email,scope,kind:"payment",status:"active",amount,provider:"goakal",
        transaction_id:payment,starts_ms:starts,expires_ms:expires,paid_ms:paid,
        duration_months:months,provider_verified:true,verified_ms:Date.now()});
    });
    const ownerRef=matches[0]?.ref || db.collection("access_legacy_owners").doc(uid);
    await db.runTransaction(async (t:any)=>{
      const owner=(await t.get(ownerRef)).data();
      if (!owner || owner.adopted_by) return;
      t.update(ownerRef,{access_grant_ids:[...new Set([...(owner.access_grant_ids || []),gid])],access_due_ms:Date.now()});
    });
    imported++;
  }
  const freeEmails = new Set(rows.filter(r=>r.status === "PAID" && Number(r.incomingAmount) === 0).map(r=>normalEmail(r.payerEmail)));
  for (const email of freeEmails) {
    if (!email) continue;
    if ((await db.collection("access_vip_registry").doc(keyOf(email)).get()).exists) continue;
    const owner = users.docs.find(d=>normalEmail(d.data().email)===email);
    if (owner && isVip(owner.data())) continue;
    const ref = owner?.ref || db.collection("access_legacy_owners").doc(`legacy_${keyOf(email)}`);
    if ((await ref.get()).exists) await ref.update({access_revocation_hold:true});
    await db.collection("access_reviews").doc(keyOf(email,"free_access")).set({email,
      code:"zero_amount_requires_admin_evidence",updated_ms:Date.now()});
  }
  await db.collection("access_control").doc("legacy_provider_audit").set({provider:"goakal",fetched_rows:rows.length,

    if (!matching.length && !existing) continue;
    const expiry=Math.max(0,...matching.map(g=>g.expires_ms || 0));
    const status=active?"active":"expired";
    if (existing?.status === status && millis(existing.expiry) === expiry) continue;
    updates[`entitlements.${scope}`]={plan:active?"premium":"expired",status,
      expiry:admin.firestore.Timestamp.fromMillis(expiry),source:"access_ledger"};
  }
  if (Object.keys(updates).length) await db.runTransaction(async (t:any)=>{
    const current=(await t.get(doc.ref)).data();
    if (!current || current.access_due_ms !== user.access_due_ms ||
        current.access_revocation_hold !== user.access_revocation_hold ||
        JSON.stringify(current.access_grant_ids || []) !== JSON.stringify(user.access_grant_ids || [])) return;
    t.update(doc.ref,updates);
  });
}
async function assignments(): Promise<void> {
  const dueUsers = await db.collection("users").where("access_due_ms", "<=", Date.now()).orderBy("access_due_ms").limit(100).get();
  const dueLegacy = await db.collection("access_legacy_owners").where("access_due_ms", "<=", Date.now()).orderBy("access_due_ms").limit(100).get();
  const due = {docs:[...dueUsers.docs, ...dueLegacy.docs]};
  for (const doc of due.docs) {
    const u = doc.data();
    if (u.access_version !== 2 || u.adopted_by) continue;
    if (!u.legacy_revoke_only && !u.account_deleted && !u.pending_deletion) {
      try {
        const authOwner = await admin.auth().getUser(doc.id);
        if (!authOwner.emailVerified || normalEmail(authOwner.email) !== normalEmail(u.email)) throw new Error("Owner identity not verified");
      } catch (_) {
        await db.collection("access_reviews").doc(keyOf(doc.id,"identity")).set({uid:doc.id,code:"identity_review",updated_ms:Date.now()});
        await doc.ref.update({access_due_ms:Date.now()+3600000});
        continue;
      }
    }
    const effective = await engine.owner(doc.id), grants = effective.grants;
    await projectRights(doc,u,grants);
    const observed = await db.collection("access_memberships").where("email","==",normalEmail(u.email)).get();
    const existing = await db.collection("access_assignments").where("uid","==",doc.id).get();
    const relevant = new Set([...observed.docs.map(d=>d.data().entity),...existing.docs.map(d=>d.data().entity)]);
    let needsRetry = false;
    for (const [entity, scope] of Object.entries(ENTITY_SCOPES)) {
      if (!relevant.has(entity) && (u.legacy_revoke_only || !rights(effective.user,grants,scope))) continue;
      try { await engine.importObserved(doc.id, entity, observed.docs); }
      catch (_) {needsRetry = true; continue;}
      if (rights(effective.user, grants, scope)) {
        try { await engine.reserve(doc.id, entity); }
        catch (e: any) { needsRetry = true; await db.collection("access_reviews").doc(keyOf(doc.id, entity)).set({uid: doc.id, entity,
          code: e.code || "unavailable", updated_ms: Date.now()}, {merge: true}); }
      } else await engine.revoke(doc.id, entity);
    }
    const expiry = grants.filter(g => g.status === "active" && g.expires_ms > Date.now()).map(g => g.expires_ms);
    const next = Math.min(Date.now() + (needsRetry ? 60000 : 3600000), ...expiry);
    await db.runTransaction(async t => {
      const current = (await t.get(doc.ref)).data();
      if (current?.access_due_ms === u.access_due_ms) t.update(doc.ref, {access_due_ms: next});
    });
  }
}
async function settleRevokes(): Promise<void> {
  const snap = await db.collection("access_assignments").where("status", "==", "revoking").get();
  for (const doc of snap.docs) {
    const a = doc.data();
    let absent = true;
    for (const id of a.history || [a.notebook_id]) {
      const m = (await db.collection("access_memberships").doc(keyOf(id, a.email)).get()).data();
      if (!m || m.present || !m.verified_ms) absent = false;
    }
    if (absent) await doc.ref.update({status: "revoked", verified_ms: Date.now()});
  }
}
// The sharing server hands authenticated GoAkal webhook events to this queue
// once the VPS writer is active. Without a consumer a real payment would wait
// forever, so each cycle settles a bounded batch.
async function consumeLegacyEvents(): Promise<void> {
  const events = await db.collection("access_legacy_events").where("status", "==", "verification_required").limit(50).get();
  for (const doc of events.docs) {
    const decision = classifyLegacyEvent(doc.data(), resolveAkalScopes);
    if (decision.action !== "grant") {
      await doc.ref.update({status: decision.action === "noted" ? "noted" : "operator_review",
        decision_reason: decision.reason, processed_ms: Date.now()});
      continue;
    }
    try {
      const matches = await db.collection("users").where("email", "==", decision.email).limit(2).get();
      if (matches.size > 1) {
        await doc.ref.update({status: "operator_review", decision_reason: "ambiguous_owner", processed_ms: Date.now()});
        continue;
      }
      const ownerRef = matches.docs[0]?.ref || db.collection("access_legacy_owners").doc(`legacy_${keyOf(decision.email)}`);
      if (!matches.size) await ownerRef.set({email: decision.email, legacy_revoke_only: true, access_due_ms: Date.now()}, {merge: true});
      const granted: string[] = [];
      for (const scope of decision.scopes) {
        const ref = db.collection("access_grants").doc(keyOf("goakal", decision.transactionId, scope));
        await db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
          if ((await t.get(ref)).exists) return;
          t.create(ref, {uid: ownerRef.id, email: decision.email, scope, kind: "payment", status: "active",
            amount: decision.amount, provider: "goakal", source: "akal_webhook", transaction_id: decision.transactionId,
            starts_ms: decision.paidMs, expires_ms: decision.expiresMs, created_ms: Date.now()});
        });
        granted.push(ref.id);
      }
      await db.runTransaction(async (t: any) => {
        const owner = (await t.get(ownerRef)).data();
        if (!owner || owner.adopted_by) return;
        t.update(ownerRef, {access_grant_ids: [...new Set([...(owner.access_grant_ids || []), ...granted])],
          access_version: 2, access_due_ms: Date.now()});
      });
      await doc.ref.update({status: "granted", grant_ids: granted, processed_ms: Date.now()});
    } catch (_) {
      // Leave the event queued; the next cycle retries it.
      console.error("Legacy event could not be settled; retrying next cycle");
    }
  }
}
async function cycle(): Promise<void> {
  stats.last_cycle_ms = Date.now();
  const cfg = (await runtime.get()).data();
  stats.mode = cfg?.writer === "vps-v2" ? "active" : "shadow";
  stats.revocations_paused = cfg?.revocations_paused === true;
  if (cfg?.writer !== "vps-v2") return; // Installed shadow mode until explicit cutover.
  // Consume source jobs incrementally rather than scanning every account/tx.
  const source = await db.collection("provisioning_outbox").where("status", "in", ["pending", "retry", "processing", "failed"]).limit(100).get();
  for (const job of source.docs) {
    if (job.data().next_attempt_ms>Date.now()) continue;
    const uid = job.data().uid;
    if (typeof uid !== "string" || uid.includes("@")) {await job.ref.update({status:"v2_review"}); continue;}
    try {
      const doc = await db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
      if (doc.exists) {
        await importOwner(doc);
        if ((await doc.ref.get()).data()?.access_version !== 2) {
          await job.ref.update({status:"v2_review",reason:"legacy_evidence_required",updated_ms:Date.now()});
          continue;
        }
      } else {
        const a = await db.collection("access_assignments").where("uid", "==", uid).get();
        for (const assignment of a.docs) await engine.revoke(uid, assignment.data().entity);
      }
      await job.ref.update({status:"v2_handed_off", updated_ms:Date.now()});
    } catch (error:any) {
      const permanent=["auth/user-not-found","auth/invalid-uid","failed-precondition"].includes(error.code);
      await job.ref.update({status:permanent?"v2_review":"retry",reason:permanent?"identity_or_billing_review":"temporary_dependency_failure",
        next_attempt_ms:Date.now()+60000,updated_ms:Date.now()});
    }
  }
  await consumeLegacyEvents();
  await assignments();
  await settleRevokes();
  const jobs = await db.collection("access_jobs").where("due_ms", "<=", Date.now()).count().get();
  stats.last_success_ms = Date.now(); stats.error = ""; stats.cycles++;
  await db.collection("access_control").doc("heartbeat").set({...stats, pending_jobs: jobs.data().count, ...telemetry, writer: "vps-v2"});
}
async function runJobs(): Promise<void> {
  while (true) {
    try {
      if ((await runtime.get()).data()?.writer === "vps-v2") {
        const jobs = await db.collection("access_jobs").where("due_ms", "<=", Date.now()).orderBy("due_ms").limit(20).get();
        for (const job of jobs.docs) await engine.runJob(job.ref);
      }
    } catch (_) { console.error("Job loop failed; retrying"); }
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
  }
}
async function reconcile(): Promise<void> {
  const all = Object.values(NOTEBOOK_ENTITIES).flatMap(e => notebooks(e));
  let cursor = 0;
  while (true) {
    try {
      if ((await runtime.get()).data()?.writer === "vps-v2") {
        const target = all[cursor++ % all.length];
        const ref = db.collection("access_notebooks").doc(target.id);
        const snapshot = await ref.get();
        if (snapshot.exists) {
          const observation = await provider.observe(target.id);
          if (!observation.complete) throw new Error("Incomplete health observation");
          const emails = new Set(observation.emails.map(normalEmail));
          const memberships = await db.collection("access_memberships").where("notebook_id", "==", target.id).get();
          const reserved = memberships.docs.filter(d => d.data().counted && !emails.has(d.data().email)).length;
          await db.runTransaction(async t => {
            const current = (await t.get(ref)).data();
            if (!current) return;
            // Account for reservations not yet observed by Google; an external
            // manual invite must not allow the allocator to overbook.
            t.update(ref, {occupied: Math.max(current.occupied, emails.size + reserved),
              observed_count: emails.size, observed_ms: Date.now(), healthy_until_ms: Date.now() + 86400000,
              is_public: observation.isPublic, status: observation.isPublic ? "quarantined" : current.status});
          });
          if (!observation.isPublic) for (const member of memberships.docs) {
            const m = member.data();
            if (m.uid && m.present && !emails.has(m.email)) await engine.repair(m.uid, m.entity);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {console.error("Notebook reconciliation unavailable; retrying next target");}
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 15000));
  }
}
async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const mode = process.argv[2];
  if (mode === "--seed" || mode === "--restrict") return seed(mode === "--restrict");
  if (mode === "--import") return pages("users", importOwner);
  if (mode === "--import-akal-evidence") return importVerifiedAkalEvidence(process.argv[3]);
  if (mode === "--prepare") return prepareLegacy();
  if (mode === "--prepare-assignments") return assignments();
  if (mode === "--run-one") {
    const id=process.argv[3];
    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(id || "")) throw new Error("A verified job ID is required");
    const ref=db.collection("access_jobs").doc(id);
    await engine.runJob(ref);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({job_status:(await ref.get()).data()?.status,...telemetry}));
    return;
  }
  if (mode === "--once") return cycle();
  createServer((_, res) => {res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
    const providerStale = stats.mode === "active" && Date.now()-telemetry.last_provider_success_ms > 300000;
    res.statusCode = stats.error || telemetry.authentication_error || providerStale ? 503 : 200;
    res.end(JSON.stringify({...stats,...telemetry}));
  }).listen(8091, "127.0.0.1");
  void runJobs(); // Separate from scheduler: a slow provider cannot postpone expiry discovery.
  void reconcile();
  while (true) {
    try { await cycle(); }
    catch (_) {stats.error = "Access cycle failed; inspect authenticated diagnostics"; console.error(stats.error);}
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 15000));
  }
}
main().catch(() => {console.error("Access worker startup failed"); process.exitCode = 1;});
```

```typescript
// ================================================================

async function sendTelegramNotification(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const token = process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN;
  const chatId = process.env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID;
  if (!token || !chatId) return false;

  try {
    const result=await axios.post(
      `https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/sendMessage`,
      {
        chat_id: chatId,
        text,
        parse_mode: "HTML",
      },
      { timeout: 5000 }
    );
    return result.data?.ok === true;
  } catch (_) {
    console.error("[Telegram] Notification delivery failed; credentials redacted.");
    return false;
  }
}


// Telegram messages use parse_mode HTML; every value that originates from a
// user, a payment provider or a client device must pass through this.
function esc(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").slice(0, 400);
}

// Cutover switch shared with the VPS worker and the legacy Python writers.
async function vpsWriterActive(): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await db.collection("access_control").doc("runtime").get()).data()?.writer === "vps-v2";
}

// Scopes the profile shows as active that no ledger grant backs. Moving such
// an account to the ledger-only evaluator would silently drop those modules,
// so the caller places it on a revocation hold for review instead.
function unbackedLegacyScopes(entitlements: Record<string, any>, grants: any[], skipScope: string, now: number): string[] {
  return Object.entries(entitlements || {}).filter(([scope, ent]) => {
    if (scope === skipScope || !ent || ent.status === "revoked" || ent.status === "expired") return false;
    const expiry = millis(ent.expiry);
    if (!Number.isFinite(expiry) || expiry <= now) return false;
    return !grants.some(g => g && g.status === "active" && Number.isFinite(g.expires_ms) && g.expires_ms > now &&
      [scope, "all_access", "all_ai"].includes(g.scope));
  }).map(([scope]) => scope);
}

function getEntitlementKey(agentId: string): string {
  const entitlementKey = AGENT_ENTITLEMENTS[agentId];
  if (!entitlementKey) {
    // OT-F001: Jangan pernah mengembalikan input mentah client untuk mencegah privilege escalation
    return "";
  }
  return entitlementKey;
}

export function addCalendarMonthsClamped(baseDate: Date, months: number): Date {
  const result = new Date(baseDate.getTime());
  const originalDay = result.getDate();
  result.setDate(1);
  result.setMonth(result.getMonth() + months);
  const maxDays = new Date(result.getFullYear(), result.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  result.setDate(Math.min(originalDay, maxDays));
  return result;
}

function getEntitlementAccess(userData: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData, entitlementKey: string): { premiumPlan: boolean; active: boolean } {
  if (isVip(userData)) return {premiumPlan:true,active:true};
  if (userData.account_deleted === true) return {premiumPlan:false,active:false};
  const entitlements = userData.entitlements && typeof userData.entitlements === "object"
    ? userData.entitlements as Record<string, any> : {};
  const now = Date.now();
  const active = (ent: any): boolean => {
    if (!ent || typeof ent.plan !== "string") return false;
    if (ent.status === "revoked" || ent.status === "expired") return false;
    const allowed = /^(trial|tholib(?:_1m|_6m)?|bahits(?:_1y)?|premium|all_access|all_ai.*|single|sultan|pro|voucher(?:_.*)?|redeem(?:_.*)?|custom|full)$/.test(ent.plan);
    const expiry = ent.expiry?.toDate ? ent.expiry.toDate() : (ent.expiry?._seconds ? new Date(ent.expiry._seconds * 1000) : new Date(ent.expiry ?? ""));
    return allowed && Number.isFinite(expiry.getTime()) && expiry.getTime() > now;
  };
  const all = entitlements.all_access ?? entitlements.all_ai;
  if (active(all)) return { premiumPlan: true, active: true };
  const specific = entitlements[entitlementKey];
  if (active(specific)) return { premiumPlan: true, active: true };

  // Only explicit revocation of all_access blocks global subscription fallback
  if (all && all.status === "revoked") {
    return { premiumPlan: true, active: false };
  }

  // Account-level active subscription
  const expiry = userData.subscription_expiry?.toDate
    ? userData.subscription_expiry.toDate() : new Date(userData.subscription_expiry ?? "");
  const isGlobalExpiryValid = Number.isFinite(expiry.getTime()) && expiry.getTime() > now;

  const globalPlanPattern = /^(all_access|all_ai.*|full|sultan|tholib.*|bahits.*|premium|pro|custom|voucher.*|redeem.*)$/;
  const isGlobalPlan = typeof userData.plan === "string" && globalPlanPattern.test(userData.plan);

  if (isGlobalPlan && isGlobalExpiryValid) {
    return { premiumPlan: true, active: true };
  }

  if (userData.plan === "single") {
    return { premiumPlan: !!specific, active: false };
  }

  const legacy = ["all_access", "all_ai_1m", "all_ai_6m", "all_ai_1y", "all_ai", "full", "sultan", "tholib_1m", "tholib_6m", "bahits_1y", "tholib", "bahits", "premium", "pro", "custom"].includes(userData.plan);
  return { premiumPlan: legacy, active: legacy && isGlobalExpiryValid };
}

export const getAgentUrl = functions
  .runWith({ serviceAccount: "open-turath@appspot.gserviceaccount.com" })
  .https.onCall(async (data, context) => {
    if (!context.auth) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "unauthenticated",
        "Login diperlukan untuk mengakses agent."
      );
    }

    const uid = context.auth.uid;
    await enforceRateLimit(
      `agent_url_${uid}`,
      60,
      60,
      "Terlalu banyak permintaan membuka asisten. Silakan coba kembali sebentar lagi."
    );
    const agentId = data.agentId as string;

    if (!agentId) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "invalid-argument",
        "agentId diperlukan."
      );
    }

    const resolved = resolveAgentNotebook(agentId, uid);
    const url = resolved ? resolved.url : AGENT_URLS[agentId];
    if (!url) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "not-found",
        "Agent tidak ditemukan atau belum aktif."
      );
    }

    const userDoc = await db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
    if (!userDoc.exists) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found", "User tidak ditemukan.");
    }

    const userData = userDoc.data()!;
    // Until cutover no worker creates notebook assignments, so ledger-only
    // resolution would lock out every paying account. Legacy evaluation applies.
    const ledgerActive = userData.access_version === 2 && await vpsWriterActive();
    if (ledgerActive && (context.auth.token.email_verified !== true ||
        String(context.auth.token.email || "").trim().toLowerCase() !== String(userData.email || "").trim().toLowerCase())) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("failed-precondition","Gunakan email terverifikasi yang terdaftar untuk akses notebook ini.");
    }
    if (ledgerActive) {
      const entity = AGENT_TO_ENTITY[agentId];
      if (!entity) throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found", "Kajian tidak ditemukan.");
      try { return await new AccessControl(db, NOTEBOOK_ENTITIES, ENTITY_SCOPES).resolve(uid, entity); }
      catch (e) {
        if (e instanceof AccessFault) throw new functions.https.HttpsError(e.code as functions.https.FunctionsErrorCode, e.message);
        throw e;
      }
    }
    const questionsUsed = (userData.questions_used as number) || 0;
    const entitlementKey = getEntitlementKey(agentId);

    const entitlementAccess = getEntitlementAccess(userData, entitlementKey);
    if (entitlementAccess.active) {
      if (await vpsWriterActive()) {
        const entity=AGENT_TO_ENTITY[agentId];
        if (!entity) throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found","Kajian tidak ditemukan.");
        try {return await new AccessControl(db,NOTEBOOK_ENTITIES,ENTITY_SCOPES).resolveObservedLegacy(uid,userData.email,entity);}
        catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof AccessFault) throw new functions.https.HttpsError(e.code as functions.https.FunctionsErrorCode,e.message);
          throw e;
        }
      }
      return {
        url,
        notebookId: resolved?.notebookId,
        cloneName: resolved?.cloneName,
        entityCode: resolved?.entityCode,
        isMaster: resolved?.isMaster,
      };
    }

    throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
      "permission-denied",
      "Akses modul riset ini membutuhkan langganan aktif atau kode redeem santri. Silakan berlangganan atau masukkan kode akses untuk melanjutkan."
    );
  });

// Trial sekarang berbasis masa berlaku voucher, bukan kuota pertanyaan.

export const recordQuestion = functions
  .runWith({ serviceAccount: "open-turath@appspot.gserviceaccount.com" })
  .https.onCall(async (data, context) => {
    if (!context.auth) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Login diperlukan.");
    }
    const agentId = data.agentId as string;
    const resolved = resolveAgentNotebook(agentId);
    if (!agentId || (!resolved && !AGENT_URLS[agentId])) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found", "Kajian tidak ditemukan atau belum aktif.");
    }
    const entitlementKey = getEntitlementKey(agentId);
    const userRef = db.collection("users").doc(context.auth.uid);

    return db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
      const snapshot = await transaction.get(userRef);
      if (!snapshot.exists) {
        throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found", "User tidak ditemukan.");
      }
      const userData = snapshot.data()!;
      const entitlementAccess = getEntitlementAccess(userData, entitlementKey);
      if (entitlementAccess.active) {
        return { isPremium: true, questionsUsed: userData.questions_used || 0, questionsRemaining: null };
      }
      if (entitlementAccess.premiumPlan) {
        throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
          "permission-denied",
          "Langganan Anda untuk kajian ini telah berakhir."
        );
      }

      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "permission-denied",
        "Akses Pro untuk kajian ini belum aktif. Tukarkan voucher atau berlangganan untuk melanjutkan."
      );
    });
  });

// Native chat prototype. Enabling this requires a dedicated operator session,
// an isolated test notebook and an explicitly configured test UID.
export const askAgent = functions
  .runWith({
    serviceAccount: "open-turath@appspot.gserviceaccount.com",
    secrets: ["NOTEBOOK_BRIDGE_KEY"],
    timeoutSeconds: 120,
    maxInstances: 1,
  })
  .https.onCall(async (data, context) => {
    if (context.auth) {
      const header = context.rawRequest.headers.authorization;
      try {
        if (!header?.startsWith("Bearer ")) throw new Error("Missing token");
        const verified = await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(header.slice(7), true);
        if (verified.uid !== context.auth.uid) throw new Error("Identity mismatch");
      } catch (_) {
        throw new functions.https.HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Silakan masuk kembali ke OpenTurath.");
      }
    }
    try {
      return await handleNativeChat(data, context.auth?.uid, {
        testUid: process.env.NOTEBOOK_BRIDGE_TEST_UID,
        authorize: async (uid, agentId) => {
          const key = getEntitlementKey(agentId);
          if (!key || !AGENT_URLS[agentId]) return false;
          const snapshot = await db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
          return snapshot.exists && getEntitlementAccess(snapshot.data()!, key).active;
        },
        rateLimit: uid => enforceRateLimit(`native_chat_${uid}`, 10, 60, "Terlalu banyak pertanyaan. Silakan tunggu sebentar."),
        ask: async request => {
          const endpoint = process.env.NOTEBOOK_BRIDGE_URL;
          const key = process.env.NOTEBOOK_BRIDGE_KEY;
          if (!endpoint || !key || key.length < 32) {
            throw new NativeChatError("failed-precondition", "Koneksi asisten di aplikasi belum diaktifkan.");
          }
          const url = new URL(endpoint);
          const local = process.env.FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR === "true" &&
            url.protocol === "http:" && ["127.0.0.1", "localhost"].includes(url.hostname);
          if ((!local && url.protocol !== "https:") || url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash || url.pathname !== "/ask") {
            throw new NativeChatError("failed-precondition", "Konfigurasi koneksi asisten belum valid.");
          }
          const response = await axios.post(url.toString(), request, {
            headers: {Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`},
            timeout: 80000,
            maxRedirects: 0,
            maxContentLength: 512000,
            maxBodyLength: 40000,
          });
          return response.data;
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof NativeChatError) {
        throw new functions.https.HttpsError(error.code, error.message);
      }
      if (error instanceof functions.https.HttpsError) throw error;
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("unavailable", "Asisten belum dapat dihubungi.");
    }
  });

// ================================================================
// DOKU PAYMENT GATEWAY INTEGRATION
// ================================================================

function getDokuConfig() {
  const env = process.env.DOKU_ENV || "sandbox";
  const baseUrl = env === "production" ? "https://api.doku.com" : "https://api-sandbox.doku.com";
  const clientId = process.env.DOKU_CLIENT_ID || "";
  const secretKey = process.env.DOKU_SECRET_KEY || "";
  const apiKey = process.env.DOKU_API_KEY || "";
  if (!clientId || !secretKey) {
    throw new Error("DOKU credentials are not configured");
  }
  return { env, baseUrl, clientId, secretKey, apiKey };
}

function generateDokuSignature(
  clientId: string,
  requestId: string,
  timestamp: string,
  targetPath: string,
  rawBody: string,
  secretKey: string
): string {
  const digest = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(rawBody).digest("base64");
  const signatureComponent =
    `Client-Id:${clientId}\n` +
    `Request-Id:${requestId}\n` +
    `Request-Timestamp:${timestamp}\n` +
    `Request-Target:${targetPath}\n` +
    `Digest:${digest}`;
  const hmac = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secretKey).update(signatureComponent).digest("base64");
  return `HMACSHA256=${hmac}`;
}

function resolvePlanPricing(agentId: string, plan: string): { amount: number; durationMonths: number; label: string; entitlementKey: string } {
  const isAllAi = agentId === "all_ai" || agentId === "all_access" || plan.startsWith("all_ai") || plan.startsWith("all_access");

  if (isAllAi) {
    throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
      "failed-precondition",
      "Paket Semua AI sementara dinonaktifkan. Silakan pilih paket per modul spesialis."
    );
  }

  // OT-F001: Closed-set whitelist enforcement
  if (!PURCHASABLE_AGENTS.has(agentId)) {
    throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
      "invalid-argument",
      "Modul spesialis tidak valid atau tidak dapat dibeli."
    );
  }

  // Harga Mandiri Khusus Fikih Tahawwulat
  if (agentId.startsWith("fiqh_tahawwulat")) {
    const tahawwulatTiers: Record<string, { amount: number; durationMonths: number; labelSuffix: string }> = {
      tholib_1m: { amount: 300000, durationMonths: 1, labelSuffix: "(1 Bulan)" },
      tholib_6m: { amount: 1499000, durationMonths: 6, labelSuffix: "(6 Bulan)" },
      bahits_1y: { amount: 1999000, durationMonths: 12, labelSuffix: "(1 Tahun)" },
      "1m": { amount: 300000, durationMonths: 1, labelSuffix: "(1 Bulan)" },
      "6m": { amount: 1499000, durationMonths: 6, labelSuffix: "(6 Bulan)" },
      "1y": { amount: 1999000, durationMonths: 12, labelSuffix: "(1 Tahun)" },
    };
    const tTier = tahawwulatTiers[plan];
    if (tTier) {
      return {
        amount: tTier.amount,
        durationMonths: tTier.durationMonths,
        label: `AI Fikih Tahawwulat ${tTier.labelSuffix}`,
        entitlementKey: "fiqh_tahawwulat",
      };
    }
  }

  const tier = MODULE_PLANS[plan];
  if (!tier) {
    throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
      "invalid-argument",
      "Paket langganan tidak valid."
    );
  }

  const entitlementKey = getEntitlementKey(agentId);
  if (!entitlementKey || entitlementKey === "all_access" || entitlementKey === "all_ai") {
    throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
      "failed-precondition",
      "Entitlement untuk modul ini tidak valid atau dinonaktifkan."
    );
  }

  const agentTitle = agentId.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (l) => l.toUpperCase());
  return {
    amount: tier.amount,
    durationMonths: tier.durationMonths,
    label: `Modul AI ${agentTitle} ${tier.labelSuffix}`,
    entitlementKey,
  };
}

async function requestDokuCheckout(params: {
  invoiceNumber: string;
  amount: number;
  itemName: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string;
}): Promise<string> {
  const { baseUrl, clientId, secretKey } = getDokuConfig();
  const requestId = `REQ-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19) + "Z";
  const targetPath = "/checkout/v1/payment";

  const requestBody = {
    order: {
      amount: params.amount,
      invoice_number: params.invoiceNumber,
      callback_url: "https://openturath-ai.web.app",
      line_items: [
        {
          name: params.itemName.slice(0, 50),
          price: params.amount,
          quantity: 1
        }
      ]
    },
    payment: {
      payment_due_date: 120 // 2 jam
    },
    customer: {
      name: params.customerName || "Peneliti OpenTurath",
      email: params.customerEmail,
      phone: (params.customerPhone && params.customerPhone.trim().length >= 8) ? params.customerPhone.trim() : "081234567890"
    }
  };

  const rawJson = JSON.stringify(requestBody);
  const signature = generateDokuSignature(
    clientId,
    requestId,
    timestamp,
    targetPath,
    rawJson,
    secretKey
  );

  console.log(`[DOKU API] Requesting Checkout for ${params.invoiceNumber} (${params.itemName}) - Rp ${params.amount}...`);
  const response = await axios.post(`${baseUrl}${targetPath}`, requestBody, {
    headers: {
      "Client-Id": clientId,
      "Request-Id": requestId,
      "Request-Timestamp": timestamp,
      "Signature": signature,
      "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    timeout: 15000
  });

  const paymentUrl = response.data?.response?.payment?.url || response.data?.payment?.url;
  if (!paymentUrl) {
    console.error("[DOKU API] No payment URL in response:", JSON.stringify(response.data));
    throw new Error("DOKU tidak mengembalikan payment URL.");
  }

  return paymentUrl;
}

// ================================================================
// MIDTRANS PAYMENT GATEWAY INTEGRATION (SNAP PRODUCTION)

function getMidtransConfig() {
  const env = process.env.MIDTRANS_ENV || "production";
  const isProd = env === "production";
  const snapUrl = isProd
    ? "https://app.midtrans.com/snap/v1/transactions"
    : "https://app.sandbox.midtrans.com/snap/v1/transactions";
  const apiUrl = isProd
    ? "https://api.midtrans.com/v2"
    : "https://api.sandbox.midtrans.com/v2";
  const merchantId = process.env.MIDTRANS_MERCHANT_ID || "";
  const clientKey = process.env.MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY || "";
  const serverKey = process.env.MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY || "";
  if (!serverKey) {
    throw new Error("MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY is not configured");
  }
  return { env, isProd, snapUrl, apiUrl, merchantId, clientKey, serverKey };
}

async function requestMidtransSnapCheckout(params: {
  invoiceNumber: string;
  amount: number;
  itemName: string;
  planId: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string;
}): Promise<{ token: string; redirectUrl: string }> {
  const cfg = getMidtransConfig();
  const authHeader = "Basic " + Buffer.from(cfg.serverKey + ":").toString("base64");

  const payload: Record<string, any> = {
    transaction_details: {
      order_id: params.invoiceNumber,
      gross_amount: params.amount,
    },
    item_details: [
      {
        id: params.planId.slice(0, 50),
        price: params.amount,
        quantity: 1,
        name: params.itemName.slice(0, 50),
      },
    ],
    customer_details: {
      first_name: params.customerName || "Peneliti OpenTurath",
      email: params.customerEmail,
      phone: (params.customerPhone && params.customerPhone.trim().length >= 8) ? params.customerPhone.trim() : "081234567890",
    },
    callbacks: {
      finish: "https://openturath-ai.web.app/payment-success",
    },
  };

  console.log(`[Midtrans Snap] Requesting Checkout for ${params.invoiceNumber} (${params.itemName}) - Rp ${params.amount}...`);
  const response = await axios.post(cfg.snapUrl, payload, {
    headers: {
      "Authorization": authHeader,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Accept": "application/json",
    },
    timeout: 15000,
  });

  const token = response.data?.token;
  const redirectUrl = response.data?.redirect_url;
  if (!redirectUrl) {
    console.error("[Midtrans Snap] Missing redirect_url in response:", response.data);
    throw new Error("Midtrans tidak mengembalikan redirect_url.");
  }
  return { token, redirectUrl };
}

// ================================================================
// ================================================================
// RATE LIMITING HELPER (In-Memory / Firestore Atomic Window)
// ================================================================
async function enforceRateLimit(
  key: string,
  limit: number,
  windowSeconds: number,
  errorMessage: string
): Promise<void> {
  const now = Date.now();
  const rateLimitRef = db.collection("rate_limits").doc(key);

  await db.runTransaction(async (t) => {
    const snap = await t.get(rateLimitRef);
    if (!snap.exists) {
      t.set(rateLimitRef, {
        count: 1,
        reset_at: admin.firestore.Timestamp.fromMillis(now + windowSeconds * 1000),
        updated_at: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
      return;
    }

    const data = snap.data()!;
    const resetAt = data.reset_at?.toMillis ? data.reset_at.toMillis() : (data.reset_at || 0);

    if (now > resetAt) {
      // Window reset
      t.set(rateLimitRef, {
        count: 1,
        reset_at: admin.firestore.Timestamp.fromMillis(now + windowSeconds * 1000),
        updated_at: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
      return;
    }

    const currentCount = (data.count || 0) as number;
    if (currentCount >= limit) {
      const waitSec = Math.ceil((resetAt - now) / 1000);
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "resource-exhausted",
        `${errorMessage} Harap tunggu ${waitSec} detik lagi.`
      );
    }

    t.update(rateLimitRef, {
      count: currentCount + 1,
      updated_at: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  });
}

// ================================================================
// FUNCTION 2: createCheckout
// Dipanggil dari app & web — mengembalikan link DOKU Checkout
// ================================================================
export const createCheckout = functions
  .runWith({ serviceAccount: "open-turath@appspot.gserviceaccount.com" })
  .https.onCall(async (data, context) => {
    if (!context.auth) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "unauthenticated",
        "Login diperlukan untuk melakukan transaksi."
      );
    }
    const { plan, agentId, expectedAmount, pricingRevision } = data || {};
    const text = (value: unknown, max: number): string => typeof value === "string" ? value.trim().slice(0, max) : "";
    const name = text(data?.name, 120);
    const email = text(data?.email, 254).toLowerCase();
    const phone = text(data?.phone, 20).replace(/[^0-9+]/g, "");

    if (typeof plan !== "string" || !plan || !name || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "invalid-argument",
        "Data tidak lengkap (nama dan email diperlukan)."
      );
    }

    const currentAgentId = typeof agentId === "string" && agentId ? agentId : "fiqh_tahawwulat";
    const pricing = resolvePlanPricing(currentAgentId, plan as string);
    // Reject stale offers before creating any invoice or contacting the gateway.
    if (expectedAmount !== undefined &&
        (!Number.isSafeInteger(expectedAmount) || expectedAmount !== pricing.amount ||
         pricingRevision !== "perdana-2026-09-20")) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("failed-precondition", "Harga penawaran telah berubah. Muat ulang aplikasi.");
    }
    // Each checkout writes two documents and calls the gateway.
    await enforceRateLimit(
      `checkout_${context.auth.uid}`,
      10,
      600,
      "Terlalu banyak permintaan pembayaran."
    );
    const invoiceNumber = `OT-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;

    const trxRef = db.collection("transactions").doc();
    const trxId = trxRef.id;
    const uid = context.auth?.uid || null;

    // F-07: Tulis dokumen transaksi berstatus pending SEBELUM memanggil gateway Midtrans
    await trxRef.set({
      uid,
      plan,
      agent_id: currentAgentId,
      gateway: "midtrans",
      invoice_number: invoiceNumber,
      amount: pricing.amount,
      duration_months: pricing.durationMonths,
      entitlement_key: pricing.entitlementKey,
      status: "pending",
      source: uid ? "app" : "website",
      customer_name: name,
      customer_email: email,
      customer_phone: phone || "",
      created_at: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    await db.collection("payment_reconciliation").doc(invoiceNumber).set({invoice_number:invoiceNumber,
      transaction_document:trxId,uid,gateway:"midtrans",state:"pending",due_ms:Date.now()+60000,attempts:0});
    let paymentUrl = "";
    let snapToken = "";
    try {
      const snapRes = await requestMidtransSnapCheckout({
        invoiceNumber,
        amount: pricing.amount,
        itemName: pricing.label,
```
