```typescript
    const email = (context.auth.token.email || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    // Pembelian diklaim berdasarkan email, jadi email wajib sudah diverifikasi penyedia identitas.
    if (!email || context.auth.token.email_verified !== true) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("failed-precondition", "Akun Google Anda tidak memiliki alamat email yang valid.");
    }

    const apiKey = getAkalApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("internal", "Kunci API GoAkal belum dikonfigurasi di server.");
    }
    // One sync fans out to every GoAkal service; bound it per account.
    await enforceRateLimit(`akal_sync_${uid}`, 3, 600, "Sinkronisasi baru saja dijalankan.");

    const now = Date.now();
    const deadline = now + 45000;
    const syncedServices: string[] = [];

    const ownRows = async (cuid: string): Promise<any[]> => {
      const rows: any[] = [];
      for (const status of ["PAID", "SETTLED"]) {
        for (let page = 1; page <= 4 && Date.now() < deadline; page++) {
          const apiUrl = `https://goakal.com/service/api/v1/services/${cuid}/transactions?status=${status}&pageSize=100&page=${page}`;
          let txns: any[];
          try {
            const response = await axios.get(apiUrl, { headers: { "X-Api-Key": apiKey }, timeout: 8000 });
            txns = Array.isArray(response.data?.data) ? response.data.data : [];
          } catch (e: any) {
            console.warn(`[syncAkalPurchases] Query failed for one service page: ${e.message}`);
            break;
          }
          rows.push(...txns.filter(t => String(t?.payerEmail || "").trim().toLowerCase() === email));
          if (txns.length < 100) break;
        }
      }
      return rows;
    };

    const syncService = async (service: typeof AKAL_SERVICES[number]): Promise<void> => {
      let applied = false;
      for (const cuid of [service.cuid, ...service.fallbacks]) {
        const rows = (await ownRows(cuid))
          .map(t => ({t, paidMs: millis(t.paidAt || t.createdAt)}))
          .filter(r => Number.isFinite(r.paidMs))
          .sort((a, b) => a.paidMs - b.paidMs);
        let chainEnd = 0;
        for (const {t, paidMs} of rows) {
          const months = detectDurationMonths(t.priceSchemeTitle || "", t.serviceTitle || "");
          const rawId = typeof t.id === "string" && t.id.trim() ? t.id : t.paymentId;
          const amount = Number(t.incomingAmount ?? t.amount);
          const valid = typeof rawId === "string" && rawId.trim() && Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0;
          // The provider's invoice expiry is not the subscription period. A
          // renewal paid before the previous period ended continues from it.
          const startsMs = valid ? Math.max(paidMs, chainEnd) : paidMs;
          const expiresMs = billingExpiry(startsMs, months);
          if (valid) chainEnd = expiresMs;
          if (expiresMs <= now) continue;
          if (!valid) {
            await quarantineAkalEvidence({
              email, uid, service: service.name, transaction_id: typeof rawId === "string" ? rawId : "",
              amount: Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : null, paid_at: String(t.paidAt || t.createdAt || ""),
            }, "invalid_billing_identity_or_amount");
            continue;
          }
          await applyAkalPurchase({
            uid, email, name: String(t.payerName || "Santri Peneliti").slice(0, 120),
            transactionId: akalTransactionId(rawId, [email, service.cuid, String(paidMs)]),
            amount, scopes: service.scopes,
            plan: months === 12 ? "bahits_1y" : (months === 6 ? "tholib_6m" : "tholib_1m"),
            months, paidMs, startsMs, serviceTitle: String(t.serviceTitle || service.name).slice(0, 200),
          });
          applied = true;
        }
      }
      if (applied) syncedServices.push(service.name);
    };

    let cursor = 0;
    const worker = async () => { while (cursor < AKAL_SERVICES.length && Date.now() < deadline) await syncService(AKAL_SERVICES[cursor++]); };
    await Promise.all([worker(), worker(), worker(), worker(), worker(), worker()]);
    syncedServices.sort();

    if (syncedServices.length > 0) {
      await sendTelegramNotification(
        `🔄 <b>[SINKRONISASI GOAKAL OTOMATIS]</b>\n` +
        `👤 Pengguna: <code>${esc(email)}</code>\n` +
        `📚 Hak Akses Aktif: <b>${esc(syncedServices.join(", "))}</b>`
      );
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      synced: syncedServices,
      count: syncedServices.length,
      message: syncedServices.length > 0
        ? `Alhamdulillah! Akses aktif berhasil disinkronkan: ${syncedServices.join(", ")}.`
        : "Belum ditemukan transaksi aktif di GoAkal untuk email ini. Pastikan Anda menggunakan email akun Google yang sama saat membayar di GoAkal.",
    };
  });

// ================================================================
// FUNCTION: akalWebhook (Webhook Receiver HTTP dari GoAkal)
// ================================================================
export const akalWebhook = functions
  .runWith({ serviceAccount: "open-turath@appspot.gserviceaccount.com" })
  .https.onRequest(async (req, res) => {
    if (req.method !== "POST") {
      res.status(405).send("Method Not Allowed");
      return;
    }

    const payload = req.body || {};
    // Fail-closed: tanpa secret terkonfigurasi, webhook menolak semua request.
    const akalSecret = process.env.AKAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET || "";
    if (akalSecret.length < 32) {
      console.error("[Akal Webhook] AKAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not configured; rejecting request.");
      res.status(503).json({ error: "Webhook not configured" });
      return;
    }

    // Verifikasi token dari Akal (di dalam body JSON payload.token atau payload.data.token)
    const token = payload.token || payload.data?.token || req.headers["x-akal-token"];
    if (typeof token !== "string" || !safeTimingEqual(token, akalSecret)) {
      console.warn("[Akal Webhook] Signature verification failed or missing token.");
      res.status(401).json({ error: "Unauthorized" });
      return;
    }

    const data = payload.data || payload;
    const status = String(data.status || "").toUpperCase().trim();
    if (!["PAID", "SETTLED"].includes(status)) {
      console.log(`[Akal Webhook] Transaction status is '${status}'. Acknowledging receipt.`);
      res.status(200).json({ received: true, status });
      return;
    }

    const payer = data.payer || data.user || {};
    const email = String(payer.email || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const name = String(payer.name || "").trim().slice(0, 120) || "Santri Peneliti";
    const service = data.service || {};
    const serviceTitle = String(service.name || service.title || "").trim().slice(0, 200);
    const priceScheme = data.priceScheme || {};
    const priceSchemeTitle = String(priceScheme.name || priceScheme.title || "").trim();
    const rawTxnId = typeof data.id === "string" ? data.id.trim() : "";
    const amount = Number(data.amount);
    const scopes = resolveAkalScopes(serviceTitle);
    const paidMs = data.paidAt ? millis(data.paidAt) : Date.now();
    const evidence = {email, service: serviceTitle, transaction_id: rawTxnId, payment_status: status,
      amount: Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : null, paid_at: String(data.paidAt || "")};

    if (!email) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing payer email" });
      return;
    }
    // Preserve invalid evidence for operator verification; never auto-extend
    // and never guess which module an unknown product should unlock.
    const reason = !rawTxnId || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0 ? "invalid_billing_identity_or_amount"
      : !scopes.length ? "unknown_service"
      : !Number.isFinite(paidMs) ? "invalid_payment_time" : "";
    if (reason) {
      await quarantineAkalEvidence(evidence, reason);
      res.status(200).json({received: true, verification_required: true});
      return;
    }

    const months = detectDurationMonths(priceSchemeTitle, serviceTitle);
    const plan = months === 12 ? "bahits_1y" : (months === 6 ? "tholib_6m" : "tholib_1m");
    const txnId = akalTransactionId(rawTxnId, [email, serviceTitle, priceSchemeTitle, String(data.paidAt || ""), String(amount)]);
    let result: {expiresMs: number; linked: boolean};
    try {
      result = await applyAkalPurchase({email, name, transactionId: txnId, amount, scopes, plan, months, paidMs, serviceTitle});
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[Akal Webhook] Purchase could not be applied:", err.message);
      res.status(500).json({ error: "Internal error" });
      return;
    }

    await sendTelegramNotification(
      `⚡ <b>[WEBHOOK GOAKAL REALTIME]</b>\n` +
      `👤 Pembeli: <code>${esc(email)}</code> (${esc(name)})\n` +
      `📦 Layanan: <b>${esc(serviceTitle)}</b>\n` +
      `⏳ Paket: ${esc(plan)} (${months} bulan)\n` +
      `🔑 Entitlement: <code>${esc(scopes.join(", "))}</code>\n` +
      `💰 Nominal: Rp ${amount.toLocaleString("id-ID")}\n` +
      `📅 Masa Aktif: s/d ${new Date(result.expiresMs).toISOString().split("T")[0]}` +
      (result.linked ? "" : `\nℹ️ Pembeli belum terdaftar di aplikasi; akses ditautkan saat ia mendaftar.`)
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, txnId, entitlementKeys: scopes });
  });


// ================================================================
// TELEMETRY CLOUD FUNCTION: Forward critical errors to Telegram
// ================================================================
export const onClientErrorLogged = functions.firestore
  .document("client_error_logs/{logId}")
  .onCreate(async (snap, ctx) => {
    const data = snap.data();
    if (!data) return;

    const severity = String(data.severity || "error");
    if (!["critical", "error"].includes(severity)) return;
    // Any signed-in client can write this collection. Bound what one account
    // can push to the operator channel so payment alerts are never drowned out.
    const owner = typeof data.userId === "string" && data.userId ? data.userId : "unknown";
    try {
      await enforceRateLimit(`client_alert_${owner}`.slice(0, 200), 5, 900, "limited");
      await enforceRateLimit("client_alert_global", 30, 900, "limited");
    } catch (_) {
      return;
    }

    const msg = `⚠️ <b>[ALERT CLIENT ERROR]</b>\n` +
      `<b>Context:</b> ${esc(data.context || "general")}\n` +
      `<b>Severity:</b> ${esc(severity.toUpperCase())}\n` +
      `<b>Platform:</b> ${esc(data.platform || "unknown")}\n` +
      `<b>User:</b> ${esc(data.userEmail || data.userId || "anonymous")}\n` +
      `<b>Error:</b> <code>${esc(String(data.error || "Unknown Error").substring(0, 300))}</code>\n` +
      `<b>ID:</b> <code>${esc(ctx.params.logId)}</code>`;

    await sendTelegramNotification(msg);
  });
```

## File: `openturath_ai/functions/src/native_chat.ts`

```typescript
// Prototype boundary: Firebase identity is independent of the operator's Google session.
export type ChatCode = "unauthenticated" | "invalid-argument" | "permission-denied" | "failed-precondition" | "unavailable";

export class NativeChatError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: ChatCode, message: string) { super(message); }
}

export interface ChatRequest { agentId: string; question: string; requestId: string; expectedUid: string; }
export interface ChatCitation { sourceId: string; citationNumber: number; excerpt: string | null; }
export interface ChatReply { requestId: string; answer: string; citations: ChatCitation[]; }
export interface NativeChatDependencies {
  testUid: string | undefined;
  authorize(uid: string, agentId: string): Promise<boolean>;
  rateLimit(uid: string): Promise<void>;
  ask(request: Omit<ChatRequest, "expectedUid"> & { uid: string }): Promise<unknown>;
}

const requestPattern = /^[a-f0-9]{32}$/;
const uuidPattern = /^[a-f0-9]{8}(?:-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i;

export function parseChatRequest(value: unknown): ChatRequest {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
    throw new NativeChatError("invalid-argument", "Pertanyaan tidak valid.");
  }
  const data = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (Object.keys(data).some(key => !["agentId", "question", "requestId", "expectedUid"].includes(key)) ||
      typeof data.agentId !== "string" || !/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,79}$/.test(data.agentId) ||
      typeof data.question !== "string" || !data.question.trim() || data.question.length > 8000 ||
      typeof data.requestId !== "string" || !requestPattern.test(data.requestId) ||
      typeof data.expectedUid !== "string" || !data.expectedUid || data.expectedUid.length > 128) {
    throw new NativeChatError("invalid-argument", "Pertanyaan tidak valid atau terlalu panjang.");
  }
  return {agentId: data.agentId, question: data.question.trim(), requestId: data.requestId, expectedUid: data.expectedUid};
}

export function parseChatReply(value: unknown, requestId: string): ChatReply {
  const invalid = () => new NativeChatError("unavailable", "Jawaban asisten belum dapat dibaca.");
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw invalid();
  const data = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (data.requestId !== requestId || typeof data.answer !== "string" ||
      !data.answer.trim() || data.answer.length > 128000 ||
      !Array.isArray(data.citations) || data.citations.length > 100) throw invalid();
  const citations = data.citations.map((item: unknown): ChatCitation => {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) throw invalid();
    const ref = item as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof ref.sourceId !== "string" || !uuidPattern.test(ref.sourceId) ||
        typeof ref.citationNumber !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(ref.citationNumber) ||
        ref.citationNumber < 1 || ref.citationNumber > 1000 ||
        (ref.excerpt !== null && (typeof ref.excerpt !== "string" || ref.excerpt.length > 4000))) throw invalid();
    return {sourceId: ref.sourceId, citationNumber: ref.citationNumber, excerpt: ref.excerpt as string | null};
  });
  // Deliberately return only display data; discard cookies, URLs, conversation IDs and debug blobs.
  return {requestId, answer: data.answer.trim(), citations};
}

export async function handleNativeChat(data: unknown, uid: string | undefined, deps: NativeChatDependencies): Promise<ChatReply> {
  if (!uid) throw new NativeChatError("unauthenticated", "Silakan masuk ke OpenTurath.");
  const request = parseChatRequest(data);
  if (request.expectedUid !== uid) throw new NativeChatError("unauthenticated", "Akun berubah. Silakan kirim pertanyaan dari akun aktif.");
  // No production rollout: initially permit only the explicitly configured prototype user.
  if (!deps.testUid) throw new NativeChatError("failed-precondition", "Koneksi asisten di aplikasi belum diaktifkan.");
  if (uid !== deps.testUid) throw new NativeChatError("permission-denied", "Akses pengujian asisten belum tersedia untuk akun ini.");
  if (!await deps.authorize(uid, request.agentId)) {
    throw new NativeChatError("permission-denied", "Akses kajian ini belum aktif.");
  }
  await deps.rateLimit(uid);
  try {
    const {expectedUid: _, ...payload} = request;
    return parseChatReply(await deps.ask({...payload, uid}), request.requestId);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof NativeChatError) throw error;
    // Never return/log upstream errors: they can include request headers or account/session data.
    throw new NativeChatError("unavailable", "Asisten belum dapat menjawab. Pertanyaan tidak dikirim ulang otomatis.");
  }
}
```

```typescript
export interface ResolvedNotebook {
  url: string;
  notebookId: string;
  cloneName: string;
  entityCode: string;
  isMaster: boolean;
  cloneIndex?: number;
}

/**
 * Resolves optimal notebook URL for a given agentId and optional user UID.
 */
export function resolveAgentNotebook(agentId: string, uid?: string): ResolvedNotebook | null {
  const entityCode = AGENT_TO_ENTITY[agentId];
  if (!entityCode) return null;

  const entity = NOTEBOOK_ENTITIES[entityCode];
  if (!entity) return null;

  // Selalu arahkan ke Master Notebook resmi terverifikasi yang terhubung ke sharing/provisioning
  return {
    url: entity.masterUrl,
    notebookId: entity.masterId,
    cloneName: `${entity.name} (Master)`,
    entityCode,
    isMaster: true,
  };
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

abstract final class AdabIcons {
  static const values = [
    Icons.school_outlined,
    Icons.manage_search_rounded,
    Icons.diversity_3_outlined,
    Icons.verified_user_outlined,
    Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
    Icons.hub_outlined,
    Icons.speaker_notes_outlined,
    Icons.edit_note_rounded
  ];
  static IconData? forSection(String id) {
    final i = int.tryParse(id.split('_').last);
    return id.startsWith('guideline_') && i != null && i >= 2 && i <= 9
        ? values[i - 2]
        : null;
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

/// Direction is determined by the first strong letter, never by the presence
/// of an Arabic fragment somewhere in a Latin paragraph. Numbers are neutral.
TextDirection answerDirection(String text) {
  final first = RegExp(
          r'[A-Za-z\u00C0-\u024F\u0620-\u064A\u066E-\u06D3\u06FA-\u06FC\u0750-\u077F\u08A0-\u08C9]')
      .firstMatch(text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^\s*(?:#{1,6}|>|[-*])\s*'), ''));
  if (first == null) return TextDirection.ltr;
  return RegExp(
              r'[\u0620-\u064A\u066E-\u06D3\u06FA-\u06FC\u0750-\u077F\u08A0-\u08C9]')
          .hasMatch(first.group(0)!)
      ? TextDirection.rtl
      : TextDirection.ltr;
}

/// Isolation is a display transformation only. Clipboard and stored answers
/// must continue to use the original text, without added control characters.
String isolateArabicPhrases(String text) {
  if (answerDirection(text) == TextDirection.rtl ||
      RegExp(r'^\s*(?:`{3,}|~{3,})').hasMatch(text)) {
    return text;
  }
  return text.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(
        r'[\u0620-\u065F\u0670\u066E-\u06D3\u06FA-\u06FC\u0750-\u077F\u08A0-\u08FF]+(?:[ \t]+[\u0620-\u065F\u0670\u066E-\u06D3\u06FA-\u06FC\u0750-\u077F\u08A0-\u08FF]+)*'),
    (match) => '\u2067${match.group(0)}\u2069',
  );
}

/// Keep fenced Markdown intact and split unstructured bilingual lines when
/// their reading direction changes, including replies without blank lines.
List<String> answerDisplayBlocks(String text) {
  final result = <String>[];
  final current = <String>[];
  String? fence;
  void flush() {
    if (current.isNotEmpty) result.add(current.join('\n'));
    current.clear();
  }

  for (final line in text.split('\n')) {
    final marker = RegExp(r'^\s*(`{3,}|~{3,})').firstMatch(line)?.group(1);
    if (marker != null) {
      if (fence == null) {
        flush();
        fence = marker[0];
      } else if (marker[0] == fence) {
        current.add(line);
        flush();
        fence = null;
        continue;
      }
    }
    if (fence == null && line.trim().isEmpty) {
      flush();
      continue;
    }
    final structured = current
        .any((part) => RegExp(r'^\s*(?:[-*+]\s|\d+[.)]\s|\|)').hasMatch(part));
    if (fence == null &&
        current.isNotEmpty &&
        !structured &&
        answerDirection(current.first) != answerDirection(line)) {
      flush();
    }
    current.add(line);
  }
  flush();
  return result;
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class AppConfig {
  static final ValueNotifier<ThemeMode> themeNotifier = ValueNotifier(ThemeMode.system);
  static final ValueNotifier<String> localeNotifier = ValueNotifier('id'); // 'id', 'en', 'ar'

  static const String _themeKey = 'app_theme_mode';
  static const String _localeKey = 'app_locale';

  static Future<void> init() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    
    // Load Theme (Default: ThemeMode.system)
    final themeStr = prefs.getString(_themeKey);
    if (themeStr == 'light') {
      themeNotifier.value = ThemeMode.light;
    } else if (themeStr == 'dark') {
      themeNotifier.value = ThemeMode.dark;
    } else {
      themeNotifier.value = ThemeMode.system;
    }

    // Load Locale
    final localeStr = prefs.getString(_localeKey);
    if (const ['id', 'en', 'ar'].contains(localeStr)) {
      localeNotifier.value = localeStr!;
    } else {
      localeNotifier.value = 'id';
    }
  }

  static Future<void> setThemeMode(ThemeMode mode) async {
    themeNotifier.value = mode;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (mode == ThemeMode.light) {
      await prefs.setString(_themeKey, 'light');
    } else if (mode == ThemeMode.dark) {
      await prefs.setString(_themeKey, 'dark');
    } else {
      await prefs.setString(_themeKey, 'system');
    }
  }

  static Future<void> setLocale(String langCode) async {
    if (!const ['id', 'en', 'ar'].contains(langCode)) return;
    localeNotifier.value = langCode;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_localeKey, langCode);
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'theme.dart';
import 'design/ot_colors.dart';

enum SnackType { info, success, warning, error }

class AppSnackBar {
  static void show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String message,
    SnackType type = SnackType.info,
    Duration? duration,
    SnackBarAction? action,
    bool persist = false,
  }) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    // Notifikasi monokrom editorial: status dibedakan lewat BENTUK IKON dan
    // kalimat, bukan lewat warna jenuh. Hanya status kritis yang diberi
    // isyarat merah bata redup agar tetap terbaca tanpa merusak ketenangan.
    final backgroundColor = OTColors.inverseSurface(isDark);
    final textColor = isDark ? OTColors.onInverseSurface : OTColors.surfaceLight;

    final Color accentColor;
    final IconData icon;

    switch (type) {
      case SnackType.success:
        accentColor = textColor;
        icon = Icons.check_circle_outline;
        break;
      case SnackType.warning:
        accentColor = textColor;
        icon = Icons.warning_amber_rounded;
        break;
      case SnackType.error:
        accentColor = OTColors.destructiveDark; // Merah bata redup, bukan neon
        icon = Icons.error_outline;
        break;
      case SnackType.info:
        accentColor = textColor;
        icon = Icons.info_outline;
        break;
    }

    // Garis batas tetap hairline netral; hanya galat yang meninggalkan jejak warna.
    final borderColor = type == SnackType.error
        ? accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.45)
        : OTColors.onInverseSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.18);

    final effectiveDuration = duration ??
        (type == SnackType.error
            ? const Duration(seconds: 4)
            : type == SnackType.warning
                ? const Duration(seconds: 3)
                : const Duration(milliseconds: 2600));

    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    messenger.clearSnackBars();
    messenger.showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(icon, color: accentColor, size: 20),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                message,
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: textColor,
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  height: 1.35,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        elevation: 4,
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
          side: BorderSide(
            color: borderColor,
            width: 0.8,
          ),
        ),
        duration: effectiveDuration,
        persist: persist,
        dismissDirection: DismissDirection.horizontal,
        action: action,
      ),
    );

    // Safeguard timeout: jamin snackbar selalu tertutup otomatis setelah durasi habis,
    // bahkan jika ada persistensi bawaan framework saat action != null atau service aksesibilitas aktif.
    if (!persist) {
      Timer(effectiveDuration + const Duration(milliseconds: 200), () {
        try {
          messenger.clearSnackBars();
        } catch (_) {}
      });
    }
  }

  static void clear(BuildContext context) {
    try {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  static void success(
    BuildContext context,
    String message, {
    Duration? duration,
    SnackBarAction? action,
    bool persist = false,
  }) =>
      show(
        context,
        message: message,
        type: SnackType.success,
        duration: duration,
        action: action,
        persist: persist,
      );

  static void error(
    BuildContext context,
    String message, {
    Duration? duration,
    SnackBarAction? action,
    bool persist = false,
  }) =>
      show(
        context,
        message: message,
        type: SnackType.error,
        duration: duration,
        action: action,
        persist: persist,
      );

  static void warning(
    BuildContext context,
    String message, {
    Duration? duration,
    SnackBarAction? action,
    bool persist = false,
  }) =>
      show(
        context,
        message: message,
        type: SnackType.warning,
        duration: duration,
        action: action,
        persist: persist,
      );

  static void info(
    BuildContext context,
    String message, {
    Duration? duration,
    SnackBarAction? action,
    bool persist = false,
  }) =>
      show(
        context,
        message: message,
        type: SnackType.info,
        duration: duration,
        action: action,
        persist: persist,
      );
}
```

```dart
/// Utility Normalisasi & Pencarian Cerdas Teks Arab (Smart Arabic Search)
/// - Menghilangkan seluruh harakat (fathah, dhommah, kasrah, tanwin, sukun, tasydid)
/// - Menyatukan variasi huruf Alif (أ, إ, آ, ٱ -> ا)
/// - Menyatukan Ta Marbuthah & Ha (ة -> ه)
/// - Menyatukan Ya & Alif Maqshurah (ى -> ي)
/// - Menghilangkan tatweel / kashida (ـ)
class ArabicUtils {
  static final RegExp _harakatRegex = RegExp(r'[\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u06D6-\u06ED]');
  static final RegExp _tatweelRegex = RegExp(r'\u0640');

  /// Normalisasi string Arab & Latin untuk perbandingan pencarian fleksibel
  static String normalize(String text) {
    if (text.isEmpty) return '';
    
    // 1. Hapus harakat & tatweel
    var normalized = text.replaceAll(_harakatRegex, '').replaceAll(_tatweelRegex, '');
    
    // 2. Normalisasi variasi huruf alif
    normalized = normalized
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[أإآٱ]'), 'ا')
        .replaceAll('ة', 'ه')
        .replaceAll('ى', 'ي')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[ؤئ]'), 'ء');
        
    return normalized.toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  /// Cek apakah teks target mengandung query pencarian (baik Arab maupun Latin)
  static bool matches(String source, String query) {
    if (query.trim().isEmpty) return true;
    
    final normSource = normalize(source);
    final normQuery = normalize(query);
    
    // Cek versi normalisasi
    if (normSource.contains(normQuery)) return true;
    
    // Cek versi teks mentah (case-insensitive)
    if (source.toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase().trim())) return true;
    
    return false;
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'localization.dart';

/// Jenis naskah harus berasal dari metadata, bukan dugaan dari nama kitab.
enum BookStudyLevel {
  all, matan, sharh, hashiyah, unclassified;
  String get label => Loc.tr(switch (this) {
    all => 'allBooks', matan => 'matan', sharh => 'sharh',
    hashiyah => 'hashiyah', unclassified => 'unclassified',
  });
  static BookStudyLevel fromMetadata(String value) {
    final normalized = value.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (const ['matan', 'matn', 'متن', 'المتون', 'matan dasar'].contains(normalized)) return matan;
    if (const ['syarah', 'sharh', 'شرح', 'الشروح', "syarah mu'tamad"].contains(normalized)) return sharh;
    if (const ['hasyiyah', 'hashiyah', 'حاشية', 'الحواشي', 'hasyiyah ilmiah'].contains(normalized)) return hashiyah;
    return unclassified;
  }
}
```

```dart
/// A display-ready representation of an AI response saved to Catatan.
///
/// The full answer is never rewritten here. The parser only derives a stable
/// title and preview so legacy items remain intact.
class ParsedAiAnswerContent {
  final String title;
  final String preview;
  final bool hasFallbackTitle;

  const ParsedAiAnswerContent({
    required this.title,
    required this.preview,
    required this.hasFallbackTitle,
  });
}

ParsedAiAnswerContent parseAiAnswerContent(String answer) {
  final lines = answer.split(RegExp(r'\r?\n'));
  final headingIndex = lines.indexWhere((line) {
    final clean = line.trim();
    if (RegExp(r'^#{1,6}\s*percakapan\b', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(clean)) {
      return false;
    }
    return RegExp(r'^\s{0,3}#{1,6}\s+\S').hasMatch(line);
  });
  final hasHeading = headingIndex >= 0;
  final titleIndex = hasHeading
      ? headingIndex
      : lines.indexWhere((line) => _displayLine(line).isNotEmpty);

  if (titleIndex < 0) {
    return const ParsedAiAnswerContent(
      title: 'Kajian tanpa judul',
      preview: '',
      hasFallbackTitle: true,
    );
  }

  final title = _limitTitle(_displayLine(lines[titleIndex]));
  final previewLines = <String>[];
  for (var index = titleIndex + 1; index < lines.length; index++) {
    final line = _displayLine(lines[index]);
    if (line.isNotEmpty) previewLines.add(line);
    if (previewLines.join(' ').length >= 180) break;
  }

  return ParsedAiAnswerContent(
    title: title.isEmpty ? 'Kajian tanpa judul' : title,
    preview: previewLines.join(' '),
    hasFallbackTitle: !hasHeading,
  );
}

String _displayLine(String line) {
  var value = line.trim();
  if (RegExp(r'^#{1,6}\s*percakapan\b', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(value)) {
    return '';
  }
  value = value.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^#{1,6}\s*'), '');
  value = value.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^\[[^\]]{1,12}\]\s*'), '');
  value = value.replaceFirst(
      RegExp(r'^(jawaban\s+langsung|jawaban\s+ai|percakapan)\s*:\s*',
          caseSensitive: false),
      '');
  value = value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^[>*\-\s]+'), '').trim();
  value = value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^\*+|\*+$'), '').trim();
  return value;
}

String _limitTitle(String title) {
  if (title.length <= 80) return title;
  final cutoff = title.substring(0, 80);
  final lastSpace = cutoff.lastIndexOf(' ');
  return '${cutoff.substring(0, lastSpace > 40 ? lastSpace : 80).trim()}…';
}

/// Mengubah artefak teknis hasil salin percakapan menjadi Markdown yang
/// nyaman dibaca, tanpa mengubah isi jawaban itu sendiri.
String readableAiAnswerMarkdown(String answer) {
  final lines = answer.split(RegExp(r'\r?\n'));
  final output = <String>[];
  for (final rawLine in lines) {
    final line = rawLine.trimRight();
    if (RegExp(r'^\s*#\s*percakapan\b', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(line)) {
      continue;
    }
    final question = RegExp(r'^\s*pertanyaan\s*\d*\s*$', caseSensitive: false)
        .hasMatch(line);
    final answerLabel =
        RegExp(r'^\s*jawaban\s*\d*\s*$', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(line);
    final section =
        RegExp(r'^\s*\[[A-Za-z]\]\s*(.+?)(?:\*+)?\s*$').firstMatch(line);
    if (question) {
      output.add('## Pertanyaan');
    } else if (answerLabel) {
      output.add('## Jawaban');
    } else if (section != null) {
      final label = section.group(1)!.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\*+$'), '').trim();
      output.add('## $label');
    } else {
      output.add(line);
    }
  }
  return output.join('\n').trim();
}

String aiAnswerTitle(String answer, String agentTitle) {
  final cleanAgent =
      agentTitle.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), '');
  final lines = answer.split(RegExp(r'\r?\n'));
  final questionIndex = lines.indexWhere((line) =>
      RegExp(r'^\s*pertanyaan\s*\d*\s*$', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(line));
  if (questionIndex >= 0) {
    for (var i = questionIndex + 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
      final candidate = _displayLine(lines[i]);
      if (candidate.isNotEmpty) return _limitTitle(candidate);
    }
  }
  final parsed = parseAiAnswerContent(answer);
  final raw = parsed.title.toLowerCase();
  if (!raw.contains('percakapan') &&
      !raw.contains('jawaban langsung') &&
      !raw.contains('jawaban ai') &&
      parsed.title.isNotEmpty &&
      parsed.title != 'Kajian tanpa judul') {
    return parsed.title;
  }
  for (final line in lines) {
    final candidate = _displayLine(line);
    final lower = candidate.toLowerCase();
    if (candidate.isNotEmpty &&
        !lower.contains('percakapan') &&
        !lower.contains('jawaban langsung') &&
        !lower.contains('jawaban ai') &&
        !lower.startsWith('pertanyaan')) {
      return _limitTitle(candidate);
    }
  }
  return cleanAgent.isNotEmpty ? cleanAgent : 'Catatan Kajian';
}
```

```dart
/// Chooses concise, high-value facts for a catalogue card.
/// Full bibliographic data remains available in the book dossier.
List<String> catalogCardFacts({
  required String? volumes,
  required String? publisher,
  required String? printYear,
  required String? muhaqqiq,
  String editorLabel = 'Tahqiq',
}) {
  bool usable(String? value) {
    final normalized = value?.trim();
    return normalized != null &&
        normalized.isNotEmpty &&
        normalized != '-' &&
        normalized != 'غير مدون' &&
        normalized != 'Tidak dicatat';
  }

  final facts = <String>[
    if (usable(volumes)) volumes!.trim(),
    if (usable(publisher)) publisher!.trim(),
    if (usable(printYear)) printYear!.trim(),
  ];
  if (facts.length < 3 && usable(muhaqqiq)) {
    facts.add('$editorLabel: ${muhaqqiq!.trim()}');
  }
  return facts.take(3).toList(growable: false);
}

```

```dart
      'Hadis dan fatwa',
      'Hadith and legal opinions',
      'الحديث والفتاوى'
    ],
  };

  static String of(String source) {
    final normalized = source.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized == '-') {
      return Loc.tr('unknownMetadata');
    }
    final index = Loc.supportedCodes.indexOf(Loc.language);
    for (final entry in _sections.entries) {
      if (normalized.startsWith(entry.key)) return entry.value[index];
    }
    // Proper names and unclassified source terms stay intact for scholarly review.
    return normalized;
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/answer_citation.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import 'bookmark_content.dart';

BookmarkModel copiedAnswerBookmark(
  String answer,
  AgentModel agent, {
  List<AnswerCitation> citations = const [],
}) {
  final text = answer.trim();
  if (text.isEmpty || text.length > 200000) {
    throw ArgumentError('Invalid answer length');
  }
  return BookmarkModel(
    id: sha256.convert(utf8.encode('${agent.id}:$text')).toString(),
    title: aiAnswerTitle(text, agent.title),
    agentId: agent.id,
    agentTitle: agent.title,
    fieldName: agent.category,
    fieldId: agent.fieldId,
    arabicExcerpt: '',
    fullAnswer: text,
    bookReference: '',
    pageNumber: '',
    createdAt: DateTime.now(),
    documentKind: BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer,
    verificationStatus: BookmarkVerificationStatus.unverified,
    citations: citations,
  );
}

```

```dart
  "brandPhilosophy": [
    "Dalam identitas OpenTurath, tiga ruang di dalam lambang mewakili Islam, Iman, dan Ihsan sebagai ats-tsawabit. Lengkungan luar melambangkan Fikih Tahawwulat sebagai benteng penjaga ketiganya. Sebutan ar-rukn ar-rabi’ digunakan dalam kerangka Fikih Tahawwulat. Gerbang dan segel menandai keterbukaan belajar serta komitmen untuk memeriksa rujukan.",
    "In OpenTurath’s identity, the three inner spaces represent Islam, Iman, and Ihsan as al-thawabit. The outer arch represents Fiqh al-Tahawwulat as their guardian. The term al-rukn al-rabi‘ belongs to that scholarly framework. The gateway and seal express openness to learning and a commitment to verifying references.",
    "في هوية أوبن تراث ترمز المساحات الثلاث الداخلية إلى الإسلام والإيمان والإحسان، وهي الثوابت. ويرمز القوس الخارجي إلى فقه التحولات بوصفه سياجًا يحميها. ويُستعمل مصطلح الركن الرابع في إطار فقه التحولات. وتعبر البوابة والخاتم عن الانفتاح على العلم والالتزام بمراجعة المراجع."
  ],

  "introTitle": [
    "Mengenal Fikih Tahawwulat",
    "Introducing Fiqh al-Tahawwulat",
    "التعريف بفقه التحولات"
  ],
  "introFoundation": [
    "Tsawabit dan tanda zaman",
    "The Constants and the Signs of the Times",
    "الثوابت وعلامات الزمان"
  ],
  "introFoundationBody": [
    "Dalam kerangka Al-Habib Abu Bakar Al-Adni Al-Masyhur, Fikih Tahawwulat menelaah perubahan zaman untuk menjaga Islam, Iman, dan Ihsan. Sebutan Rukun Keempat dipahami dalam kerangka keilmuan tersebut.",
    "Within the framework of al-Habib Abu Bakr al-Adni al-Mashhur, Fiqh al-Tahawwulat studies changing times in order to safeguard Islam, Iman, and Ihsan. The designation Fourth Pillar belongs to this scholarly framework.",
    "يدرس فقه التحولات، في إطار الحبيب أبي بكر العدني المشهور، تغيرات الزمان لصيانة الإسلام والإيمان والإحسان. ويُفهم وصف الركن الرابع ضمن هذا الإطار العلمي."
  ],
  "introMethod": [
    "Adab dan cara menelaah",
    "Scholarly Etiquette and Method",
    "آداب المطالعة ومنهجها"
  ],
  "introMethodBody": [
    "Baca teks bersama konteksnya. Periksa kutipan, nama kitab, jilid, dan halaman. Pembacaan tanda zaman perlu kehati-hatian, bimbingan guru, serta penjagaan lisan dan tindakan.",
    "Read each passage in context. Check its wording, title, volume, and page. Studying the signs of the times calls for care, guidance from teachers, and restraint in speech and action.",
    "اقرأ النص في سياقه، وراجع ألفاظه واسم الكتاب والجزء والصفحة. ودراسة علامات الزمان تستلزم التثبت وإرشاد المعلمين وصيانة اللسان والعمل."
  ],
  "introRooms": [
    "Lima ruang telaah",
    "Five Study Rooms",
    "خمسة مجالس للمطالعة"
  ],
  "introReferences": [
    "Menelusuri karya dan rujukan",
    "Following the Works and References",
    "تتبع المؤلفات والمراجع"
  ],
  "introReferencesBody": [
    "Koleksi mempertemukan karya tulis dan materi muhadharah yang tercatat dalam katalog. Setiap jawaban tetap perlu dicocokkan dengan sumbernya.",
    "The collection brings together written works and lecture material recorded in the catalog. Each answer should still be checked against its source.",
    "تجمع المجموعة المؤلفات ومواد المحاضرات المسجلة في الفهرس. وتبقى مراجعة كل جواب في مصدره لازمة."
  ],
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../localization.dart';
import 'native_fonts.dart';
import 'ot_colors.dart';
import 'ot_typography.dart';

/// Native-only design vocabulary. The AI room keeps its original tokens.
abstract final class NativeColors {
  static const canvasLight = OTColors.canvasLight;
  static const canvasDark = OTColors.canvasDark;
  static const surfaceLight = OTColors.surfaceLight;
  static const surfaceDark = OTColors.surfaceDark;
  static const surfaceSubtleLight = OTColors.surfaceSubtleLight;
  static const surfaceSubtleDark = OTColors.surfaceSubtleDark;
  static const textPrimaryLight = OTColors.textPrimaryLight;
  static const textPrimaryDark = OTColors.textPrimaryDark;
  static const textSecondaryLight = OTColors.textSecondaryLight;
  static const textSecondaryDark = OTColors.textSecondaryDark;
  static const textTertiaryLight = OTColors.textTertiaryLight;
  static const textTertiaryDark = OTColors.textTertiaryDark;
  static const borderLight = OTColors.borderLight;
  static const borderDark = OTColors.borderDark;
  static const borderStrongLight = OTColors.borderStrongLight;
  static const borderStrongDark = OTColors.borderStrongDark;
  static const accentLight = OTColors.accentLight;
  static const accentDark = OTColors.accentDark;
  static const destructiveLight = OTColors.destructiveLight;
  static const destructiveDark = OTColors.destructiveDark;
  static Color canvas(bool dark) => dark ? canvasDark : canvasLight;
  static Color surface(bool dark) => dark ? surfaceDark : surfaceLight;
  static Color surfaceSubtle(bool dark) =>
      dark ? surfaceSubtleDark : surfaceSubtleLight;
  static Color textPrimary(bool dark) =>
      dark ? textPrimaryDark : textPrimaryLight;
  static Color textSecondary(bool dark) =>
      dark ? textSecondaryDark : textSecondaryLight;
  static Color textTertiary(bool dark) =>
      dark ? textTertiaryDark : textTertiaryLight;
  static Color border(bool dark) => dark ? borderDark : borderLight;
  static Color borderStrong(bool dark) =>
      dark ? borderStrongDark : borderStrongLight;
  static Color accent(bool dark) => dark ? accentDark : accentLight;
  static Color onAccent(bool dark) => OTColors.onAccent(dark);
  static Color actionFill(bool dark) => OTColors.accent(dark);
  static Color destructiveFill(bool dark) => OTColors.destructive(dark);
  static Color inverseSurface(bool dark) =>
      dark ? surfaceLight : textPrimaryLight;
  static Color destructive(bool dark) =>
      dark ? destructiveDark : destructiveLight;
  static Color marja(bool dark) => OTColors.marja(dark);
  static Color collection(bool dark) => OTColors.surface(dark);
  static Color brass(bool dark) => accent(dark);
}

/// Pembungkus tipis di atas skala [OTFontSize]. Ukuran yang diminta selalu
/// dibulatkan ke langkah skala terdekat, sehingga layar native tidak bisa
/// keluar dari skala. Kode baru memakai [OTTypography] langsung.
abstract final class NativeType {
  static double _snap(double size) => OTFontSize.scale
      .reduce((a, b) => (a - size).abs() <= (b - size).abs() ? a : b);
  static TextStyle title(bool dark, {double size = OTFontSize.s26}) =>
      NativeFonts.outfit(
          fontSize: _snap(size),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          letterSpacing: -.35,
          height: 1.2,
          color: NativeColors.textPrimary(dark));
  static TextStyle body(bool dark, {double size = OTFontSize.s16}) =>
      NativeFonts.outfit(
          fontSize: _snap(size),
          height: 1.5,
          color: NativeColors.textPrimary(dark));
  static TextStyle meta(bool dark) => NativeFonts.outfit(
      fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
      height: 1.45,
      color: NativeColors.textSecondary(dark));
  static TextStyle arabic(bool dark, {double size = OTFontSize.s26}) =>
      NativeFonts.scheherazadeNew(
          fontSize: _snap(size),
          height: 1.9,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: NativeColors.textPrimary(dark));
}

    ],
  };
  static String text(String key, [List<String> args = const []]) {
    final translations = values[key];
    if (translations == null) throw ArgumentError.value(key, 'key');
    var result = translations[Loc.supportedCodes.indexOf(Loc.language)];
    for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
      result = result.replaceAll('{$i}', args[i]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  static String role(String id) => text(id.split('_').last);
}
```

## File: `openturath_ai/lib/core/design/native_fonts.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../localization.dart';

/// Bundled native fonts, deliberately named separately from GoogleFonts assets.
abstract final class NativeFonts {
  static TextStyle outfit(
      {TextStyle? textStyle,
      Color? color,
      Color? backgroundColor,
      double? fontSize,
      FontWeight? fontWeight,
      FontStyle? fontStyle,
      double? letterSpacing,
      double? height,
      TextDecoration? decoration}) {
    final arabic = Loc.isArabic;
    return (textStyle ?? const TextStyle()).copyWith(
        fontFamily: 'NativeOutfit',
        fontFamilyFallback: const ['NativeArabicUI', 'NativeInter'],
        color: color,
        backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
        fontSize: fontSize,
        fontWeight: fontWeight,
        fontStyle: fontStyle,
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'ot_colors.dart';
import 'ot_spacing.dart';
import 'ot_typography.dart';

/// Varian tombol di luar bawaan tema. Bentuk (pil), tinggi, dan huruf tombol
/// diatur tema di `core/theme.dart`; berkas ini hanya memuat penyimpangan yang
/// punya arti, sehingga layar tidak perlu menulis `styleFrom` sendiri.
abstract final class OTButtons {
  /// Aksi permanen: hapus akun, hapus catatan, keluar.
  static ButtonStyle destructive(bool dark) => FilledButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: OTColors.destructive(dark),
        foregroundColor: OTColors.onAccent(dark),
      );

  /// Tombol primer di atas permukaan yang selalu gelap (kartu pembuka).
  static ButtonStyle onInk() => FilledButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: OTColors.textPrimaryDark,
        foregroundColor: OTColors.textPrimaryLight,
      );

  /// Aksi teks yang sengaja diredam (mis. "Gunakan voucher").
  static ButtonStyle quiet(bool dark) => TextButton.styleFrom(
        foregroundColor: OTColors.textSecondary(dark),
      );

  /// Aksi kecil di dalam kartu: garis tepi, tinggi 36.
  static ButtonStyle compactOutlined(bool dark) => OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
        foregroundColor: OTColors.textPrimary(dark),
        side: BorderSide(color: OTColors.borderStrong(dark)),
        minimumSize: const Size(0, 36),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.md),
        textStyle: OTTypography.captionMedium(),
      );

  /// Aksi kecil di dalam kartu: isi tonal, tinggi 36.
  static ButtonStyle compactTonal(bool dark) => FilledButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
        foregroundColor: OTColors.textPrimary(dark),
        minimumSize: const Size(0, 36),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.md),
        textStyle: OTTypography.captionMedium(),
      );
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// OpenTurath Design System — Monochrome Editorial Palette
/// Prinsip Karakter Visual: Perpustakaan digital turath, ruang telaah akademik, dan katalog kitab modern.
/// Bukan: SaaS generik, fintech, AI neon/gradient, ataupun kartu warna-warni.
/// Kedalaman dibangun melalui kontras, tipografi, ruang kosong, hairline border, dan tekstur kertas arsip.
///
/// KONTRAK: berkas ini adalah SATU-SATUNYA tempat nilai warna mentah boleh ditulis.
/// Seluruh `screens/` dan `widgets/` wajib mengambil warna dari sini.
class OTColors {
  // ── 1. Light Mode (Neutral Paper) ──
  static const Color canvasLight =
      Color(0xFFF6F6F6); // Kertas hangat untuk ruang telaah
  static const Color surfaceLight = Color(
      0xFFFFFFFF); // Panel utama, bottom sheet, dialog, kartu, input field
  static const Color surfaceSubtleLight =
      Color(0xFFEDEDED); // Kontainer tonal sekunder
  static const Color textPrimaryLight = Color(0xFF171717);
  static const Color textSecondaryLight = Color(0xFF606060);
  static const Color textTertiaryLight = Color(0xFF6B6B6B); // Placeholder, hint
  static const Color borderLight = Color(0xFFDADADA);
  static const Color borderSubtleLight = Color(0xFFEBEBEB);
  static const Color borderStrongLight = Color(0xFF767676);
  static const Color accentLight = Color(0xFF171717);
  static const Color primaryContainerLight = Color(0xFFF0F0F0);
  static const Color onPrimaryContainerLight = Color(0xFF171717);

  // ── 2. Dark Mode (Neutral Ink) ──
  static const Color canvasDark = Color(0xFF151515);
  static const Color surfaceDark = Color(0xFF292929);
  static const Color surfaceSubtleDark = Color(0xFF353535);
  static const Color textPrimaryDark = Color(0xFFF5F5F5);
  static const Color textSecondaryDark = Color(0xFFB8B8B8);
  static const Color textTertiaryDark = Color(0xFF9A9A9A); // Placeholder, hint
  static const Color borderDark = Color(0xFF454545);
  static const Color borderSubtleDark = Color(0xFF2D2D2D);
  static const Color borderStrongDark = Color(0xFF808080);
  static const Color accentDark = Color(0xFFF5F5F5);
  static const Color primaryContainerDark = Color(0xFF222222);
  static const Color onPrimaryContainerDark = Color(0xFFF5F5F5);

  // ── 3. Tinta Balik (Foreground di atas permukaan ber-accent) ──
  // Tombol primer diisi `accent`, sehingga labelnya wajib memakai `onAccent`.
  // Token inilah pengganti resmi `Colors.white` / `Colors.black` di seluruh UI.
  static const Color onAccentLight = surfaceLight;
  static const Color onAccentDark = Color(0xFF171717);

  // ── 4. Permukaan Terbalik (Snackbar, tooltip, pil gelap di mode terang) ──
  static const Color inverseSurfaceLight = textPrimaryLight;
  static const Color inverseSurfaceDark = Color(0xFF2B2B2B);
  static const Color onInverseSurface = Color(0xFFF5F5F5);

  // ── 5. Status rujukan — dibedakan dengan label dan ikon ──
  // Dipakai HANYA sebagai penanda status marja' / terverifikasi, tidak pernah dekoratif.
  static const Color marjaLight = Color(0xFF4A4A4A); // Tinta status
  static const Color marjaDark =
      Color(0xFFC4C4C4); // Tinta status di mode gelap

  // ── 6. Status kritis — satu-satunya warna di luar tinta dan kertas ──
  // Merah hanya untuk galat dan aksi permanen, selalu bersama ikon dan pesan.
  static const Color errorLight = Color(0xFFB91C1C);
  static const Color errorDark = Color(0xFFF87171);
  static const Color errorContainerLight = Color(0xFFFEF2F2);
  static const Color errorContainerDark = Color(0xFF2F1616);
  static const Color destructiveLight = errorLight;
  static const Color destructiveDark = errorDark;

  // ── 6b. Dasar bayangan dan scrim; selalu dipakai dengan alpha ──
  static const Color shadow = Color(0xFF000000);

  // ── 7. Context-Aware Adaptive Helpers ──
  static Color canvas(bool isDark) => isDark ? canvasDark : canvasLight;
  static Color surface(bool isDark) => isDark ? surfaceDark : surfaceLight;
  static Color surfaceSubtle(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? surfaceSubtleDark : surfaceSubtleLight;
  static Color border(bool isDark) => isDark ? borderDark : borderLight;
  static Color borderSubtle(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? borderSubtleDark : borderSubtleLight;
  static Color borderStrong(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? borderStrongDark : borderStrongLight;
  static Color textPrimary(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? textPrimaryDark : textPrimaryLight;
  static Color textSecondary(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? textSecondaryDark : textSecondaryLight;
  static Color textTertiary(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? textTertiaryDark : textTertiaryLight;
  static Color accent(bool isDark) => isDark ? accentDark : accentLight;
  static Color onAccent(bool isDark) => isDark ? onAccentDark : onAccentLight;
  static Color primaryContainer(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? primaryContainerDark : primaryContainerLight;
  static Color onPrimaryContainer(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? onPrimaryContainerDark : onPrimaryContainerLight;
  static Color inverseSurface(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? inverseSurfaceDark : inverseSurfaceLight;
  static Color marja(bool isDark) => isDark ? marjaDark : marjaLight;
  static Color destructive(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? destructiveDark : destructiveLight;
  static Color error(bool isDark) => isDark ? errorDark : errorLight;
  static Color errorContainer(bool isDark) =>
      isDark ? errorContainerDark : errorContainerLight;
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../scholarly_fonts.dart';
import '../localization.dart';

/// OpenTurath Design System — Typography (3-Pilar Arsitektur Baku)
/// 1. Editorial & Heading Layer: Newsreader (Display, Page Title, Nama Kitab Besar)
/// 2. Interface Layer: Outfit (Tombol, Navigasi, Input, Chip, Metadata, Angka Indeks)
/// 3. Arabic & Turats Layer: Scheherazade New (Naskh murni teks Arab, matan, syarah, ibarah)
///
/// Hapus total ketergantungan pada font Amiri dan Tajawal.

/// Skala ukuran huruf tertutup. `screens/` dan `widgets/` tidak boleh menulis
/// angka `fontSize` sendiri; pilih salah satu dari sembilan langkah ini.
abstract final class OTFontSize {
  static const double calendarDay = 32; // Dedicated dual-calendar day role.
  static const double s11 = 11; // Kepala seksi kapital, micro-pill
  static const double s12 = 12; // Keterangan, metadata
  static const double s14 = 14; // Teks antarmuka, tombol
  static const double s16 = 16; // Teks baca Latin, judul kartu
  static const double s18 = 18; // Judul seksi, Arab di daftar
  static const double s20 = 20; // Judul kitab Latin
  static const double s22 = 22; // Arab syarah, wordmark
  static const double s26 = 26; // Judul halaman, Arab matan
  static const double s36 = 36; // Display, satu kali per layar

  static const List<double> scale = [
    s11,
    s12,
    s14,
    s16,
    s18,
    s20,
    s22,
    s26,
    s36
  ];
}

class OTTypography {
  /// Flag to bypass runtime font loading in test and air-gapped environments.
  static bool useSystemFontFallback = false;

  // ── 1. Newsreader (Editorial & Heading) ──
  static TextStyle _newsreader({
    required double fontSize,
    FontWeight? fontWeight,
    double? letterSpacing,
    double? height,
    Color? color,
  }) {
    if (useSystemFontFallback) {
      return TextStyle(
        fontFamily: Loc.isArabic ? 'NativeArabicUI' : 'Newsreader',
        fontSize: fontSize,
        fontWeight: fontWeight,
        letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
        height: Loc.isArabic && (height == null || height < 1.4) ? 1.5 : height,
        color: color,
      );
    }
    return ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
      fontSize: fontSize,
      fontWeight: fontWeight,
      letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
      height: Loc.isArabic && (height == null || height < 1.4) ? 1.5 : height,
      color: color,
    );
  }

  // ── 2. Outfit (Interface, UI, Metadata & Body) ──
  static TextStyle _outfit({
    required double fontSize,
    FontWeight? fontWeight,
    double? letterSpacing,
    double? height,
    Color? color,
  }) {
    if (useSystemFontFallback) {
      return TextStyle(
        fontFamily: Loc.isArabic ? 'NativeArabicUI' : 'Outfit',
        fontSize: fontSize,
        fontWeight: fontWeight,
        letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
        height: Loc.isArabic && (height == null || height < 1.4) ? 1.5 : height,
        color: color,
      );
    }
    return ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
      fontSize: fontSize,
      fontWeight: fontWeight,
      letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
      height: Loc.isArabic && (height == null || height < 1.4) ? 1.5 : height,
      color: color,
    );
  }

  // ── 3. Scheherazade New (Arabic Scholarly Turats) ──
  static TextStyle _scheherazadeNew({
    required double fontSize,
    FontWeight? fontWeight,
    double? letterSpacing,
    double? height,
    Color? color,
  }) {
    if (useSystemFontFallback) {
      return TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Scheherazade New',
        fontSize: fontSize,
        fontWeight: fontWeight,
        letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
        height:
            Loc.isArabic && (height == null || height < 1.85) ? 1.85 : height,
        color: color,
      );
    }
    return ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
      fontSize: fontSize,
      fontWeight: fontWeight,
      letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
      height: Loc.isArabic && (height == null || height < 1.85) ? 1.85 : height,
      color: color,
    );
  }

  // ── Editorial & Heading Styles ──
  static TextStyle brandLogo({Color? color}) => useSystemFontFallback
      ? TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'Newsreader',
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          letterSpacing: -.4,
          color: color)
      : ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          letterSpacing: -.4,
          color: color);

  static TextStyle displayLarge({Color? color}) => _newsreader(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s36,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -1.0,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle pageTitle({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.6,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle editorialHero({Color? color}) => _newsreader(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.4,
        height: 1.25,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle bookTitle({Color? color}) => _newsreader(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s20,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.3,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle screenTitle({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s20,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.3,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle corpusTitle({Color? color}) => _newsreader(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s18,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.2,
        color: color,
      );

  // ── Interface & Body Styles ──
  static TextStyle sectionTitle({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s18,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.2,

  static TextStyle sectionHeading({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: 0.8,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle cardTitle({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.1,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle body({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        height: 1.45,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle bodyMedium({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        height: 1.4,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle caption({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        height: 1.35,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle captionMedium({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle metadataTag({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: 0.8,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle button({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: 0.1,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle price({Color? color}) => _outfit(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        letterSpacing: -0.5,
        color: color,
      );

  // ── Arabic Scholarly Layer (Scheherazade New) ──
  static TextStyle arabicDisplay({Color? color, double height = 1.85}) =>
      _scheherazadeNew(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        height: Loc.isArabic && height < 1.85 ? 1.85 : height,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle arabicReading({Color? color, double height = 1.85}) =>
      _scheherazadeNew(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s18,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        height: Loc.isArabic && height < 1.85 ? 1.85 : height,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle arabicIbarah({Color? color, double height = 1.85}) =>
      _scheherazadeNew(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        height: Loc.isArabic && height < 1.85 ? 1.85 : height,
        color: color,
      );

  static TextStyle arabicQuote({Color? color, double height = 1.85}) =>
      _scheherazadeNew(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        height: Loc.isArabic && height < 1.85 ? 1.85 : height,
        color: color,
      );
}
```

<a name="file-openturath_ai-lib-core-hijri_date_utils-dart"></a>

```dart
import 'localization.dart';

/// Utilitas penanggalan Islam (Hijriah) dan Masehi tabular dan deterministik
/// untuk tajuk editorial OpenTurath.
class HijriDateUtils {
  static ({int day, String month, int year, String era}) hijriParts(
      DateTime date) {
    final h = gregorianToHijri(date);
    return (
      day: h.day,
      month: _hijriMonths[h.month - 1],
      year: h.year,
      era: _hijriEra
    );
  }

  static ({int day, String month, int year, String era}) gregorianParts(
          DateTime date) =>
      (
        day: date.day,
        month: _masehiMonths[date.month - 1],
        year: date.year,
        era: _gregorianEra
      );

  static const List<String> _hijriMonthsId = [
    'Muharram',
    'Shafar',
    'Rabi\'ul Awwal',
    'Rabi\'uts Tsani',
    'Jumadil Ula',
    'Jumadil Akhir',
    'Rajab',
    'Sya\'ban',
    'Ramadhan',
    'Syawwal',
    'Dzulqa\'dah',
    'Dzulhijjah',
  ];

  static const List<String> _masehiMonthsId = [
    'Januari',
    'Februari',
    'Maret',
    'April',
    'Mei',
    'Juni',
    'Juli',
    'Agustus',
    'September',
    'Oktober',
    'November',
    'Desember',
  ];

  static List<String> get _hijriMonths => Loc.language == 'ar'
      ? const [
          'محرم',
          'صفر',
          'ربيع الأول',
          'ربيع الآخر',
          'جمادى الأولى',
          'جمادى الآخرة',
          'رجب',
          'شعبان',
          'رمضان',
          'شوال',
          'ذو القعدة',
          'ذو الحجة'
        ]
      : Loc.language == 'en'
          ? const [
              'Muharram',
              'Safar',
              'Rabi al-Awwal',
              'Rabi al-Thani',
              'Jumada al-Ula',
              'Jumada al-Akhirah',
              'Rajab',
              'Sha‘ban',
              'Ramadan',
              'Shawwal',
              'Dhu al-Qa‘dah',
              'Dhu al-Hijjah'
            ]
          : _hijriMonthsId;
  static List<String> get _masehiMonths => Loc.language == 'ar'
      ? const [
          'يناير',
          'فبراير',
          'مارس',
          'أبريل',
          'مايو',
          'يونيو',
          'يوليو',
          'أغسطس',
          'سبتمبر',
          'أكتوبر',
          'نوفمبر',
          'ديسمبر'
        ]
      : Loc.language == 'en'
          ? const [
              'January',
              'February',
              'March',
              'April',
              'May',
              'June',
              'July',
              'August',
              'September',
              'October',
              'November',
              'December'
            ]
          : _masehiMonthsId;

  static String get _hijriEra => Loc.isArabic
      ? 'هـ'
      : Loc.language == 'en'
          ? 'AH'
          : 'H';
  static String get _gregorianEra => Loc.isArabic
      ? 'م'
      : Loc.language == 'en'
          ? 'CE'
          : 'M';

  static final Map<String, ({int day, int month, int year})> _apiCache = {};

  /// Mengonversi DateTime Masehi ke representasi Hijriah (Tahun, Bulan, Hari).
  /// Memanfaatkan cache API AlAdhan jika tersedia, atau perhitungan aritmetika tabular, bukan penetapan rukyat atau tabel Umm al-Qura.
  static ({int day, int month, int year}) gregorianToHijri(DateTime date) {
    final key = '${date.year}-${date.month}-${date.day}';
    if (_apiCache.containsKey(key)) {
      return _apiCache[key]!;
    }

    int day = date.day;
    int month = date.month;
    int year = date.year;

    int m = month;
    int y = year;
    if (m < 3) {
      y -= 1;
      m += 12;
    }

    int a = y ~/ 100;
    int b = 2 - a + (a ~/ 4);
    int jd = (365.25 * (y + 4716)).toInt() +
        (30.6001 * (m + 1)).toInt() +
        day +
        b -
        1524;

    // Menghitung hari Hijriah dari Julian Day (Epoch 1 Muharram 1 H = JD 1948440)
    int l = jd - 1948440 + 10632;
    int n = (l - 1) ~/ 10631;
    l = l - 10631 * n + 354;
    int j = ((10985 - l) ~/ 5316) * ((50 * l) ~/ 17719) +
        (l ~/ 5670) * ((43 * l) ~/ 15238);
    l = l -
        ((30 - j) ~/ 15) * ((17719 * j) ~/ 50) -
        (j ~/ 16) * ((15238 * j) ~/ 43) +
        29;
    int hMonth = (24 * l) ~/ 709;
    int hDay = l - (709 * hMonth) ~/ 24;
    int hYear = 30 * n + j - 30;

    return (day: hDay.clamp(1, 30), month: hMonth.clamp(1, 12), year: hYear);
  }

  /// Menghasilkan format tanggal ganda yang anggun dan editorial:
  /// Contoh: "26 Shafar 1448 H • 9 September 2026 M"
  static String formatDualDate([DateTime? date]) {
    final now = date ?? DateTime.now();
    final h = gregorianToHijri(now);

    final hMonthName =
        (h.month >= 1 && h.month <= 12) ? _hijriMonths[h.month - 1] : 'Bulan';
    final mMonthName =
        (now.month >= 1 && now.month <= 12) ? _masehiMonths[now.month - 1] : '';

    return '${h.day} $hMonthName ${h.year} $_hijriEra • ${now.day} $mMonthName ${now.year} $_gregorianEra';
  }

  /// Menghasilkan hanya tanggal Hijriah pendek:
  /// Contoh: "26 Shafar 1448 H"
  static String formatHijriOnly([DateTime? date]) {
    final now = date ?? DateTime.now();
    final h = gregorianToHijri(now);
    final hMonthName =
        (h.month >= 1 && h.month <= 12) ? _hijriMonths[h.month - 1] : 'Bulan';
    return '${h.day} $hMonthName ${h.year} $_hijriEra';
  }

  /// Menghasilkan hanya tanggal Masehi pendek:
  /// Contoh: "12 September 2026 M"
  static String formatMasehiOnly([DateTime? date]) {
    final now = date ?? DateTime.now();
    final mMonthName =
        (now.month >= 1 && now.month <= 12) ? _masehiMonths[now.month - 1] : '';
    return '${now.day} $mMonthName ${now.year} $_gregorianEra';
  }

  /// Menambahkan durasi bulan kalender dengan month-end clamping deterministik.
  /// Contoh: 31 Januari + 1 bulan = 28 Februari (atau 29 pada kabisat).
  /// 31 Maret + 1 bulan = 30 April.
  static DateTime addCalendarMonthsClamped(DateTime baseDate, int months) {
    var newYear = baseDate.year;
    var newMonth = baseDate.month + months;
    while (newMonth > 12) {
      newYear++;
      newMonth -= 12;
    }
    while (newMonth < 1) {
      newYear--;
      newMonth += 12;
    }
    final daysInTargetMonth = DateTime(newYear, newMonth + 1, 0).day;
    final clampedDay =
        baseDate.day > daysInTargetMonth ? daysInTargetMonth : baseDate.day;
    return DateTime(
      newYear,
      newMonth,
      clampedDay,
      baseDate.hour,
      baseDate.minute,
      baseDate.second,
      baseDate.millisecond,
      baseDate.microsecond,
    );
  }
}

```

```dart
  final String title;
  final String content;

  const LegalSection({
    this.id = '',
    required this.title,
    required this.content,
  });
}
```

<a name="file-openturath_ai-lib-core-localization-dart"></a>
## File: `openturath_ai/lib/core/localization.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'app_config.dart';
import 'copy_catalog.dart';

class LocaleScope extends InheritedNotifier<ValueNotifier<String>> {
  LocaleScope({super.key, required super.child})
      : super(notifier: AppConfig.localeNotifier);
}

abstract final class Loc {
  static const supportedCodes = ['id', 'en', 'ar'];
  static const supportedLocales = [Locale('id'), Locale('en'), Locale('ar')];
  static const languageNames = {
    'id': 'Bahasa Indonesia',
    'en': 'English',
    'ar': 'العربية'
  };
  static String get language =>
      supportedCodes.contains(AppConfig.localeNotifier.value)
          ? AppConfig.localeNotifier.value
          : 'id';
  static bool get isArabic => language == 'ar';
  static void watch(BuildContext context) {
    context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<LocaleScope>();
  }

  static final Map<String, String> _sourceKeys = {
    for (final entry in copyCatalog.entries)
      for (final value in entry.value) value: entry.key,
  };
  static const _aliases = {
    'app_name': 'appName',
    'available_now': 'readyToUse',
    'coming_soon': 'comingSoon',
    'manage_subscription': 'manageSubscription',
    'settings': 'navSettings',
    'logout': 'logoutButton',
    'welcome': 'ahlanDefault',
    'subtitle_dash': 'defaultFieldDesc',
    'active_sub': 'activeSubscription',
    'valid_until': 'validUntil',
    'full_access': 'fullAccess',
    'unlimited_research': 'academicSlogan',
    'explore_corpus': 'chooseField',
    'theme_mode': 'appearance',
    'theme_system': 'modeSystem',
    'theme_light': 'modeLight',
    'theme_dark': 'modeDark',
    'choose_plan': 'choosePlan',
  };

  /// Mengurung teks kiri-ke-kanan (angka, kode, nama merek) agar urutannya
  /// tidak teracak di tengah kalimat Arab.
  static String ltr(String value) => '\u2066$value\u2069';

  /// "4.800+" atau "4,1 juta+"; dalam bahasa Arab tanda tambah di depan.
  static String atLeast(String number, [String unit = '']) {
    final tail = unit.isEmpty ? '' : ' $unit';
    return language == 'ar' ? '${ltr('+$number')}$tail' : '$number$tail+';
  }

  static String tr(String key, [List<String>? args]) {
    final values = copyCatalog[_aliases[key] ?? key];
    assert(values != null, 'Missing translation: $key');
    var text = values?[supportedCodes.indexOf(language)] ?? key;
    if (args != null) {
      for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
        text = text.replaceAll('{$i}', args[i]);
      }
    }
    return text;
  }

  /// Terjemahkan label katalog statis. Naskah sumber dan nama kitab dipertahankan.
  static String text(String source) {
    final key = _sourceKeys[source];
    return key == null ? source : tr(key);
  }

  static String cleanTitle(String title) => title
      .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^(?:Super\s+)?AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
      .trim();
}
```

## File: `openturath_ai/lib/core/localized_legal.dart`

```dart
import 'legal_copy.dart';
import 'legal_copy_en.dart';
import 'legal_copy_ar.dart';
import 'localization.dart';

enum LegalDocumentId { terms, privacy, refund, guideline, contact }

class LegalDocumentContent {
  const LegalDocumentContent(this.title, this.subtitle, this.sections);
  final String title, subtitle;
  final List<LegalSection> sections;
}

abstract final class LocalizedLegal {
  /// Isolates UI-only Latin identifiers; canonical text remains untouched.
  static String displayBody(String source, {String? locale}) {
    if ((locale ?? Loc.language) != 'ar') return source;
    return source.replaceAllMapped(
        RegExp(
            r'https?://[^\s]+|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}|[0-9]+/[0-9]+'),
        (match) => Loc.ltr(match.group(0)!));
  }

  static List<LegalSection> canonical(LegalDocumentId id) => switch (id) {
        LegalDocumentId.terms => LegalCopy.termsSections,
        LegalDocumentId.privacy => LegalCopy.privacySections,
        LegalDocumentId.refund => LegalCopy.refundSections,
        LegalDocumentId.guideline => LegalCopy.aiGuidelineSections,
        LegalDocumentId.contact => LegalCopy.contactSections,
      };
  static LegalDocumentContent resolve(LegalDocumentId id, {String? locale}) {
    final code = locale ?? Loc.language;
    final source = canonical(id);
    final names = switch (id) {
      LegalDocumentId.terms => [
          LegalCopy.termsTitle,
          'Terms of Service',
          'شروط الخدمة'
        ],
      LegalDocumentId.privacy => [
          LegalCopy.privacyTitle,
          'Privacy Policy',
          'سياسة الخصوصية'
        ],
      LegalDocumentId.refund => [
          LegalCopy.refundTitle,
          'Payment and Refunds',
          'الدفع والاسترداد'
        ],
      LegalDocumentId.guideline => [
          LegalCopy.aiGuidelineTitle,
          'AI Use and Reference Guide',
          'دليل استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي والمراجع'
        ],
      LegalDocumentId.contact => [
          LegalCopy.contactTitle,
          'Support and Contact',
          'الدعم والتواصل'
        ],
    };
    final i = code == 'ar'
        ? 2
        : code == 'en'
            ? 1
            : 0;
    final translated =
        i == 0 ? null : (i == 2 ? legalArabic : legalEnglish)[id.name];
    if (i != 0 && (translated == null || translated.length != source.length)) {
      throw StateError('Incomplete legal translation: ${id.name}/$code');
    }
    return LegalDocumentContent(
        names[i],
        [
          'Versi ${LegalCopy.documentVersion} · Berlaku mulai ${LegalCopy.effectiveDate}',
          'Version ${LegalCopy.documentVersion} · Effective 13 September 2026',
          'الإصدار ${LegalCopy.documentVersion} · نافذ منذ 13 سبتمبر 2026',
        ][i],
        i == 0
            ? source
            : [
                for (var n = 0; n < source.length; n++)
                  LegalSection(
                      id: source[n].id,
                      title: translated![n].$1,
                      content: translated[n].$2)
              ]);
  }
}
```

<a name="file-openturath_ai-lib-core-login_error_message-dart"></a>
## File: `openturath_ai/lib/core/login_error_message.dart`

```dart
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import 'app_copy.dart';

/// Maps SDK failures to useful copy without displaying SDK payloads or tokens.
/// An empty message means the user cancelled the authorization flow.
String loginErrorMessage(Object error) {
  if (error is PlatformException) {
    if (error.code == 'sign_in_canceled') return '';
    if (error.code == 'network_error') return AppCopy.networkError;
    if (error.code == 'sign_in_failed' &&
        '${error.details}'.toLowerCase().contains('keychain')) {
      return AppCopy.desktopKeychainError;
    }
  }
  if (error is FirebaseAuthException) {
    return switch (error.code) {
      'keychain-error' => AppCopy.desktopKeychainError,
      'popup-closed-by-user' || 'canceled' => '',
      'network-request-failed' => AppCopy.networkError,
      _ => AppCopy.googleSignInFailed,
    };
  }
  return AppCopy.googleSignInFailed;
}
```

```dart
import 'app_copy.dart';
import '../models/user_model.dart';

enum MembershipPassState {
  locked,
  trialPro,
  activePro,
  expiringSoon,
  paymentPending,
  paymentFailed,
  permanent,
}

class MembershipPassSummary {
  const MembershipPassSummary({
    required this.state,
    required this.badge,
    required this.accessLabel,
    required this.supportingLabel,
    required this.expiryLabel,
    required this.expiresAt,
    required this.ctaLabel,
    this.agentIds = const [],
  });

  final MembershipPassState state;
  final String badge;
  final String accessLabel;
  final String supportingLabel;
  final String expiryLabel;
  final DateTime? expiresAt;
  final String ctaLabel;
  final List<String> agentIds;

  bool get isOpen => switch (state) {
        MembershipPassState.locked ||
        MembershipPassState.paymentPending ||
        MembershipPassState.paymentFailed =>
          false,
        _ => true,
      };
}

MembershipPassSummary resolveMembershipPass(UserModel? user, {DateTime? now}) {
  final reference = now ?? DateTime.now();
  // Owner-designated VIP status takes precedence over every paid package.
  if (user?.isVip == true) {
    return MembershipPassSummary(
      state: MembershipPassState.permanent,
      badge: 'VIP',
      accessLabel: AppCopy.allAssistantsAvailable,
      supportingLabel: AppCopy.permanentAccessLabel,
      expiryLabel: AppCopy.validUntil,
      expiresAt: null,
      ctaLabel: AppCopy.manageAccess,
    );
  }
  final entitlements =
      user?.entitlements ?? const <String, ModuleEntitlement>{};
  final values = entitlements.entries.toList();
  final active = values.where((entry) {
    final entitlement = entry.value;
    return (entitlement.status == 'active' || entitlement.status == 'trial') &&
        (entitlement.plan == 'permanent' ||
            (entitlement.expiry != null &&
                entitlement.expiry!.isAfter(reference)));
  }).toList();
  if (active.isEmpty && user?.subscriptionExpiry?.isAfter(reference) == true) {
    final expiry = user!.subscriptionExpiry;
    final expiring = expiry != null && expiry.difference(reference).inDays <= 3;
    return MembershipPassSummary(
      state: expiring
          ? MembershipPassState.expiringSoon
          : MembershipPassState.activePro,
      badge: user.isTrial ? 'TRIAL' : 'PRO',
      accessLabel: AppCopy.allAssistantsAvailable,
      supportingLabel:
          expiring ? AppCopy.accessExpiringSoon : AppCopy.readyToUse,
      expiryLabel: AppCopy.validUntil,
      expiresAt: expiry,
      ctaLabel: expiring ? AppCopy.renewPro : AppCopy.manageSubscription,
    );
  }
  if (active.isEmpty) {
    final hasPending = values.any((entry) =>
        entry.value.status == 'pending' ||
        entry.value.paymentStatus == 'pending');
    final hasFailed = values.any((entry) =>
        entry.value.status == 'failed' ||
        entry.value.paymentStatus == 'failed');
    if (hasPending) {
      return _base(
        MembershipPassState.paymentPending,
        AppCopy.preparingProAccess,
        AppCopy.paymentBeingVerified,
        AppCopy.viewPaymentStatus,
        badge: 'GRATIS',
      );
    }
    if (hasFailed) {
      return _base(
        MembershipPassState.paymentFailed,
        AppCopy.accessNotYetActive,
        AppCopy.paymentNotSuccessful,
        AppCopy.tryPaymentAgain,
        badge: 'GRATIS',
      );
    }
    return _base(
      MembershipPassState.locked,
      AppCopy.notSubscribed,
      AppCopy.chooseAssistantAndPlan,
      AppCopy.chooseProPlan,
      badge: 'GRATIS',
    );
  }

  final all = active
      .where((entry) => entry.key == 'all_access' || entry.key == 'all_ai')
      .toList();
  final selected = all.isNotEmpty ? all : active;
  final isTrial = active.every(
      (entry) => entry.value.plan == 'trial' || entry.value.status == 'trial');
  final isPermanent =
      selected.every((entry) => entry.value.plan == 'permanent');
  final expiries = selected
      .map((entry) => entry.value.expiry)
      .whereType<DateTime>()
      .toList()
    ..sort();
  final expiry = expiries.isEmpty ? null : expiries.first;
  final accessLabel = all.isNotEmpty
      ? AppCopy.allAssistantsAvailable
      : AppCopy.assistantsAvailableCount(selected.length);
  if (isPermanent) {
    return MembershipPassSummary(
        state: MembershipPassState.permanent,
        badge: 'PRO',
        accessLabel: accessLabel,
        supportingLabel: AppCopy.permanentAccessLabel,
        expiryLabel: AppCopy.validUntil,
        expiresAt: null,
        ctaLabel: AppCopy.manageAccess,
        agentIds: selected.map((entry) => entry.key).toList());
  }
  if (isTrial) {
    final days = expiry == null ? 0 : expiry.difference(reference).inDays + 1;
    return MembershipPassSummary(
        state: MembershipPassState.trialPro,
        badge: 'TRIAL',
        accessLabel: accessLabel,
        supportingLabel: AppCopy.trialDaysLeft(days),
        expiryLabel: AppCopy.validUntil,
        expiresAt: expiry,
        ctaLabel: AppCopy.chooseProPlan,
        agentIds: selected.map((entry) => entry.key).toList());
  }
  final state = expiry != null && expiry.difference(reference).inDays <= 3
      ? MembershipPassState.expiringSoon
      : MembershipPassState.activePro;
  return MembershipPassSummary(
      state: state,
      badge: 'PRO',
      accessLabel: accessLabel,
      supportingLabel: state == MembershipPassState.expiringSoon
          ? AppCopy.accessExpiringSoon
          : AppCopy.readyToUse,
      expiryLabel: AppCopy.validUntil,
      expiresAt: expiry,
      ctaLabel: state == MembershipPassState.expiringSoon
          ? AppCopy.renewPro
          : AppCopy.manageSubscription,
      agentIds: selected.map((entry) => entry.key).toList());
}

MembershipPassSummary _base(
  MembershipPassState state,
  String access,
  String supporting,
  String cta, {
  String badge = 'GRATIS',
}) =>
    MembershipPassSummary(
      state: state,
      badge: badge,
      accessLabel: access,
      supportingLabel: supporting,
      expiryLabel: AppCopy.validUntil,
      expiresAt: null,
      ctaLabel: cta,
    );
```
