```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// [NavigationGuard] mencegah masalah navigasi bertumpuk (*stacked pages*)
/// yang timbul ketika pengguna mengetuk tombol navigasi secara berulang-ulang
/// dalam jeda waktu singkat saat perangkat sedang sibuk atau mengalami lag.
///
/// Mekanisme penguncian bekerja secara *per-route in-flight window* (450ms),
/// sehingga double tap pada rute yang sama ditolak, namun navigasi anak (child routes)
/// dari dalam halaman yang sedang aktif tetap dapat dibuka secara normal.
class NavigationGuard {
  NavigationGuard._();

  static final Set<String> _inFlightRoutes = <String>{};
  static bool _isCustomNavigating = false;

  /// Mengeksekusi [Navigator.pushNamed] dengan perlindungan *Single-Flight Guard* per-route.
  ///
  /// Kunci dilepaskan otomatis setelah jendela animasi/transisi 450 milidetik selesai,
  /// sehingga rute tidak terkunci selamanya saat halaman masih terbuka di layar.
  static Future<T?> safePushNamed<T>(
    BuildContext context,
    String routeName, {
    Object? arguments,
  }) async {
    if (!context.mounted) return null;

    if (!_inFlightRoutes.add(routeName)) {
      debugPrint('[NavigationGuard] Menolak push duplikat untuk "$routeName" (rute sedang in-flight)');
      return null;
    }

    // Jadwalkan pelepasan kunci rute setelah jendela debounce 450ms
    unawaited(
      Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 450))
          .whenComplete(() => _inFlightRoutes.remove(routeName)),
    );

    try {
      return await Navigator.pushNamed<T>(
        context,
        routeName,
        arguments: arguments,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      _inFlightRoutes.remove(routeName);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Mengeksekusi navigasi kustom dengan pengunci *Single-Flight Guard*.
  static Future<T?> safeNavigate<T>(
    BuildContext context,
    Future<T?> Function() navigationAction,
  ) async {
    if (_isCustomNavigating) {
      debugPrint('[NavigationGuard] Menolak navigasi duplikat (operasi navigasi sedang aktif)');
      return null;
    }

    _isCustomNavigating = true;
    unawaited(
      Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 450))
          .whenComplete(() => _isCustomNavigating = false),
    );

    try {
      if (!context.mounted) return null;
      return await navigationAction();
    } catch (_) {
      _isCustomNavigating = false;
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Reset internal state untuk keperluan unit test.
  @visibleForTesting
  static void resetForTesting() {
    _inFlightRoutes.clear();
    _isCustomNavigating = false;
  }
}
```

```dart
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';

String noteClipboardText(BookmarkModel item) {
  final title = item.title.trim();
  final body = item.fullAnswer.trim();
  if (title.isEmpty) return body;
  if (body.isEmpty) return '# $title';
  return '# $title\n\n$body';
}
```

```dart
class NotebookNavigation {
  // Google redirects the legacy host here. Use the destination directly so
  // unavailable legacy DNS routes cannot prevent the redirect from starting.
  static const canonicalHost = 'notebook.google.com';
  static const canonicalOrigin = 'https://$canonicalHost';
  static const hosts = {
    'notebooklm.google.com',
    'notebook.google.com',
  };
  static const _authenticationHosts = {
    'accounts.google.com',
    'accounts.google.co.id',
    'myaccount.google.com',
    'accounts.youtube.com',
    'consent.google.com',
    'ogs.google.com',
  };
  static const authenticationMessage =
      'Koneksi AI di dalam aplikasi belum mendukung sesi akun ini. '
      'Login ulang OpenTurath tidak menyambungkan sesi AI. '
      'Silakan kembali ke beranda.';

  static bool _trustedHttps(Uri uri) =>
      uri.scheme == 'https' && uri.userInfo.isEmpty && uri.port == 443;

  static bool authentication(Uri uri) =>
      _trustedHttps(uri) &&
      (_authenticationHosts.contains(uri.host.toLowerCase()) ||
          (hosts.contains(uri.host.toLowerCase()) &&
              uri.path
                  .toLowerCase()
                  .split('/')
                  .any(const {'login', 'signin', 'servicelogin'}.contains)));

  /// Halaman milik Google yang dilewati selama proses masuk (verifikasi dua
  /// langkah, penyetelan sesi). Hanya HTTPS ke domain Google; halaman ini
  /// ditampilkan apa adanya, tanpa skrip dari aplikasi.
  static bool signInFlow(Uri uri) {
    if (notebook(uri)) return false;
    if (uri.scheme == 'about' || uri.scheme == 'data' || uri.scheme == 'blob') {
      return true;
    }
    if (!_trustedHttps(uri)) return false;
    final host = uri.host.toLowerCase();
    return authentication(uri) ||
        host == 'google.com' ||
        (host.endsWith('.google.com') && !hosts.contains(host)) ||
        host.endsWith('.google.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.gstatic.com') ||
        host.endsWith('.googleusercontent.com') ||
        host.endsWith('.youtube.com') ||
        host.endsWith('.googleapis.com') ||
        host.endsWith('.recaptcha.net') ||
        RegExp(r'^accounts\.google\.[a-z.]{2,6}$').hasMatch(host);
  }

  // Skrip aplikasi hanya berjalan di halaman notebook, tidak di halaman masuk.
  static bool allowed(Uri uri) =>
      _trustedHttps(uri) &&
      hosts.contains(uri.host.toLowerCase()) &&
      !authentication(uri);

  static bool notebook(Uri uri) => allowed(uri);
}
```

```dart
/// Conversation cleanup and explicit copy capture, restricted to NotebookLM.
const notebookUiScript = r'''
(function () {
  if (window.top !== window || !['notebooklm.google.com', 'notebook.google.com'].includes(location.hostname)) return;
  if (window.otNotebook) {
    window.otOpenLanguageSettings = window.otNotebook.openLanguageSettings;
    window.otDeleteChatHistory = window.otNotebook.deleteChatHistory;
    window.otClearChat = window.otNotebook.clearChat;
    if (typeof window.otNotebook.clean === 'function') {
      window.otNotebook.clean();
    }
    return;
  }
  const answerSelector = '.chat-message[data-sender="model"], .model-message, .response-message, .to-user-container, .to-user-message, .chat-message-pair .answer, [data-message-author-role="assistant"], app-chat-response, app-chat-message, .chat-response, [role="article"], app-chat-turn, chat-turn, [class*="model-turn" i], [class*="model-response" i]';
  const questionSelector = '.chat-message[data-sender="user"], .user-message, .from-user, .to-model-container, [data-message-author-role="user"], app-chat-query, app-chat-prompt, [class*="user-turn" i], [class*="user-query" i], [class*="user-prompt" i]';
  const visible = el => !!el && el.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden' && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none';
  const text = el => (el?.innerText || el?.textContent || '').trim();
  function answerText(el) {
    if (!el) return '';
    const clone = el.cloneNode(true);
    clone.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], .message-actions, .feedback-buttons, [class*="action" i], [class*="feedback" i]').forEach(e => e.remove());
    return text(clone);
  }
  function latest() {
    let answers = [...document.querySelectorAll(answerSelector)].filter(visible);
    if (!answers.length) {
      answers = [...document.querySelectorAll('.rendered-markdown, div[class*="response-container" i], [role="article"]')].filter(visible);
    }
    return answers.length ? answerText(answers[answers.length - 1]) : '';
  }
  function conversation() {
    const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll(questionSelector + ',' + answerSelector)].filter(visible);
    const entries = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    nodes.forEach(node => {
      const value = answerText(node);
      if (!value || seen.has(value)) return;
      const isQuestion = node.matches(questionSelector) || !!node.closest(questionSelector);
      const role = isQuestion ? 'PERTANYAAN' : 'JAWABAN';
      if (entries.some(entry => entry.role === role && entry.value.includes(value))) return;
      entries.push({role, value});
      seen.add(value);
    });
    if (!entries.some(entry => entry.role === 'JAWABAN')) {
      const answer = latest();
      if (answer) entries.push({role: 'JAWABAN', value: answer});
    }
    if (!entries.length) return '';
    const counters = {PERTANYAAN: 0, JAWABAN: 0};
    return entries.map(entry => {
      counters[entry.role] += 1;
      return `${entry.role} ${counters[entry.role]}\n${entry.value}`;

    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim() || value.length > 200000) return;

    if (window.flutter_inappwebview?.callHandler) window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('otCopiedAnswer', value.trim());
  }
  // Tangkap klik pada tombol copy NotebookLM maupun seleksi copy biasa
  let copyUntil = 0;
  let selectedAnswer = '';
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const copyTarget = event.target.closest?.('button, [role="button"], [data-action*="copy" i], [aria-label*="copy" i], [aria-label*="salin" i], .copy-button');
    if (!copyTarget) return;
    const label = [
      copyTarget.getAttribute('aria-label'),
      copyTarget.getAttribute('title'),
      copyTarget.getAttribute('data-action'),
      text(copyTarget),
      copyTarget.className
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    if (!/\b(copy|salin|content_copy)\b|نسخ/i.test(label) && !copyTarget.classList.toString().toLowerCase().includes('copy')) return;

    let answer = copyTarget.closest(answerSelector) ||
                 copyTarget.closest('.chat-message, .chat-response, app-chat-response, app-chat-message, [role="article"], .to-user-container, div[class*="response" i], div[class*="message" i], mat-card, .rendered-markdown');
    let extracted = answer ? answerText(answer) : '';
    if (!extracted) extracted = latest();
    if (!extracted) return;

    selectedAnswer = extracted;

        flex: 0 0 auto !important;

        min-height: 100% !important;
        max-height: none !important;
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;

        min-height: 100% !important;

        flex-direction: column !important;
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
      }
      .chat-message, .model-message, .user-message, .chat-message-pair,
      app-chat-response, app-chat-message, app-chat-query, app-chat-prompt,
      .to-user-container, .to-model-container, [role="article"], .rendered-markdown,
      app-chat-turn, chat-turn, [data-message-author-role] {

        visibility: visible !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
      }
      .dark-theme .rendered-markdown, .dark .rendered-markdown,
      .dark-theme .chat-response, .dark .chat-response,
      .dark-theme .chat-message, .dark .chat-message,
      .dark-theme .model-message, .dark .model-message,
      .dark-theme .user-message, .dark .user-message,
      .dark-theme [role="article"], .dark [role="article"],
      [data-theme="dark"] .rendered-markdown, [data-theme="dark"] .chat-response,
      [data-theme="dark"] .chat-message, [data-theme="dark"] [role="article"] {
        color: #E4E4E7 !important;
      }
      .chat-message-pair:last-child,
      .model-message:last-child,
      .user-message:last-child,
      app-chat-response:last-child,
      app-chat-message:last-child,
      app-chat-turn:last-child,
      chat-turn:last-child,
      .chat-message:last-child,
      [role="article"]:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 120px !important;

      .ot-chat-composer {

        bottom: max(22px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
        left: 50% !important;

        width: calc(100% - 32px) !important;
        max-width: 768px !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;

        z-index: 1000 !important;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
      }
      .ot-chat-composer textarea::placeholder,
      .ot-chat-composer input::placeholder { color: transparent !important; }

      /* Sembunyikan elemen judul, ikon, cover, kartu guide, dan tab-bar agar tampilan bersih murni obrolan */
      .empty-state-header,
      .chat-empty-state-container .empty-state-header,

      [class*="project-cover" i],

      .cover-card,
      [class*="cover-card" i],
      .cover-image-container,
      [class*="cover-image" i],
      [class*="cover-container" i],
      .summary-card,
      [class*="summary-card" i],
      [class*="hero-card" i],
      [class*="hero-container" i],
      [class*="title-card" i],
      [class*="overview-card" i],
      /* Sembunyikan bilah tab Sources | Chat | Studio dan tombol add/upload non-obrolan */
      [role="tablist"],
      .tab-bar, app-tab-bar, .tabs-container, nav[class*="tab" i], div[class*="tab-bar" i],
      mat-tab-header, .mat-mdc-tab-header, .mobile-tab-bar, .mobile-tabs, .mobile-navigation,
      button[aria-label*="Add source" i], button[aria-label*="Tambah sumber" i],
      button[aria-label*="Upload" i], button[aria-label*="Unggah" i],
      app-chat-empty-state h1, app-chat-empty-state h2, app-chat-empty-state h3,
      app-chat-empty-state mat-icon, app-chat-empty-state img, app-chat-empty-state svg,
      app-empty-state h1, app-empty-state h2, app-empty-state h3,
      app-empty-state mat-icon, app-empty-state img, app-empty-state svg,
      .chat-empty-state h1, .chat-empty-state h2, .chat-empty-state h3,
      .chat-empty-state mat-icon, .chat-empty-state img, .chat-empty-state svg,

      /* Pastikan bilah input chat dan komponen di dalamnya selalu terlihat dan interaktif */
      app-chat-input,
      app-chat-input *,

      div.chat-input-container *,

      .input-container *,

      [contenteditable="true"] *,

        visibility: visible !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        pointer-events: auto !important;

      .chat-message-pair, .to-user-container, .to-model-container {

      .chat-panel-content, .chat-view, .conversation-container { scrollbar-width: thin; }
      .rendered-markdown { max-width: 720px; margin-inline: auto; }
      .rendered-markdown p, .rendered-markdown li { unicode-bidi: plaintext; }

      /* Sembunyikan dialog / pop-up selamat datang dan intro Gemini Notebook */
      app-welcome-dialog, app-onboarding-dialog,

      [class*="welcome-dialog" i], [class*="onboarding-dialog" i],

        display: none !important;

        pointer-events: none !important;
      }
    `;
  }

  function removeTopToolbars() {
    const selectors = [
      'body > header', 'top-bar', '.top-bar', 'app-header', '.app-header',
      'mat-toolbar', 'mat-toolbar-row', '.notebook-header', 'app-notebook-header',
      '.project-header', 'app-project-header', 'header', '[role="banner"]',
      'app-chat-header', 'chat-header', '.chat-header', 'app-top-bar', '.mobile-header',
      'app-user-avatar', 'div[class*="gb_"]', '#gb', '#gbwa',
      '[aria-label*="Google apps" i]', '[aria-label*="Aplikasi Google" i]',
      '[aria-label*="Google Account" i]', '[aria-label*="Akun Google" i]',
      'a[href*="myaccount.google.com"]',
      'labs-tailwind-logo', 'a.logo-link', 'a[aria-label*="NotebookLM" i]', 'svg[aria-label*="NotebookLM" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Settings" i]', 'button[aria-label*="Setelan" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Pengaturan" i]', 'button[aria-label*="Notebook settings" i]',
      '.pro-badge', '[class*="pro-badge" i]', '[class*="tier-badge" i]'
    ];
    selectors.forEach(sel => {
      document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => {
        el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      });
    });

    // Preserve response menus, citation actions, and keyboard-accessible controls.
    // Sembunyikan tombol opsi titik tiga (more_vert / more_horiz / options) di luar balon pesan obrolan
    document.querySelectorAll('mat-icon, [data-mat-icon-name]').forEach(icon => {
      const name = (icon.getAttribute('data-mat-icon-name') || icon.getAttribute('fonticon') || icon.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (name === 'more_vert' || name === 'more_horiz') {
        if (icon.closest('.chat-message, .model-message, .user-message, [role="article"], .rendered-markdown, app-chat-response')) {
          return;
        }
        const btn = icon.closest('button, [role="button"]') || icon;
        btn.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        btn.style.setProperty('visibility', 'hidden', 'important');
        btn.style.setProperty('opacity', '0', 'important');
        btn.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'none', 'important');
      }
    });

    // Sembunyikan lencana PRO dengan selektor spesifik (tanpa querySelectorAll(*))
    document.querySelectorAll('.pro-badge, [class*="pro-badge" i], [class*="tier-badge" i], button span, a span').forEach(el => {
      if (el.children.length === 0 && (el.textContent || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'PRO') {
        const badge = el.closest('button, a, span, div');
        if (badge && badge !== document.body && badge.querySelectorAll('textarea, input').length === 0) {
          badge.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        }
      }
    });

    // Sembunyikan baris header atas spesifik tanpa forced layout loop
    document.querySelectorAll('header, [role="banner"], app-top-bar, .top-bar, app-header, mat-toolbar').forEach(el => {
      if (el.children.length > 0 && el.children.length <= 10) {
        const txt = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const hasShared = txt.includes('shared') || txt.includes('dibagikan');
        const hasAvatar = el.querySelector('app-user-avatar, [aria-label*="Google Account" i]');
        if ((hasShared || hasAvatar) && !el.querySelector('textarea, [contenteditable="true"], form')) {
          if (!el.matches('.chat-view, .chat-panel-content, main, [role="main"], app-root')) {
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function removeHeroCard() {
    const isComposerOrInput = el => !el || !!el.closest('app-chat-input, form, .chat-input-container, .query-box-container, textarea, [contenteditable="true"]');
    const isMessageOrBubble = el => !el || !!el.closest('.chat-message, .model-message, .user-message, [role="article"], .rendered-markdown, app-chat-response, app-chat-query, app-chat-prompt, app-chat-turn, chat-turn, [data-message-author-role]');

    // 1. Sembunyikan elemen guide / overview / cover melalui selektor spesifik
    const guideSelectors = [
      'app-notebook-guide', 'notebook-guide', '.notebook-guide', '[class*="notebook-guide" i]',
      'app-guide-card', '.guide-card', '[class*="guide-card" i]',
      'app-artifact-summary', '.artifact-summary', '[class*="artifact-summary" i]',
      'app-project-summary', '.project-summary', '[class*="project-summary" i]',
      'app-notebook-overview', '.notebook-overview', '[class*="notebook-overview" i]',
      'app-guide-intro', '.guide-intro', '[class*="guide-intro" i]',
      'app-notebook-intro', '.notebook-intro', '[class*="notebook-intro" i]',
      'app-project-intro', '.project-intro', '[class*="project-intro" i]',
      'app-notebook-title', 'app-project-title',
      'app-notebook-cover', '.notebook-cover', '[class*="notebook-cover" i]',
      'app-project-cover', '.project-cover', '[class*="project-cover" i]',
      'app-cover-card', '.cover-card', '[class*="cover-card" i]',
      '.cover-image-container', '[class*="cover-image" i]', '[class*="cover-container" i]',
      '.summary-card', '[class*="summary-card" i]',
      '[class*="hero-card" i]', '[class*="hero-container" i]', '[class*="hero-header" i]',
      '[class*="title-card" i]', '[class*="overview-card" i]',
      '.empty-state-header'
    ];
    guideSelectors.forEach(sel => {
      document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => {
        if (!isComposerOrInput(el) && !isMessageOrBubble(el)) {
          el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
          el.style.setProperty('height', '0px', 'important');
          el.style.setProperty('overflow', 'hidden', 'important');
        }
      });
    });

    // 2. Deteksi kartu sampul berbasis teks spesifik "0 sumber · [tanggal]" / "X sources · [date]"
    document.querySelectorAll('span, p, div, small').forEach(el => {
      if (isComposerOrInput(el) || isMessageOrBubble(el)) return;
      if (el.children.length > 2) return;
      const txt = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim();
      if (!txt || txt.length > 60) return;

      const isSourceCount = /^\d+\s*(sumber|source|sources)\s*[·•]/i.test(txt) ||
                            ((txt.includes('sumber') || txt.includes('source')) && (txt.includes('·') || txt.includes('•')) && /\b202\d\b/.test(txt));
      if (!isSourceCount) return;

      // Temukan kartu pembungkusnya (maksimal 3 tingkat ke atas, JANGAN PERNAH menyembunyikan main/chat-view!)
      let target = el;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3 && target.parentElement; i++) {
        const parent = target.parentElement;
        if (parent === document.body || parent.matches('main, [role="main"], app-chat-view, app-chat-panel, app-chat, .chat-panel-content, .chat-view, .conversation-container, .message-list, [role="log"]')) {
          break;
        }
        if (parent.querySelector('textarea, [contenteditable="true"], form')) {
          break;
        }
        if (parent.querySelector('.user-turn, .model-turn, .chat-message, app-chat-response, [role="article"]')) {
          break;
        }
        target = parent;
        if (target.matches('mat-card, [class*="card" i], [class*="guide" i], [class*="hero" i], [class*="cover" i], [class*="summary" i]')) {
          break;
        }
      }
      target.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      target.style.setProperty('height', '0px', 'important');
      target.style.setProperty('min-height', '0px', 'important');
      target.style.setProperty('max-height', '0px', 'important');
      target.style.setProperty('margin', '0px', 'important');
      target.style.setProperty('padding', '0px', 'important');
      target.style.setProperty('overflow', 'hidden', 'important');
    });

    // 3. Pastikan tab Chat selalu aktif jika antarmuka mobile/tab NotebookLM terbuka
    try {
      const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"], button, a');
      for (const tab of tabs) {
        if (isComposerOrInput(tab) || isMessageOrBubble(tab)) continue;
        const txt = (tab.innerText || tab.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (txt === 'chat' || txt === 'obrolan' || txt === 'percakapan') {
          const isSelected = tab.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' ||
                             tab.classList.contains('active') ||
                             tab.classList.contains('selected') ||
                             tab.classList.contains('mat-mdc-tab-active');
          if (!isSelected) {
            tab.click?.();
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 4. Panel pesan obrolan: bersihkan elemen header/cover di atas pesan pertama
    const messageSel = questionSelector + ',' + answerSelector + ', .chat-message-pair, app-chat-turn, chat-turn, app-chat-message, app-chat-response, [data-message-author-role]';
    document.querySelectorAll('.chat-panel-content, .chat-view, .conversation-container, .message-list, [role="log"]').forEach(panel => {
      const messages = [...panel.querySelectorAll(messageSel)].filter(el => !isComposerOrInput(el));
      const firstMessage = messages[0];
      if (firstMessage) {
        let prev = firstMessage.previousElementSibling;
        while (prev) {
          if (!isComposerOrInput(prev)) {
            const prevTxt = (prev.innerText || prev.textContent || '').trim();
            const isSourceHeader = /^\d+\s*(sumber|source|sources)\s*[·•]/i.test(prevTxt) ||
                                   (prev.querySelector('img, svg, mat-icon') && !prev.matches('.user-turn, .model-turn'));
            if (prev.matches('.empty-state-header, app-notebook-guide, notebook-guide, .notebook-guide, app-guide-card, .guide-card, app-notebook-title, app-project-title, app-notebook-cover, .notebook-cover, .cover-emoji, .cover-image-container, app-artifact-summary, .artifact-summary, .summary-card, [class*="hero-header" i], [class*="intro-header" i], app-suggestion-chips, .suggestion-chips') ||
                prev.querySelector('.empty-state-header, app-notebook-cover, .cover-image-container, app-artifact-summary, .artifact-summary, .summary-card') ||
                isSourceHeader) {
              prev.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
              prev.style.setProperty('height', '0px', 'important');
              prev.style.setProperty('overflow', 'hidden', 'important');
            }
          }
          prev = prev.previousElementSibling;
        }
      } else {
        panel.querySelectorAll('.empty-state-header, app-notebook-guide, notebook-guide, .notebook-guide, app-guide-card, .guide-card, app-notebook-title, app-notebook-cover, .notebook-cover, .cover-emoji, [class*="hero-header" i], [class*="intro-header" i], app-chat-empty-state mat-icon, app-chat-empty-state img, app-chat-empty-state svg, app-empty-state mat-icon, app-empty-state img, app-empty-state svg').forEach(el => {
          if (!isComposerOrInput(el) && !isMessageOrBubble(el)) {
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('height', '0px', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('overflow', 'hidden', 'important');
          }
        });
      }
    });

    // Sembunyikan emoji cover / Ka'bah (🕋) jika berdiri sendiri di luar obrolan
    document.querySelectorAll('span, div, p, [role="img"]').forEach(el => {
      if (isComposerOrInput(el) || el.closest('.chat-message, .model-message, .user-message, [role="article"], .rendered-markdown, app-chat-response')) return;
      if (el.children.length === 0) {
        const t = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim();
        if (t === '🕋' || (t.includes('🕋') && t.length <= 4)) {
          el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        }
      }
    });

    // Sembunyikan pesan loading hanya pada leaf node
    document.querySelectorAll('app-loading-screen, .loading-container, div, p, span, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5').forEach(el => {
      if (isComposerOrInput(el) || el.querySelector('.chat-message, [role="article"]')) return;
      if (el.matches('app-loading-screen, .loading-container')) {
        el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        return;
      }
      if (el.children.length === 0) {
        const txt = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (txt && txt.length < 35 && (txt === 'loading notebook...' || txt === 'memuat notebook...' || txt === 'loading notebook' || txt === 'memuat notebook' || txt.includes('loading notebook') || txt.includes('memuat notebook'))) {
          el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function dismissPopups() {
    try {
      const dialogs = document.querySelectorAll(
        'mat-dialog-container, .mat-mdc-dialog-container, [role="dialog"], [aria-modal="true"], .cdk-overlay-pane, app-welcome-dialog, app-onboarding-dialog'
      );

      let foundPromoOrWelcome = false;
      dialogs.forEach(dialog => {
        // Jangan ganggu dialog pemilihan bahasa / menu asisten yang sengaja dibuka
        if (dialog.querySelector('[role="menu"], .mat-mdc-menu-panel, mat-radio-group, [role="radiogroup"], mat-radio-button')) {
          return;
        }

        const fullText = (dialog.innerText || dialog.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const isWelcomeOrPromo =
          fullText.includes('selamat datang') ||
          fullText.includes('welcome') ||
          fullText.includes('gemini notebook') ||
          fullText.includes('fleksibilitas dan kontrol') ||
          fullText.includes('flexibility and control') ||
          fullText.includes('batas diperbarui') ||
          fullText.includes('limits updated') ||
          fullText.includes('data anda dilindungi') ||
          fullText.includes('your data is protected') ||
          fullText.includes('persyaratan layanan') ||
          fullText.includes('terms of service') ||
          fullText.includes('info terbaru');

        if (isWelcomeOrPromo) {
          foundPromoOrWelcome = true;
          // Otomatis klik tombol konfirmasi / tutup agar status tersimpan di backend Google
          const buttons = dialog.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]');
          for (const btn of buttons) {
            const btnText = (btn.innerText || btn.textContent || btn.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const hasCloseIcon = !!btn.querySelector('mat-icon[data-mat-icon-name="close"], mat-icon[fonticon="close"], svg');
            if (btnText === 'oke' || btnText === 'ok' || btnText === 'mengerti' || btnText === 'got it' ||
                btnText === 'close' || btnText === 'tutup' || btnText.includes('close') || hasCloseIcon ||
                btnText === 'lanjutkan' || btnText === 'continue' || btnText === 'setuju' || btnText === 'agree' ||
                btnText === 'mulai' || btnText === 'get started' || btnText === 'accept' || btnText === 'terima') {
              try { btn.click(); break; } catch (_) {}
            }
          }

          dialog.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
          dialog.style.setProperty('opacity', '0', 'important');
          dialog.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'none', 'important');
          dialog.style.setProperty('visibility', 'hidden', 'important');

          const pane = dialog.closest('.cdk-overlay-pane');
          if (pane) {
            pane.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            pane.style.setProperty('opacity', '0', 'important');
            pane.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'none', 'important');
          }
        }
      });

      if (foundPromoOrWelcome) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.cdk-overlay-backdrop').forEach(bd => {
          const activeMenu = document.querySelector('[role="menu"]:not([style*="display: none"]), .mat-mdc-menu-panel:not([style*="display: none"])');
          if (!activeMenu) {
            bd.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            bd.style.setProperty('opacity', '0', 'important');
            bd.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'none', 'important');
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// Desktop releases never inherit Android version numbers or APK URLs.
class PlatformRelease {
  const PlatformRelease(
      {required this.build,
      required this.version,
      required this.url,
      required this.notes,
      this.sha256});

  final String version;
  final Uri url;
  final String notes;

    'openturath.id',
    'www.openturath.id',
    'openturath.ai',
    'www.openturath.ai',
    'openturath.web.app',
    'open-turath.web.app',
    'openturath-ai.web.app',
    'openturath.firebaseapp.com',
    'open-turath.firebaseapp.com',
    'openturath-ai.firebaseapp.com',
  };

  static PlatformRelease? parse(
      Map<String, dynamic> data, TargetPlatform platform) {
    final key = switch (platform) {
      TargetPlatform.android => 'android',
      TargetPlatform.macOS => 'macos',
      TargetPlatform.windows => 'windows',

      release = data; // Preserve the production Android document contract.
    } else {
      return null;
    }

        int.tryParse('${release['build'] ?? release['latest_version_code']}');
    final urlValue = release['url'] ?? release['apk_url'];
    final version = release['version'] ?? release['latest_version'];
    if (build == null ||
        build <= 0 ||
        urlValue is! String ||
        version is! String ||
        version.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(urlValue);
    if (uri == null ||
        uri.scheme != 'https' ||
        uri.userInfo.isNotEmpty ||
        uri.port != 443 ||
        !allowedHosts.contains(uri.host)) {
      return null;
    }
    final path = uri.path.toLowerCase();
    final extensions = switch (platform) {
      TargetPlatform.android => ['.apk'],
      TargetPlatform.macOS => ['.dmg', '.pkg', '.zip'],
      TargetPlatform.windows => [
          '.exe',
          '.msi',
          '.msix',
          '.msixbundle',
          '.zip'
        ],
      _ => <String>[],
    };
    if (!extensions.any(path.endsWith)) return null;
    final hash = release['sha256'];
    return PlatformRelease(
      build: build,
      version: version,
      url: uri,
      notes: (release['notes'] ?? release['release_notes']) is String
          ? (release['notes'] ?? release['release_notes']) as String
          : 'Pembaruan OpenTurath AI',
      sha256: hash is String && RegExp(r'^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(hash)
          ? hash
          : null,
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'localization.dart';

/// Harga perdana resmi. Nilai Rupiah berupa integer, tanpa perhitungan float.
class SubscriptionOffer {
  const SubscriptionOffer({required this.plan, required this.months,
    required this.regularAmount, required this.amount});
  final String plan;
  final int months;
  final int regularAmount;
  final int amount;
  int get savingsPercent => ((regularAmount - amount) * 100 / regularAmount).round();
  String get title => Loc.tr(months == 1 ? 'oneMonth' : months == 6 ? 'sixMonths' : 'oneYear');
  String get period => Loc.tr(months == 1 ? 'perMonth' : months == 6 ? 'perSixMonths' : 'perYear');
  String get priceLabel => ProductPricing.rupiah(amount);
  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
    'name': title, 'price': amount, 'regularPrice': regularAmount,
    'label': priceLabel, 'period': period, 'planId': plan,
    // Harga toko eksternal harus disinkronkan oleh pengelola sebelum dipakai.
    'applyUrl': '',
  };
}

abstract final class ProductPricing {
  static const revision = 'perdana-2026-09-20';
  static const specialist = SubscriptionOffer(
    plan: 'tholib_1m', months: 1, regularAmount: 300000, amount: 50000);
  static const specialists = [
    specialist,
    SubscriptionOffer(plan: 'tholib_6m', months: 6, regularAmount: 1200000, amount: 299000),
    SubscriptionOffer(plan: 'bahits_1y', months: 12, regularAmount: 2400000, amount: 499000),
  ];
  static const tahawwulat = [
    SubscriptionOffer(plan: 'tholib_1m', months: 1, regularAmount: 1000000, amount: 300000),
    SubscriptionOffer(plan: 'tholib_6m', months: 6, regularAmount: 2995000, amount: 1499000),
    SubscriptionOffer(plan: 'bahits_1y', months: 12, regularAmount: 4995000, amount: 1999000),
  ];
  static List<SubscriptionOffer> forAgent(String agentId) =>
      agentId.startsWith('fiqh_tahawwulat') ? tahawwulat : specialists;
  static String rupiah(int amount) => 'Rp ${amount.toString().replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(\d{1,3})(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))'), (match) => '${match[1]}.')}';
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'design/native_fonts.dart';
import 'localization.dart';

abstract final class ScholarlyFonts {
  static TextStyle outfit(
          {TextStyle? textStyle,
          Color? color,
          Color? backgroundColor,
          double? fontSize,
          FontWeight? fontWeight,
          FontStyle? fontStyle,
          double? letterSpacing,
          double? height,
          TextDecoration? decoration}) =>
      Loc.isArabic
          // Antarmuka Arab: font UI (bukan font kitab), tanpa jarak huruf.
          ? (textStyle ?? const TextStyle()).copyWith(
              fontFamily: 'NativeArabicUI',
              fontFamilyFallback: const ['NativeInter'],
              color: color,
              backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
              fontSize: fontSize,
              fontWeight: fontWeight,
              fontStyle: fontStyle,
              letterSpacing: 0,
              height: height == null || height < 1.4 ? 1.5 : height,
              decoration: decoration)
          : NativeFonts.outfit(
              textStyle: textStyle,
              color: color,
              backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
              fontSize: fontSize,
              fontWeight: fontWeight,
              fontStyle: fontStyle,
              letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
              height: height,
              decoration: decoration);
```

```dart
  static TextStyle _fontNewsreader({
    required double fontSize,
    FontWeight? fontWeight,
    Color? color,
    double? letterSpacing,
    double? height,
  }) {
    if (OTTypography.useSystemFontFallback) {
      return TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Newsreader',
        fontSize: fontSize,
        fontWeight: fontWeight,
        color: color,
        letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
        height: height,
      );
    }
    return ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
      fontSize: fontSize,
      fontWeight: fontWeight,
      color: color,
      letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
      height: height,
    );
  }

  static TextStyle _fontOutfit({
    required double fontSize,
    FontWeight? fontWeight,
    Color? color,
    double? letterSpacing,
    double? height,
  }) {
    if (OTTypography.useSystemFontFallback) {
      return TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Outfit',
        fontSize: fontSize,
        fontWeight: fontWeight,
        color: color,
        letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
        height: height,
      );
    }
    return ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
      fontSize: fontSize,
      fontWeight: fontWeight,
      color: color,
      letterSpacing: letterSpacing,
      height: height,
    );
  }

  // ── Text Theme Generator ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /// Satu lapis komponen untuk kedua tema: tombol pil setinggi 48, chip pil,
  /// judul halaman Newsreader, dan bilah navigasi. Layar tidak menimpa ini.
  static ThemeData _withComponents(ThemeData base, bool dark) {
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(dark);
    final muted = OTColors.textSecondary(dark);
    const pill = StadiumBorder();
    const size = Size(0, 48);
    const padding = EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24);
    final label = OTTypography.button();
    final filled = FilledButton.styleFrom(
      backgroundColor: OTColors.accent(dark),
      foregroundColor: OTColors.onAccent(dark),
      disabledBackgroundColor: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
      disabledForegroundColor: muted,
      elevation: 0,
      minimumSize: size,
      padding: padding,
      shape: pill,
      textStyle: label,
    );
    TextStyle navLabel(Set<WidgetState> states) => OTTypography.caption(
          color: states.contains(WidgetState.selected) ? ink : muted,
        ).copyWith(
            fontWeight: states.contains(WidgetState.selected)
                ? FontWeight.w600
                : FontWeight.w400);
    IconThemeData navIcon(Set<WidgetState> states) => IconThemeData(
        size: 24, color: states.contains(WidgetState.selected) ? ink : muted);
    return base.copyWith(
      appBarTheme: base.appBarTheme
          .copyWith(titleTextStyle: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: ink)),
      filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(style: filled),
      elevatedButtonTheme: ElevatedButtonThemeData(style: filled),
      outlinedButtonTheme: OutlinedButtonThemeData(
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          foregroundColor: ink,
          side: BorderSide(color: OTColors.borderStrong(dark)),
          minimumSize: size,
          padding: padding,
          shape: pill,
          textStyle: label,
        ),
      ),
      textButtonTheme: TextButtonThemeData(
        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
          foregroundColor: ink,
          minimumSize: const Size(0, 44),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
          shape: pill,
          textStyle: label,
        ),
      ),
      chipTheme: ChipThemeData(
        backgroundColor: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
        selectedColor: OTColors.accent(dark),
        disabledColor: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
        side: BorderSide.none,
        shape: pill,
        showCheckmark: false,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
        labelStyle: OTTypography.captionMedium(
          color: WidgetStateColor.resolveWith((states) =>
              states.contains(WidgetState.selected)
                  ? OTColors.onAccent(dark)
                  : ink),
        ),
      ),
      navigationBarTheme: NavigationBarThemeData(
        backgroundColor: OTColors.surface(dark),
        indicatorColor: OTColors.primaryContainer(dark),
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        height: 68,
        labelTextStyle: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith(navLabel),
        iconTheme: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith(navIcon),
      ),
      navigationRailTheme: NavigationRailThemeData(
        backgroundColor: OTColors.surface(dark),
        indicatorColor: OTColors.primaryContainer(dark),
        selectedIconTheme: IconThemeData(size: 24, color: ink),
        unselectedIconTheme: IconThemeData(size: 24, color: muted),
        selectedLabelTextStyle: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: ink),
        unselectedLabelTextStyle: OTTypography.body(color: muted),
      ),
    );
  }

  static TextTheme _buildTextTheme(Brightness brightness) {
    final isDark = brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final primary = isDark ? textPrimaryDark : textPrimaryLight;
    final secondary = isDark ? textSecondaryDark : textSecondaryLight;
    final tertiary = isDark ? textTertiaryDark : textTertiaryLight;

    return TextTheme(
      displayLarge: _fontNewsreader(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s36,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          color: primary,
          letterSpacing: -0.6),
      displayMedium: _fontNewsreader(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: primary,
          letterSpacing: -0.4),
      headlineLarge: _fontNewsreader(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: primary,
          letterSpacing: -0.3),
      headlineMedium: _fontNewsreader(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s20,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: primary,
          letterSpacing: -0.2),
      titleLarge: _fontNewsreader(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: primary,
          letterSpacing: -0.1),
      titleMedium: _fontOutfit(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: primary),
      titleSmall: _fontOutfit(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: secondary),
      bodyLarge: _fontOutfit(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          color: primary,
          height: 1.55),
      bodyMedium: _fontOutfit(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          color: secondary,
          height: 1.45),
      bodySmall: _fontOutfit(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          color: tertiary,
          height: 1.4),
      labelLarge: _fontOutfit(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: primary),
      labelSmall: _fontOutfit(
          fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          color: tertiary,
          letterSpacing: 0.2),
    );
  }
```

```dart
import 'core/app_platform.dart';
import 'screens/browser_workspace_screen.dart';
import 'services/desktop_webview_runtime.dart';
import 'services/agent_session_manager.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart';
import 'core/theme.dart';
import 'core/routes.dart';
import 'screens/splash_screen.dart';
import 'screens/login_screen.dart';
import 'screens/main_shell_screen.dart';
import 'screens/specialist_list_screen.dart';
import 'screens/bookmark_screen.dart';
import 'screens/profile_screen.dart';
import 'screens/subscription_screen.dart';
import 'screens/google_session_auth_screen.dart';
import 'screens/book_catalog_screen.dart';
import 'screens/book_detail_screen.dart';
import 'models/book_model.dart';
import 'models/agent_model.dart';
import 'firebase_options.dart';

import 'core/app_config.dart';
import 'core/app_copy.dart';
import 'core/localization.dart';
import 'services/telemetry_service.dart';
import 'widgets/app_error_state.dart';

// The browser workspace remains available only as an explicit development
// experiment. The shipped entry keeps OpenTurath's native application shell.
const _browserWorkspaceExperiment = bool.fromEnvironment(
  'OPENTURATH_BROWSER_EXPERIMENT',
  defaultValue: false,
);

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  if (_browserWorkspaceExperiment) {
    try {
      await AppConfig.init();
    } catch (_) {}
    runApp(const BrowserWorkspaceExperimentApp());
    return;
  }

  // ── Kunci orientasi: hanya portrait ──
  if (AppPlatform.isAndroid) {
    await SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations([
      DeviceOrientation.portraitUp,
      DeviceOrientation.portraitDown,
    ]);
  }
  await DesktopWebViewRuntime.prepare();

  // Load configuration
  try {
    await AppConfig.init();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    AgentSessionTab.defaultFontScale =
        prefs.getDouble('turath_font_zoom_level') ?? 1.0;
  } catch (_) {}

  // ── Status bar transparan awal ──
  SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle(
    const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
      statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
      statusBarIconBrightness: Brightness.dark,
    ),
  );

  try {
    // ── Inisialisasi Firebase ──
    await Firebase.initializeApp(
      options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform,
    );
    // ── Inisialisasi Silent Telemetry ──
    TelemetryService.instance.init();
    runApp(const OpenTurathApp());
  } catch (error, stackTrace) {
    debugPrint(
        '[OpenTurath] Firebase initialization error: $error\n$stackTrace');
    TelemetryService.instance.reportError(
      error,
      stackTrace,
      context: 'firebase_init_failure',
      severity: 'critical',
    );
    final isUnsupportedPlatform = error is UnsupportedError;
    final title = isUnsupportedPlatform
        ? AppCopy.deviceNotSupportedTitle
        : AppCopy.cannotConnectTitle;
    final message = isUnsupportedPlatform
        ? AppCopy.deviceNotSupportedMessage
        : AppCopy.cannotConnectMessage;

    runApp(MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      theme: AppTheme.darkTheme,
      home: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.canvasDark,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: AppErrorState(
            title: title,
            message: message,
            onRetry: () => main(),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ));
  }
}

class OpenTurathApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const OpenTurathApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    return ValueListenableBuilder<ThemeMode>(
      valueListenable: AppConfig.themeNotifier,
      builder: (context, currentTheme, _) {
        return ValueListenableBuilder<String>(
          valueListenable: AppConfig.localeNotifier,
          builder: (context, currentLocale, _) {
            final platformBrightness =
                MediaQuery.maybePlatformBrightnessOf(context) ??
                    WidgetsBinding
                        .instance.platformDispatcher.platformBrightness;
            final isDark = currentTheme == ThemeMode.dark ||
                (currentTheme == ThemeMode.system &&
                    platformBrightness == Brightness.dark);

            final overlayStyle = SystemUiOverlayStyle(
              statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
              statusBarIconBrightness:
                  isDark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,
              systemNavigationBarColor:
                  isDark ? AppTheme.canvasDark : AppTheme.canvasLight,
              systemNavigationBarIconBrightness:
                  isDark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,
              systemNavigationBarDividerColor: Colors.transparent,
            );

            return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
              value: overlayStyle,
              child: MaterialApp(
                title: AppCopy.appName,
                debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
                theme: AppTheme.lightTheme,
                darkTheme: AppTheme.darkTheme,
                themeMode: currentTheme,
                locale: Locale(currentLocale),
                supportedLocales: Loc.supportedLocales,
                localizationsDelegates: GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegates,
                builder: (context, child) => LocaleScope(
                    child: Directionality(
                  textDirection: currentLocale == 'ar'
                      ? TextDirection.rtl
                      : TextDirection.ltr,
                  child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
                )),

                // ── Initial Route ──
                initialRoute: AppRoutes.splash,

                // ── Dynamic Route Generator with M3 Expressive Transitions ──
                onGenerateRoute: (settings) {
                  Widget page;
                  switch (settings.name) {
                    case AppRoutes.splash:
                      page = const SplashScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.login:
                      page = const LoginScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.dashboard:
                      page = const MainShellScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.specialistList:
                      page = const SpecialistListScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.bookmark:
                      page = const BookmarkScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.profile:
                      page = const ProfileScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.agentWebview:
                      // Jalur lama tetap kompatibel, tetapi selalu kembali ke
                      // shell yang memiliki ruang kajian multi-tab persisten.
                      // Ini mencegah dua WebView dengan perilaku copy/close
                      // yang berbeda hidup bersamaan.
                      page = const MainShellScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.subscription:
                      page = const SubscriptionScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.googleSessionAuth:
                      page = const GoogleSessionAuthScreen();
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.bookCatalog:
                      page = BookCatalogScreen(
                        agent: settings.arguments is AgentModel
                            ? settings.arguments as AgentModel
                            : null,
                      );
                      break;
                    case AppRoutes.bookDetail:
                      final book =
                          settings.arguments as CanonicalBookPresentation;
                      page = BookDetailScreen(book: book);
                      break;
                    default:
                      page = const SplashScreen();
                      break;
                  }

                  // Default Material 3 Expressive transition: FadeUpTransition (fade + subtle 30px slide-up)
                  return PageRouteBuilder(
                    settings: settings,
                    pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
                        page,
                    transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
                    reverseTransitionDuration:
                        const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
                    transitionsBuilder:
                        (context, animation, secondaryAnimation, child) {
                      final curvedAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
                        parent: animation,
                        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                        reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
                      );
                      return SlideTransition(
                        position: Tween<Offset>(
                          begin: const Offset(0.0, 0.015),
                          end: Offset.zero,
                        ).animate(curvedAnimation),
                        child: FadeTransition(
                          opacity: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0)
                              .animate(curvedAnimation),
                          child: child,
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  );
                },
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Development-only entry for the previously published browser experiment.
class BrowserWorkspaceExperimentApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const BrowserWorkspaceExperimentApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ValueListenableBuilder<ThemeMode>(
        valueListenable: AppConfig.themeNotifier,
        builder: (context, mode, _) => MaterialApp(
          title: AppCopy.appName,
          debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
          theme: AppTheme.lightTheme,
          darkTheme: AppTheme.darkTheme,
          themeMode: mode,
          home: const BrowserWorkspaceScreen(),
        ),
      );
}
```

```dart
import '../core/localization.dart';

import 'book_model.dart';

enum CorpusKind { discipline, scholar }

class AgentModel {
  final String id;
  final String _title;
  String get title {
    final label =
        Loc.isArabic && titleArabic.isNotEmpty ? titleArabic : Loc.text(_title);
    return label.startsWith('AI ') ? label : 'AI $label';
  }

  final String titleArabic;
  final String description;
  final String emoji;
  final String category;
  final String status; // 'active' or 'coming_soon'
  final int sortOrder;
  final String _subtitleAcademic;
  String get subtitleAcademic => Loc.text(_subtitleAcademic);
  final String fieldId;
  final List<String> suggestedPrompts;
  final List<SubAgentModel>? subAgents;
  final List<BookModel>? referenceBooks;
  final String? akalUrl1m;
  final String? akalUrl6m;
  final String? akalUrl1y;
  final int? price1m;
  final int? price6m;
  final int? price1y;
  final CorpusKind kind;
  final List<String> disciplineIds;
  final List<String> scholarIds;
  final String? catalogId;

  AgentModel({
    required this.id,
    required String title,
    this.titleArabic = '',
    required this.description,
    required this.emoji,
    required this.category,
    required this.status,
    required this.sortOrder,
    String subtitleAcademic = 'Matan · Syarah · Hasyiyah',
    this.fieldId = 'fiqh',
    this.suggestedPrompts = const [],
    this.subAgents,
    this.referenceBooks,
    this.akalUrl1m,
    this.akalUrl6m,
    this.akalUrl1y,
    this.price1m,
    this.price6m,
    this.price1y,
    this.kind = CorpusKind.discipline,
    this.disciplineIds = const [],
    this.scholarIds = const [],
    this.catalogId,
  })  : _title = title,
        _subtitleAcademic = subtitleAcademic;

  bool get isActive => status == 'active';
  bool get isComingSoon => status == 'coming_soon';

  factory AgentModel.fromFirestore(DocumentSnapshot doc) {
    final data = doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;
    return AgentModel(
      id: doc.id,
      title: data['title'] ?? '',
      titleArabic: data['title_arabic'] ?? '',
      description: data['description'] ?? '',
      emoji: data['emoji'] ?? '📖',
      category: data['category'] ?? 'Fiqh',
      status: data['status'] ?? 'coming_soon',
      sortOrder: data['sort_order'] ?? 99,
      subtitleAcademic:

      fieldId: data['field_id'] ?? 'fiqh',

      price6m: data['price_6m'],

      kind: data['kind'] == 'scholar'
          ? CorpusKind.scholar
          : CorpusKind.discipline,
      disciplineIds: List<String>.from(data['discipline_ids'] ?? []),
      scholarIds: List<String>.from(data['scholar_ids'] ?? []),
      catalogId: data['catalog_id'],
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// Locator rujukan satu kutipan pada jawaban asisten. Disimpan bersama catatan
/// agar jawaban yang diarsipkan tetap bisa ditelusuri ke sumbernya.
@immutable
class AnswerCitation {
  const AnswerCitation({
    required this.sourceId,
    required this.number,
    this.excerpt,
  });

  final String sourceId;
  final int number;
  final String? excerpt;

  String get display => excerpt == null || excerpt!.isEmpty
      ? 'Rujukan [$number]'
      : '[$number] $excerpt';

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'sourceId': sourceId,
        'number': number,
        'excerpt': excerpt,
      };

  static AnswerCitation? tryParse(Object? value) {
    if (value is! Map) return null;
    final sourceId = value['sourceId'];
    final number = value['number'];
    final excerpt = value['excerpt'];
    if (sourceId is! String || sourceId.isEmpty || number is! int) return null;
    return AnswerCitation(
      sourceId: sourceId,
      number: number,
      excerpt: excerpt is String ? excerpt : null,
    );
  }

  static List<AnswerCitation> listFromJson(Object? value) => value is List
      ? value.map(tryParse).whereType<AnswerCitation>().toList()
      : const [];

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is AnswerCitation &&
      other.sourceId == sourceId &&
      other.number == number &&
      other.excerpt == excerpt;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(sourceId, number, excerpt);
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

/// Legacy book reference model used in [AgentModel].
class BookModel {
  final String title;
  final String titleArabic;
  final String author;
  final String description;
  final String? url;

  BookModel({
    required this.title,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.author,
    required this.description,
    this.url,
  });
}

/// Raw imported canonical catalog entry from dataset (e.g. 01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json).
/// Preserves raw bibliographical fields without premature editorial assumptions.
class CanonicalEntry {
  const CanonicalEntry({
    required this.legacyKey,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.shortTitleArabic,
    required this.authorArabic,
    required this.authorFull,
    required this.recordedDeathYearHijri,
    required this.eraCode,
    required this.textTypeCode,
    required this.recordedAuthorityRank,
    required this.recordedVolumes,
    required this.publisher,
    required this.muhaqqiq,
    required this.raw,
  });

  final String legacyKey;
  final String titleArabic, shortTitleArabic, authorArabic, authorFull;
  final int? recordedDeathYearHijri;
  final String? eraCode, textTypeCode;
  final int? recordedAuthorityRank, recordedVolumes;
  final String? publisher, muhaqqiq;
  final Map<String, dynamic> raw;

  factory CanonicalEntry.fromLegacy(
    String key,
    Map<String, dynamic> row,
  ) {
    String? text(String name) {
      final value = row[name];
      if (value == null) return null;
      if (value is! String) {
        throw FormatException('$key: $name harus berupa teks');
      }
      final clean = value.trim();
      return clean.isEmpty ? null : clean;
    }

    String requiredText(String name) {
      final value = text(name);
      if (value == null) throw FormatException('$key: $name kosong');
      return value;
    }

    int? integer(String name) {
      final value = row[name];
      if (value == null || value == '') return null;
      if (value is! int || value < 0) {
        throw FormatException('$key: $name harus integer nonnegatif');
      }
      return value;
    }

    return CanonicalEntry(
      legacyKey: key,
      titleArabic: requiredText('full_title'),
      shortTitleArabic: requiredText('canonical_short_title'),
      authorArabic: requiredText('author_canonical'),
      authorFull: requiredText('author_full'),
      recordedDeathYearHijri: integer('death_year_hijri'),
      eraCode: text('era'),
      textTypeCode: text('text_type'),
      recordedAuthorityRank: integer('authority_rank'),
      recordedVolumes: integer('volumes_count'),
      publisher: text('publisher'),
      muhaqqiq: text('muhaqqiq'),
      raw: Map<String, dynamic>.unmodifiable(row),
    );
  }
}

class CanonicalImport {
  const CanonicalImport(this.entries, this.issues);
  final List<CanonicalEntry> entries;
  final List<String> issues; // Internal validation log; bukan copy publik.
}

CanonicalImport parseCanonicalCatalog(String source) {
  final root = jsonDecode(source);
  if (root is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
    throw const FormatException('Root katalog harus object JSON');
  }
  final entries = <CanonicalEntry>[];
  final issues = <String>[];
  for (final item in root.entries) {
    try {
      final row = item.value;
      if (row is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
        throw FormatException('${item.key}: entri bukan object');
      }
      entries.add(CanonicalEntry.fromLegacy(item.key, row));
    } on FormatException catch (error) {
      issues.add(error.message.toString());
    }
  }
  return CanonicalImport(
    List<CanonicalEntry>.unmodifiable(entries),
    List<String>.unmodifiable(issues),
  );
}

List<CanonicalBookPresentation> parseSyamilahCatalog(String source) {
  final dynamic root = jsonDecode(source);
  final dynamic list = root is List
      ? root
      : (root is Map<String, dynamic> ? (root['kitab'] ?? root['books']) : null);
  if (list is List) {
    return list
        .whereType<Map<String, dynamic>>()
        .map((item) => CanonicalBookPresentation.fromSyamilahCard(item))
        .toList();
  } else if (root is Map<String, dynamic>) {
    final legacy = parseCanonicalCatalog(source);
    return legacy.entries.map((e) => CanonicalBookPresentation.fromEntry(e)).toList();
  }
  return [];
}

/// Presentation model for catalog books reviewed for display.
/// Prevents UI widgets from turning unverified authority ranks into scientific claims.
class CanonicalBookPresentation {
  const CanonicalBookPresentation({
    required this.editionId,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.authorArabic,
    this.shortTitleArabic,
    this.sectionArabic,
    this.titleLatin,
    this.authorLatin,
    this.verifiedDeathYearHijri,
    this.reviewedTypeLabel,
    this.reviewedEraLabel,
    this.reviewedAuthorityLabel,
    this.authorityEvidence,
    this.publisher,
    this.muhaqqiq,
    this.printYear,
    this.volumesDescription,
    this.volumesCount,
    this.pagesDescription,
  });

  final String editionId, titleArabic, authorArabic;
  final String? shortTitleArabic;
  final String? sectionArabic;
  final String? titleLatin, authorLatin;
  final int? verifiedDeathYearHijri;
  final String? reviewedTypeLabel, reviewedEraLabel;
  final String? reviewedAuthorityLabel, authorityEvidence;
  final String? publisher, muhaqqiq;
  final String? printYear;
  final String? volumesDescription;
  final int? volumesCount;
  final String? pagesDescription;

  List<String> get compactLabels => [
        if (sectionArabic != null && sectionArabic!.isNotEmpty) sectionArabic!,
        if (volumesDescription != null && volumesDescription!.isNotEmpty)
          (volumesDescription!.contains('جزء') || volumesDescription!.contains('مجلد') || volumesDescription!.contains('Jilid')
              ? volumesDescription!
              : '$volumesDescription Jilid')
        else if (volumesCount != null && volumesCount! > 1)
          '$volumesCount Jilid',
        if (pagesDescription != null && pagesDescription!.isNotEmpty && pagesDescription != '-')
          '$pagesDescription Hlm',
        if (verifiedDeathYearHijri != null && verifiedDeathYearHijri! > 0)
          'ت $verifiedDeathYearHijri هـ',
        if (reviewedTypeLabel != null) reviewedTypeLabel!,
        if (reviewedEraLabel != null) reviewedEraLabel!,
      ].where((l) => l.isNotEmpty).toList();

  bool get canShowAuthority =>
      reviewedAuthorityLabel?.isNotEmpty == true &&
      authorityEvidence?.isNotEmpty == true;

  factory CanonicalBookPresentation.fromSyamilahCard(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final rawDeath = json['tahun_wafat'];
    int? deathYear;
    if (rawDeath is int) {
      deathYear = rawDeath;
    } else if (rawDeath is String) {
      deathYear = int.tryParse(rawDeath);
    }

    String? clean(dynamic v) {
      if (v == null) return null;
      final s = v.toString().trim();
      return (s.isEmpty || s == '-') ? null : s;
    }

    final rawVolumes = clean(json['عدد_الأجزاء']);
    int? volCount;
    if (rawVolumes != null) {
      final match = RegExp(r'^\d+').firstMatch(rawVolumes);
      if (match != null) {
        volCount = int.tryParse(match.group(0)!);
      }
    }

    final rawPages = clean(json['عدد_الصفحات']);
    final fullTitle = (json['الكتاب'] ?? json['full_title'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final shortTitle = clean(json['الاسم_المختصر'] ?? json['canonical_short_title']);
    final author = (json['المؤلف'] ?? json['author_canonical'] ?? json['author_full'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final section = clean(json['القسم']);
    final publisher = clean(json['الناشر'] ?? json['publisher']);
    final muhaqqiq = clean(json['المحقق_أو_المعتني'] ?? json['muhaqqiq']);
    final printYear = clean(json['سنة_الطبع_والطبعة'] ?? json['سنة_الطبع']);
    final id = json['id']?.toString() ?? json['edition_id']?.toString() ?? '1';

    return CanonicalBookPresentation(
      editionId: id,
      titleArabic: fullTitle.isNotEmpty ? fullTitle : (shortTitle ?? 'بدون عنوان'),
      shortTitleArabic: shortTitle,
      authorArabic: author.isNotEmpty ? author : 'غير معروف',
      sectionArabic: section,
      verifiedDeathYearHijri: deathYear,
      publisher: publisher,
      muhaqqiq: muhaqqiq,
      printYear: printYear,
      volumesDescription: rawVolumes,
      volumesCount: volCount,
      pagesDescription: rawPages,
    );
  }

  factory CanonicalBookPresentation.fromEntry(CanonicalEntry entry) {
    String? typeLabel;
    if (entry.textTypeCode != null) {
      switch (entry.textTypeCode) {
        case 'asl_al_madhhab':
          typeLabel = 'Asal Mazhab';
          break;
        case 'matn':
          typeLabel = 'Matan';
          break;
        case 'sharh':
          typeLabel = 'Syarah';
          break;
        case 'hashiyah':
          typeLabel = 'Hasyiyah';
          break;
        case 'khilafiyyat':
          typeLabel = 'Khilafiyyah';
          break;
        case 'fatawa':
          typeLabel = 'Fatwa';
          break;
        case 'ajwibah':
          typeLabel = 'Ajwibah';
          break;
        case 'qawaid':
          typeLabel = 'Qawa\'id';
          break;
        default:
          typeLabel = entry.textTypeCode!.replaceAll('_', ' ');
      }
    }

    String? eraLabel;
    if (entry.eraCode != null) {
      switch (entry.eraCode) {
        case 'mutaqaddimin':
          eraLabel = 'Mutaqaddimin';
          break;
        case 'ashab_al_wujuh':
          eraLabel = 'Ashab Al-Wujuh';
          break;
        case 'mutaakhkhirin':
          eraLabel = 'Muta\'akhkhirin';
          break;
        default:
          eraLabel = entry.eraCode!.replaceAll('_', ' ');
      }
    } else if (entry.recordedDeathYearHijri != null) {
      final y = entry.recordedDeathYearHijri!;
      if (y <= 505) {
        eraLabel = 'Mutaqaddimin';
      } else {
        eraLabel = 'Muta\'akhkhirin';
      }
    }

    return CanonicalBookPresentation(
      editionId: entry.legacyKey,
      titleArabic: entry.titleArabic,
      authorArabic: entry.authorArabic,
      titleLatin: null,
      authorLatin: null,
      verifiedDeathYearHijri: entry.recordedDeathYearHijri,
      reviewedTypeLabel: typeLabel,
      reviewedEraLabel: eraLabel,
      reviewedAuthorityLabel: null, // Held until editorial consensus
      authorityEvidence: null,
      publisher: entry.publisher,
      muhaqqiq: entry.muhaqqiq,
      volumesCount: entry.recordedVolumes,
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'answer_citation.dart';

enum BookmarkDocumentKind { personalNote, aiAnswer, bookReference }

enum BookmarkVerificationStatus {
  notApplicable,
  unverified,
  needsReview,
  verified
}

class BookmarkModel {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  final String agentId;
  final String agentTitle;
  final String fieldName;
  final String fieldId;
  final String arabicExcerpt;
  final String fullAnswer;
  final String bookReference;
  final String pageNumber;
  final String? author;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final DateTime? updatedAt;
  /// Tombstone for conflict-safe offline deletion. It is synchronized so an
  /// older device cannot resurrect a note that was deliberately removed.
  final DateTime? deletedAt;
  final BookmarkDocumentKind documentKind;
  final BookmarkVerificationStatus verificationStatus;

  /// Locator sumber untuk jawaban asisten; kosong untuk catatan pribadi.
  final List<AnswerCitation> citations;

  BookmarkModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.agentId,
    required this.agentTitle,
    required this.fieldName,
    required this.fieldId,
    required this.arabicExcerpt,
    required this.fullAnswer,
    required this.bookReference,
    required this.pageNumber,
    this.author,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.updatedAt,
    this.deletedAt,
    this.documentKind = BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer,
    this.verificationStatus = BookmarkVerificationStatus.unverified,
    this.citations = const [],
  });

  DateTime get effectiveTime => updatedAt ?? createdAt;
  DateTime get syncTime => deletedAt ?? effectiveTime;
  bool get isDeleted => deletedAt != null;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'title': title,
      'agentId': agentId,
      'agentTitle': agentTitle,
      'fieldName': fieldName,
      'fieldId': fieldId,
      'arabicExcerpt': arabicExcerpt,
      'fullAnswer': fullAnswer,
      'bookReference': bookReference,
      'pageNumber': pageNumber,
      'author': author,
      'createdAt': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      'updatedAt': (updatedAt ?? createdAt).toIso8601String(),
      'deletedAt': deletedAt?.toIso8601String(),
      'documentKind': documentKind.name,
      'verificationStatus': verificationStatus.name,
      if (citations.isNotEmpty)
        'citations': citations.map((citation) => citation.toJson()).toList(),
    };
  }

  factory BookmarkModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final id = json['id'] as String? ?? '';
    final agentId = json['agentId'] as String? ?? '';
    final fieldName = json['fieldName'] as String? ?? '';
    final kind = _documentKindFromJson(
      json['documentKind'] as String?,
      id: id,
      agentId: agentId,
      fieldName: fieldName,
    );
    return BookmarkModel(
      id: id,
      title: json['title'] as String? ?? '',
      agentId: agentId,
      agentTitle: json['agentTitle'] as String? ?? '',
      fieldName: fieldName,
      fieldId: json['fieldId'] as String? ?? 'fiqh',
      arabicExcerpt: json['arabicExcerpt'] as String? ?? '',
      fullAnswer: json['fullAnswer'] as String? ?? '',
      bookReference: json['bookReference'] as String? ?? '',
      pageNumber: json['pageNumber'] as String? ?? '',
      author: json['author'] as String?,
      createdAt: json['createdAt'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['createdAt'] as String) ?? DateTime.now()
          : DateTime.now(),
      updatedAt: json['updatedAt'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['updatedAt'] as String)
          : null,
      deletedAt: json['deletedAt'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['deletedAt'] as String)
          : null,
      documentKind: kind,
      verificationStatus: _verificationStatusFromJson(
        json['verificationStatus'] as String?,
        kind,
      ),
      citations: AnswerCitation.listFromJson(json['citations']),
    );
  }

  BookmarkModel copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? title,
    String? agentId,
    String? agentTitle,
    String? fieldName,
    String? fieldId,
    String? arabicExcerpt,
    String? fullAnswer,
    String? bookReference,
    String? pageNumber,
    String? author,
    DateTime? createdAt,
    DateTime? updatedAt,
    DateTime? deletedAt,
    BookmarkDocumentKind? documentKind,
    BookmarkVerificationStatus? verificationStatus,
    List<AnswerCitation>? citations,
  }) {
    return BookmarkModel(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      title: title ?? this.title,
      agentId: agentId ?? this.agentId,
      agentTitle: agentTitle ?? this.agentTitle,
      fieldName: fieldName ?? this.fieldName,
      fieldId: fieldId ?? this.fieldId,
      arabicExcerpt: arabicExcerpt ?? this.arabicExcerpt,
      fullAnswer: fullAnswer ?? this.fullAnswer,
      bookReference: bookReference ?? this.bookReference,
      pageNumber: pageNumber ?? this.pageNumber,
      author: author ?? this.author,
      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
      updatedAt: updatedAt ?? this.updatedAt,
      deletedAt: deletedAt ?? this.deletedAt,
      documentKind: documentKind ?? this.documentKind,
      verificationStatus: verificationStatus ?? this.verificationStatus,
      citations: citations ?? this.citations,
    );
  }

  static BookmarkDocumentKind _documentKindFromJson(
    String? value, {
    required String id,
    required String agentId,
    required String fieldName,
  }) {
    return BookmarkDocumentKind.values.firstWhere(
      (kind) => kind.name == value,
      orElse: () {
        if (id.startsWith('book_') ||
            fieldName.toLowerCase().contains('rujukan kitab')) {
          return BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference;
        }
        if (agentId == 'catatan_mandiri' ||
            fieldName.toLowerCase().contains('catatan pribadi')) {
          return BookmarkDocumentKind.personalNote;
        }
        return BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer;
      },
    );
  }

  static BookmarkVerificationStatus _verificationStatusFromJson(
    String? value,
    BookmarkDocumentKind kind,
  ) {
    return BookmarkVerificationStatus.values.firstWhere(
      (status) => status.name == value,
      orElse: () => kind == BookmarkDocumentKind.personalNote
          ? BookmarkVerificationStatus.notApplicable
          : kind == BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference
              ? BookmarkVerificationStatus.needsReview
              : BookmarkVerificationStatus.unverified,
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import '../core/book_study_level.dart';
import '../core/catalog_section_label.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'dart:convert';

/// Model data kanonikal untuk representasi naskah/kitab dalam katalog OpenTurath.
class OpenTurathBook {
  const OpenTurathBook({
    required this.id,
    required this.deathYear,
    required this.section,
    required this.shortName,
    required this.title,
    required this.author,
    required this.editor,
    required this.publisher,
    required this.edition,
    required this.volumes,
    required this.sourceFolder,
    required this.pages,
    this.textType = '',
  });

  final String textType;
  BookStudyLevel get studyLevel => BookStudyLevel.fromMetadata(textType);

  final int id;
  final int? deathYear;
  final String section;
  String get localizedSection => CatalogSectionLabel.of(section);
  final String shortName;
  final String title;
  final String author;
  final String editor;
  final String publisher;
  final String edition;
  final String volumes;
  final String sourceFolder;
  final String pages;

  /// Preserve the catalog value, but do not present an edition assessment as a person's name.
  String get editorName => editor.contains('طبعة أصلية معتمدة') ? '' : editor;
  String get editionNote => editor.contains('طبعة أصلية معتمدة') ? editor : '';
  bool get needsMetadataReview =>
      editionNote.isNotEmpty ||
      RegExp(r'(?:1[6-9]\d{2}|2\d{3})\s*هـ').hasMatch(edition) ||
      (int.tryParse(pages) ?? 0) > 50000;

  factory OpenTurathBook.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return OpenTurathBook(
      id: _intValue(json['id']),
      textType: _textValue(
          json['text_type'] ?? json['jenis_naskah'] ?? json['نوع_النص']),
      deathYear: _nullableInt(json['tahun_wafat']),
      section: _textValue(json['القسم'] ?? json['section'] ?? json['kategori']),
      shortName: _textValue(json['الاسم_المختصر'] ?? json['short_name']),
      title: Loc.cleanTitle(
          _textValue(json['الكتاب'] ?? json['title'] ?? json['nama_kitab'])),
      author: _textValue(json['المؤلف'] ?? json['author'] ?? json['pengarang']),
      editor: _textValue(
          json['المحقق_أو_المعتني'] ?? json['editor'] ?? json['tahqiq']),
      publisher:
          _textValue(json['الناشر'] ?? json['publisher'] ?? json['penerbit']),
      edition: _textValue(
          json['سنة_الطبع_والطبعة'] ?? json['edition'] ?? json['cetakan']),
      volumes:
          _textValue(json['عدد_الأجزاء'] ?? json['volumes'] ?? json['jilid']),
      sourceFolder: _textValue(json['folder_sumber'] ?? json['source_folder']),
      pages:
          _textValue(json['عدد_الصفحات'] ?? json['pages'] ?? json['halaman']),
    );
  }

  static List<OpenTurathBook> decodeList(String source) {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(source);
    final dynamic list = decoded is List
        ? decoded
        : decoded is Map<String, dynamic>
            ? (decoded['kitab'] ?? decoded['books'])
            : null;
    if (list is! List || list.any((item) => item is! Map<String, dynamic>)) {
      throw const FormatException(
          'Catalog must contain a list of book records');
    }
    return list
        .map((item) => OpenTurathBook.fromJson(item as Map<String, dynamic>))
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  static int _intValue(dynamic value) {
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is num) return value.round();
    final cleaned = value?.toString().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '') ?? '';
    return int.tryParse(cleaned) ?? 0;
  }

  static int? _nullableInt(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is num) return value.round();
    final cleaned = value.toString().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
    return int.tryParse(cleaned);
  }

  static String _textValue(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return '';
    return value.toString().trim();
  }

  String get volumeLabel {
    if (volumes.isEmpty || volumes == '-') return Loc.tr('unknownMetadata');
    return Loc.tr('volumeCount', [volumes]);
  }

  String get deathLabel {
    if (deathYear == null) return Loc.tr('unknownMetadata');
    return Loc.tr('deathYear', ['$deathYear']);
  }

  String get pagesLabel {
    if (pages.isEmpty || pages == '-') return Loc.tr('unknownMetadata');
    // "2267" ditampilkan "2.267"; nilai non-angka dibiarkan apa adanya.
    final count = int.tryParse(pages);
    final shown = count == null
        ? pages
        : pages.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'(\d)(?=(\d{3})+$)'),
            (match) => '${match[1]}${Loc.language == 'id' ? '.' : ','}');
    return Loc.tr('pageCount', [shown]);
  }
}
```
