import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'answer_citation.dart';

/// Model representasi pesan obrolan mandiri untuk antarmuka native OpenTurath AI.
@immutable
class TurathChatMessage {
  final String id;
  final String text;
  final bool isUser;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final bool isThinking;
  final List<String> citations;

  /// Locator terstruktur untuk [citations]; ikut tersimpan saat jawaban diarsipkan.
  final List<AnswerCitation> references;

  const TurathChatMessage({
    required this.id,
    required this.text,
    required this.isUser,
    required this.timestamp,
    this.isThinking = false,
    this.citations = const [],
    this.references = const [],
  });

  TurathChatMessage copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? text,
    bool? isUser,
    DateTime? timestamp,
    bool? isThinking,
    List<String>? citations,
    List<AnswerCitation>? references,
  }) {
    return TurathChatMessage(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      text: text ?? this.text,
      isUser: isUser ?? this.isUser,
      timestamp: timestamp ?? this.timestamp,
      isThinking: isThinking ?? this.isThinking,
      citations: citations ?? this.citations,
      references: references ?? this.references,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is TurathChatMessage &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          id == other.id &&
          text == other.text &&
          isUser == other.isUser &&
          isThinking == other.isThinking;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(id, text, isUser, isThinking);
}

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';
import '../core/entitlement_keys.dart';

/// Model Hak Akses Per Modul Notebook / Kitab (Canonical Entitlement)
class ModuleEntitlement {
  final String plan;
  final DateTime? expiry;
  final String status; // 'active', 'expired', 'trial'
  final String? sourceTransactionId;
  final DateTime? updatedAt;
  final DateTime? startedAt;
  final int? trialDurationDays;
  final String paymentStatus;

  const ModuleEntitlement({
    required this.plan,
    this.expiry,
    this.status = 'active',
    this.sourceTransactionId,
    this.updatedAt,
    this.startedAt,
    this.trialDurationDays,
    this.paymentStatus = 'none',
  });

  bool get isPremium => RegExp(
          r'^(trial|tholib(?:_1m|_6m)?|bahits(?:_1y)?|premium|all_access|all_ai.*|single|sultan|pro|voucher(?:_.*)?|redeem(?:_.*)?|custom|full)$')
      .hasMatch(plan);

  bool get isActive =>
      status != 'revoked' &&
      status != 'expired' &&
      expiry != null &&
      expiry!.isAfter(DateTime.now());

  factory ModuleEntitlement.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return ModuleEntitlement(
      plan: map['plan'] ?? AppConstants.planTrial,
      expiry: map['expiry'] != null
          ? (map['expiry'] is Timestamp
              ? (map['expiry'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime.tryParse(map['expiry'].toString()))
          : null,
      status: map['status'] ?? 'active',
      sourceTransactionId: map['source_transaction_id'] ?? map['trx_id'],
      updatedAt: map['updated_at'] != null
          ? (map['updated_at'] is Timestamp
              ? (map['updated_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime.tryParse(map['updated_at'].toString()))
          : null,
      startedAt: map['started_at'] != null
          ? (map['started_at'] is Timestamp
              ? (map['started_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime.tryParse(map['started_at'].toString()))
          : null,
      trialDurationDays: map['trial_duration_days'] as int?,
      paymentStatus: map['payment_status'] ?? 'none',
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'plan': plan,
        'expiry': expiry != null ? Timestamp.fromDate(expiry!) : null,
        'status': status,
        'source_transaction_id': sourceTransactionId,
        'updated_at': updatedAt != null ? Timestamp.fromDate(updatedAt!) : null,
        'started_at': startedAt != null ? Timestamp.fromDate(startedAt!) : null,
        'trial_duration_days': trialDurationDays,
        'payment_status': paymentStatus,
      };

  Map<String, dynamic> toJsonMap() => {
        'plan': plan,
        'expiry': expiry?.toIso8601String(),
        'status': status,
        'source_transaction_id': sourceTransactionId,
        'updated_at': updatedAt?.toIso8601String(),
        'started_at': startedAt?.toIso8601String(),
        'trial_duration_days': trialDurationDays,
        'payment_status': paymentStatus,
      };
}

class UserModel {
  final String uid;
  final String name;
  final String email;
  final String photoUrl;
  final String plan; // Legacy global plan fallback
  final int questionsUsed;
  final DateTime? subscriptionExpiry; // Legacy global expiry fallback
  final Map<String, ModuleEntitlement> entitlements;
  final bool isVip;

  UserModel({
    required this.uid,
    required this.name,
    required this.email,
    required this.photoUrl,
    required this.plan,
    required this.questionsUsed,
    this.subscriptionExpiry,
    this.entitlements = const {},
    this.isVip = false,
  });

  // ── Global Legacy Helpers ──
  bool get isTrial => !isVip && (plan == AppConstants.planTrial || plan == 'trial');
  bool get isGuest => email.isEmpty || uid.startsWith('guest_');
  bool get isPremium => isVip ||
      (plan != 'free' &&
      (plan == AppConstants.planTholib1m ||
          plan == AppConstants.planTholib6m ||
          plan == AppConstants.planBahits1y ||
          plan == 'tholib' ||
          plan == 'bahits' ||
          plan == 'all_ai_1m' ||
          plan == 'all_ai_6m' ||
          plan == 'all_ai_1y' ||
          plan == 'all_access' ||
          plan == 'all_ai' ||
          plan == 'full' ||
          plan == 'sultan' ||
          plan == 'pro' ||
          plan == 'premium' ||
          plan.startsWith('all_ai') ||
          plan.startsWith('redeem') ||
          plan.startsWith('voucher') ||
          plan == 'custom' ||
          (subscriptionExpiry != null &&
              subscriptionExpiry!.isAfter(DateTime.now()))));

  /// Voucher trial dan paket berbayar memakai sumber masa berlaku yang sama.
  /// Jangan pernah menjadikan nama paket sebagai alasan menolak masa berlaku
  /// yang masih aktif dari server.
  bool get isSubscriptionActive =>
      isVip || (subscriptionExpiry != null && subscriptionExpiry!.isAfter(DateTime.now()));

  /// Trial is an entitlement with an expiry supplied by the server voucher.
  /// A local question counter must never grant or revoke access.
  bool get hasAccess => isSubscriptionActive ||
      entitlements.values.any((entitlement) =>
          entitlement.isActive && entitlement.isPremium);

  /// Retained for legacy presentation only. Questions are no longer a quota.
  int get questionsRemaining => hasAccess ? 9999 : 0;

  bool get isTrialExhausted => false;

  // ── Modular Entitlement Helpers ──

  bool isAgentSubscriptionActive(String agentId) {
    // Owner-approved permanent VIP outranks expired or revoked paid packages.
    if (isVip) return true;
    final mappedKey = entitlementKeys[agentId] ?? agentId;

    // 1. Specific module entitlement check FIRST
    final specific = entitlements[mappedKey];
    if (specific != null && specific.isActive && specific.isPremium) {
      return true;
    }

    // 2. Explicit all_access entitlement
    final all = entitlements['all_access'] ?? entitlements['all_ai'];
    if (all != null && all.isActive && all.isPremium) {
      return true;
    }

    // If a specific module entitlement was explicitly revoked, deny access
    if (specific != null && specific.status == 'revoked') {
      return false;
    }

    // If an explicit all_access was REVOKED and no active specific entitlement, deny access
    if (all != null && all.status == 'revoked') {
      return false;
    }

    // 3. Explicit global all-access plan check (ONLY truly global all-access plans)
    const globalAllPlans = [
      'all_access',
      'all_ai_1m',
      'all_ai_6m',
      'all_ai_1y',
      'all_ai',
      'full',
      'sultan',
    ];
    final isGlobalPlan = (globalAllPlans.contains(plan) ||
            plan.startsWith('all_ai')) &&
        isSubscriptionActive;
    if (isGlobalPlan) {
      return true;
    }

    // 4. Module-specific plan matching (e.g. 'fiqh_syafii_1m', 'fiqh_tahawwulat_1m')
    if (isSubscriptionActive) {
      final cleanPlan = plan.toLowerCase();
      final cleanKey = mappedKey.toLowerCase();
      if (cleanPlan == cleanKey ||
          cleanPlan.startsWith('${cleanKey}_') ||
          cleanPlan.contains(cleanKey)) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    // 5. Legacy plan backward-compatibility (ONLY when entitlements is empty)
    // When a user has modular entitlements, legacy fallback must never leak unpurchased modules.
    if (entitlements.isEmpty && isSubscriptionActive) {
      const legacyAllAccessPlans = [
        AppConstants.planTholib1m,
        AppConstants.planTholib6m,
        AppConstants.planBahits1y,
      ];
      if (legacyAllAccessPlans.contains(plan) ||
          plan.startsWith('redeem') ||
          plan.startsWith('voucher')) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  bool hasAccessToAgent(String agentId) {
    // Akses notebook memerlukan hak akses langganan atau voucher aktif spesifik modul
    return isAgentSubscriptionActive(agentId);
  }

  int questionsRemainingForAgent(String agentId) {
    if (isAgentSubscriptionActive(agentId)) return 9999;
    return 0;
  }

  factory UserModel.fromMap(String uid, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    // Parse entitlements map
    final Map<String, ModuleEntitlement> parsedEntitlements = {};
    if (data['entitlements'] != null && data['entitlements'] is Map) {
      final rawMap = data['entitlements'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
      rawMap.forEach((key, val) {
        if (val is Map<String, dynamic>) {
          parsedEntitlements[key] = ModuleEntitlement.fromMap(val);
        }
      });
    }

    DateTime? expiry;
    if (data['subscription_expiry'] != null) {
      final exp = data['subscription_expiry'];
      if (exp is Timestamp) {
        expiry = exp.toDate();
      } else if (exp is String) {
        expiry = DateTime.tryParse(exp);
      } else if (exp is int) {
        expiry = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(exp);
      }
    }

    return UserModel(
      uid: uid,
      name: data['name'] ?? '',
      email: data['email'] ?? '',
      photoUrl: data['photo_url'] ?? '',
      plan: data['plan'] ?? AppConstants.planTrial,
      questionsUsed: data['questions_used'] ?? 0,
      subscriptionExpiry: expiry,
      entitlements: parsedEntitlements,
      isVip: data['is_vip'] == true ||
          ['vip', 'admin', 'guru', 'special'].contains(
            (data['role'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase()),
    );
  }

  factory UserModel.fromFirestore(DocumentSnapshot doc) {
    final data = doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    return UserModel.fromMap(doc.id, data);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'is_vip': isVip,
        'name': name,
        'email': email,
        'photo_url': photoUrl,
        'plan': plan,
        'questions_used': questionsUsed,
        'subscription_expiry': subscriptionExpiry != null
            ? Timestamp.fromDate(subscriptionExpiry!)
            : null,
        'entitlements': entitlements.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toMap())),
      };

  Map<String, dynamic> toJsonMap() => {
        'is_vip': isVip,
        'name': name,
        'email': email,
        'photo_url': photoUrl,
        'plan': plan,
        'questions_used': questionsUsed,
        'subscription_expiry': subscriptionExpiry?.toIso8601String(),
        'entitlements': entitlements.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toJsonMap())),
      };

  UserModel copyWith({
    int? questionsUsed,
    String? plan,
    DateTime? subscriptionExpiry,
    Map<String, ModuleEntitlement>? entitlements,
  }) {
    return UserModel(
      uid: uid,
      name: name,
      email: email,
      photoUrl: photoUrl,
      plan: plan ?? this.plan,
      questionsUsed: questionsUsed ?? this.questionsUsed,
      subscriptionExpiry: subscriptionExpiry ?? this.subscriptionExpiry,
      entitlements: entitlements ?? this.entitlements,
      isVip: isVip,
    );
  }
}

/// Halaman Katalog Kitab (Full-Screen Route).
/// Mendukung 2.226 Kitab Induk lintas 6 disiplin ilmu kanonikal dengan pencarian Arab toleran harakat,
/// filter hierarki disiplin (القسم), abad keilmuan, dan kartu kitab minimalis bergaya turath.
class BookCatalogScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final AgentModel? agent;
  final String? initialQuery;

  const BookCatalogScreen({
    super.key,
    this.agent,
    this.initialQuery,
  });

  @override
  State<BookCatalogScreen> createState() => _BookCatalogScreenState();
}

class _BookCatalogScreenState extends State<BookCatalogScreen> {
  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final CanonicalLibraryService _service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;
  Timer? _debounce;

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _allBooks;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _filteredBooks;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;

  String? _selectedSection;
  String? _selectedEra;
  String? _selectedType;
  String? _selectedCentury;
  String _searchQuery = '';

  List<String> _availableSections = [];
  bool _hasEras = false;
  bool _hasTypes = false;

  final List<String> _eras = [
    'Mutaqaddimin',
    'Ashab Al-Wujuh',
    'Muta\'akhkhirin',
  ];

  final List<String> _types = [
    'Asal Mazhab',
    'Matan',
    'Syarah',
    'Hasyiyah',
  ];

  final List<String> _centuries = [
    'Salaf (≤ 300 H)',
    'Mutaqaddimin (301-600 H)',
    'Muta\'akhkhirin (601-1100 H)',
    'Mu\'ashir (> 1100 H)',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.initialQuery != null && widget.initialQuery!.isNotEmpty) {
      _searchCtrl.text = widget.initialQuery!;
      _searchQuery = widget.initialQuery!;
    }
    _loadCatalog();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    _debounce?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadCatalog() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final List<CanonicalBookPresentation> books;
      if (widget.agent != null) {
        books = await _service.loadCatalogForAgent(widget.agent!);
      } else {
        books = await _service.loadSyafiiCatalog();
      }

      final Set<String> rawSections = {};
      bool hasEras = false;
      bool hasTypes = false;

      for (final b in books) {
        if (b.sectionArabic != null && b.sectionArabic!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
          rawSections.add(b.sectionArabic!.trim());
        }
        if (b.reviewedEraLabel != null && b.reviewedEraLabel!.isNotEmpty) {
          hasEras = true;
        }
        if (b.reviewedTypeLabel != null && b.reviewedTypeLabel!.isNotEmpty) {
          hasTypes = true;
        }
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allBooks = books;
        _availableSections = rawSections.toList()..sort();
        _hasEras = hasEras;
        _hasTypes = hasTypes;
        _isLoading = false;
        _applyFilters();
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.catalogLoadFailed;
      });
    }
  }

  void _onSearchChanged(String val) {
    if (_debounce?.isActive ?? false) _debounce!.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 180), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _searchQuery = val.trim();
          _applyFilters();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  void _applyFilters() {
    if (_allBooks == null) return;
    _filteredBooks = _service.filterBooks(
      _allBooks!,
      _searchQuery,
      sectionFilter: _selectedSection,
      eraFilter: _selectedEra,
      typeFilter: _selectedType,
      centuryFilter: _selectedCentury,
    );
  }

  void _clearFilters() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _searchCtrl.clear();
    setState(() {
      _searchQuery = '';
      _selectedSection = null;
      _selectedEra = null;
      _selectedType = null;
      _selectedCentury = null;
      _applyFilters();
    });
  }

  void _clearSearch() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _searchCtrl.clear();
    setState(() {
      _searchQuery = '';
      _applyFilters();
    });
    _searchFocusNode.requestFocus();
  }

  bool get _hasActiveFilters =>
      _searchQuery.isNotEmpty ||
      _selectedSection != null ||
      _selectedEra != null ||
      _selectedType != null ||
      _selectedCentury != null;

  void _openBookDetail(CanonicalBookPresentation book) {
    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
      context,
      AppRoutes.bookDetail,
      arguments: book,
    );
  }

  String _formatNumber(int number) {
    return NumberFormat.decimalPattern(Loc.language).format(number);
  }

  String _cleanSectionLabel(String full) {
    return CatalogSectionLabel.of(full);
  }

  String _resolveSubtitle() {
    final count = _allBooks?.length;
    final label = count == null
        ? Loc.tr('bookCatalog')
        : Loc.tr('bookCount', [_formatNumber(count)]);
    return widget.agent == null ? label : '$label · ${widget.agent!.title}';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DesktopShortcuts(
        onFind: _searchFocusNode.requestFocus,
        onEscape: () {
          _clearSearch();
          _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
        },
        child: _buildScreen(context),
      );

  Widget _buildScreen(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final background = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final primaryAccent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: background,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        titleSpacing: otTitleSpacing(context),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(AppCopy.referenceBooks),
            Text(
              _resolveSubtitle(),
              style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary)
                  .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s12),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          if (_hasActiveFilters)
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _clearFilters,
              child: Text(
                Loc.tr('ui_ae4f9663d7'),
                style: OTTypography.button(color: primaryAccent)
                    .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s14),
              ),
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // ── SEARCH CONTAINER ──
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
                vertical: OTSpacing.sm,
              ),
              child: Container(
                height: 48,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.chip),
                  border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _searchCtrl,
                        focusNode: _searchFocusNode,
                        onChanged: _onSearchChanged,
                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s14, color: textPrimary),
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: Loc.tr('ui_214d016291'),
                          hintStyle: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                            color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                          ),
                          border: InputBorder.none,
                          enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          disabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          errorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          focusedErrorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          filled: false,

                    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty)

            _buildFilterChipsBar(

              primaryAccent: primaryAccent,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),

            // ── RESULTS COUNT HEADER ──
            if (!_isLoading && _filteredBooks != null && _allBooks != null)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(

                    if (_selectedSection != null ||
                        _selectedEra != null ||
                        _selectedType != null ||
                        _selectedCentury != null)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: primaryAccent.withValues(
                              alpha: isDark ? 0.12 : 0.06),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          [
                            if (_selectedSection != null)
                              _cleanSectionLabel(_selectedSection!),
                            if (_selectedEra != null) Loc.text(_selectedEra!),
                            if (_selectedType != null) Loc.text(_selectedType!),
                            if (_selectedCentury != null) _selectedCentury!,
                          ].join(' · '),
                          style: OTTypography.caption(color: primaryAccent)
                              .copyWith(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,

                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

            // ── MAIN CONTENT LIST / EMPTY / ERROR / LOADING ──
            Expanded(

              ),

  }

  Widget _buildFilterChipsBar({
    required bool isDark,
    required Color surface,
    required Color border,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required Color primaryAccent,
  }) {
    final hasFilters = _hasActiveFilters;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.lg),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          _filterChip(
            label: hasFilters ? Loc.tr('ui_c0c96d1d9a') : Loc.tr('allBooks'),
            isSelected: !hasFilters,
            onTap: hasFilters ? _clearFilters : () {},
            isDark: isDark,
            border: border,
            surface: surface,
            textPrimary: textPrimary,
            textSecondary: textSecondary,
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => _showFilterSheet(
                isDark, surface, border, textPrimary, textSecondary),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded, size: 16),
            label: Text(Loc.tr('ui_d7decf1aa2')),
            style: OTButtons.compactOutlined(isDark),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showFilterSheet(bool isDark, Color surface, Color border,
      Color textPrimary, Color textSecondary) {
    final isSyafii = widget.agent == null ||
        widget.agent!.id == 'fiqh_syafii' ||
        widget.agent!.catalogId == 'canonical_syafii' ||
        widget.agent!.fieldId == 'fiqh';
    final eraChoices = isSyafii && _hasEras ? _eras : _centuries;
    return showAdaptiveSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: surface,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (_, setSheetState) => Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                OTSpacing.lg, 0, OTSpacing.lg, OTSpacing.lg),
            child: ListView(
              shrinkWrap: true,
              children: [
                Text(Loc.tr('ui_ac03e7c93b'),
                    style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: textPrimary)),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (_availableSections.length > 1) ...[
                  Text(Loc.tr('ui_8b71077ed7'),
                      style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: textSecondary)),
                  Wrap(
                      spacing: 8,
                      children: _availableSections
                          .map((section) => ChoiceChip(
                              label: Text(_cleanSectionLabel(section)),
                              selected: _selectedSection == section,
                              onSelected: (_) {
                                setState(() {
                                  _selectedSection = _selectedSection == section
                                      ? null
                                      : section;
                                  _applyFilters();
                                });
                                setSheetState(() {});
                              }))
                          .toList()),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                ],
                Text(Loc.tr('ui_f37a89cbd1'),
                    style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: textSecondary)),
                Wrap(
                    spacing: 8,
                    children: eraChoices
                        .map((era) => ChoiceChip(
                            label: Text(Loc.text(era)),
                            selected:
                                _selectedCentury == era || _selectedEra == era,
                            onSelected: (_) {
                              setState(() {
                                if (isSyafii && _hasEras) {
                                  _selectedEra =
                                      _selectedEra == era ? null : era;
                                  _selectedCentury = null;
                                } else {
                                  _selectedCentury =
                                      _selectedCentury == era ? null : era;
                                  _selectedEra = null;
                                }
                                _applyFilters();
                              });
                              setSheetState(() {});
                            }))
                        .toList()),
                if (_hasTypes) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(Loc.tr('ui_47b35543e3'),
                      style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: textSecondary)),
                  Wrap(
                      spacing: 8,
                      children: _types
                          .map((type) => ChoiceChip(
                              label: Text(Loc.text(type)),
                              selected: _selectedType == type,
                              onSelected: (_) {
                                setState(() {
                                  _selectedType =
                                      _selectedType == type ? null : type;
                                  _applyFilters();
                                });
                                setSheetState(() {});
                              }))
                          .toList()),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                TextButton(
                    onPressed: () {
                      _clearFilters();
                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                    },
                    child: Text(Loc.tr('ui_a74cf8b9bd'))),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Retained as a fallback while the compact filter sheet is rolled out.

  Widget _buildContent({
    required bool isDark,
    required Color surface,
    required Color border,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required Color primaryAccent,
  }) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.lg),
        itemCount: 8,
        itemBuilder: (ctx, i) => _buildSkeletonItem(surface, border),
      );
    }

    if (_errorMessage != null) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.xl),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, size: 48, color: textSecondary),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                _errorMessage!,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: OTTypography.body(color: textPrimary),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              AppleInteractiveWrapper(
                onTap: _loadCatalog,
                child: Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: primaryAccent,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    AppCopy.tryAgain,
                    style:
                        OTTypography.button(color: OTColors.onAccent(isDark)),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (_filteredBooks == null || _filteredBooks!.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.xl),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.search_off_rounded, size: 48, color: textSecondary),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                Loc.tr('ui_022c202d54'),
                style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                Loc.tr('ui_6e35db0b1e'),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
              ),
              if (_hasActiveFilters) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                AppleInteractiveWrapper(
                  onTap: _clearFilters,
                  child: Container(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border.all(color: border),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      Loc.tr('ui_ae4f9663d7'),
                      style: OTTypography.button(color: textPrimary)
                          .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s14),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _loadCatalog,
      color: primaryAccent,
      child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) {
        final columns = bookReadingColumns(
            context, constraints.maxWidth - OTSpacing.lg * 2);
        return ListView.builder(
          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(
              parent: BouncingScrollPhysics()),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: OTSpacing.lg, vertical: OTSpacing.sm),
          itemCount: (_filteredBooks!.length / columns).ceil(),
          itemBuilder: (context, row) => bookReadingRow(
              context, row, columns, _filteredBooks!.length, (context, index) {
            final book = _filteredBooks![index];
            return BookRowItem(
                book: book,
                searchQuery: _searchQuery,
                onTap: () => _openBookDetail(book));
          }),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSkeletonItem(Color surface, Color border) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: OTSpacing.sm),
      height: 72,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
        border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _filterChip({
    required String label,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    required bool isDark,
    required Color border,
    required Color surface,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
  }) {
    final activeBg = OTColors.primaryContainer(isDark);
    final activeFg = OTColors.onPrimaryContainer(isDark);

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 4),
      child: AppleInteractiveWrapper(
        onTap: onTap,
        pressedScale: 0.94,
        hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.selection,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? activeBg : surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected ? activeBg : border,
              width: 0.8,
            ),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: OTTypography.caption(
                    color: isSelected ? activeFg : textSecondary)
                .copyWith(
              fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../core/catalog_section_label.dart';
import '../core/scholarly_fonts.dart';

import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';

import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/book_model.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import '../services/bookmark_service.dart';
import '../services/research_notes_service.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_radius.dart';
/// Halaman Detail Edisi Kitab Mandiri (Full-Screen Route).
/// Chrome follows the app locale; source titles and names retain Arabic RTL.
class BookDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final CanonicalBookPresentation book;
  final AgentModel? agent;

  const BookDetailScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.book,
    this.agent,
  });

  @override
  State<BookDetailScreen> createState() => _BookDetailScreenState();
}

class _BookDetailScreenState extends State<BookDetailScreen> {
  final ResearchNotesService _notesService = ResearchNotesService();
  bool _isSaving = false;
  bool _isSaved = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _checkIfSaved();
  }

  Future<void> _checkIfSaved() async {
    try {
      final noteId = 'book_${widget.book.editionId}';
      final isBookmarked = await BookmarkService().isBookmarked(noteId);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSaved = isBookmarked);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _toggleSaveBook() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    try {
      final noteId = 'book_${widget.book.editionId}';
      if (_isSaved) {
        await _notesService.deleteNote(noteId);
        await BookmarkService().deleteBookmark(noteId);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isSaved = false;
            _isSaving = false;
          });
          AppSnackBar.show(context, message: Loc.tr('bookmarkDeleted'));
        }
      } else {
        final agent = _resolveTargetAgent();
        final deathYearStr = widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri != null
            ? ' (ت: ${widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri} هـ)'
            : '';
        final publisherStr = widget.book.publisher != null
            ? '، دار النشر: ${widget.book.publisher}'
            : '';
        final muhaqqiqStr = widget.book.muhaqqiq != null
            ? '، تحقيق: ${widget.book.muhaqqiq}'
            : '';

        final newNote = ResearchNote(
          id: noteId,
          agentId: agent.id,
          agentTitle: agent.title,
          title: widget.book.titleArabic,
          excerpt:
              'كتاب ${widget.book.titleArabic}، للمؤلف ${widget.book.authorArabic}$deathYearStr$publisherStr$muhaqqiqStr.',
          bookTitle: widget.book.titleArabic,
          bookVolume: widget.book.volumesCount?.toString(),
          tags: [
            'بطاقة كتاب',
            if (widget.book.reviewedTypeLabel != null)
              widget.book.reviewedTypeLabel!,
            if (widget.book.reviewedEraLabel != null)
              widget.book.reviewedEraLabel!,
          ],
          createdAt: DateTime.now(),
        );

        final newBookmark = BookmarkModel(
          id: noteId,
          title: widget.book.titleArabic,
          agentId: agent.id,
          agentTitle: agent.title,
          fieldName: 'بطاقة كتاب',
          fieldId: 'fiqh',
          arabicExcerpt: widget.book.titleArabic,
          fullAnswer:
              'كتاب ${widget.book.titleArabic}، للمؤلف ${widget.book.authorArabic}$deathYearStr$publisherStr$muhaqqiqStr.',
          bookReference: widget.book.titleArabic,
          pageNumber: '',
          author: widget.book.authorArabic,
          createdAt: DateTime.now(),
          documentKind: BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference,
          verificationStatus: BookmarkVerificationStatus.needsReview,
        );

        await _notesService.saveNote(newNote);
        await BookmarkService().addBookmark(newBookmark);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isSaved = true;
            _isSaving = false;
          });
          HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
          AppSnackBar.success(context, Loc.tr('savedSuccess'));
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSaving = false);
        AppSnackBar.error(context, Loc.tr('saveFailed'));
      }
    }
  }

  AgentModel _resolveTargetAgent() {
    if (widget.agent != null) return widget.agent!;
    try {
      return AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere(
        (a) => a.catalogId == 'canonical_syafii' || a.id == 'fiqh',
        orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return AgentModel.defaultAgents.first;
    }
  }

  void _copyScholarlyCitation() {
    final deathYearStr = widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri != null
        ? ' (ت: ${widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri} هـ)'
        : '';
    final publisherStr = widget.book.publisher != null
        ? '، دار النشر: ${widget.book.publisher}'
        : '';
    final muhaqqiqStr =
        widget.book.muhaqqiq != null ? '، تحقيق: ${widget.book.muhaqqiq}' : '';
    final volStr = (widget.book.volumesDescription != null &&
            widget.book.volumesDescription!.isNotEmpty)
        ? '، ${widget.book.volumesDescription}'
        : (widget.book.volumesCount != null
            ? '، ${widget.book.volumesCount} أجزاء'
            : '');
    final printYearStr =
        (widget.book.printYear != null && widget.book.printYear != '-')
            ? '، سنة الطبع: ${widget.book.printYear}'
            : '';

    final citation =
        '${widget.book.authorArabic}$deathYearStr، ${widget.book.titleArabic}$muhaqqiqStr$publisherStr$printYearStr$volStr.';

    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: citation));
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    AppSnackBar.success(context, Loc.tr('ui_e150b5de89'));
  }

  String _translateType(String? type) {
    if (type == null || type.isEmpty) return Loc.tr('bookTypeWork');
    final l = type.toLowerCase();
    if (l.contains('matn') || l.contains('matan')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookTypeMatn');
    }
    if (l.contains('syarah') || l.contains('sharh')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookTypeSharh');
    }
    if (l.contains('hasyiyah') || l.contains('hashiyah')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookTypeHashiyah');
    }
    if (l.contains('mukhtasar') || l.contains('ringkasan')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookTypeSummary');
    }
    if (l.contains('ensiklopedia') || l.contains('mausuah')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookTypeEncyclopedia');
    }
    if (l.contains('manzhumah') || l.contains('nazham')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookTypePoem');
    }
    return Loc.text(type);
  }

  String _translateEra(String? era) {
    if (era == null || era.isEmpty) return Loc.tr('bookEraHeritage');
    final l = era.toLowerCase();
    if (l.contains('mutaqaddim') || l.contains('awal')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookEraEarly');
    }
    if (l.contains('mutawassith') || l.contains('pertengahan')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookEraMiddle');
    }
    if (l.contains('muta\'akhkhir') ||
        l.contains('mutaakhir') ||
        l.contains('lanjut')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookEraLate');
    }
    if (l.contains('mu\'ashir') ||
        l.contains('kontemporer') ||
        l.contains('modern')) {
      return Loc.tr('bookEraModern');
    }
    return Loc.text(era);
  }

  String _formatVolumes() {
    final vd = widget.book.volumesDescription;
    if (vd != null && vd.isNotEmpty) {
      return (vd.contains('جزء') ||
              vd.contains('مجلد') ||
              vd.toLowerCase().contains('jilid'))
          ? vd
          : Loc.tr('volumeCount', [vd]);
    }
    final count = widget.book.volumesCount;
    if (count != null && count > 0) {
      return Loc.tr('volumeCount', ['$count']);
    }
    return Loc.tr('unknownMetadata');
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);

    return Directionality(

            ),
            IconButton(

              onPressed: _copyScholarlyCitation,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ],
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
              vertical: OTSpacing.md,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                // ── KARTU 1: IDENTITAS KITAB (ARABIC HERO) ──
                _buildCard(
                  isDark: isDark,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Flexible(
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 8,
                                vertical: 4,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: OTColors.primaryContainer(isDark),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
                              ),
                              child: Text(

                                        widget.book.sectionArabic!),
                                maxLines: 1,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                style: OTTypography.caption(
                                        color:
                                            OTColors.onPrimaryContainer(isDark))
                                    .copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Flexible(
                            child: Directionality(
                              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                              child: Text(
                                widget.book.editionId,
                                maxLines: 1,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

                                        .copyWith(
                                  fontFamily: 'Courier',
                                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),

                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),
                      Directionality(
                        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                        child: Text(
                          widget.book.titleArabic,
                          textAlign: TextAlign.start,
                          style: OTTypography.arabicDisplay(color: textPrimary)
                              .copyWith(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            height: 1.85,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (widget.book.shortTitleArabic != null &&
                          widget.book.shortTitleArabic!.isNotEmpty &&
                          widget.book.shortTitleArabic !=
                              widget.book.titleArabic) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 6),
                        Directionality(
                          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                          child: Text(
                            widget.book.shortTitleArabic!,
                            textAlign: TextAlign.start,
                            style:
                                OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textSecondary)
                                    .copyWith(
                              fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                            ),
                          ),

                      ],
                      if (widget.book.titleLatin != null &&
                          widget.book.titleLatin!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Directionality(

                const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),

                // ── KARTU 2: MUALLIF / PENGARANG ──
                _buildCard(

                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                      _buildMetaRow(
                        icon: Icons.business_outlined,
                        label: Loc.tr('bookPublisher'),
                        value:
                            widget.book.publisher ?? Loc.tr('unknownMetadata'),
                        textPrimary: textPrimary,
                        textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      ),
                      const Divider(height: 16, thickness: 0.5),
                      _buildMetaRow(
                        icon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,
                        label: Loc.tr('ui_ad39f1c3af'),
                        value:
                            widget.book.muhaqqiq ?? Loc.tr('unknownMetadata'),
                        textPrimary: textPrimary,
                        textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      ),
                      if (widget.book.printYear != null &&
                          widget.book.printYear != '-') ...[
                        const Divider(height: 16, thickness: 0.5),

                          value: widget.book.printYear!,

                          textSecondary: textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xl),

            ),

  }

  Widget _buildCard({
    required bool isDark,
    required Color surface,
    required Color border,
    required Widget child,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          vertical: OTSpacing.md, horizontal: OTSpacing.xs),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(
            bottom:
                BorderSide(color: border.withValues(alpha: .75), width: .8)),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSectionHeader(String title, Color color) {
    return Text(
      title,
      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(color: color).copyWith(
        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMetaRow({
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required String value,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 17, color: textSecondary),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
              child: Text(
            label,
            style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(color: textSecondary).copyWith(
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
            ),
          )),
        ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 24),
          child: Directionality(
            textDirection: RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(value)
                ? TextDirection.rtl
                : Directionality.of(context),
            child: Text(
              value,
              textAlign: TextAlign.start,
              style: (RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(value)
                      ? OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textPrimary)
                      : ScholarlyFonts.outfit(color: textPrimary))
                  .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import '../widgets/book_reading_rows.dart';
import '../widgets/desktop_shortcuts.dart';
import '../widgets/book_identity_card.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/design/native_design.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../core/app_snackbar.dart';
import '../core/arabic_utils.dart';
import '../core/answer_direction.dart';
import '../widgets/tahawwulat_hero.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../widgets/ot_motion_widgets.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_spacing.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_radius.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../core/scholarly_fonts.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import '../models/open_turath_book.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../services/open_turath_catalog_repository.dart';
import '../services/bookmark_service.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../widgets/ot_components.dart';

/// Halaman Katalog Kitab Editorial OpenTurath (Monochrome Editorial)
class OpenTurathBookLibraryPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const OpenTurathBookLibraryPage({
    super.key,
    required this.books,
    required this.collectionName,
    this.onOpenBook,
    this.metadata,
  });

  final List<OpenTurathBook> books;
  final String collectionName;
  final AiLibraryMetadata? metadata;
  final ValueChanged<OpenTurathBook>? onOpenBook;

  @override
  State<OpenTurathBookLibraryPage> createState() =>
      _OpenTurathBookLibraryPageState();
}

enum _BookSort { title, author, volumes }

enum _BookVolumeFilter {
  all,
  singleVolume,
  multiVolume,
}

class _OpenTurathBookLibraryPageState extends State<OpenTurathBookLibraryPage> {
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;
  late final FocusNode _searchFocusNode;

  String _query = '';
  _BookSort _sort = _BookSort.title;
  bool _list = true;
  bool _opening = false;
  _BookVolumeFilter _filter = _BookVolumeFilter.all;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _searchController = TextEditingController();
    _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();
    _searchController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController
      ..removeListener(_onSearchChanged)
      ..dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _query = _searchController.text.trim().toLowerCase());
  }

  List<OpenTurathBook> get _filteredBooks {
    final result = widget.books.where((book) {
      final matchesQuery = _query.isEmpty ||
          [
            book.title,
            book.shortName,
            book.author,
            book.editor,
            book.publisher,
            book.section,
            book.localizedSection,
          ].any((value) => ArabicUtils.matches(value, _query));

      if (!matchesQuery) return false;

      switch (_filter) {
        case _BookVolumeFilter.all:
          return true;
        case _BookVolumeFilter.singleVolume:
          final vols = book.volumes.trim();
          return vols == '1' || vols.toLowerCase().contains('jilid tunggal');
        case _BookVolumeFilter.multiVolume:
          final vols = book.volumes.trim();
          final numVol = int.tryParse(vols);
          return (numVol != null && numVol > 1) ||
              vols.contains('+') ||
              vols.contains('-');
      }
    }).toList();
    result.sort((a, b) => switch (_sort) {
          _BookSort.title => a.title.compareTo(b.title),
          _BookSort.author => a.author.compareTo(b.author),
          _BookSort.volumes => (int.tryParse(a.volumes) ?? 0)
              .compareTo(int.tryParse(b.volumes) ?? 0),
        });
    return result;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DesktopShortcuts(
        onFind: _searchFocusNode.requestFocus,
        onEscape: () {
          _searchController.clear();
          _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
        },
        child: _buildContent(context),
      );

  Widget _buildContent(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final visibleBooks = _filteredBooks;
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, box) {
      final pageInset = ((box.maxWidth - 1160) / 2)
          .clamp(box.maxWidth < 600 ? 16.0 : 24.0, double.infinity);
      final available = box.maxWidth - 2 * pageInset;
      final largeText = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(16) > 24;
      final columns = available >= 1100
          ? 3
          : available >= 720
              ? 2
              : 1;
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          titleSpacing: otTitleSpacing(context),
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          title: Text(widget.collectionName),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: CustomScrollView(
            slivers: [
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(pageInset, 8, pageInset, 0),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      if (widget.metadata != null) ...[
                        Text(
                            '${Loc.tr('bookCount', [
                                  '${widget.metadata!.totalKitab}'
                                ])} · ${widget.metadata!.totalJilid}',
                            style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      ],
                      // Search Bar
                      TextField(
                        controller: _searchController,
                        focusNode: _searchFocusNode,
                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            color: ink, fontSize: OTFontSize.s14),
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: Loc.tr('ui_0ae09a2807'),
                          hintStyle: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                              color: textSecondary, fontSize: OTFontSize.s14),
                          prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                              color: textSecondary, size: 20),
                          suffixIcon: _query.isNotEmpty
                              ? IconButton(
                                  tooltip: Loc.tr('clearSearch'),
                                  icon: Icon(Icons.clear_rounded,
                                      color: textSecondary, size: 18),
                                  onPressed: () {
                                    _searchController.clear();
                                    _searchFocusNode.requestFocus();
                                  },
                                )
                              : null,
                          filled: true,
                          fillColor: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark),
                          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                          border: OutlineInputBorder(
                            borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                            borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                          ),
                          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                            borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                            borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                          ),
                          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                            borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                            borderSide: BorderSide(color: ink, width: 1.2),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      // Filter Chips
                      SingleChildScrollView(
                        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            _FilterChip(
                              label: Loc.tr('allBooks'),
                              isSelected: _filter == _BookVolumeFilter.all,
                              onTap: () => setState(
                                  () => _filter = _BookVolumeFilter.all),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            _FilterChip(
                              label: Loc.tr('singleVolume'),
                              isSelected:
                                  _filter == _BookVolumeFilter.singleVolume,
                              onTap: () => setState(() =>
                                  _filter = _BookVolumeFilter.singleVolume),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            _FilterChip(
                              label: Loc.tr('multipleVolumes'),
                              isSelected:
                                  _filter == _BookVolumeFilter.multiVolume,
                              onTap: () => setState(() =>
                                  _filter = _BookVolumeFilter.multiVolume),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Wrap(
                          spacing: 12,
                          runSpacing: 8,
                          crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            SizedBox(
                                width: available < 240 ? available - 100 : 180,
                                child: DropdownButton<_BookSort>(
                                    isExpanded: true,
                                    value: _sort,
                                    underline: const SizedBox.shrink(),
                                    onChanged: (v) {
                                      if (v != null) setState(() => _sort = v);
                                    },
                                    items: [
                                      DropdownMenuItem(
                                          value: _BookSort.title,
                                          child: Text(reviewCopy(
                                              'Judul', 'العنوان', 'Title'))),
                                      DropdownMenuItem(
                                          value: _BookSort.author,
                                          child: Text(reviewCopy('Pengarang',
                                              'المؤلف', 'Author'))),
                                      DropdownMenuItem(
                                          value: _BookSort.volumes,
                                          child: Text(reviewCopy('Jumlah jilid',
                                              'عدد الأجزاء', 'Volumes'))),
                                    ])),
                            IconButton.filledTonal(
                                tooltip: reviewCopy('Tampilan kartu',
                                    'عرض البطاقات', 'Card view'),
                                isSelected: !_list,
                                onPressed: () => setState(() => _list = false),
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.grid_view_rounded)),
                            IconButton.filledTonal(
                                tooltip: reviewCopy('Daftar ringkas',
                                    'قائمة مختصرة', 'Compact list'),
                                isSelected: _list,
                                onPressed: () => setState(() => _list = true),
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.view_list_rounded)),
                          ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        _query.isEmpty && _filter == _BookVolumeFilter.all
                            ? Loc.tr('bookCount', ['${visibleBooks.length}'])
                            : Loc.tr('booksShown', [
                                '${visibleBooks.length}',
                                '${widget.books.length}',

                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                          fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,

              if (visibleBooks.isEmpty)
                SliverFillRemaining(
                  hasScrollBody: false,
                  child: Center(
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.search_off_rounded,
                            size: 48, color: textSecondary),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Text(
                          Loc.tr('ui_54db73b3af'),
                          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                            color: ink,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        Text(
                          Loc.tr('ui_f7c779cb7d'),
                          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                            color: textSecondary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              else
                SliverPadding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(pageInset, 8, pageInset, 40),
                  sliver: Builder(builder: (context) {
                    final delegate =
                        SliverChildBuilderDelegate((context, index) {
                      final book = visibleBooks[index];
                      return _BookEditorialItem(
                          book: book,
                          index: index + 1,
                          onTap: () async {
                            if (_opening) return;
                            if (widget.onOpenBook != null) {
                              widget.onOpenBook!(book);
                              return;
                            }
                            _opening = true;
                            try {
                              await Navigator.of(context).push(
                                  MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                                      builder: (_) => OpenTurathBookDetailPage(
                                          book: book)));
                            } finally {
                              _opening = false;
                            }
                          });
                    }, childCount: visibleBooks.length);
                    if (_list || largeText || columns == 1) {
                      final readingColumns =
                          bookReadingColumns(context, available);
                      return SliverList(
                          delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
                              (context, row) => bookReadingRow(
                                  context,
                                  row,
                                  readingColumns,
                                  visibleBooks.length,
                                  (context, index) =>
                                      delegate.builder(context, index)!),
                              childCount: (visibleBooks.length / readingColumns)
                                  .ceil()));
                    }
                    return SliverGrid(
                        delegate: delegate,
                        gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                            crossAxisCount: columns,
                            crossAxisSpacing: 16,
                            mainAxisSpacing: 16,
                            mainAxisExtent:
                                MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(280)));
                  }),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    });
  }
}

class OpenTurathBookDetailPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const OpenTurathBookDetailPage({
    super.key,
    required this.book,
  });

  final OpenTurathBook book;

  Future<void> _handleBookmark(BuildContext context) async {
    final uid = AuthService().currentUser?.uid;
    final bookmark = BookmarkModel(
      id: 'book_${book.id}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      title: book.title,
      agentId: 'pustaka_turats',
      agentTitle: book.section,
      fieldName: book.section,
      fieldId: 'pustaka',
      arabicExcerpt: book.title,
      fullAnswer: '${book.title}. ${Loc.tr('authorCredit', [book.author])}. '
          '${Loc.tr('editorCredit', [book.editor])}. '
          '${Loc.tr('bookPublisher')}: ${book.publisher} (${book.edition}). '
          '${book.volumeLabel}; ${book.pagesLabel}.',
      bookReference: '${book.title} - ${book.author}',
      pageNumber: book.pagesLabel,
      author: book.author,
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      documentKind: BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference,
      verificationStatus: book.needsMetadataReview
          ? BookmarkVerificationStatus.needsReview
          : BookmarkVerificationStatus.unverified,
    );

    await BookmarkService().addBookmark(bookmark, userId: uid);
    if (context.mounted) {
      AppSnackBar.success(context, Loc.tr('ui_225b7ddde1'));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleCopyCitation(BuildContext context) async {
    final citation = '''[OpenTurath AI]
${Loc.tr('bookReferenceLabel')}: ${book.title}
${Loc.tr('authorCredit', [book.author])} (${book.deathLabel})
${Loc.tr('ui_ad39f1c3af')}: ${book.editorName.isEmpty ? Loc.tr('editorNotRecorded') : book.editorName}
${book.editionNote.isEmpty ? '' : '${Loc.tr('editionNote')}: ${book.editionNote}'}
${Loc.tr('bookPublisher')}: ${book.publisher} (${book.edition})
${book.volumeLabel} | ${book.pagesLabel}
${Loc.tr('bookScienceSection')}: ${book.section}''';

    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: citation));
    if (context.mounted) {
      AppSnackBar.success(context, Loc.tr('ui_e150b5de89'));
    }
  }

/// Data edisi kitab sebagai bento: fakta singkat di ubin kecil, teks panjang
/// (muhaqqiq, penerbit) di ubin lebar. Ubin tanpa data tidak ditampilkan.
class _BookBentoGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const _BookBentoGrid({required this.book});

  final OpenTurathBook book;

  static bool _has(String value) => value.trim().isNotEmpty && value != '-';

  // Teks Arab atau panjang tidak muat sebagai angka besar di ubin kecil.
  static bool _isLong(String value) =>
      value.trim().length > 14 || RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(value);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final facts = <_BentoTile>[
      if (_has(book.volumes))
        _BentoTile(
          icon: Icons.layers_outlined,
          label: Loc.tr('bookVolumes'),
          value: book.volumeLabel,
        ),
      if (_has(book.pages))
        _BentoTile(
          icon: Icons.description_outlined,
          label: Loc.tr('bookPages'),
          value: book.pagesLabel,
        ),
      if (_has(book.edition) && !_isLong(book.edition))
        _BentoTile(
          icon: Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
          label: Loc.tr('bookEdition'),
          value: book.edition,
        ),
    ];
    final wide = <_BentoTile>[
      if (_has(book.edition) && _isLong(book.edition))
        _BentoTile(
          icon: Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
          label: Loc.tr('bookEdition'),
          value: book.edition,
          wide: true,
        ),
      _BentoTile(
        icon: Icons.edit_outlined,
        label: Loc.tr('ui_ad39f1c3af'),
        value: book.editorName.isEmpty
            ? Loc.tr('editorNotRecorded')
            : book.editorName,
        wide: true,
      ),
      if (_has(book.editionNote))
        _BentoTile(
            icon: Icons.info_outline_rounded,
            label: Loc.tr('editionNote'),
            value: book.editionNote,
            wide: true),
      if (_has(book.publisher))
        _BentoTile(
          icon: Icons.apartment_outlined,
          label: Loc.tr('bookPublisher'),
          value: book.publisher,
          wide: true,
        ),
    ];
    if (facts.isEmpty && wide.isEmpty) {
      return Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: OTSpacing.md),
        child: Text(Loc.tr('unknownMetadata')),
      );
    }

    // Satu tabel identitas edisi: kartu hanya untuk benda yang bisa dibuka,
    // jadi fakta-fakta ini berbagi satu permukaan dengan garis pemisah.
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final rows = [...facts, ...wide];
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
          OTSpacing.base, OTSpacing.md, OTSpacing.base, OTSpacing.xs),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: OTColors.surface(isDark),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
        border: Border.all(color: OTColors.surface(isDark)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Text(
            NativeCopy.text('edition').toUpperCase(),
            style: OTTypography.sectionHeading(
                color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark)),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xs),
          for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) ...[
            if (i > 0) Divider(height: 1, color: OTColors.borderSubtle(isDark)),
            OTReveal(index: i, child: rows[i]),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _BentoTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _BentoTile({
    required this.icon,
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    this.wide = false,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String label;
  final String value;
  final bool wide;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final displayValue = value.trim();
    final isArabic = answerDirection(displayValue) == TextDirection.rtl;

    final valueText = Text(
      displayValue,
      textDirection: answerDirection(displayValue),
      textAlign: TextAlign.start,
      style: isArabic
          ? ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s18, height: 1.7, color: ink)
          : OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: ink),
    );
    final labelRow = Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Icon(icon, size: 16, color: textSecondary),
        const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.sm),
        Flexible(
          child: Text(
            label,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: OTSpacing.md),
      child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, box) {
        if (box.maxWidth < 560) {
          return Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                labelRow,
                const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xs),
                valueText
              ]);
        }
        return Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          SizedBox(width: 168, child: labelRow),
          const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.lg),
          Expanded(child: valueText),
        ]);
      }),
    );
  }
}
