  /// Memeriksa cookie sesi Google di WebView. `null` berarti platform tidak
  /// dapat membacanya, sehingga keputusan tidak boleh didasarkan padanya.
  Future<bool?> _hasGoogleSession() async {
    try {
      final cookies = await DesktopWebViewRuntime.cookies.getCookies(
        url: WebUri(NotebookNavigation.canonicalOrigin),
        webViewController: _webController,
      );
      const names = {'SID', '__Secure-1PSID', '__Secure-3PSID'};
      return cookies.any((cookie) =>
          names.contains(cookie.name) &&
          (cookie.value?.toString().isNotEmpty ?? false));
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Tombol Lanjutkan manual untuk memeriksa login dan konfirmasi akun
  Future<void> _handleManualContinue() async {
    if (!mounted || _isSessionReady) return;
    final controller = _webController;
    final currentWebUrl = await controller?.getUrl();
    final urlStr = currentWebUrl?.toString() ?? '';

    if (urlStr.isEmpty ||
        urlStr.contains('accounts.google') ||
        urlStr.contains('InteractiveLogin') ||
        urlStr.contains('ServiceLogin') ||
        urlStr.contains('signin/v2')) {
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.warning(
          context,
          'Harap selesaikan proses login Google terlebih dahulu.',
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    final currentEmail = (AuthService().cachedCurrentUser?.email ??
            AuthService().currentUser?.email ??
            '')
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

    if (controller != null) {
      final detectedEmail = await _detectGoogleEmail(controller);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (detectedEmail != null && detectedEmail.isNotEmpty) {
        if (currentEmail.isNotEmpty && detectedEmail != currentEmail) {
          _showAccountMismatchDialog(detectedEmail, currentEmail);
          return;
        }
        await _onSessionAuthenticated();
        return;
      }
    }

    if (!mounted) return;

    // Konfirmasi manual hanya berlaku bila sesi Google benar-benar ada;
    // tanpa itu ruang AI pasti gagal dibuka.
    if (await _hasGoogleSession() == false) {
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.warning(
          context,
          'Harap selesaikan proses login Google terlebih dahulu.',
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;

    // Jika belum terbaca dari DOM, tampilkan konfirmasi akun sama
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: OTColors.surface(isDark),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.dialog),
          side: BorderSide(color: OTColors.border(isDark)),
        ),
        title: Text(
          'Konfirmasi Akun Google',
          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
            color: OTColors.textPrimary(isDark),
          ),
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              'Pastikan Anda telah masuk ke Google dengan akun:',
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: OTColors.canvas(isDark),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
                border: Border.all(color: OTColors.border(isDark)),
              ),
              child: Text(
                currentEmail.isNotEmpty ? currentEmail : 'Akun yang sama',
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: OTColors.accent(isDark),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: Text(
              'Periksa Lagi',
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                  color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark)),
            ),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: Text(
              'Ya, Sudah Masuk',
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm == true && mounted) {
      await _onSessionAuthenticated();
    }
  }

  /// Menandai sesi Google terautentikasi dan melanjutkan
  Future<void> _onSessionAuthenticated() async {
    if (!mounted || _isSessionReady) return;
    setState(() => _isSessionReady = true);

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setBool('google_session_ready', true);
      final email = (AuthService().cachedCurrentUser?.email ??
              AuthService().currentUser?.email ??
              '')
          .trim()
          .toLowerCase();
      if (email.isNotEmpty) {
        await prefs.setString('google_session_email', email);
        await prefs.setString('notebook_google_email', email);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    await AuthService.rememberWebSessionOwner(
        AuthService().cachedCurrentUser?.email ??
            AuthService().currentUser?.email ??
            '');

    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
      Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } else {
      Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
        context,
        AppRoutes.dashboard,
        (route) => false,
      );
    }
  }

  /// Dialog konfirmasi jika pengguna membatalkan / keluar dari langkah ke-2
  Future<void> _confirmCancelAndSignOut() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final primary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final secondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);

    final shouldSignOut = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
          side: BorderSide(color: OTColors.border(isDark)),
        ),
        title: Text(
          Loc.tr('cancelSignInTitle'),
          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: primary,
          ),
        ),
        content: Text(
          Loc.tr('googleSessionSignInSameAccountDesc'),
          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
            fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
            color: secondary,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: Text(
              Loc.tr('cancel'),
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                color: secondary,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: OTButtons.destructive(isDark),
            child: Text(
              Loc.tr('exit'),
              style: OTTypography.button(color: OTColors.onAccent(isDark)),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (shouldSignOut == true && mounted) {
      await AuthService().signOut();
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
        context,
        AppRoutes.login,
        (route) => false,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final currentEmail = (AuthService().cachedCurrentUser?.email ??
            AuthService().currentUser?.email ??
            '')
        .trim();

    if (_isSessionReady) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        body: Center(
          child: AppLoader(
            title: AppCopy.googleSessionConnected,
            subtitle: AppCopy.googleSessionPreparing,
            dotSize: 10,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) async {
        if (didPop) return;
        final canGoBack = await _webController?.canGoBack() ?? false;
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (canGoBack) {
          await _webController?.goBack();
        } else {
          await _confirmCancelAndSignOut();
        }
      },
      child: AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
        value: SystemUiOverlayStyle(
          statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
          statusBarIconBrightness: isDark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,
          systemNavigationBarColor: canvas,
          systemNavigationBarIconBrightness:
              isDark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,
        ),
        child: Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          appBar: AppBar(
            backgroundColor: canvas,
            elevation: 0,
            scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
            leading: IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded,
                  size: 20, color: textSecondary),
              tooltip: Loc.tr('back'),
              onPressed: () async {
                final canGoBack = await _webController?.canGoBack() ?? false;
                if (canGoBack) {
                  await _webController?.goBack();
                } else {
                  await _confirmCancelAndSignOut();
                }
              },
            ),
            title: Text(
              Loc.tr('roomSameAccountTitle'),
              style: ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: textPrimary,
                letterSpacing: -0.2,
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              IconButton(
                tooltip: Loc.tr('tryAgain'),
                icon:
                    Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                onPressed: () {
                  _webController?.reload();
                },
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: _handleManualContinue,
                child: Text(
                  'Lanjutkan',
                  style: OTTypography.button(color: textPrimary),
                ),
              ),
              IconButton(
                tooltip: Loc.tr('exit'),
                icon:
                    Icon(Icons.logout_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                onPressed: _confirmCancelAndSignOut,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
            ],
            bottom: PreferredSize(
              preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(2),
              child: ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
                valueListenable: _loadProgress,
                builder: (context, progress, child) {
                  if (progress >= 1.0) return const SizedBox(height: 2);
                  return LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: progress,
                    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                    valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(textPrimary),
                    minHeight: 2,
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: Column(
              children: [
                // ── Info Wajib Akun yang Sama (Langkah 2) ──

                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: surface,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
                    border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [

                        children: [
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),

                              color: textPrimary.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
                              border: Border.all(
                                color: border,
                                width: 0.6,
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              'LANGKAH 2 DARI 2',
                              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                                fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                letterSpacing: 0.6,
                                color: textPrimary,
                              ),

                              incognito: false,
                              javaScriptEnabled: true,
                              domStorageEnabled: true,
                              databaseEnabled: true,
                              useWideViewPort: false,
                              loadWithOverviewMode: false,
                              cacheEnabled: true,
                              clearCache: false,
                              transparentBackground: false,
                              allowsInlineMediaPlayback: true,
                              supportZoom: false,
                              displayZoomControls: false,
                              mixedContentMode:
                                  MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
                              thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
                              sharedCookiesEnabled: true,
                              hardwareAcceleration: true,
                              useHybridComposition: true,
                              useOnRenderProcessGone: true,
                              supportMultipleWindows: true,
                              javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically: true,
                              isInspectable: kDebugMode,
                              forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
                              forceDarkStrategy: ForceDarkStrategy
                                  .PREFER_WEB_THEME_OVER_USER_AGENT_DARKENING,
                              algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: true,
                            ),
                            onCreateWindow:
                                (controller, createWindowAction) async {
                              final targetUrl = createWindowAction.request.url;
                              if (targetUrl != null &&
                                  (NotebookNavigation.signInFlow(
                                          targetUrl.uriValue) ||
                                      NotebookNavigation.allowed(
                                          targetUrl.uriValue))) {
                                await controller.loadUrl(
                                    urlRequest: URLRequest(url: targetUrl));
                                return true;
                              }
                              return false;
                            },
                            onWebViewCreated: (controller) =>
                                _webController = controller,
                            onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) {
                              if (mounted) _loadProgress.value = progress / 100;
                            },
                            onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
                              if (!mounted || url == null) return;
                              await _checkAccountVerification(controller);
                            },
                            onUpdateVisitedHistory:
                                (controller, url, isReload) async {
                              if (!mounted || url == null) return;
                              await _checkAccountVerification(controller);
                            },
                            onReceivedError: (controller, request, error) {
                              debugPrint(
                                  '[GoogleSessionAuth] WebView error: ${error.description}');
                            },
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';

import '../models/open_turath_book.dart';
import '../widgets/app_loader.dart';
import 'book_library_editorial_screen.dart';

String _readerTitle(String value) {
  return value
      .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^(Super\s+)?AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s*\([^)]*\)'), '')
      .trim();
}

String _collectionTitle(AiLibraryMetadata metadata) {
  if (Loc.isArabic) return metadata.namaArab;
  if (Loc.language == 'id') return _readerTitle(metadata.nama);
  return switch (metadata.keyName) {
    'fiqh_syafii' => 'Shafi‘i jurisprudence',
    'hadits' => 'Hadith and Prophetic tradition',
    'ushul_fiqh' => 'Principles of jurisprudence',
    'bahasa_arab' => 'Arabic language and literature',
    'tafsir' => 'Qur’anic exegesis',
    'fiqh_tahawwulat' => 'Jurisprudence of transformations',
    'tarikh_sirah' => 'History and Prophetic biography',
    'fiqh_muqaran' => 'Comparative jurisprudence',
    'fatawa_masail' => 'Legal opinions and questions',
    'syarah_hadits' => 'Hadith commentaries',
    'fiqh_hanafi' => 'Hanafi jurisprudence',
    'fiqh_maliki' => 'Maliki jurisprudence',
    'fiqh_hanbali' => 'Hanbali jurisprudence',
    'tasawwuf' => 'Spiritual ethics',
    'tajwid_qiraat' => 'Qur’anic recitation',
    'qawaid_fiqhiyyah' => 'Legal maxims',
    'musthalah_hadits' => 'Hadith methodology',
    'aqidah' => 'Theology',
    'thabaqat_tarajim' => 'Scholarly biographies',
    'bibliografi_faharis' => 'Bibliography and indexes',
    _ => metadata.namaArab,
  };
}

/// Halaman Ringkasan Pustaka & Pelatihan AI (Monochrome Editorial)
class AiLibraryOverviewPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AiLibraryOverviewPage({
    super.key,
    required this.metadata,
    this.onSearch,
  });

  final AiLibraryMetadata metadata;
  final VoidCallback? onSearch;

  static PageRoute<void> route({
    required AiLibraryMetadata metadata,
    VoidCallback? onSearch,
  }) {
    return PageRouteBuilder<void>(
      transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
      reverseTransitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) {
        return AiLibraryOverviewPage(
          metadata: metadata,
          onSearch: onSearch,
        );
      },
      transitionsBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation, child) {
        final curved = CurvedAnimation(
          parent: animation,
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
        );

        return FadeTransition(
          opacity: curved,
          child: SlideTransition(
            position: Tween<Offset>(
              begin: const Offset(0, 0.03),
              end: Offset.zero,
            ).animate(curved),
            child: child,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  State<AiLibraryOverviewPage> createState() => _AiLibraryOverviewPageState();
}

class _AiLibraryOverviewPageState extends State<AiLibraryOverviewPage> {
  late Future<List<OpenTurathBook>> _books = OpenTurathCatalogRepository
      .instance
      .loadBooksForModule(widget.metadata.keyName);
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => FutureBuilder<List<OpenTurathBook>>(
      future: _books,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.hasData) {
          return OpenTurathBookLibraryPage(
              books: snapshot.data!,
              metadata: widget.metadata,
              collectionName: _collectionTitle(widget.metadata));
        }
        return Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(title: Text(Loc.tr('libraryOverview'))),
            body: snapshot.hasError
                ? Center(
                    child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                    Text(Loc.tr('catalogFailure')),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    FilledButton(
                        onPressed: () => setState(() {
                              _books = OpenTurathCatalogRepository.instance
                                  .loadBooksForModule(widget.metadata.keyName);
                            }),
                        child: Text(Loc.tr('retryCatalog'))),
                  ]))
                : AppLoader.fullscreen(subtitle: Loc.tr('loadingReferences')));
      });
}

class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}

class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen> {
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String? _desktopError;
  late final TapGestureRecognizer _termsRecognizer;
  late final TapGestureRecognizer _privacyRecognizer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _termsRecognizer = TapGestureRecognizer()
      ..onTap = () => _openLegalUrl('https://openturath.id/terms.html');
    _privacyRecognizer = TapGestureRecognizer()
      ..onTap = () => _openLegalUrl('https://openturath.id/privacy.html');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _termsRecognizer.dispose();
    _privacyRecognizer.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _openLegalUrl(String url) async {
    final uri = Uri.parse(url);
    try {
      if (!await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication)) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.platformDefault);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.error(context, Loc.tr('ui_0fb589d0e6'));
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _signIn() async {
    if (_isLoading) return;
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _desktopError = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = await _authService.signInWithGoogle();

      if (user != null && mounted) {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        if (!mounted) return;
        final sessionReady = prefs.getBool('google_session_ready') ?? false;
        final sessionEmail = prefs.getString('google_session_email') ?? '';
        final userEmail = user.email.trim().toLowerCase();
        await AuthService.reconcileWebSession(userEmail);
        if (!mounted) return;

        if (sessionReady && userEmail.isNotEmpty && sessionEmail == userEmail) {
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.dashboard);
        } else {
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.googleSessionAuth);
        }
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final message = loginErrorMessage(e);
      if (message.isEmpty) return;
      if (AppPlatform.isDesktop) {
        setState(() => _desktopError = message);
      } else {
        AppSnackBar.error(context, message);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

class _LibraryTotals extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LibraryTotals({required this.ink, required this.muted});

  final Color ink;
  final Color muted;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FutureBuilder<Map<String, AiLibraryMetadata>>(
      future: OpenTurathCatalogRepository.instance.loadAllMetadata(),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final all = snapshot.data ?? const <String, AiLibraryMetadata>{};
        if (snapshot.hasError) return Text(Loc.tr('catalogFailure'));
        if (all.isEmpty) return const SizedBox(height: 44);
        final number = NumberFormat.decimalPattern(Loc.language);
        final entries =
            all.values.fold<int>(0, (sum, item) => sum + item.totalKitab);
        final pages =
            all.values.fold<int>(0, (sum, item) => sum + item.totalHalaman);
        Widget stat(String value, String label) => Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    value,
                    style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                      fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      letterSpacing: -0.4,
                      color: ink,
                    ).copyWith(
                        fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()]),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(label,
                      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                          fontSize: OTFontSize.s12, color: muted)),
                ],
              ),
            );
        return Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            stat(number.format(all.length), Loc.tr('loginStatLibraries')),
            // Dibulatkan ke bawah: sebagian angka halaman di metadata adalah perkiraan.
            stat(Loc.atLeast(number.format(entries ~/ 100 * 100)),
                Loc.tr('loginStatEntries')),
            stat(
                Loc.atLeast(
                    number.format(pages ~/ 100000 / 10), Loc.tr('unitMillion')),
                Loc.tr('loginStatPages')),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class MainShellScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final int initialTab;

  const MainShellScreen({super.key, this.initialTab = 0});

  @override
  State<MainShellScreen> createState() => _MainShellScreenState();

class _MainShellScreenState extends State<MainShellScreen> {
  final FocusNode _dashboardSearchFocus = FocusNode();
  late int _currentIndex;
  late final PageController _pageController;
  String? _selectedFieldId;

    _currentIndex = widget.initialTab;

  void _onTabSelected(int index, {String? fieldId, CorpusKind? kind}) {
    AppSnackBar.clear(context);
    if (_pageController.hasClients && _currentIndex != index) {
      // Lompat lalu pudarkan: halaman tidak meluncur melewati tab di antaranya.
      _pageController.jumpToPage(index);
    }
    setState(() {
      _currentIndex = index;
      _selectedFieldId = fieldId;
      _selectedKind = kind;
    });
  }

  List<Widget> _buildScreens() {
    final field = _selectedFieldId != null
        ? FieldModel.defaultFields.firstWhere(
            (f) => f.id == _selectedFieldId,
            orElse: () => FieldModel.defaultFields.first,
          )
        : null;

    final pages = <Widget>[
      DashboardScreen(searchFocusNode: _dashboardSearchFocus),
      SpecialistListScreen(
        key: ValueKey('${_selectedFieldId}_${_selectedKind?.name}'),
        field: field,
      ),
      const BookmarkScreen(),
      const ProfileScreen(),
    ];
    return [
      for (var i = 0; i < pages.length; i++)
        OTActiveFade(active: i == _currentIndex, child: pages[i]),
    ];
  }

  void _showPage(int index) {
    AgentSessionManager.instance.closeRoom();
    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    _onTabSelected(index);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DesktopShortcuts(
        onFind: () {
          _showPage(0);
          if (_pageController.hasClients) _pageController.jumpToPage(0);
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (mounted) _dashboardSearchFocus.requestFocus();
          });
        },
        onNewTab: () => _showPage(1),
        onSettings: () => _showPage(3),
        onCloseTab: () {
          final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
          if (manager.isOpen) manager.closeTab(manager.activeIndex);
        },
        onReload: () {
          // Dinonaktifkan: Cmd+R di dalam sesi AI merusak layout obrolan (menampilkan bilah Sources/Studio).
          // Pintasan diabaikan secara aman agar tidak mereset sesi aktif.
        },
        onEscape: () {
          final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
          if (manager.isOpen) manager.closeRoom();
          FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
        },
        child: _buildShell(context),
      );

  Widget _buildShell(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);
    final indicator = OTColors.primaryContainer(isDark);

    final isWideScreen = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 600;
    final expandedSidebar = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 1100;
    final screens = _buildScreens();

    final Widget baseScaffold = isWideScreen
        ? Scaffold(
            backgroundColor: canvas,
            body: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: surface,
                      border: BorderDirectional(
                          end: BorderSide(
                              color: OTColors.borderSubtle(isDark)))),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: NavigationRail(
                          backgroundColor: surface,
                          indicatorColor: indicator,
                          minWidth: 88,
                          minExtendedWidth: 208,
                          extended: expandedSidebar,
                          selectedIndex: _currentIndex,
                          // Ikon saja; nama tujuan muncul sebagai tooltip.
                          labelType: expandedSidebar
                              ? NavigationRailLabelType.none
                              : NavigationRailLabelType.all,
                          leading: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16, bottom: 20),
                            child:
                                Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                              SizedBox.square(
                                  dimension: 56,
                                  child: Center(
                                      child: OpenTurathMark(
                                          size: 40, color: accent))),
                              if (expandedSidebar) ...[
                                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                Text('OpenTurath',
                                    style: Theme.of(context)
                                        .textTheme
                                        .titleMedium),
                              ],
                            ]),
                          ),
                          onDestinationSelected: (index) {
                            HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                            _onTabSelected(index);
                          },
                          destinations: [
                            NavigationRailDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
                              selectedIcon: const Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
                              label: Text(Loc.tr('navHome')),
                            ),
                            NavigationRailDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_stories_outlined),
                              selectedIcon:
                                  const Icon(Icons.auto_stories_rounded),
                              label: Text(Loc.tr('navStudies')),
                            ),
                            NavigationRailDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_note_outlined),
                              selectedIcon: const Icon(Icons.edit_note_rounded),
                              label: Text(Loc.tr('navSaved')),
                            ),
                            NavigationRailDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined),
                              selectedIcon: const Icon(Icons.settings_rounded),
                              label: Text(Loc.tr('navSettings')),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: PageView(
                    controller: _pageController,
                    physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                    children: screens,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          )
        : Scaffold(
            backgroundColor: canvas,
            body: PageView(
              controller: _pageController,
              physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              children: screens,
            ),
            extendBody: false,
            bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
              backgroundColor: surface,
              indicatorColor: indicator,
              selectedIndex: _currentIndex,
              labelBehavior: NavigationDestinationLabelBehavior.alwaysShow,
              onDestinationSelected: (index) {
                HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                _onTabSelected(index);
              },
              destinations: [
                NavigationDestination(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
                  selectedIcon: const Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
                  label: Loc.tr('navHome'),
                ),
                NavigationDestination(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_stories_outlined),
                  selectedIcon: const Icon(Icons.auto_stories_rounded),
                  label: Loc.tr('navStudies'),
                ),
                NavigationDestination(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_note_outlined),
                  selectedIcon: const Icon(Icons.edit_note_rounded),
                  label: Loc.tr('navSaved'),
                ),
                NavigationDestination(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined),
                  selectedIcon: const Icon(Icons.settings_rounded),
                  label: Loc.tr('navSettings'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );

    return MainShellController(
      switchTab: _onTabSelected,
      child: ListenableBuilder(
        listenable: AgentSessionManager.instance,
        builder: (context, child) {
          final sessionManager = AgentSessionManager.instance;

          return PopScope(
            // canPop hanya diizinkan jika ruang tertutup DAN sedang di tab 0
            canPop: !sessionManager.isOpen && _currentIndex == 0,
            onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) async {
              if (didPop) return;
              if (sessionManager.isOpen) {
                // Periksa apakah webview pada tab aktif memiliki riwayat navigasi sebelumnya
                final activeWebCtrl = sessionManager.activeTab?.webController;
                if (activeWebCtrl != null && await activeWebCtrl.canGoBack()) {
                  await activeWebCtrl.goBack();
                  return;
                }
                if (context.mounted) {
                  AppSnackBar.clear(context);
                }
                sessionManager.closeRoom();
                return;
              }
              if (_currentIndex != 0) {
                if (context.mounted) {
                  AppSnackBar.clear(context);
                }
                _onTabSelected(0);
              }
            },
            child: Stack(
              children: [
                // 1. Dashboard latar belakang (Stationary - bebas GPU overhead)
                ExcludeFocus(
                    excluding: sessionManager.isOpen, child: baseScaffold),

                // 2. Ruang AI Multi-Tab (Instant zero-glitch display dengan retensi memori penuh)
                Positioned.fill(
                  child: Visibility(
                    visible: sessionManager.isOpen,
                    maintainState: true,
                    maintainAnimation: true,
                    maintainSize: true,
                    child: ExcludeFocus(
                        excluding: !sessionManager.isOpen, child: child!),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
        child: const AgentMultiTabRoom(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../core/app_copy.dart';

import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import '../services/bookmark_service.dart';
import '../widgets/note_editor_sheet.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_typography.dart';

/// Focused reading surface: the archive list remains an index, not an editor.
class NoteReaderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const NoteReaderScreen({super.key, required this.item});
  final BookmarkModel item;

  @override
  State<NoteReaderScreen> createState() => _NoteReaderScreenState();
}

class _NoteReaderScreenState extends State<NoteReaderScreen> {
  late BookmarkModel _item = widget.item;

  Future<void> _edit() async {
    final updated = await NoteEditorSheet.show(context, item: _item);
    if (updated != null && mounted) setState(() => _item = updated);
  }

  Future<void> _delete() async {
    final remove = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(AppCopy.deleteNoteTitle),
        content: Text(AppCopy.deleteNoteDesc),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text(AppCopy.cancel)),
          FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              child: Text(AppCopy.delete)),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (remove != true) return;
    await BookmarkService().deleteBookmark(_item.id);
    if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
  }

  void _copy() {
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: noteClipboardText(_item)));
    AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.noteContentCopied);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = NativeColors.canvas(isDark);
    final primary = NativeColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final secondary = NativeColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final displayTitle = _item.documentKind == BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer
        ? aiAnswerTitle(_item.fullAnswer, _item.agentTitle)
        : _item.title;
    final displayContent = _item.documentKind == BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer
        ? readableAiAnswerMarkdown(_item.fullAnswer)
        : (_item.fullAnswer.isEmpty ? _item.arabicExcerpt : _item.fullAnswer);
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        title: Text(AppCopy.savedCollection),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_outlined),
              tooltip: AppCopy.copyContentTooltip,
              onPressed: _copy),
          PopupMenuButton<String>(
            onSelected: (value) {
              if (value == 'edit') _edit();
              if (value == 'delete') _delete();
            },
            itemBuilder: (_) => [
              PopupMenuItem(value: 'edit', child: Text(AppCopy.editNote)),
              PopupMenuItem(value: 'delete', child: Text(AppCopy.deleteNote)),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Align(
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
                child: SelectionArea(
                  child: ListView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                        OTSpacing.lg, OTSpacing.md, OTSpacing.lg, OTSpacing.xl),
                    children: [
                      Text(_kindLabel(_item),
                          style: NativeFonts.outfit(
                              fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: secondary,
                              letterSpacing: .6)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Directionality(
                        textDirection:
                            Bidi.detectRtlDirectionality(displayTitle)
                                ? TextDirection.rtl
                                : TextDirection.ltr,
                        child: Text(
                          displayTitle,
                          style: Bidi.detectRtlDirectionality(displayTitle)
                              ? NativeFonts.scheherazadeNew(
                                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
                                  height: 1.7,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  color: primary)
                              : NativeFonts.newsreader(
                                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
                                  height: 1.2,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  color: primary),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (_item.agentTitle.isNotEmpty &&
                          _item.documentKind == BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer &&
                          !displayTitle.toLowerCase().contains(_item.agentTitle
                              .replaceFirst(
                                  RegExp(r'^AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
                              .toLowerCase())) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        Text(
                          _item.agentTitle.replaceFirst(
                              RegExp(r'^AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), ''),
                          style: NativeFonts.outfit(
                              fontSize: OTFontSize.s14, color: secondary),
                        ),
                      ],
                      const SizedBox(height: 20),
                      Divider(color: secondary.withValues(alpha: .25)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 20),
                      ScholarlyAnswer(
                          text: displayContent, ink: primary, muted: secondary),
                      if (_item.citations.isNotEmpty) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xl),
                        Divider(color: secondary.withValues(alpha: .25)),
                        const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.base),
                        Text(Loc.tr('sourceReferences'),
                            style: NativeFonts.outfit(
                                fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                color: secondary,
                                letterSpacing: .6)),
                        const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
                        for (final citation in _item.citations)
                          Padding(
                            padding:
                                const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: OTSpacing.sm),
                            child: Directionality(
                              textDirection:
                                  Bidi.detectRtlDirectionality(citation.display)
                                      ? TextDirection.rtl
                                      : TextDirection.ltr,
                              child: Text(citation.display,
                                  style: RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]')
                                          .hasMatch(citation.display)
                                      ? NativeFonts.scheherazadeNew(
                                          fontSize: OTFontSize.s18,
                                          height: 1.85,
                                          color: primary)
                                      : NativeFonts.outfit(
                                          fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                                          height: 1.5,
                                          color: primary)),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ))),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _kindLabel(BookmarkModel item) => switch (item.documentKind) {
        BookmarkDocumentKind.personalNote => AppCopy.navSaved,
        BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer => item.agentTitle.isNotEmpty
            ? item.agentTitle
                .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
            : (item.fieldName.isNotEmpty ? item.fieldName : AppCopy.studySpace),
        BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference => AppCopy.bookReferenceLabel,
      };
}

class ProfileScreen extends StatefulWidget {

}

class _ProfileScreenState extends State<ProfileScreen> {
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  bool _isLoggingOut = false;
  bool _isDeletingAccount = false;
  String _appVersion = '—';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadAppVersion();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAppVersion() async {
    try {
      final info = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _appVersion = '${info.version}+${info.buildNumber}');
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
          title: Text(
            AppCopy.logoutDialogTitle,
            style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary)
                .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s18),
          ),
          content: Text(
            AppCopy.logoutDialogBody,
            style: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text(AppCopy.cancel,
                  style: OTTypography.button(color: textSecondary)),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              style: OTButtons.destructive(isDark),
              child: Text(AppCopy.logoutButton,
                  style: OTTypography.button(color: OTColors.onAccent(isDark))),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isLoggingOut = true);
    try {
      await _authService.signOut();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
            context, AppRoutes.login, (r) => false);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoggingOut = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteAccount() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
          title: Row(

              Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
                  color: OTColors.destructive(isDark), size: 24),
              const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.sm),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  AppCopy.deleteAccountTitle,
                  style: OTTypography.cardTitle(
                          color: OTColors.destructive(isDark))
                      .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s18),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          content: Text(
            AppCopy.deleteAccountBody,
            style: OTTypography.body(color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark)),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text(AppCopy.cancel,
                  style: OTTypography.button(
                      color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark))),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),

              child: Text(AppCopy.deleteAccountButton,
                  style: OTTypography.button(color: OTColors.onAccent(isDark))),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isDeletingAccount = true);
    try {

      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.deleteAccountSuccess);
        Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(

        AppSnackBar.error(context, errText);

          orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
        ),

  void _showAccessPortfolio(UserModel? user, MembershipPassSummary summary) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final entries = (user?.entitlements.entries ??
            const <MapEntry<String, ModuleEntitlement>>[])
        .where((entry) => summary.agentIds.contains(entry.key))
        .toList();
    final allAccess = summary.agentIds.contains('all_access') ||
        summary.agentIds.contains('all_ai');
    // Akses penuh: tampilkan nama asisten yang benar-benar terbuka.
    final rows = allAccess
        ? [
            for (final agent in AgentModel.defaultAgents)
              if (!agent.isComingSoon) (Loc.text(agent.title), ''),

        : [
            for (final entry in entries)

                entry.value.expiry == null
                    ? Loc.tr('activeSubscription')
                    : Loc.tr(
                        'expiryDate', [_formatAccessDate(entry.value.expiry!)]),
              ),
          ];
    showAdaptiveSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: rows.length > 6,
      backgroundColor: surface,
      builder: (sheetContext) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(24, 16, 12, 20),

                      Text(

                            ? '${Loc.tr('ui_b236ca6182')} · ${summary.supportingLabel}'
                            : Loc.tr('ui_b92aed18d1'),
                        style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary)
                            .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s14),
                      ),

                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip:
                      MaterialLocalizations.of(sheetContext).closeButtonTooltip,
                  icon:
                      Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Flexible(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 12),
                child: ListView.separated(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  itemCount: rows.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                      Divider(height: 1, color: OTColors.border(isDark)),

  }

  static String _formatAccessDate(DateTime value) =>
      HijriDateUtils.formatMasehiOnly(value.toLocal());

  static String _entitlementTitle(String key) => Loc.text(switch (key) {
        'fiqh_tahawwulat' => 'Fikih Tahawwulat',
        'fiqh_syafii' => "Fikih Syafi'i",
        'nahwu' => 'Bahasa Arab',
        'ushul_fiqh' => 'Usul Fikih',
        'tafsir' => 'Tafsir',
        'hadits' => 'Hadis',
        'aqidah' => 'Akidah',
        _ => AppCopy.navStudies,
      });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);

        scrolledUnderElevation: 0,

          AppCopy.navSettings,

      body: SafeArea(
        child: StreamBuilder<UserModel?>(
          stream: _authService.userStream,

            final fbUser = _authService.currentUser;

                ? userModel!.name
                : (fbUser?.displayName ?? 'Pengguna');
            final email = userModel?.email.isNotEmpty == true
                ? userModel!.email
                : (fbUser?.email ?? '');
            final membership = resolveMembershipPass(userModel);

            return Align(
              alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 760),
                child: ListView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  children: [

                        child: _MembershipPass(
                      holderName: displayName,
                      email: email,
                      memberId: _memberIdFor(userModel?.uid ?? ''),
                      summary: membership,
                      isDark: isDark,
                      onManage: () => _openSubscription(userModel),
                      onViewAccess: membership.isOpen &&
                              membership.agentIds.isNotEmpty
                          ? () => _showAccessPortfolio(userModel, membership)
                          : null,
                    )),

                    const SizedBox(height: 18),

                    // ── Card 2: Mode Tampilan 3 Pilihan & Bahasa ──
                    Container(

                      child: Column(

                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                                            OTRadius.input),
                                      ),
                                      child: LayoutBuilder(
                                          builder: (context, box) {
                                        const stacked = false;
                                        final choices = <Widget>[
                                          _buildThemeOption(
                                            stacked: stacked,

                                                ? 'تلقائي'

                                            icon: Icons.brightness_auto_rounded,
                                            isSelected:
                                                currentMode == ThemeMode.system,
                                            isDark: isDark,

                          ),

                          Padding(

  void _showAboutModal(

    Color textSecondary,

    showDialog(

                borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder,

                AppCopy.aboutTitle,
                style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: textPrimary)
                    .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s20),

                physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      AppCopy.versionWithTagline(_appVersion),
                      style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: textSecondary),
                    ),

                      AppCopy.aboutDescription,

                      AppCopy.aboutScholarlyPrinciple,

                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    ExpansionTile(
                      tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,

                      leading: const OpenTurathMark(size: 32),
                      title: Text(Loc.tr('brandPhilosophyTitle'),
                          style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary)),
                      children: [
                        Text(Loc.tr('brandPhilosophy'),
                            style: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary)),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Divider(height: 1, color: border),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    _buildAboutDocTile(
                      icon: Icons.article_outlined,
                      title: AppCopy.termsOfService,
                      textPrimary: textPrimary,
                      textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      onTap: () {
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        LegalDocumentSheet.showTermsOfService(context);

                    _buildAboutDocTile(
                      icon: Icons.security_outlined,
                      title: AppCopy.privacyPolicy,
                      textPrimary: textPrimary,
                      textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      onTap: () {
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        LegalDocumentSheet.showPrivacyPolicy(context);
                      },
                    ),
                    _buildAboutDocTile(
                      icon: Icons.payment_outlined,

                      textPrimary: textPrimary,
                      textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      onTap: () {
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);

                      },

                    _buildAboutDocTile(
                      icon: Icons.menu_book_outlined,

                      textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      onTap: () {
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        LegalDocumentSheet.showAiGuideline(context);
                      },
                    ),
                    _buildAboutDocTile(
                      icon: Icons.headset_mic_outlined,
                      title: AppCopy.supportAndContact,
                      textPrimary: textPrimary,
                      textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      onTap: () {
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        LegalDocumentSheet.showContactSupport(context);
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                  child: Text(AppCopy.close, style: OTTypography.button()),
                ),

            ));
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAboutDocTile({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 4),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(icon, size: 18, color: textSecondary),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                Loc.text(title),
                style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: textPrimary),
              ),
            ),
            Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, size: 16, color: textSecondary),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _memberIdFor(String uid) {
    final clean = uid.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]'), '').toUpperCase();
    if (clean.length < 8 || uid.startsWith('guest_')) return '';
    return 'OT  ${clean.substring(0, 4)}  ${clean.substring(clean.length - 4)}';
  }

  Widget _buildThemeOption({
    required String title,
    IconData? icon,
    required bool isSelected,
    required bool isDark,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    bool stacked = false,
  }) {
    final color = isSelected ? textPrimary : textSecondary;
    final option = Semantics(
        button: true,
        label: Loc.text(title),
        selected: isSelected,
        child: Material(
            color: isSelected ? OTColors.surface(isDark) : Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
            child: InkWell(
                onTap: () {
                  HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                  onTap();
                },
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
                child: ConstrainedBox(
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48),
                    child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 4, vertical: 8),
                        child: Tooltip(
                            message: Loc.text(title),
                            child: Center(
                                child: icon == null
                                    ? Text(title,
                                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                            color: color))
                                    : Icon(icon, size: 22, color: color))))))));
    return stacked ? option : Expanded(child: option);
  }
}

/// Kartu akses anggota: merangkum identitas, status, dan ruang AI yang dapat
/// dipakai tanpa menyamarkan halaman pengaturan sebagai layar perbankan.
class _MembershipPass extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MembershipPass(
      {required this.holderName,
      required this.email,
      required this.summary,
      required this.isDark,
      required this.onManage,
      this.onViewAccess,
      this.memberId = ''});
  final String holderName;
  final String email;
  final String memberId;
  final MembershipPassSummary summary;
  final bool isDark;
  final VoidCallback onManage;
  final VoidCallback? onViewAccess;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final muted = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final unlimited = summary.isOpen &&
        (summary.expiresAt == null || summary.expiresAt!.year >= 2090);
    final expiry = unlimited
        ? Loc.tr('lifetimeAccess')
        : summary.expiresAt == null
            ? null
            : HijriDateUtils.formatMasehiOnly(summary.expiresAt!.toLocal());
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: OTColors.surface(isDark), borderRadius: OTRadius.cardBorder),
      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        Row(children: [
          Container(
              width: 48,
              height: 48,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark),
                  borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder),
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              child: Text(
                  holderName.trim().isEmpty
                      ? 'O'
                      : holderName.trim().characters.first.toUpperCase(),
                  style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: ink))),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                Text(holderName, style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: ink)),
                if (email.isNotEmpty)
                  Text(email.replaceAll('@', '@\u200b'),
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                      style: OTTypography.caption(color: muted)),
              ])),
          if (summary.isOpen) ...[
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: OTColors.primaryContainer(isDark),
                borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
              ),
              child: Text(
                summary.badge,
                style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: ink),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Divider(height: 1, color: OTColors.borderSubtle(isDark)),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          Icon(
              summary.isOpen
                  ? Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded
                  : Icons.lock_outline_rounded,
              size: 20,
              color: muted),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                Text(summary.accessLabel,
                    style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: ink)),
                if (expiry != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(unlimited ? expiry : '${AppCopy.validUntil} $expiry',
                      style: OTTypography.caption(color: muted)),
                ],
              ])),
          if (onViewAccess != null)
            IconButton(
                tooltip: Loc.tr('viewAccessList'),
                onPressed: onViewAccess,
                icon: Icon(Icons.auto_stories_outlined, size: 20, color: ink)),
        ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Divider(height: 1, color: OTColors.borderSubtle(isDark)),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          child: FilledButton.icon(
            key: const ValueKey('visible-subscription-button'),
            onPressed: onManage,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.card_membership_outlined, size: 20),
            label: Text(AppCopy.subscription),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }
}

          style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
        ),
        trailing: trailing,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SpecialistListScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final FieldModel? field; // Nullable if opened as general Specialist tab

  const SpecialistListScreen({super.key, this.field});

  @override
  State<SpecialistListScreen> createState() => _SpecialistListScreenState();
}

class _SpecialistListScreenState extends State<SpecialistListScreen> {
  final AgentService _agentService = AgentService();
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final ScrollController _listScrollCtrl = ScrollController();
  Timer? _debounce;

  List<AgentModel> _allAgents = [];
  String? _selectedFieldId;
  String _searchQuery = '';
  bool _isLoading = true;
  CorpusKind _corpusKind = CorpusKind.discipline;
  Map<String, AiLibraryMetadata> _libraryStats = const {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedFieldId = widget.field?.id;
    _loadAgents();
    OpenTurathCatalogRepository.instance.loadAllMetadata().then((all) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _libraryStats = all);
    }).catchError((Object error, StackTrace stack) {
      TelemetryService.instance
          .reportError(error, stack, context: 'library_metadata');
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    _listScrollCtrl.dispose();
    _debounce?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAgents() async {
    try {
      final agents = await _agentService.getAgents();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _allAgents = agents;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _allAgents = AgentModel.defaultAgents;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _onSearchChanged(String val) {
    if (_debounce?.isActive ?? false) _debounce!.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 250), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _searchQuery = val.trim();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  List<AgentModel> _computeFilteredAgents() {
    return _allAgents.where((agent) {
      // 1. Filter by CorpusKind
      if (agent.kind != _corpusKind) return false;

      // 2. Filter by discipline field if in discipline mode
      if (_corpusKind == CorpusKind.discipline) {
        final matchesField = _selectedFieldId == null ||
            _selectedFieldId == 'all' ||
            agent.fieldId == _selectedFieldId;
        if (!matchesField) return false;
      }

      // 3. Filter by search query
      if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return true;

      return ArabicUtils.matches(agent.title, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.titleArabic, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.subtitleAcademic, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.description, _searchQuery);
    }).toList();
  }

  void _openAgent(AgentModel agent) {
    OTMotion.light();
    if (agent.isComingSoon) {
      AppSnackBar.warning(
        context,
        AppCopy.preparingModule(agent.title),
      );
      return;
    }

    final user = _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    if (user == null || !user.hasAccessToAgent(agent.id)) {
      _openSubscriptionForAgent(agent, user: user);
      return;
    }

    AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(agent, user: user);
  }

  void _openTahawwulatSubAgent(AgentModel parentAgent, SubAgentModel subAgent) {
    OTMotion.light();
    final user = _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    if (user == null || !user.hasAccessToAgent(parentAgent.id)) {
      _openSubscriptionForAgent(parentAgent, user: user);
      return;
    }

    final personaAgent = AgentModel(
      id: subAgent.id,
      title: 'Fikih Tahawwulat: ${subAgent.name}',
      titleArabic: subAgent.nameArabic,
      description: subAgent.description,
      emoji: subAgent.emoji,
      category: parentAgent.category,
      status: 'active',
      sortOrder: parentAgent.sortOrder,
      fieldId: parentAgent.fieldId,
      subtitleAcademic: subAgent.description,
      suggestedPrompts: parentAgent.suggestedPrompts,
      referenceBooks: parentAgent.referenceBooks,
      catalogId: parentAgent.catalogId,
      kind: parentAgent.kind,
      disciplineIds: parentAgent.disciplineIds,
      scholarIds: parentAgent.scholarIds,
    );

    AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(personaAgent, user: user);
  }

  void _openSubscriptionForAgent(AgentModel agent, {UserModel? user}) {
    final targetUser = user ?? _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
      context,
      AppRoutes.subscription,
      arguments: {'agent': agent, 'user': targetUser},
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final isGeneralTab = widget.field == null;
    final title = isGeneralTab ? AppCopy.navStudies : widget.field!.name;
    final filtered = _computeFilteredAgents();
    final shell = MainShellController.of(context);

    return PopScope(
      canPop: isGeneralTab && (shell == null || !Navigator.canPop(context)),
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
        if (didPop) return;
        if (!isGeneralTab) {
          if (shell != null) {
            shell.switchTab(0);
          } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
            Navigator.pop(context);
          }
        } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
          Navigator.pop(context);
        }
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(
            Loc.text(title),
          ),
          centerTitle: false,
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          elevation: 0,
          scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
          leading: isGeneralTab
              ? null
              : IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded, color: textPrimary),
                  onPressed: () {
                    final shell = MainShellController.of(context);
                    if (shell != null) {
                      shell.switchTab(0);
                    } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                    }
                  },
                ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Align(
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 1040),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  // Search & Controls Container
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: OTSpacing.lg, vertical: OTSpacing.sm),
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Container(
                          height: 44,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: surface,
                            borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                            border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1.0),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                                  size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                              const SizedBox(width: 10),
                              Expanded(
                                child: TextField(
                                  controller: _searchCtrl,
                                  onChanged: _onSearchChanged,
                                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                                      fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                                      color: textPrimary),
                                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                                    hintText: Loc.tr('assistantSearch'),
                                    hintStyle: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                                        color: textSecondary),
                                    border: InputBorder.none,
                                    enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                    focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                    disabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                    errorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                    focusedErrorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                    filled: false,
                                    isDense: true,
                                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty)
                                GestureDetector(
                                  onTap: () {
                                    _searchCtrl.clear();
                                    setState(() => _searchQuery = '');
                                  },
                                  child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                      size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (isGeneralTab) ...[
                          const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),
                          // Dual Taxonomy Switcher
                          CorpusKindControl(
                            value: _corpusKind,
                            onChanged: (k) {
                              setState(() {
                                _corpusKind = k;
                                _selectedFieldId = null;
                              });
                            },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),

                  // Discipline Filter Chips (only in discipline mode)
                  if (isGeneralTab && _corpusKind == CorpusKind.discipline) ...[
                    SizedBox(
                      height: Loc.isArabic ? 52 : 40,
                      child: ListView(
                        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: OTSpacing.lg),
                        children: [
                          _filterChip(
                            label: AppCopy.allCategories,
                            isSelected: _selectedFieldId == null ||
                                _selectedFieldId == 'all',
                            onTap: () =>
                                setState(() => _selectedFieldId = 'all'),
                            isDark: isDark,
                            border: border,
                            surface: surface,
                            textPrimary: textPrimary,
                            textSecondary: textSecondary,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          ...FieldModel.defaultFields.map((field) {
                            return Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 8),
                              child: _filterChip(
                                label: field.name,
                                isSelected: _selectedFieldId == field.id,
                                onTap: () =>
                                    setState(() => _selectedFieldId = field.id),

                                border: border,
                                surface: surface,

                          }),
