```dart
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
                  ],

                  // Content List
                  Expanded(
                    child: _corpusKind == CorpusKind.scholar
                        ? const ScholarsComingSoon()
                        : _isLoading
                            ? const OTSkeletonList()
                            : filtered.isEmpty

                                          if (b.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat') {
                                            return 1;
                                          }
                                          if (a.isActive && !b.isActive) {
                                            return -1;
                                          }
                                          if (!a.isActive && b.isActive) {
                                            return 1;
                                          }
                                          return 0;
                                        });
                                      }

                                      final flagship = sorted
                                          .where((agent) =>
                                              agent.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat')
                                          .firstOrNull;
                                      final others = sorted
                                          .where((agent) =>
                                              agent.id != flagship?.id)
                                          .toList();
                                      AiLibraryMetadata? statsOf(
                                              AgentModel agent) =>
                                          OpenTurathCatalogRepository
                                              .exactMetadata(
                                                  _libraryStats, agent.id);

                                      return ListView(
                                        controller: _listScrollCtrl,
                                        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(
                                            parent:
                                                AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics()),
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                                            OTSpacing.lg,
                                            OTSpacing.md,
                                            OTSpacing.lg,
                                            24),
                                        children: [
                                          if (flagship != null) ...[
                                            OTReveal(
                                              child: TahawwulatFlagshipCard(
                                                agent: flagship,
                                                metadata: statsOf(flagship),
                                                isSubscribed: _authService
                                                        .cachedCurrentUser
                                                        ?.hasAccessToAgent(
                                                            flagship.id) ??
                                                    false,
                                                onOpenMain: () =>
                                                    _openAgent(flagship),
                                                onOpenSubAgent: (sub) =>
                                                    _openTahawwulatSubAgent(
                                                        flagship, sub),
                                                onOpenLibrary:
                                                    flagship.catalogId != null
                                                        ? () =>
                                                            showResearchLibrary(
                                                                context,
                                                                agent: flagship)
                                                        : null,
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                            const SizedBox(
                                                height: OTSpacing.md),
                                          ],
                                          // Grid seragam: satu ketukan langsung membuka asisten.
                                          LayoutBuilder(
                                              builder: (context, box) {
                                            final columns = box.maxWidth >= 900
                                                ? 3
                                                : box.maxWidth >= 560
                                                    ? 2
                                                    : 1;
                                            Widget card(int index) {
                                              final agent = others[index];
                                              return OTReveal(
                                                index: index % 6 + 1,
                                                child: AssistantGridCard(
                                                  agent: agent,
                                                  metadata: statsOf(agent),
                                                  onOpen: () =>
                                                      _openAgent(agent),
                                                  onOpenLibrary: agent
                                                              .catalogId !=
                                                          null
                                                      ? () =>
                                                          showResearchLibrary(
                                                              context,
                                                              agent: agent)
                                                      : null,
                                                ),
                                              );
                                            }

                                            return Column(
                                              children: [
                                                for (var start = 0;
                                                    start < others.length;
                                                    start += columns) ...[
                                                  if (start > 0)
                                                    const SizedBox(
                                                        height: OTSpacing.md),
                                                  if (columns == 1)
                                                    card(start)
                                                  else
                                                    IntrinsicHeight(
                                                      child: Row(
                                                        crossAxisAlignment:
                                                            CrossAxisAlignment
                                                                .stretch,
                                                        children: [
                                                          for (var c = 0;
                                                              c < columns;
                                                              c++) ...[
                                                            if (c > 0)
                                                              const SizedBox(
                                                                  width:
                                                                      OTSpacing
                                                                          .md),
                                                            Expanded(
                                                              child: start + c <
                                                                      others
                                                                          .length
                                                                  ? card(
                                                                      start + c)
                                                                  : const SizedBox
                                                                      .shrink(),
                                                            ),
                                                          ],
                                                        ],
                                                      ),
                                                    ),
                                                ],
                                              ],
                                            );
                                          }),
                                        ],
                                      );
                                    },
                                  ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _filterChip({
    required String label,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    required bool isDark,
    required Color border,
    required Color surface,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
  }) {
    // Horizontal ListView meregangkan anak setinggi daftar; Center menjaga tinggi alami chip.
    return Center(
        child: AppleInteractiveWrapper(
      onTap: onTap,
      pressedScale: 0.97,
      hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.selection,
      borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? OTColors.accent(isDark) : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? OTColors.accent(isDark) : border,
            width: 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          Loc.text(label),
          style: OTTypography.caption(
                  color: isSelected ? OTColors.onAccent(isDark) : textSecondary)
              .copyWith(
            fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
            fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ));
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_motion.dart';
import '../core/routes.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../widgets/ot_arch_motion.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key, this.resolveInitialRoute});

  final String Function()? resolveInitialRoute;

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Navigator's initial route must finish mounting before it is replaced.
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) _checkAuthAndNavigate();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _checkAuthAndNavigate() async {
    // Pembuka terlihat sejenak, tetapi tidak pernah menahan lebih lama.
    final hold = Future<void>.delayed(OTMotion.splashHold);
    var targetRoute = AppRoutes.login;
    try {
      if (widget.resolveInitialRoute != null) {
        targetRoute = widget.resolveInitialRoute!();
      } else {
        final restoredUser = await AuthService().restoreSession();
        final firebaseUser = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
        if (restoredUser != null ||
            (firebaseUser != null && !firebaseUser.isAnonymous)) {
          final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
          final sessionReady = prefs.getBool('google_session_ready') ?? false;
          final sessionEmail = prefs.getString('google_session_email') ?? '';
          final currentEmail = (firebaseUser?.email ?? restoredUser?.email ?? '')
              .trim()
              .toLowerCase();
          if (sessionReady &&
              (currentEmail.isEmpty || sessionEmail.isEmpty || sessionEmail == currentEmail)) {
            targetRoute = AppRoutes.dashboard;
          } else {
            targetRoute = AppRoutes.googleSessionAuth;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Reading auth state may fail, but must not leave an endless splash.
      targetRoute = AppRoutes.login;
    }
    await hold;
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, targetRoute);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Mengikuti tema aplikasi, sama seperti layar luncur sistem.
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bg = OTColors.canvas(dark);

    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
      value: SystemUiOverlayStyle(
        statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
        statusBarIconBrightness: dark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,
        systemNavigationBarColor: bg,
        systemNavigationBarIconBrightness:
            dark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,
      ),
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: bg,
        body: Center(child: OTSplashIntro(ink: OTColors.textPrimary(dark))),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import '../widgets/app_loader.dart';

import '../core/design/ot_expressive.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../core/product_pricing.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/sub_agent_model.dart';
import '../services/subscription_service.dart';
import '../widgets/payment_checkout_sheet.dart';
import '../widgets/promo_price.dart';
import '../widgets/redeem_code_sheet.dart';
import '../core/app_platform.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../services/telemetry_service.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_radius.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_buttons.dart';

/// Penawaran perdana. Hak akses tetap diputuskan oleh backend yang terverifikasi.
class SubscriptionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SubscriptionScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<SubscriptionScreen> createState() => _SubscriptionScreenState();
}

class _SubscriptionScreenState extends State<SubscriptionScreen> {
  final _service = SubscriptionService();
  String _selectedAgentId = 'fiqh_syafii';
  int _tahawwulatIndex = 0;
  int _specialistIndex = 0;
  bool _processing = false;
  bool _initialized = false;
  String? _checkoutError;
  String? _checkoutAgentId;

  String _checkoutErrorMessage(FirebaseFunctionsException error) {
    switch (error.code.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'unauthenticated':
        return Loc.tr('checkoutAuthExpired');
      case 'deadline-exceeded':
      case 'unavailable':
        return Loc.tr('checkoutServiceUnavailable');
      case 'failed-precondition':
        return Loc.tr('checkoutPlanUnavailable');
      case 'permission-denied':
        return Loc.tr('checkoutAccountDenied');
      case 'invalid-argument':
        return Loc.tr('checkoutSelectionInvalid');
      default:
        return Loc.tr('checkoutError');
    }
  }

  Widget _checkoutNotice(String agentId) {
    final message = _checkoutAgentId == agentId ? _checkoutError : null;
    if (message == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final color = OTColors.destructive(dark);
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.09),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
          border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.35)),
        ),
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, size: 18, color: color),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(message,
                  style: OTTypography.caption(color: OTColors.textPrimary(dark))
                      .copyWith(height: 1.4)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<AgentModel> get _specialists => AgentModel.defaultAgents
      .where((a) =>
          a.kind == CorpusKind.discipline &&
          a.isActive &&
          a.id != 'fiqh_tahawwulat')
      .toList();

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;
    final args = ModalRoute.of(context)?.settings.arguments;
    final agent = args is Map ? args['agent'] : null;
    if (agent is AgentModel && _specialists.any((a) => a.id == agent.id)) {
      _selectedAgentId = agent.id;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkout(AgentModel agent, SubscriptionOffer offer) async {
    if (_processing) return;
    final user = AuthService().currentUser;
    if (user == null || user.isAnonymous) {
      setState(() {
        _checkoutAgentId = agent.id;
        _checkoutError = Loc.tr('signInRequired');
      });
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _processing = true;
      _checkoutError = null;
      _checkoutAgentId = agent.id;
    });
    try {
      final title = '${agent.title} · ${offer.title}';
      final result = await _service.createPayment(
          uid: user.uid,
          agentId: agent.id,
          plan: offer.plan,
          planTitle: title,
          amount: offer.amount,
          name: user.displayName ??
              user.email?.split('@').first ??
              AppCopy.ahlanDefault,
          email: user.email ?? '',
          phone: user.phoneNumber ?? '');
      if (!mounted) return;
      // An old backend or stale quote must never open a differently priced checkout.
      if (result['amount'] != offer.amount ||
          result['pricingRevision'] != ProductPricing.revision) {
        setState(() => _checkoutError = Loc.tr('priceChanged'));
        return;
      }
      final paymentUrl = result['redirectUrl'];
      final invoice = result['invoiceNumber'];
      if (paymentUrl is! String ||
          Uri.tryParse(paymentUrl)?.scheme != 'https' ||
          invoice is! String ||
          invoice.isEmpty) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid checkout response');
      }
      final paid = await PaymentCheckoutSheet.show(context,
          paymentUrl: paymentUrl,
          invoiceNumber: invoice,
          trxId: result['trxId'] as String?,
          planTitle: title,
          amount: offer.amount,
          regularAmount: offer.regularAmount,
          periodLabel: offer.period);
      if (mounted && paid == true) {
        await PaymentSuccessDialog.show(context,
            plan: title, invoice: invoice, amount: offer.amount);
      }
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (error, stack) {
      TelemetryService.instance.reportError(error, stack, context: 'checkout');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _checkoutError = _checkoutErrorMessage(error));
      }
    } on FormatException {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _checkoutError = Loc.tr('checkoutLinkUnavailable'));
      }
    } catch (error, stack) {
      TelemetryService.instance.reportError(error, stack, context: 'checkout');
      if (mounted) setState(() => _checkoutError = Loc.tr('checkoutError'));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _processing = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _card({required Widget child, bool flagship = false}) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final border = OTColors.surface(dark);
    if (flagship) {
      return Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: OTColors.surface(dark),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
          border: Border.all(color: OTColors.borderStrong(dark), width: 1.5),
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: child,
      );
    }
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: OTColors.surface(dark),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),

  /// Kepala paket utama: panel gelap bergradasi dengan lencana eksklusif,

      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Flexible(
                child: Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: OTExpressive.white,
                    borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,

  Widget _trustNote(Color color) => Padding(

          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,

  void _showDisciplinePickerModal(
      BuildContext context, List<AgentModel> specialists) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(dark);
    final muted = OTColors.textSecondary(dark);
    final border = OTColors.border(dark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(dark);

    showAdaptiveSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: surface,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius:
            BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(OTRadius.dialog)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) {
        var query = '';
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (modalCtx, setModalState) {
            final filtered = query.isEmpty
                ? specialists
                : specialists.where((a) {
                    final q = query.toLowerCase();
                    return a.title.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
                        a.titleArabic.contains(q) ||
                        (a.referenceBooks?.any((b) =>
                                b.title.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
                                b.titleArabic.contains(q)) ??
                            false);
                  }).toList();

            return DraggableScrollableSheet(
              // Di desktop lembar ini berada di dalam dialog: isi penuh, tanpa ruang kosong.
              initialChildSize: AppPlatform.isDesktop ? 1 : 0.75,
              minChildSize: AppPlatform.isDesktop ? 1 : 0.5,
              maxChildSize: AppPlatform.isDesktop ? 1 : 0.92,
              expand: false,
              builder: (_, scrollController) {
                return Column(
                  children: [
                    if (AppPlatform.isDesktop)
                      const SizedBox(height: 8)
                    else
                      const SheetGrabber(top: 10, bottom: 10),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 12),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                Loc.tr('chooseField'),
                                style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: ink),
                              ),
                              IconButton(
                                icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted),
                                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(modalCtx),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          TextField(
                            autofocus: false,
                            onChanged: (val) =>
                                setModalState(() => query = val),
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              hintText: Loc.tr('searchFieldHint'),
                              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                                  size: 20, color: muted),
                              contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ListView.separated(
                        controller: scrollController,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 16),
                        itemCount: filtered.length,
                        separatorBuilder: (_, __) => Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                          child: Divider(height: 1, color: border),
                        ),
                        itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                          final a = filtered[i];
                          final isSelected = a.id == _selectedAgentId;
                          return InkWell(
                            onTap: () {
                              setState(() => _selectedAgentId = a.id);
                              Navigator.pop(modalCtx);
                            },
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Text(
                                      Loc.text(a.title),
                                      style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: ink)
                                          .copyWith(
                                        fontWeight: isSelected
                                            ? FontWeight.w600
                                            : FontWeight.w400,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  if (isSelected)
                                    Icon(Icons.check_rounded,
                                        color: ink, size: 20),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(dark);
    final muted = OTColors.textSecondary(dark);
    final border = OTColors.border(dark);
    final flagship =
        AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere((a) => a.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat');
    final offer = ProductPricing.tahawwulat[_tahawwulatIndex];
    final specialists = _specialists;
    final selected = specialists.firstWhere((a) => a.id == _selectedAgentId,
        orElse: () => specialists.first);

    final single = ProductPricing.specialists[_specialistIndex];

    Widget cta(VoidCallback onPressed, int amount) => SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          height: 48,
          child: FilledButton(
            onPressed: _processing ? null : onPressed,
            child: Text(Loc.tr('payAmount', [ProductPricing.rupiah(amount)])),
          ),
        );

    // Dua kartu memakai urutan bagian yang sama agar sejajar saat
    // berdampingan: label, judul, keterangan, cakupan, masa akses, harga,
    // manfaat, tombol.
    List<Widget> planBody({
      required bool wide,
      required String label,
      required String title,
      required String description,
      required Widget scope,
      required Widget tiers,
      required SubscriptionOffer price,
      required List<String> benefits,
      required VoidCallback onCheckout,
      required String agentId,
    }) =>
        [
          if (agentId == flagship.id)
            _flagshipHeader(label, title, flagship)
          else
            Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
                    borderRadius: OTRadius.cardBorder),
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(label, style: OTTypography.caption(color: muted)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(title, style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: ink)),
                    ])),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text(description,
              style: OTTypography.body(color: muted).copyWith(height: 1.45)),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          scope,
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          tiers,
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          PromoPrice(
            amount: price.amount,
            regularAmount: price.regularAmount,
            period: price.period,
            display: agentId == flagship.id,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Divider(color: border, height: 1),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          for (final benefit in benefits) _benefitRow(benefit, ink),
          if (wide) const Spacer() else const SizedBox(height: 8),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (price.months > 1) ...[
            Text(
                Loc.tr('monthlyEquivalent', [
                  ProductPricing.rupiah((price.amount / price.months).round())
                ]),
                style: OTTypography.caption(color: muted)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ],
          cta(onCheckout, price.amount),
          _trustNote(muted),
          _checkoutNotice(agentId),
        ];

    // Cakupan paket utama: lima asisten, sebagai teks.
    final subAgents = flagship.subAgents ?? const <SubAgentModel>[];
    final flagshipScope = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(Loc.tr('planFeaturedIncludes', ['${subAgents.length}']),
            style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: ink)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Wrap(
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          children: [
            for (final sub in subAgents)
              Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
                  borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                  border: Border.all(color: border),
                ),
                child: Text(Loc.isArabic ? sub.nameArabic : sub.name,
                    style: OTTypography.caption(color: ink)),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );

    // Cakupan paket satu bidang: pemilih bidang.
    final fieldPicker = Material(
      color: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: _processing
            ? null
            : () => _showDisciplinePickerModal(context, specialists),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(20, 12, 16, 12),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(Loc.tr('chooseField'),
                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s12, color: muted)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      Loc.text(selected.title),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: ink),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Icon(Icons.unfold_more_rounded, size: 20, color: muted),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: OTColors.canvas(dark),
      appBar: AppBar(
        titleSpacing: otTitleSpacing(context),
        title: Text(AppCopy.subscription),
        backgroundColor: OTColors.canvas(dark),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, viewport) {
          final wide = viewport.maxWidth >= 1000;

          Widget plan({required bool featured, required List<Widget> body}) =>
              _card(
                flagship: featured,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: body,
                ),
              );

          final featuredPlan = plan(
            featured: true,
            body: planBody(
              wide: wide,
              label: Loc.isArabic
                  ? 'حصري في OpenTurath · 5 AI'
                  : Loc.language == 'en'
                      ? 'Exclusive to OpenTurath · 5 AI'
                      : 'Eksklusif di OpenTurath · 5 AI',
              title: AppCopy.planTahawwulat,
              description: Loc.tr('planFeaturedDescription'),
              scope: flagshipScope,
              tiers: _TierSelector(
                offers: ProductPricing.tahawwulat,
                selected: _tahawwulatIndex,
                onSelect: _processing
                    ? null
                    : (i) => setState(() => _tahawwulatIndex = i),
              ),
              price: offer,
              benefits: [
                Loc.tr('planFeaturedBenefit1'),
                Loc.tr('planFeaturedBenefit3'),
                Loc.tr('planFeaturedBenefit4'),
              ],
              onCheckout: () => _checkout(flagship, offer),
              agentId: flagship.id,
            ),
          );

          final singlePlan = plan(
            featured: false,
            body: planBody(
              wide: wide,
              label: Loc.tr('planSingleLabel'),
              title: Loc.tr('specialistAccess'),
              description: Loc.tr('planSingleDescription'),
              scope: fieldPicker,
              tiers: _TierSelector(
                offers: ProductPricing.specialists,
                selected: _specialistIndex,
                onSelect: _processing
                    ? null
                    : (i) => setState(() => _specialistIndex = i),
              ),
              price: single,
              benefits: [
                Loc.tr('planSingleBenefit1', [Loc.text(selected.title)]),
                Loc.tr('planSingleBenefit2'),
                Loc.tr('planSingleBenefit3'),
              ],
              onCheckout: () => _checkout(selected, single),
              agentId: selected.id,
            ),
          );

          return SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 48),
            child: Center(
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: wide ? 1040 : 640),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      Loc.tr('launchOffer'),
                      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        letterSpacing: -0.4,
                        color: ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(AppCopy.manualRenewalNotice,
                        style: OTTypography.body(color: muted)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    if (wide)
                      IntrinsicHeight(
                        child: Row(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                          children: [
                            Expanded(child: featuredPlan),
                            const SizedBox(width: 16),
                            Expanded(child: singlePlan),
                          ],
                        ),
                      )
                    else ...[
                      featuredPlan,
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      singlePlan,
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    if (_processing)
                      const Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
                        child: Center(
                          child: AppLoader(),
                        ),
                      ),
                    Center(
                      child: TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _processing
                            ? null
                            : () => RedeemCodeSheet.show(context),
                        style: OTButtons.quiet(dark),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.confirmation_number_outlined,
                            size: 18),
                        label: Text(Loc.tr('redeemAccess')),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Pilihan masa akses satu paket: masa, harga, dan setara per bulan.
class _TierSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TierSelector({
    required this.offers,
    required this.selected,
    required this.onSelect,
  });

  final List<SubscriptionOffer> offers;
  final int selected;
  final ValueChanged<int>? onSelect;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(dark);
    final stacked = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(16) > 24;
    Widget option(int i) {
      final active = selected == i;
      final textColor = active ? OTColors.canvas(dark) : ink;
      final title = Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Text(offers[i].title,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: textColor)),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          Text(Loc.tr('saving', ['${offers[i].savingsPercent}']),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: OTTypography.metadataTag(
                  color: textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.72))),
        ],
      );
      return Semantics(
        button: true,
        selected: active,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: onSelect == null ? null : () => onSelect!(i),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
          child: AnimatedContainer(
            duration: OTMotion.fast,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: active ? ink : OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
            ),
            child: Center(child: title),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (stacked) {
      return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: [
        for (var i = 0; i < offers.length; i++) ...[
          if (i > 0) const SizedBox(height: 8),
          option(i),
        ],
      ]);
    }
    return IntrinsicHeight(
        child: Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: [
      for (var i = 0; i < offers.length; i++) ...[
        if (i > 0) const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Expanded(child: option(i)),
      ],
    ]));
  }
}
```

## File: `openturath_ai/lib/services/agent_service.dart`

```dart
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import '../core/notebook_navigation.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import 'callable_gateway.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';

class AgentService {
  AgentService({CallableGateway? functions})
      : _functions = functions ?? const CallableGateway();

  final CallableGateway _functions;

  // ── Ambil daftar semua agent dari Firestore / model lokal ────
  Future<List<AgentModel>> getAgents() async {
    return AgentModel.defaultAgents;
  }

  static final _notebookPath = RegExp(
    r'^/notebook/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/?$',
  );

  // ── Ambil URL agent dari Cloud Function secara aman (Server-Side Entitlement) ────
  Future<String?> getAgentUrl(String agentId) async {
    try {
      final result = await _functions
          .call(AppConstants.fnGetAgentUrl, {'agentId': agentId});
      if (result is! Map) {
        throw const AgentAccessException(
            'invalid-response', 'Respons alamat AI tidak valid.');
      }
      final url = result['url'];
      if (url == null || url == '') {
        throw const AgentAccessException(
            'empty-url', 'URL AI belum tersedia untuk bidang ini.');
      }
      if (url is! String) {
        throw const AgentAccessException(
            'invalid-url', 'Alamat AI dari server tidak valid.');
      }
      final uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
      if (uri == null ||
          url != url.trim() ||
          url.contains('%') ||
          !NotebookNavigation.notebook(uri) ||
          !_notebookPath.hasMatch(uri.path) ||
          uri.hasQuery ||
          uri.hasFragment) {
        throw const AgentAccessException(
            'invalid-url', 'Alamat AI dari server tidak valid.');
      }
      // The authenticated server owns notebook selection and entitlement checks.
      // Preserve its exact notebook ID/path and validate before normalizing only
      // the legacy Google host to the verified Google redirect destination.
      return uri.replace(host: NotebookNavigation.canonicalHost).toString();
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == 'permission-denied') {
        throw AgentAccessException(
          'permission-denied',
          e.message ?? 'Langganan diperlukan untuk membuka AI ini.',
        );
      }
      throw AgentAccessException(
          e.code, e.message ?? 'Tidak dapat terhubung ke server.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is AgentAccessException) rethrow;
      throw AgentAccessException('unknown-error', e.toString());
    }
  }

  // ── Catat pertanyaan trial secara atomik di Cloud Functions ───
  Future<TrialUsage> recordQuestion(String agentId) async {
    try {
      final result =
          await _functions.call('recordQuestion', {'agentId': agentId});
      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result as Map);
      return TrialUsage(
        isPremium: data['isPremium'] == true,
        questionsUsed: (data['questionsUsed'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
        questionsRemaining: (data['questionsRemaining'] as num?)?.toInt(),
      );
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      throw AgentAccessException(
          e.code, e.message ?? 'Gagal mencatat kuota pertanyaan.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is AgentAccessException) rethrow;
      throw AgentAccessException('record-error', e.toString());
    }
  }
}

class TrialUsage {
  const TrialUsage({
    required this.isPremium,
    required this.questionsUsed,
    required this.questionsRemaining,
  });

  final bool isPremium;
  final int questionsUsed;
  final int? questionsRemaining;
}

class AgentAccessException implements Exception {
  const AgentAccessException(this.code, this.message);
  final String code;
  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AgentAccessException($code): $message';
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart';
import 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/turath_chat_message.dart';
import '../models/user_model.dart';

/// Represents a single active AI specialist tab in memory.
class AgentSessionTab {
  final AgentModel agent;
  String? resolvedUrl;
  InAppWebViewController? webController;
  final InAppWebViewKeepAlive keepAlive = InAppWebViewKeepAlive();
  bool isUrlLoading = true;
  bool isWebLoading = true;
  bool isSessionReady = false;
  String? errorMessage;
  bool isPaywallRequired = false;
  bool isTimeoutError = false;
  bool isGooglePermissionError = false;
  bool isGoogleAuthPage = false;

  static double defaultFontScale = 1.0;
  double fontScale = defaultFontScale;
  bool hasInjectedEarlyScript = false;
  bool isMenuOpen = false;

  /// Mode tampilan: false untuk tampilan DOM WebView murni (default), true jika menggunakan overlay native.
  bool isNativeView = false;
  final List<TurathChatMessage> chatMessages = [];
  bool isGenerating = false;

  AgentSessionTab({
    required this.agent,
    this.resolvedUrl,
  });

  /// Lepaskan seluruh resource WebView dan handler JavaScript untuk mencegah kebocoran memori.
  Future<void> disposeWebResources() async {
    try {
      await webController?.stopLoading();
      webController?.removeJavaScriptHandler(handlerName: 'otCopiedAnswer');
      webController?.removeJavaScriptHandler(handlerName: 'otAnswerState');
      webController?.removeJavaScriptHandler(handlerName: 'otAnswerChunk');
      webController?.removeJavaScriptHandler(handlerName: 'otDismissMenu');
    } catch (_) {}
    if (webController != null) {
      // Dispose only after the corresponding platform view has left the tree.
      SchedulerBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) async {
        try {
          await InAppWebViewController.disposeKeepAlive(keepAlive);
        } catch (_) {
          /* A disposed/unsupported platform view is already released. */
        }
      });
      SchedulerBinding.instance.scheduleFrame();
    }
    webController = null;
    isSessionReady = false;
    isWebLoading = false;
    hasInjectedEarlyScript = false;
  }
}

/// AgentSessionManager: Singleton state manager for multi-tab AI study sessions.
/// Keeps up to 3 specialists loaded in background memory like Google Chrome tabs.
class AgentSessionManager extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final AgentSessionManager instance = AgentSessionManager._();
  AgentSessionManager._();

  static const int maxTabs = 3;

  final List<AgentSessionTab> _tabs = [];
  int _activeIndex = 0;
  bool _isOpen = false;

  List<AgentSessionTab> get tabs => List.unmodifiable(_tabs);
  int get activeIndex => _activeIndex;
  bool get isOpen => _isOpen;

  AgentSessionTab? get activeTab {
    if (_tabs.isEmpty || _activeIndex < 0 || _activeIndex >= _tabs.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return _tabs[_activeIndex];
  }

  /// Open an agent or switch to its existing active tab with zero reload.
  void openAgent(AgentModel agent, {UserModel? user}) {
    final existingIndex = _tabs.indexWhere((t) => t.agent.id == agent.id);
    if (existingIndex != -1) {
      _activeIndex = existingIndex;
    } else {
      if (_tabs.length >= maxTabs) {
        // Tab limit reached: close oldest non-active tab to preserve WebView memory
        final evictIndex = _activeIndex == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        closeTab(evictIndex);
      }
      _tabs.add(AgentSessionTab(agent: agent));
      _activeIndex = _tabs.length - 1;
    }
    _isOpen = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Switch active tab (like clicking a Chrome tab).
  void selectTab(int index) {
    if (index >= 0 && index < _tabs.length && _activeIndex != index) {
      _activeIndex = index;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  /// Close a specific tab with the 'x' button.
  void closeTab(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= _tabs.length) return;

    final tabToClose = _tabs[index];
    tabToClose.disposeWebResources();

    _tabs.removeAt(index);

    if (_tabs.isEmpty) {
      _isOpen = false;
      _activeIndex = 0;
    } else if (index < _activeIndex) {
      _activeIndex--;
    } else if (_activeIndex >= _tabs.length) {
      _activeIndex = _tabs.length - 1;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Hide the AI study room to return to the Dashboard while keeping all WebViews alive.
  void closeRoom() {
    _isOpen = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Reset all sessions (e.g. on user logout).
  void closeAll() {
    for (final tab in _tabs) {
      tab.disposeWebResources();
    }
    _tabs.clear();
    _activeIndex = 0;
    _isOpen = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'agent_session_manager.dart';

import 'desktop_webview_runtime.dart';
import 'browser_companion_chat_service.dart';

class AuthService {
  // Ditunda sampai dipakai, agar layar bisa dirender tanpa Firebase (pratinjau, tes).
  late final FirebaseAuth _auth = FirebaseAuth.instance;
  final GoogleSignIn _googleSignIn = GoogleSignIn(
    clientId: (!kIsWeb &&
            (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ||
                defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.macOS))
        ? '255541559800-fen41rigfp5o3fsntiieaien3v915ptd.apps.googleusercontent.com'
        : null,
    serverClientId:
        '255541559800-jcip3mf8umtscgf5jm8khflm4u83rmcj.apps.googleusercontent.com',
  );
  late final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  Stream<UserModel?>? _cachedUserStream;

  // In-memory cache to prevent entitlement loss on network hiccup (F41)
  static final Map<String, UserModel> _userCache = {};

  // ── Cache Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  static Future<void> _cacheUserLocally(UserModel user) async {
    _userCache[user.uid] = user;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString('current_user_uid', user.uid);
      await prefs.setString(
        'openturath_cached_user_${user.uid}',
        jsonEncode(user.toJsonMap()),
      );
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  static Future<UserModel?> _getCachedUser(String uid) async {
    if (_userCache.containsKey(uid)) {
      return _userCache[uid];
    }
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final raw = prefs.getString('openturath_cached_user_$uid');
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final map = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final user = UserModel.fromMap(uid, map);
        _userCache[uid] = user;
        return user;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }

  /// Pengguna contoh untuk pratinjau dan tes render; tidak dipakai di aplikasi.
  @visibleForTesting
  static UserModel? previewUser;

  // ── Current Firebase User ──────────────────────────────────────
  User? get currentUser => previewUser != null ? null : _auth.currentUser;
  Stream<User?> get authStateChanges => _auth.authStateChanges();

  UserModel? get cachedCurrentUser {
    if (previewUser != null) return previewUser;
    final user = _auth.currentUser;
    if (user != null) {
      return _userCache[user.uid] ??
          UserModel(
            uid: user.uid,
            name: user.displayName ?? 'Pengguna',
            email: user.email ?? '',
            photoUrl: user.photoURL ?? '',
            plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
            questionsUsed: 0,
          );
    }
    // Only an unambiguous cached profile may stand in; with several accounts
    // in memory there is no way to know which one this session belongs to.
    if (_userCache.length == 1) {
      return _userCache.values.single;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// Memulihkan sesi pengguna secara aman dari Firebase Auth atau cache disk lokal
  Future<UserModel?> restoreSession() async {
    if (previewUser != null) return previewUser;
    User? firebaseUser = _auth.currentUser;
    if (firebaseUser == null) {
      try {
        firebaseUser = await _auth
            .authStateChanges()
            .firstWhere((u) => u != null)
            .timeout(const Duration(milliseconds: 1200));
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // Silent Sign-in Fallback: Pulihkan kredensial Google OAuth tanpa prompt jika sesi Firebase belum siap
    if (firebaseUser == null &&
        !kIsWeb &&
        (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android ||
            defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ||
            defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.macOS)) {
      try {
        final googleUser = await _googleSignIn.signInSilently();
        if (googleUser != null) {
          final googleAuth = await googleUser.authentication;
          final credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credential(
            accessToken: googleAuth.accessToken,
            idToken: googleAuth.idToken,
          );
          final userCredential = await _auth.signInWithCredential(credential);
          firebaseUser = userCredential.user;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      // The cached profile is keyed by the UID of the last verified sign-in.
      // Never guess from other cached profiles: that could surface another
      // account's name and entitlements on a shared device.
      final uid = firebaseUser?.uid ?? prefs.getString('current_user_uid');

      if (uid != null && uid.isNotEmpty) {
        final cached = await _getCachedUser(uid);
        if (cached != null) {
          _userCache[cached.uid] = cached;
          return cached;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    if (firebaseUser != null) {
      final fallback = UserModel(
        uid: firebaseUser.uid,
        name: firebaseUser.displayName ?? 'Pengguna',
        email: firebaseUser.email ?? '',
        photoUrl: firebaseUser.photoURL ?? '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 0,
      );
      _userCache[fallback.uid] = fallback;
      return fallback;
    }

    return null;
  }

  // ── Google Sign In ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  Future<UserModel?> signInWithGoogle() async {
    var stage = 'google-authorize';
    try {
      User? firebaseUser;

      if (!kIsWeb &&
          (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android ||
              defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ||
              defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.macOS)) {
        // Native GoogleSignIn SDK on Android, iOS, & macOS (Darwin)
        final GoogleSignInAccount? googleUser = await _googleSignIn.signIn();
        if (googleUser == null) return null; // Pengguna membatalkan login

        stage = 'google-token';
        final GoogleSignInAuthentication googleAuth =
            await googleUser.authentication;

        final credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credential(
          accessToken: googleAuth.accessToken,
          idToken: googleAuth.idToken,
        );

        try {
          stage = 'firebase-credential';
          final userCredential = await _auth.signInWithCredential(credential);
          firebaseUser = userCredential.user;
        } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
          if (e.code == 'keychain-error' && _auth.currentUser != null) {
            firebaseUser = _auth.currentUser;
          } else {
            rethrow;
          }
        }
      } else if (kIsWeb) {
        final result = await _auth.signInWithPopup(GoogleAuthProvider());
        firebaseUser = result.user;
      } else {
        // Platform desktop lain (Windows/Linux) langsung via Firebase OAuth Provider
        final provider = GoogleAuthProvider();
        final userCredential = await _auth.signInWithProvider(provider);
        firebaseUser = userCredential.user;
      }

      if (firebaseUser == null) return null;
      stage = 'profile-resolve';
      final userModel = await _resolveOrCreateFirebaseUser(firebaseUser);
      final effectiveEmail = firebaseUser.email?.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (effectiveEmail != null && effectiveEmail.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
          await prefs.setString('current_user_uid', firebaseUser.uid);
          await prefs.setString('google_session_email', effectiveEmail);
          await prefs.setString('notebook_google_email', effectiveEmail);
          // Sesi kuki WebView Google (Langkah 2) WAJIB diselesaikan via GoogleSessionAuthScreen
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      return userModel;
    } catch (e) {
      // Only fixed diagnostic categories: never log OAuth tokens or account data.
      final code = e is PlatformException
          ? e.code
          : e is FirebaseAuthException
          ? e.code
          : e.runtimeType.toString();
      final detail = e is PlatformException ? '${e.details}'.toLowerCase() : '';
      final category = detail.contains('keychain')
          ? 'keychain'
          : detail.contains('cancel')
          ? 'cancelled'
          : detail.contains('network')
          ? 'network'
          : detail.contains('configuration')
          ? 'configuration'
          : 'unspecified';
      final safeCode = RegExp(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,80}$').hasMatch(code)
          ? code
          : 'unknown';
      // ignore: avoid_print
      print('OpenTurathAuth stage=$stage code=$safeCode category=$category');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // ── Helper Resolusi Profil User Firestore ──────────────────────
  Future<UserModel> _resolveOrCreateFirebaseUser(
    User firebaseUser, {
    String? fallbackName,
    String? fallbackEmail,
  }) async {
    // Firestore rules cap the stored name at 120 characters.
    final rawName = firebaseUser.displayName ?? fallbackName ?? 'Pengguna';
    final effectiveName =
        rawName.length > 120 ? rawName.substring(0, 120) : rawName;
    final effectiveEmail = firebaseUser.email ?? fallbackEmail ?? '';
    final photoUrl = firebaseUser.photoURL ?? '';

    try {
      final docRef =
          _db.collection(AppConstants.colUsers).doc(firebaseUser.uid);
      final doc = await docRef.get().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));

      if (!doc.exists) {
        final newUser = UserModel(
          uid: firebaseUser.uid,
          name: effectiveName,
          email: effectiveEmail,
          photoUrl: photoUrl,
          plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
          questionsUsed: 0,
        );
        await docRef.set({
          'name': newUser.name,
          'email': newUser.email,
          'photo_url': newUser.photoUrl,
          'plan': newUser.plan,
          'questions_used': newUser.questionsUsed,
          'subscription_expiry': null,
        }).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
        await _cacheUserLocally(newUser);
        return newUser;
      } else {
        final userModel = UserModel.fromFirestore(doc);
        await _cacheUserLocally(userModel);
        return userModel;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      final cached = await _getCachedUser(firebaseUser.uid);
      if (cached != null) return cached;

      final fallback = UserModel(
        uid: firebaseUser.uid,
        name: effectiveName,
        email: effectiveEmail,
        photoUrl: photoUrl,
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 0,
      );
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  // ── Get Current UserModel from Firestore ───────────────────────
  Future<UserModel?> getCurrentUserModel() async {
    final user = currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      if (cachedCurrentUser != null) return cachedCurrentUser;
      try {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        final uid = prefs.getString('current_user_uid');
        if (uid != null && uid.isNotEmpty) {
          final cached = await _getCachedUser(uid);
          if (cached != null) return cached;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      return null;
    }
    try {
      final doc = await _db
          .collection(AppConstants.colUsers)
          .doc(user.uid)
          .get()
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
      if (!doc.exists) {
        final fallback = UserModel(
          uid: user.uid,
          name: user.displayName ?? 'Pengguna',
          email: user.email ?? '',
          photoUrl: user.photoURL ?? '',
          plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
          questionsUsed: 0,
        );
        return fallback;
      }
      final userModel = UserModel.fromFirestore(doc);
      await _cacheUserLocally(userModel);
      return userModel;
    } catch (_) {
      // Pertahankan snapshot terakhir jika ada (F41)
      final cached = await _getCachedUser(user.uid);
      if (cached != null) return cached;

      return UserModel(
        uid: user.uid,
        name: user.displayName ?? 'Pengguna',
        email: user.email ?? '',
        photoUrl: user.photoURL ?? '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 0,
      );
    }
  }

  // ── Stream user changes (real-time with single persistent cached stream, F10 & F41) ──
  Stream<UserModel?> get userStream => previewUser != null
      ? Stream<UserModel?>.value(previewUser)
      : _cachedUserStream ??= _buildUserStream();

  Stream<UserModel?> _buildUserStream() => sessionUserStream<UserModel>(
        auth: _auth.authStateChanges().map((user) => user?.uid),
        cached: _getCachedUser,
        watch: (uid) => _db
            .collection(AppConstants.colUsers)
            .doc(uid)
            .snapshots()
            .map((doc) {
          if (!doc.exists) return null;
          final user = UserModel.fromFirestore(doc);
          if (_auth.currentUser?.uid == uid) {
            unawaited(_cacheUserLocally(user));
          }
          return user;
        }),
      );

  static const webSessionOwnerKey = 'webview_session_owner';

  /// Mencatat akun pemilik sesi Google yang tersimpan di WebView.
  static Future<void> rememberWebSessionOwner(String email) async {
    final owner = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (owner.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(webSessionOwnerKey, owner);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Menghapus sesi Google di WebView bila bukan milik [email], agar akun
  /// sebelumnya tidak terbawa ke pengguna berikutnya di perangkat yang sama.
  static Future<void> reconcileWebSession(String email) async {
    final current = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final owner = prefs.getString(webSessionOwnerKey) ?? '';
      if (current.isNotEmpty && owner == current) return;
      await DesktopWebViewRuntime.clearSession();
      await prefs.remove(webSessionOwnerKey);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // ── Sign Out ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Future<void> signOut() async {
    final currentUid = _auth.currentUser?.uid;
    // Revoke native capabilities before asynchronous SDK/storage cleanup.
    await BrowserCompanionChatService.stop();

    try {
      AgentSessionManager.instance.closeAll();
    } catch (_) {}

    // Sesi Google di WebView sengaja dipertahankan saat keluar: cookie
    // "perangkat tepercaya" ikut tersimpan di sana, sehingga verifikasi dua
    // langkah tidak diminta ulang setiap kali masuk. Sesi itu dihapus oleh
    // [reconcileWebSession] bila akun berikutnya berbeda.

    try {
      if (kIsWeb || defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.windows) {
        await _googleSignIn.signOut();
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.remove('current_user_uid');
      await prefs.remove('google_session_ready');
      await prefs.remove('google_session_email');
      await prefs.remove('notebook_google_email');
      await prefs.remove('last_opened_notebook_id');
      if (currentUid != null) {
        _userCache.remove(currentUid);
        await prefs.remove('openturath_cached_user_$currentUid');
      } else {
        _userCache.clear();
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // Propagate Auth signOut to avoid half-signed-out UI state (F41)
    await _auth.signOut();
  }

  // ── Delete Account & User Data (Google Play Compliance & Orphan Cleanup, P0) ──
  Future<void> deleteAccount() async {
    final user = currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    final uid = user.uid;
    await BrowserCompanionChatService.stop();

    // Auth deletion enforces recent login. The server trigger owns revocation and recursive cleanup.
    try {
      await user.delete();
    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == 'requires-recent-login') {
        if (kIsWeb || defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.windows) {
          final googleUser = await _googleSignIn.signIn();
          if (googleUser != null) {
            final googleAuth = await googleUser.authentication;
            final credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credential(
              accessToken: googleAuth.accessToken,
              idToken: googleAuth.idToken,
            );
            await user.reauthenticateWithCredential(credential);
            await user.delete();
          } else {
            rethrow;
          }
        } else {
          rethrow;
        }
      } else {
        rethrow;
      }
    }
    AgentSessionManager.instance.closeAll();
    try {
      await DesktopWebViewRuntime.clearSession();
    } catch (_) {}

    // 4. Bersihkan ONLY preferensi spesifik user UID ini (F08 & F41: dilarang prefs.clear())
    try {
      _userCache.remove(uid);
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final keys = prefs.getKeys();
      for (final key in keys) {
        if (key.startsWith('openturath_${uid}_') ||
            key == 'openturath_cached_user_$uid' ||
            key == 'google_session_ready' ||
            key == webSessionOwnerKey ||
            key == 'google_session_email' ||
            key == 'notebook_google_email' ||
            key == 'last_opened_notebook_id') {
          await prefs.remove(key);
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 5. Putuskan hubungan Google Sign In
    try {
      if (kIsWeb || defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.windows) {
        await _googleSignIn.disconnect();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        if (kIsWeb || defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.windows) {
          await _googleSignIn.signOut();
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 6. Pastikan sign-out bersih
    try {
      await _auth.signOut();
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import 'scoped_json_store.dart';

class BookmarkService extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final BookmarkService _instance = BookmarkService._internal();
  factory BookmarkService({FirebaseFirestore? firestore, FirebaseAuth? auth}) {
    if (firestore != null) _instance._firestore = firestore;
    if (auth != null) _instance._auth = auth;
    return _instance;
  }
  BookmarkService._internal()
      : _readCloudOverride = null,
        _currentUserIdOverride = null {
    _initAuthListener();
  }

  @visibleForTesting
  BookmarkService.forTesting({
    required Future<List<BookmarkModel>> Function(String uid) readCloud,
    String? currentUserId,
  })  : _readCloudOverride = readCloud,
        _currentUserIdOverride = currentUserId;

  final Future<List<BookmarkModel>> Function(String uid)? _readCloudOverride;
  final String? _currentUserIdOverride;
  String? get currentUserId => _readCloudOverride != null
      ? _currentUserIdOverride
      : _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;

  FirebaseFirestore? _firestore;
  FirebaseAuth? _auth;
  bool _isSyncing = false;
  bool _resyncRequested = false;

  /// Catatan yang sudah tersimpan di perangkat tetapi belum sampai ke cloud.
  final Set<String> _pendingPushIds = <String>{};
  int get pendingSyncCount => _pendingPushIds.length;
  bool get hasPendingSync => _pendingPushIds.isNotEmpty;

  FirebaseAuth? get _activeAuth {
    if (_auth != null) return _auth;
    try {
      return FirebaseAuth.instance;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  FirebaseFirestore? get _db {
    if (_firestore != null) return _firestore;
    try {
      return FirebaseFirestore.instance;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  void _initAuthListener() {
    try {
      _activeAuth?.authStateChanges().listen((user) {
        if (user != null && user.uid.isNotEmpty) {
          syncWithCloud(userId: user.uid);
        } else if (_pendingPushIds.isNotEmpty) {
          _pendingPushIds.clear();
          notifyListeners();
        }
      });
    } catch (_) {}
    // Push yang gagal saat offline dicoba lagi ketika aplikasi kembali aktif.
    try {
      AppLifecycleListener(onResume: () => unawaited(syncWithCloud()));
    } catch (_) {
      // Binding belum tersedia (mis. unit test murni); sinkronisasi login tetap berjalan.
    }
  }

  final _store = ScopedJsonListStore<BookmarkModel>(
    storage: PreferencesStringStore(),
    decode: BookmarkModel.fromJson,
    encode: (bookmark) => bookmark.toJson(),
  );

  static const String _legacyKey = 'openturath_saved_bookmarks';

  String _key(String? userId) {
    final uid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    return uid == null || uid.isEmpty
        ? _legacyKey
        : 'openturath_${uid}_saved_bookmarks';
  }

  Future<List<BookmarkModel>> getBookmarks({String? userId}) async =>
      (await _store.read(_key(userId)))
          .where((bookmark) => !bookmark.isDeleted)
          .toList();

  Future<void> addBookmark(BookmarkModel bookmark, {String? userId}) async {
    final effectiveUid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    final key = _key(effectiveUid);

    // 1. Instant local offline-first update
    await _store.update(key, (items) {
      items.removeWhere((item) => item.id == bookmark.id);
      items.insert(0, bookmark);
      return items;
    });
    notifyListeners();

    // 2. Asynchronous cloud push if logged in
    if (effectiveUid != null && effectiveUid.isNotEmpty) {
      unawaited(_pushToCloud(bookmark, effectiveUid));
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteBookmark(String id, {String? userId}) async {
    final effectiveUid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    final key = _key(effectiveUid);

    // 1. Instant local update
    BookmarkModel? deleted;
    await _store.update(key, (items) {
      final index = items.indexWhere((item) => item.id == id);
      if (index == -1) return items;
      deleted = items[index].copyWith(
        deletedAt: DateTime.now(),
        updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      );
      items[index] = deleted!;
      return items;
    });
    notifyListeners();

    // 2. Sync a tombstone instead of deleting remotely. An offline older
    // device will then receive the deletion rather than restoring stale data.
    if (effectiveUid != null && effectiveUid.isNotEmpty && deleted != null) {
      unawaited(_pushToCloud(deleted!, effectiveUid));
    }
  }

  Future<bool> isBookmarked(String id, {String? userId}) async =>
      (await getBookmarks(userId: userId)).any((item) => item.id == id);

  Future<void> _pushToCloud(BookmarkModel bookmark, String uid) async {
    final db = _db;
    if (db == null) return;
    try {
      await db
          .collection('users')
          .doc(uid)
          .collection('bookmarks')
          .doc(bookmark.id)
          .set(bookmark.toJson(), SetOptions(merge: true));
      if (_pendingPushIds.remove(bookmark.id)) notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      // Offline or network glitch; retried on resume, login, or manual sync.
      debugPrint('[BookmarkService] Cloud push skipped/failed: $e');
      if (_pendingPushIds.add(bookmark.id)) notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  /// Bidirectional smart synchronization between local storage and Firestore.
  /// Reconciles differences, migrates legacy offline notes, and ensures zero data loss.
  Future<void> syncWithCloud({String? userId}) async {
    final effectiveUid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    if (effectiveUid == null || effectiveUid.isEmpty) return;

    if (_isSyncing) {
      // Jangan buang permintaan: jalankan ulang setelah sinkronisasi berjalan selesai.
      _resyncRequested = true;
      return;
    }
    _isSyncing = true;

    try {
      final userKey = _key(effectiveUid);

      // Step 1: Migrate legacy anonymous notes if any exist
      final legacyNotes = await _store.read(_legacyKey);
      if (legacyNotes.isNotEmpty) {
        final current = await _store.read(userKey);
        final mergedLocal = <String, BookmarkModel>{
          for (final b in current) b.id: b,
        };
        for (final b in legacyNotes) {
          mergedLocal.putIfAbsent(b.id, () => b);
        }
        await _store.replace(userKey, mergedLocal.values.toList());
        await _store.replace(_legacyKey, <BookmarkModel>[]);
        notifyListeners();
      }

      final db = _db;
      if (db == null && _readCloudOverride == null) {
        return;
      }

      // Fetch remotely before acquiring the local write lock.
      final cloudMap = <String, BookmarkModel>{};
      final readCloud = _readCloudOverride;
      if (readCloud != null) {
        for (final bookmark in await readCloud(effectiveUid)) {
          cloudMap[bookmark.id] = bookmark;
        }
      } else {
        final snapshot = await db!
            .collection('users')
            .doc(effectiveUid)
            .collection('bookmarks')
            .get();
        for (final doc in snapshot.docs) {
          try {
            final data = doc.data();
            if (!data.containsKey('id') || (data['id'] as String).isEmpty) {
              data['id'] = doc.id;
            }
            final model = BookmarkModel.fromJson(data);
            cloudMap[model.id] = model;
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      // Read and merge inside one locked update. A snapshot captured before
      // the network await can erase edits or resurrect deleted notes.
      final toPush = <BookmarkModel>[];
      await _store.update(userKey, (localItems) {
        final merged = <String, BookmarkModel>{
          for (final bookmark in localItems) bookmark.id: bookmark,
        };
        for (final bookmark in localItems) {
          final cloudItem = cloudMap[bookmark.id];
          if (cloudItem == null ||
              bookmark.syncTime.isAfter(cloudItem.syncTime)) {
            toPush.add(bookmark);
          }
        }
        for (final entry in cloudMap.entries) {
          final existing = merged[entry.key];
          if (existing == null ||
              entry.value.syncTime.isAfter(existing.syncTime)) {
            merged[entry.key] = entry.value;
          }
        }
        return merged.values.toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => b.effectiveTime.compareTo(a.effectiveTime));
      });
      await Future.wait(
          toPush.map((bookmark) => _pushToCloud(bookmark, effectiveUid)));
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[BookmarkService] syncWithCloud failed: $e');
    } finally {
      _isSyncing = false;
      if (_resyncRequested) {
        _resyncRequested = false;
        unawaited(syncWithCloud());
      }
    }
  }
}
```
