```dart
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';

import 'agent_service.dart';
import 'browser_companion.dart';
import 'notebook_chat_service.dart';

/// Personal browser session transport; Firebase still owns app entitlement.
class BrowserCompanionChatService extends NotebookChatService {
  BrowserCompanionChatService(
      {AgentService? agents,
      BrowserCompanionRuntime? transport,
      CompanionIdentity? Function()? identity,
      Future<void> Function()? prepare,
      int Function()? sessionGeneration})
      : _agents = agents ?? AgentService(),
        _transport = transport ?? runtime,
        _identityReader = identity ?? currentIdentity,
        _prepare = prepare ?? start,
        _sessionGeneration = sessionGeneration ?? (() => _generation);

  final AgentService _agents;
  final BrowserCompanionRuntime _transport;
  final CompanionIdentity? Function() _identityReader;
  final Future<void> Function() _prepare;
  final int Function() _sessionGeneration;
  static final runtime = BrowserCompanionRuntime(identity: currentIdentity);
  static final Map<String, _Conversation> _conversations = {};
  static StreamSubscription<User?>? _accountChanges;
  static String? _ownerKey;
  static int _generation = 0;
  static Future<void>? _starting;

  static CompanionIdentity? currentIdentity() =>
      _identityFromUser(FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser);

  static CompanionIdentity? _identityFromUser(User? user) {
    if (user == null || user.isAnonymous || !user.emailVerified) return null;
    final providers =
        user.providerData.where((p) => p.providerId == 'google.com');
    if (providers.length != 1) return null;
    final provider = providers.single;
    final sub = provider.uid;
    final email = user.email?.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (email == null ||
        email.isEmpty ||
        provider.email?.trim().toLowerCase() != email ||
        sub == null ||
        !RegExp(r'^\d{1,64}$').hasMatch(sub)) {
      return null;
    }
    return CompanionIdentity(uid: user.uid, googleSub: sub, email: email);
  }

  static String? _key(CompanionIdentity? owner) =>
      owner == null ? null : '${owner.uid}|${owner.googleSub}|${owner.email}';

  static Future<void> start() =>
      _starting ??= _start().whenComplete(() => _starting = null);

  static Future<void> _start() async {
    final owner = currentIdentity();
    if (owner == null) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unauthenticated',
          message: Loc.tr('errGoogleSignInFirst'));
    }
    final key = _key(owner);
    if (_ownerKey != null && _ownerKey != key) _generation++;
    final generation = _generation;
    if (_ownerKey != key) {
      await runtime.stop();
      _conversations.clear();
    }
    if (generation != _generation || _key(currentIdentity()) != key) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unauthenticated',
          message: 'Akun berubah ketika penghubung disiapkan.');
    }
    _ownerKey = key;
    _accountChanges ??= FirebaseAuth.instance.userChanges().listen((user) {
      if (_ownerKey != _key(_identityFromUser(user))) unawaited(stop());
    });
    await runtime.start();
    if (generation != _generation || _key(currentIdentity()) != key) {
      await stop();
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unauthenticated',
          message: 'Akun berubah ketika penghubung disiapkan.');
    }
  }

  static Future<void> stop() async {
    _generation++;
    _ownerKey = null;
    _conversations.clear();
    await runtime.stop();
  }

  void _checkOwner(String expectedUid, String ownerKey, int generation) {
    if (_identityReader()?.uid != expectedUid ||
        _key(_identityReader()) != ownerKey ||
        _sessionGeneration() != generation) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unauthenticated',
          message: Loc.tr('errAccountChanged'));
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<NotebookChatReply> ask(
      {required String expectedUid,
      required String agentId,
      required String question,
      required String requestId}) async {
    if (question.trim().isEmpty || question.length > 8000) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'invalid-argument',
          message: Loc.tr('errQuestionInvalid'));
    }
    final owner = _identityReader();
    if (owner == null || owner.uid != expectedUid) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unauthenticated',
          message: Loc.tr('errGoogleSignInFirst'));
    }
    final ownerKey = _key(owner)!;
    final generation = _sessionGeneration();
    await _prepare();
    _checkOwner(expectedUid, ownerKey, generation);
    if (!_transport.connected) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unavailable',
          message: Loc.tr('errChromeBridge'));
    }
    try {
      // Resolve from the authenticated server on every send; never client catalog.
      final url = await _agents.getAgentUrl(agentId);
      _checkOwner(expectedUid, ownerKey, generation);
      if (url == null) {
        throw const AgentAccessException(
            'failed-precondition', 'Alamat kajian belum tersedia.');
      }
      final notebookId =
          Uri.parse(url).pathSegments.where((p) => p.isNotEmpty).last;
      await _agents.recordQuestion(agentId);
      _checkOwner(expectedUid, ownerKey, generation);
      final conversationKey = '$ownerKey|$generation|$notebookId';
      final conversation = _conversations[conversationKey];
      final raw = await _transport.ask(
          expectedUid: expectedUid,
          notebookId: notebookId,
          question: question.trim(),
          requestId: requestId,
          history: conversation?.history,
          conversationId: conversation?.id);
      _checkOwner(expectedUid, ownerKey, generation);
      final reply = NotebookChatService.decodeReply(raw, requestId);
      final next = _Conversation(raw['conversationId'] as String, [
        ...?conversation?.history,
        [reply.answer, null, 2],
        [question.trim(), null, 1]
      ]);
      // Keep bounded context in memory only. Conversation IDs never become auth.
      while (next.history.length > 40 ||
          jsonEncode(next.history).length > 110000) {
        if (next.history.length < 2) break;
        next.history.removeRange(0, 2);
      }
      _conversations[conversationKey] = next;
      return reply;
    } on AgentAccessException catch (error) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: error.code, message: error.message);
    }
  }
}

class _Conversation {
  _Conversation(this.id, this.history);
  final String id;
  final List<List<Object?>> history;
}
```

```dart
final _nonce = RegExp(r'^[0-9a-f]{32}$');
final _uuid = RegExp(r'^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}){3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$');
final _email = RegExp(r'^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$');

/// Firebase's Google subject binds the native owner. The browser independently
/// verifies its observed account email; it does not prove a Google subject.
class CompanionIdentity {
  CompanionIdentity({
    required this.uid,
    required this.googleSub,
    required this.email,
  }) {
    if (uid.isEmpty ||
        uid.length > 128 ||
        !RegExp(r'^\d{1,64}$').hasMatch(googleSub) ||
        email.length > 320 ||
        email != email.toLowerCase() ||
        !_email.hasMatch(email)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Identitas Google tidak valid.');
    }
  }

  final String uid;
  final String googleSub;
  final String email;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is CompanionIdentity &&
      uid == other.uid &&
      googleSub == other.googleSub &&
      email == other.email;
  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(uid, googleSub, email);
}

class _PendingCompanionJob {
  _PendingCompanionJob(this.job, this.record) {
    // Owner revocation can occur while durable queueing is still awaiting IO.
    completer.future.ignore();

  final Map<String, dynamic> job;
  final Map<String, dynamic> record;
  final completer = Completer<Map<String, dynamic>>();

  String? _bearer;

  static Directory _defaultDirectory() {

    if (Platform.isMacOS && home != null) {

        p.join(

          'Application Support',

    if (Platform.isWindows) {
      return Directory(

      'googleSub',
      'email',

      'digest',
      'state',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',

      'queued',
      'dispatched',
      'completed',
      'failed',
      'uncertain',
      'cancelled',

          raw.length != keys.length ||

          raw['epoch'] is! String ||

  Future<void> _invalidate(String code) async {
    _clientId = null;
    _lastSeen = null;
    for (final pending in _pending.values.toList(growable: false)) {
      pending.timer?.cancel();

      pending.record['updatedAt'] = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
      if (!pending.completer.isCompleted) {

    _pending.clear();
    if (_holdsLock && _ledger.isNotEmpty) await _saveLedger();
    _setStatus(code == 'unauthenticated' ? 'signed-out' : 'waiting');
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> ask({
    required String expectedUid,
    required String notebookId,
    required String question,
    required String requestId,
    List<List<Object?>>? history,
    String? conversationId,
  }) async {
    final pending = await _serial(() async {
      if (_server == null) throw _error('unavailable');
      await _checkOwner();
      if (_owner!.uid != expectedUid) throw _error('unauthenticated');
      if (!_nonce.hasMatch(requestId) ||
          !_uuid.hasMatch(notebookId) ||
          question.trim().isEmpty ||
          question.length > 8000 ||
          (conversationId != null && !_uuid.hasMatch(conversationId)) ||
          !_validHistory(history)) {
        throw _error('invalid-argument');
      }
      if (_ledger.containsKey(requestId)) throw _error('failed-precondition');
      if (!connected) throw _error('unavailable');
      if (_ledger.length >= 4096 || _pending.length >= 16) {
        throw _error('resource-exhausted');
      }
      if (_pending.values.any((item) => item.job['notebookId'] == notebookId)) {
        throw _error('busy');
      }
      final owner = _owner!;
      final job = <String, dynamic>{
        'requestId': requestId,
        'epoch': _epoch,
        'uid': owner.uid,
        'googleSub': owner.googleSub,
        'email': owner.email,
        'notebookId': notebookId,
        'question': question.trim(),
        'history': history == null ? null : jsonDecode(jsonEncode(history)),
        'conversationId': conversationId,
      };
      final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
      final record = <String, dynamic>{
        'requestId': requestId,
        'epoch': _epoch,
        'uid': owner.uid,
        'googleSub': owner.googleSub,
        'email': owner.email,
        'notebookId': notebookId,
        'digest': sha256.convert(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(job))).toString(),
        'state': 'queued',
        'createdAt': now,
        'updatedAt': now,
      };
      final pending = _PendingCompanionJob(job, record);
      _ledger[requestId] = record;
      _pending[requestId] = pending;
      try {
        await _saveLedger();
        await _checkOwner();
      } catch (error) {
        _pending.remove(requestId);
        pending.record['state'] = 'uncertain';
        if (!pending.completer.isCompleted) {
          pending.completer.completeError(_error('uncertain'));
        }
        if (error is FirebaseFunctionsException) rethrow;
        throw _error('uncertain');
      }
      pending.timer = Timer(responseTimeout, () {
        _maintenance(() async {
          if (_pending[requestId] != pending) return;
          pending.record['state'] = 'uncertain';
          pending.record['updatedAt'] = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
          await _saveLedger();
          _pending.remove(requestId);
          if (!pending.completer.isCompleted) {
            pending.completer.completeError(_error('uncertain'));
          }
        });
      });
      return pending;
    });
    final reply = await pending.completer.future;
    if (!_ownerMatches || _owner!.uid != expectedUid) {
      throw _error('unauthenticated');
    }
    return reply;
  }

  bool _validHistory(List<dynamic>? history) =>
      history == null ||
      (history.length <= 80 &&
          history.every(
            (turn) =>
                turn is List &&
                turn.length == 3 &&
                turn[0] is String &&
                (turn[0] as String).length <= 128000 &&
                turn[1] == null &&
                (turn[2] == 1 || turn[2] == 2),
          ) &&
          jsonEncode(history).length <= 120000);

  bool _tokenMatches(String? candidate) {
    final expected = 'Bearer $_bearer';
    if (candidate == null || candidate.length != expected.length) return false;
    var different = 0;
    for (var index = 0; index < expected.length; index++) {
      different |= candidate.codeUnitAt(index) ^ expected.codeUnitAt(index);
    }
    return different == 0;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _body(HttpRequest request) async {
    if (request.contentLength > 1024 * 1024) throw _error('invalid-argument');
    final bytes = <int>[];
    final result = Completer<Map<String, dynamic>>();
    late StreamSubscription<List<int>> subscription;
    final timer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 5), () {
      unawaited(subscription.cancel());
      if (!result.isCompleted) {
        result.completeError(_error('deadline-exceeded'));
      }
    });
    subscription = request.listen(
      (chunk) {
        if (result.isCompleted) return;
        if (bytes.length + chunk.length > 1024 * 1024) {
          unawaited(subscription.cancel());
          result.completeError(_error('invalid-argument'));
        } else {
          bytes.addAll(chunk);
        }
      },
      onError: (Object _) {
        if (!result.isCompleted) {
          result.completeError(_error('invalid-argument'));
        }
      },
      onDone: () {
        if (result.isCompleted) return;
        try {
          final decoded = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(bytes));
          if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic>) throw const FormatException();
          result.complete(decoded);
        } catch (_) {
          result.completeError(_error('invalid-argument'));
        }
      },
    );
    try {
      return await result.future;
    } finally {
      timer.cancel();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _respond(
    HttpRequest request,
    int status,
    Map<String, dynamic> body,
  ) async {
    try {
      request.response.statusCode = status;
      request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      request.response.headers.set(HttpHeaders.cacheControlHeader, 'no-store');
      request.response.write(jsonEncode(body));
      await request.response.close();
    } catch (_) {
      /* A lost acknowledgement never permits replay. */
    }
  }

  Future<void> _route(HttpRequest request) async {
    if (_server == null ||
        request.connectionInfo?.remoteAddress.address != '127.0.0.1' ||
        request.headers.value(HttpHeaders.hostHeader) !=
            '127.0.0.1:${_server!.port}' ||
        request.headers['origin'] != null ||
        !_tokenMatches(
          request.headers.value(HttpHeaders.authorizationHeader),
        )) {
      await _respond(request, 403, {'ok': false, 'code': 'permission-denied'});
      return;
    }
    if (request.method != 'POST' ||
        request.uri.hasQuery ||
        !{
          '/attach',
          '/poll',
          '/result',
          '/disconnect',
        }.contains(request.uri.path)) {
      await _respond(request, 404, {'ok': false, 'code': 'invalid-argument'});
      return;
    }
    final contentType = request.headers.contentType;
    if (contentType?.mimeType != 'application/json' ||
        (contentType?.charset != null &&
            contentType!.charset!.toLowerCase() != 'utf-8')) {
      await _respond(request, 415, {'ok': false, 'code': 'invalid-argument'});
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (!_ownerMatches) {
        await _serial(() => _checkOwner());
      }
      final body = await _body(request);
      final response = await _serial(() async {
        await _checkOwner();
        final allowed = request.uri.path == '/attach'
            ? {'clientId', 'protocol', 'epoch'}
            : request.uri.path == '/result'
                ? {'clientId', 'epoch', 'result'}
                : {'clientId', 'epoch'};
        if (body.keys.toSet().difference(allowed).isNotEmpty ||
            body.length != allowed.length ||
            body['clientId'] is! String ||
            !_nonce.hasMatch(body['clientId'] as String) ||
            body['epoch'] != _epoch) {
          throw _error('invalid-argument');
        }
        final clientId = body['clientId'] as String;
        if (request.uri.path == '/attach') {
          if (body['protocol'] is! int || body['protocol'] != 1) {
            throw _error('failed-precondition');
          }
          if (_clientId != null && _clientId != clientId && connected) {
            throw _error('busy');
          }
          if (_clientId != null && !connected) await _invalidate('unavailable');
          _clientId = clientId;
          _lastSeen = DateTime.now();
          _setStatus('connected');
          return <String, dynamic>{'ok': true};
        }
        if (_clientId != clientId || !connected) throw _error('unavailable');
        _lastSeen = DateTime.now();
        if (request.uri.path == '/disconnect') {
          await _invalidate('unavailable');
          return <String, dynamic>{'ok': true};
        }
        if (request.uri.path == '/poll') {
          final queued = _pending.values.where(
            (pending) => !pending.dispatched,
          );
          if (queued.isEmpty) return <String, dynamic>{'job': null};
          final pending = queued.first;
          pending.dispatched = true;
          pending.record['state'] = 'dispatched';
          pending.record['updatedAt'] = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
          // This flush precedes exposure to Chrome. A lost response is uncertain.
          await _saveLedger();
          await _checkOwner();
          return <String, dynamic>{'job': pending.job};
        }
        await _acceptResult(body['result']);
        return <String, dynamic>{'ok': true};
      });
      if (!_ownerMatches) {
        await _serial(() => _checkOwner());
      }
      await _respond(request, 200, response);
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (error) {
      await _respond(request, error.code == 'busy' ? 409 : 400, {
        'ok': false,
        'code': error.code,
      });
    } catch (_) {
      await _respond(request, 400, {
        'ok': false,
        'code': 'failed-precondition',
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _acceptResult(dynamic raw) async {
    if (raw is! Map || raw['requestId'] is! String) {
      throw _error('invalid-argument');
    }
    final pending = _pending[raw['requestId']];
    if (pending == null || !pending.dispatched) {
      throw _error('failed-precondition');
    }
    const tupleKeys = [
      'requestId',
      'epoch',
      'uid',
      'googleSub',
      'email',
      'notebookId',
    ];
    if (tupleKeys.any((key) => raw[key] != pending.job[key])) {
      throw _error('account-mismatch');
    }
    const codes = {
      'invalid-argument',
      'unavailable',
      'unauthenticated',
      'account-mismatch',
      'failed-precondition',
      'deadline-exceeded',
      'uncertain',
      'busy',
      'resource-exhausted',
    };
    final code = raw['code'];
    Map<String, dynamic>? reply;
    String? failureCode;
    if (code != null) {
      // Only a validated browser result receives this transport-specific code.
      // Native owner revocation keeps its existing unauthenticated error.
      failureCode = code == 'unauthenticated'
          ? 'notebook-session-required'
          : codes.contains(code)
              ? code as String
              : 'failed-precondition';
    } else if (raw['accountEmail'] != _owner!.email ||
        raw['answer'] is! String ||
        (raw['answer'] as String).trim().isEmpty ||
        (raw['answer'] as String).length > 128000 ||
        raw['conversationId'] is! String ||
        !_uuid.hasMatch(raw['conversationId'] as String) ||
        raw['citations'] is! List ||
        (raw['citations'] as List).length > 100) {
      failureCode = raw['accountEmail'] != _owner!.email
          ? 'account-mismatch'
          : 'failed-precondition';
    } else {
      final citations = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (final item in raw['citations'] as List) {
        if (item is! Map ||
            item['sourceId'] is! String ||
            !_uuid.hasMatch(item['sourceId'] as String) ||
            item['citationNumber'] is! int ||
            (item['citationNumber'] as int) < 1 ||
            (item['citationNumber'] as int) > 1000 ||
            (item['excerpt'] != null &&
                (item['excerpt'] is! String ||
                    (item['excerpt'] as String).length > 4000))) {
          failureCode = 'failed-precondition';
          break;
        }
        citations.add({
          'sourceId': item['sourceId'],
          'citationNumber': item['citationNumber'],
          'excerpt': item['excerpt'],
        });
      }
      if (failureCode == null) {
        reply = {
          for (final key in tupleKeys) key: raw[key],
          'answer': raw['answer'],
          'citations': citations,
          'conversationId': raw['conversationId'],
          'accountEmail': raw['accountEmail'],
        };
      }
    }
    pending.record['state'] = failureCode == 'uncertain'
        ? 'uncertain'
        : failureCode == null
            ? 'completed'
            : 'failed';
    pending.record['updatedAt'] = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    await _saveLedger();
    await _checkOwner();
    _pending.remove(raw['requestId']);
    pending.timer?.cancel();
    if (failureCode != null) {
      pending.completer.completeError(_error(failureCode));
    } else {
      pending.completer.complete(Map<String, dynamic>.unmodifiable(reply!));
    }
  }

  Future<void> stop() => _serial(_stopInternal);

  Future<void> _stopInternal() async {
    _heartbeat?.cancel();
    _heartbeat = null;
    try {
      await _invalidate('unauthenticated');
    } catch (_) {
      /* Still revoke below. */
    }
    final server = _server;
    _server = null;
    await server?.close(force: true);
    try {
      await _regularFile(_metadata, optional: true);
      if (_holdsLock && _epoch != null && await _metadata.exists()) {
        final raw = jsonDecode(await _metadata.readAsString());
        if (raw is Map && raw['epoch'] == _epoch) await _metadata.delete();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      /* Never remove a replaced file or another process's epoch. */
    }
    try {
      if (_holdsLock) await _lock?.unlock();
    } catch (_) {
      /* A failed start may have no lock. */
    }
    await _lock?.close();
    _lock = null;
    _holdsLock = false;
    if (_claimedDirectory != null) {
      _claimedDirectories.remove(_claimedDirectory);
    }
    _claimedDirectory = null;
    _owner = null;
    _bearer = null;
    _epoch = null;
    _setStatus('stopped');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    _heartbeat?.cancel();
    unawaited(stop());
    super.dispose();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

class WorkspaceLaunchException implements Exception {
  const WorkspaceLaunchException(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  String toString() => message;
}

/// Opens the same browser workspace on every platform. Credentials stay with
/// Firebase in that browser; they are never sent back to the native launcher.
class BrowserWorkspaceLauncher {
  static const configuredUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
    'OPENTURATH_WORKSPACE_URL',
    defaultValue: 'https://open-turath.firebaseapp.com/workspace/',
  );

  static Uri workspaceUri({String? agentId, String base = configuredUrl}) {
    final uri = Uri.parse(base);
    final trustedHost = const {
          'openturath.id',
          'www.openturath.id',
          'open-turath.firebaseapp.com',
          'open-turath.web.app',
        }.contains(uri.host) ||
        RegExp(r'^open-turath--[a-z0-9-]+\.web\.app$').hasMatch(uri.host);
    if (uri.scheme != 'https' ||
        !trustedHost ||
        uri.hasPort ||
        uri.userInfo.isNotEmpty ||
        uri.path != '/workspace/' ||
        uri.hasQuery ||
        uri.hasFragment) {
      throw const WorkspaceLaunchException('Alamat ruang kajian tidak valid.');
    }
    if (agentId == null) return uri;
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9_-]{1,80}$').hasMatch(agentId)) {
      throw const WorkspaceLaunchException('Bidang kajian tidak valid.');
    }
    return uri.replace(queryParameters: {'agent': agentId});
  }

  Future<void> open({String? agentId}) async {
    final uri = workspaceUri(agentId: agentId);
    // A native HTTP preflight can fail while the system browser can connect
    // (for example, through its own proxy). Open the validated public HTTPS
    // destination directly; the browser owns connectivity and authentication.
    try {
      if (await launchUrl(uri,
          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication, webOnlyWindowName: '_self')) {
        return;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    throw const WorkspaceLaunchException(
      'Browser belum dapat dibuka. Pastikan perangkat memiliki browser utama.',
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

/// Uses the documented callable wire protocol where FlutterFire has no plugin.
/// The same server functions continue to enforce authentication and entitlements.
class CallableGateway {
  const CallableGateway({this.timeout = const Duration(seconds: 30)});

  final Duration timeout;

  Future<dynamic> call(String name, [Map<String, dynamic>? data]) async {
    if (!kIsWeb && defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.windows) {
      final client = http.Client();
      try {
        return await CallableHttpTransport(
          client: client,
          projectId: Firebase.app().options.projectId,
          token: () async => FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.getIdToken(),
          timeout: timeout,
        ).call(name, data);
      } finally {
        client.close();
      }
    }
    try {
      final result = await FirebaseFunctions.instance
          .httpsCallable(
            name,
            options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: timeout),
          )
          .call(data);
      return result.data;
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == 'unauthenticated' &&
          FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser != null) {
        try {
          await FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.getIdToken(true);
          final retryResult = await FirebaseFunctions.instance
              .httpsCallable(
                name,
                options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: timeout),
              )
              .call(data);
          return retryResult.data;
        } catch (_) {
          rethrow;
        }
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }
}

class CallableHttpTransport {
  const CallableHttpTransport({
    required this.client,
    required this.projectId,
    required this.token,
    this.region = 'us-central1',
    this.timeout = const Duration(seconds: 30),
  });

  final http.Client client;
  final String projectId;
  final String region;
  final Future<String?> Function() token;
  final Duration timeout;

  Future<dynamic> call(String name, [Map<String, dynamic>? data]) async {
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$').hasMatch(name)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(name, 'name', 'Invalid callable name');
    }
    try {
      final idToken = await token().timeout(timeout);
      if (idToken == null || idToken.isEmpty) {
        throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unauthenticated',
          message: Loc.tr('errSignInAgain'),
        );
      }
      // No automatic retry: checkout/redeem/quota calls may mutate server state.
      final response = await client
          .post(
            Uri.https('$region-$projectId.cloudfunctions.net', '/$name'),
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
              'Authorization': 'Bearer $idToken',
            },
            body: jsonEncode({'data': data}),
          )
          .timeout(timeout);
      if (response.bodyBytes.length > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
        throw const FormatException('Callable response is too large');
      }
      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
      if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid callable envelope');
      }
      final error = decoded['error'];
      if (error is Map) {
        throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: (error['status'] as String? ?? 'INTERNAL')
              .toLowerCase()
              .replaceAll('_', '-'),
          message:
              error['message'] as String? ?? Loc.tr('errServiceUnavailable'),
          details: error['details'],
        );
      }
      if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {
        throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
          code: 'unavailable',
          message: Loc.tr('errServiceUnavailable'),
        );
      }
      if (decoded.containsKey('result')) return decoded['result'];
      if (decoded.containsKey('data')) return decoded['data'];
      throw const FormatException('Missing callable result');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException {
      rethrow;
    } on TimeoutException {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
        code: 'deadline-exceeded',
        message: Loc.tr('errServerTimeout'),
      );
    } on FormatException {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
        code: 'internal',
        message: Loc.tr('errUnreadableResponse'),
      );
    } on http.ClientException {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
        code: 'unavailable',
        message: Loc.tr('errCheckConnection'),
      );
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
  final Map<String, List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> _catalogCache = {};

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _syafiiPresentations;

  /// Loads catalog for a specific agent or discipline.
  Future<List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> loadCatalogForAgent(AgentModel agent) async {
    final assetPath = (agent.catalogId != null ? _assetMapByCatalogId[agent.catalogId!] : null) ??
        _assetMapByAgentId[agent.id] ??
        _assetMapByField[agent.fieldId];
    if (assetPath == null) {
      if (agent.fieldId == 'fiqh') {
        return loadCatalogFromAsset('assets/data/01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json');
      }
      return [];
    }
    return loadCatalogFromAsset(assetPath);
  }

  /// Loads catalog from asset bundle with in-memory caching.
  Future<List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> loadCatalogFromAsset(String assetPath) async {
    if (_catalogCache.containsKey(assetPath)) {
      return _catalogCache[assetPath]!;
    }

    try {
      final jsonStr = await rootBundle.loadString(assetPath);
      final books = parseSyamilahCatalog(jsonStr);
      _catalogCache[assetPath] = books;
      if (assetPath.contains('01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII')) {
        _syafiiPresentations = books;
      }
      return books;
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Loads the canonical Syafi'i catalog from asset bundle (backwards compatible).
  Future<List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> loadSyafiiCatalog() async {
    if (_syafiiPresentations != null) {
      return _syafiiPresentations!;
    }
    return loadCatalogFromAsset('assets/data/01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json');
  }

  /// Get cached presentations or null if not yet loaded.
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? get cachedSyafiiBooks => _syafiiPresentations;

  /// Filter books by query string with diacritic-tolerant Arabic & Latin normalization.
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation> filterBooks(
    List<CanonicalBookPresentation> books,
    String query, {
    String? eraFilter,
    String? typeFilter,
    String? sectionFilter,
    String? centuryFilter,
  }) {
    final cleanQuery = query.trim();

    return books.where((book) {
      if (eraFilter != null && eraFilter.isNotEmpty && book.reviewedEraLabel != eraFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (typeFilter != null && typeFilter.isNotEmpty && book.reviewedTypeLabel != typeFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (sectionFilter != null && sectionFilter.isNotEmpty && book.sectionArabic != sectionFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (centuryFilter != null && centuryFilter.isNotEmpty) {
        final year = book.verifiedDeathYearHijri;
        if (centuryFilter == 'Salaf (≤ 300 H)') {
          if (year == null || year > 300) return false;
        } else if (centuryFilter == 'Mutaqaddimin (301-600 H)') {
          if (year == null || year <= 300 || year > 600) return false;
        } else if (centuryFilter == 'Muta\'akhkhirin (601-1100 H)') {
          if (year == null || year <= 600 || year > 1100) return false;
        } else if (centuryFilter == 'Mu\'ashir (> 1100 H)') {
          if (year != null && year <= 1100) return false;
        }
      }

      if (cleanQuery.isEmpty) return true;

      final matchTitle = ArabicUtils.matches(book.titleArabic, cleanQuery) ||
          (book.shortTitleArabic != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.shortTitleArabic!, cleanQuery)) ||
          (book.titleLatin != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.titleLatin!, cleanQuery));
      final matchAuthor = ArabicUtils.matches(book.authorArabic, cleanQuery) ||
          (book.authorLatin != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.authorLatin!, cleanQuery));
      final matchPublisher = book.publisher != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.publisher!, cleanQuery);
      final matchMuhaqqiq = book.muhaqqiq != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.muhaqqiq!, cleanQuery);
      final matchSection = book.sectionArabic != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.sectionArabic!, cleanQuery);

      return matchTitle || matchAuthor || matchPublisher || matchMuhaqqiq || matchSection;
    }).toList();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';

class DesktopWebViewRuntime {
  static WebViewEnvironment? environment;
  static String? problem;
  static Future<void>? _preparing;

  static Future<void> prepare() =>
      _preparing ??= _prepare().whenComplete(() => _preparing = null);

  static Future<void> _prepare() async {
    if (kIsWeb ||
        defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.windows ||
        environment != null) {
      return;
    }
    problem = null;
    try {
      final version = await WebViewEnvironment.getAvailableVersion()
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (version == null || version.isEmpty) {
        problem =
            'Pasang Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime untuk membuka ruang telaah di aplikasi.';
        return;
      }
      final support = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
      final profile = Directory(p.join(support.path, 'webview2'));
      await profile.create(recursive: true);
      environment = await WebViewEnvironment.create(
        settings: WebViewEnvironmentSettings(userDataFolder: profile.path),
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    } catch (_) {
      problem =
          'Ruang web belum dapat disiapkan. Periksa WebView2 dan izin penyimpanan aplikasi.';
    }
  }

  static CookieManager get cookies =>
      CookieManager.instance(webViewEnvironment: environment);

  static Future<void> clearSession() async {
    // One unsupported method must not prevent the remaining cleanup operations.
    try {
      await cookies.deleteAllCookies();
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await InAppWebViewController.clearAllCache();
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await WebStorageManager.instance().deleteAllData();
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}
```

## File: `openturath_ai/lib/services/device_service.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io' show Platform;
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:device_info_plus/device_info_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class DeviceFingerprint {
  final String deviceId;
  final String brand;
  final String model;
  final bool isPhysicalDevice;

  const DeviceFingerprint({
    required this.deviceId,
    required this.brand,
    required this.model,
    required this.isPhysicalDevice,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'deviceId': deviceId,
        'brand': brand,
        'model': model,
        'isPhysicalDevice': isPhysicalDevice,
      };

  @override
  String toString() =>
      'DeviceFingerprint(deviceId: ${deviceId.substring(0, 8)}..., model: $model, physical: $isPhysicalDevice)';
}

class DeviceService {
  static final DeviceService _instance = DeviceService._internal();
  factory DeviceService() => _instance;
  DeviceService._internal();

  final DeviceInfoPlugin _deviceInfo = DeviceInfoPlugin();
  static Future<String>? _installationId;

  static Future<String> _persistentId() => _installationId ??= (() async {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        final existing = prefs.getString('ot_installation_identity_v1');
        if (existing != null && existing.isNotEmpty) return existing;
        final random = Random.secure();
        final id =
            base64UrlEncode(List.generate(32, (_) => random.nextInt(256)));
        if (!await prefs.setString('ot_installation_identity_v1', id)) {
          throw StateError('Identitas perangkat belum dapat disimpan.');
        }
        return id;
      })()
          .catchError((Object error) {
        _installationId = null;
        throw error;
      });

  static const String _salt = 'OT_AI_HW_SALT_2026_980031db';

  /// Menghitung hash SHA-256 salted dari identitas hardware perangkat.
  /// Bersifat deterministik dan aman untuk privasi pengguna.
  static String computeHash({
    required String rawId,
    required String brand,
    required String model,
  }) {
    final cleanId = rawId.trim();
    final cleanBrand = brand.trim().toLowerCase();
    final cleanModel = model.trim().toLowerCase();
    final payload = '$_salt::$cleanId::$cleanBrand::$cleanModel';
    return sha256.convert(utf8.encode(payload)).toString();
  }

  /// Mengambil sidik jari perangkat saat ini (Device Fingerprint).
  Future<DeviceFingerprint> getDeviceFingerprint() async {
    try {
      if (kIsWeb) {
        final webInfo = await _deviceInfo.webBrowserInfo;
        final rawId = webInfo.userAgent ?? 'web_browser';
        final brand = webInfo.vendor ?? 'browser';
        final model = webInfo.browserName.name;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);
        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: true,
        );
      }

      if (Platform.isAndroid) {
        final androidInfo = await _deviceInfo.androidInfo;
        final rawId = androidInfo.id; // Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID
        final brand = androidInfo.brand;
        final model = androidInfo.model;
        final isPhysical = androidInfo.isPhysicalDevice;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);

        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: isPhysical,
        );
      }

      if (Platform.isIOS) {
        final iosInfo = await _deviceInfo.iosInfo;
        final rawId = iosInfo.identifierForVendor ?? 'ios_device';
        const brand = 'apple';
        final model = iosInfo.utsname.machine;
        final isPhysical = iosInfo.isPhysicalDevice;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);

        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: isPhysical,
        );
      }

      if (Platform.isMacOS) {
        final macInfo = await _deviceInfo.macOsInfo;
        final rawId = macInfo.systemGUID ?? await _persistentId();
        const brand = 'apple';
        final model = macInfo.model;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);

        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: true,
        );
      }
      if (Platform.isWindows) {
        final info = await _deviceInfo.windowsInfo;
        final rawId = info.deviceId.trim().isEmpty
            ? await _persistentId()
            : info.deviceId;
        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId:
              computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: 'windows', model: 'windows-pc'),
          brand: 'windows',
          model: info.productName,
          isPhysicalDevice: true,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[DeviceService] Warning failed to inspect device info: $e');
    }

    // Fallback darurat (misalnya unit test harness lokal tanpa platform channel)
    final fallbackId = await _persistentId();
    final fallbackHash = computeHash(
      rawId: fallbackId,
      brand: 'generic',
      model: 'generic_device',
    );
    return DeviceFingerprint(
      deviceId: fallbackHash,
      brand: 'generic',
      model: 'generic_device',
      isPhysicalDevice: true,
    );
  }
}
```

<a name="file-openturath_ai-lib-services-native_agent_launcher-dart"></a>
## File: `openturath_ai/lib/services/native_agent_launcher.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'auth_service.dart';

/// NativeAgentLauncher: Menangani pembukaan asisten langsung ke aplikasi resmi
/// Google Gemini Notebook (com.google.android.apps.labs.language.tailwind) secara instan (0.1 detik)
/// atau ke browser sistem dengan jaminan akun Google yang sesuai (AccountChooser + authuser).
class NativeAgentLauncher {
  static const MethodChannel _channel =
      MethodChannel('com.openturath.ai/native_launcher');
  static const String _prefNotebookEmailKey = 'notebook_google_email';

  /// Mengambil email Google yang aktif digunakan untuk membuka asisten NotebookLM.
  /// Memprioritaskan email kustom jika disetel oleh pengguna, atau akun masuk OpenTurath AI saat ini.
  static Future<String> getActiveNotebookEmail() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final custom =
          prefs.getString(_prefNotebookEmailKey)?.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (custom != null && custom.isNotEmpty) {
        return custom;
      }
      final sessionEmail =
          prefs.getString('google_session_email')?.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (sessionEmail != null && sessionEmail.isNotEmpty) {
        return sessionEmail;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return AuthService().currentUser?.email?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
  }

  /// Menyimpan email Google preferensi untuk peluncuran asisten
  static Future<void> setActiveNotebookEmail(String email) async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final clean = email.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (clean.isEmpty) {
        await prefs.remove(_prefNotebookEmailKey);
      } else {
        await prefs.setString(_prefNotebookEmailKey, clean);
        await prefs.setString('google_session_email', clean);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Memformat URL NotebookLM dengan integrasi Google AccountChooser dan authuser.
  /// Mencegah browser salah masuk ke akun default (/u/0/) jika user memiliki banyak akun Google.
  static String formatAccountBoundUrl(String url, {String? email}) {
    final cleanUrl = url.replaceAll('/preview', '');
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(cleanUrl);
    if (uri == null) return cleanUrl;

    final targetEmail = email?.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (targetEmail == null || targetEmail.isEmpty) {
      return cleanUrl;
    }

    final queryParams = Map<String, String>.from(uri.queryParameters);
    queryParams['authuser'] = targetEmail;
    final notebookWithAuthuser =
        uri.replace(queryParameters: queryParams).toString();

    return 'https://accounts.google.com/AccountChooser?Email=${Uri.encodeComponent(targetEmail)}&continue=${Uri.encodeComponent(notebookWithAuthuser)}';
  }

  /// Cek apakah aplikasi resmi Google Gemini Notebook terpasang di perangkat
  static Future<bool> isNotebookAppInstalled() async {
    if (!Platform.isAndroid) return false;
    try {
      final bool? installed =
          await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('isNotebookAppInstalled');
      return installed == true;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Buka URL notebook dengan pengikatan akun Google yang tepat
  /// Mengembalikan `true` jika berhasil diluncurkan.
  static Future<bool> launchNotebook(String url, {String? email}) async {
    final cleanUrl = url.replaceAll('/preview', '');
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(cleanUrl);
    if (uri == null ||
        uri.scheme != 'https' ||
        uri.userInfo.isNotEmpty ||
        !const {'notebooklm.google.com', 'notebook.google.com'}
            .contains(uri.host)) {
      return false;
    }

    final effectiveEmail = (email != null && email.isNotEmpty)
        ? email
        : await getActiveNotebookEmail();

    // 1. Prioritaskan peluncuran Intent langsung ke com.google.android.apps.labs.language.tailwind di Android
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      try {
        final bool? success =
            await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('openInNotebookApp', {
          'url': cleanUrl,
        });
        if (success == true) {
          return true;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 2. Format URL terikat akun Google spesifik via AccountChooser
    final targetLaunchUrl =
        formatAccountBoundUrl(cleanUrl, email: effectiveEmail);
    final targetUri = Uri.tryParse(targetLaunchUrl) ?? uri;

    // 3. Peluncuran ke browser eksternal
    try {
      final bool launched = await launchUrl(
        targetUri,
        mode: Platform.isAndroid
            ? LaunchMode.externalNonBrowserApplication
            : LaunchMode.externalApplication,
      );
      if (launched) return true;
      if (Platform.isAndroid) {
        return await launchUrl(targetUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    return false;
  }

  /// Membuka Share Sheet native Android untuk membagikan modul AI
  static Future<bool> shareText(
      {required String text, String title = 'Bagikan Modul'}) async {
    if (!Platform.isAndroid) {
      try {
        await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
        return true;
      } catch (_) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    try {
      final bool? success = await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('shareText', {
        'text': text,
        'title': title,
      });
      return success == true;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../models/answer_citation.dart';
import '../models/turath_chat_message.dart';
import 'notebook_chat_service.dart';

class NotebookChatController extends ChangeNotifier {
  NotebookChatController(
      {required this.agentId,
      required this.currentUid,
      NotebookChatService service = const NotebookChatService()})
      : _service = service;

  final String agentId;
  final String? Function() currentUid;
  final NotebookChatService _service;
  final List<TurathChatMessage> _messages = [];
  String? _owner;
  int _epoch = 0;
  bool _disposed = false;
  bool isGenerating = false;
  String? error;

  List<TurathChatMessage> get messages => List.unmodifiable(_messages);

  void synchronizeOwner() {
    if (_disposed || _owner == currentUid()) return;
    _owner = currentUid();
    _epoch++;
    _messages.clear();
    isGenerating = false;
    error = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> send(String question) async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    synchronizeOwner();
    if (isGenerating || question.trim().isEmpty) return;
    final owner = _owner;
    if (owner == null || question.length > 8000) {
      error = owner == null
          ? 'Silakan masuk ke OpenTurath.'
          : 'Pertanyaan terlalu panjang.';
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }
    final epoch = _epoch;
    final random = Random.secure();
    final id = List.generate(
            16, (_) => random.nextInt(256).toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'))
        .join();
    _messages.add(TurathChatMessage(
        id: '${id}_q',
        text: question.trim(),
        isUser: true,
        timestamp: DateTime.now()));
    isGenerating = true;
    error = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final reply = await _service.ask(
          expectedUid: owner,
          agentId: agentId,
          question: question,
          requestId: id);
      if (_disposed || epoch != _epoch || currentUid() != owner) return;
      _messages.add(TurathChatMessage(
          id: '${id}_a',
          text: reply.answer,
          isUser: false,
          timestamp: DateTime.now(),
          citations: reply.citations.map((ref) => ref.display).toList(),
          references: reply.citations
              .map((ref) => AnswerCitation(
                  sourceId: ref.sourceId,
                  number: ref.number,
                  excerpt: ref.excerpt))
              .toList()));
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (failure) {
      if (_disposed || epoch != _epoch || currentUid() != owner) return;
      error = switch (failure.code) {
        'unauthenticated' => 'Silakan masuk kembali ke OpenTurath.',
        'notebook-session-required' =>
          'Buka ruang AI di profil Chrome tempat penghubung dipasang, lalu masuk dengan akun Google yang sama dengan OpenTurath.',
        'permission-denied' => 'Akses kajian ini belum aktif untuk akun Anda.',
        'account-mismatch' =>
          'Akun Google di Chrome berbeda. Gunakan akun yang sama dengan OpenTurath.',
        'uncertain' =>
          'Pengiriman terputus. Pertanyaan mungkin sudah diterima; tidak dikirim ulang otomatis.',
        'busy' => 'Tunggu jawaban percakapan yang sedang berjalan.',
        'unavailable' =>
          'Penghubung AI belum tersambung. Periksa koneksi Anda.',
        'failed-precondition' => 'Koneksi AI di aplikasi belum diaktifkan.',
        'resource-exhausted' =>
          'Terlalu banyak pertanyaan. Silakan tunggu sebentar.',
        'deadline-exceeded' =>
          'Respons belum diterima. Pertanyaan tidak dikirim ulang otomatis.',
        _ =>
          'AI belum dapat menjawab. Pertanyaan tidak dikirim ulang otomatis.',
      };
    } catch (_) {
      if (_disposed || epoch != _epoch || currentUid() != owner) return;
      error =
          'AI belum dapat dihubungi. Pertanyaan tidak dikirim ulang otomatis.';
    } finally {
      if (!_disposed && epoch == _epoch) {
        if (currentUid() != owner) {
          synchronizeOwner();
        } else {
          isGenerating = false;
          notifyListeners();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    _epoch++;
    _messages.clear();
    super.dispose();
  }
}
```

```dart
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';

import 'callable_gateway.dart';

class NotebookChatCitation {
  const NotebookChatCitation(this.sourceId, this.number, this.excerpt);
  final String sourceId;
  final int number;
  final String? excerpt;

  String get display => excerpt == null || excerpt!.isEmpty
      ? 'Rujukan [$number]'
      : '[$number] $excerpt';
}

class NotebookChatReply {
  const NotebookChatReply(this.answer, this.citations);
  final String answer;
  final List<NotebookChatCitation> citations;
}

/// Calls OpenTurath's backend using the existing Firebase identity.
/// Google operator sessions and upstream conversation IDs never enter the app.
class NotebookChatService {
  const NotebookChatService({
    CallableGateway gateway = const CallableGateway(
      timeout: Duration(seconds: 100),
    ),
  }) : _gateway = gateway;

  final CallableGateway _gateway;

  Future<NotebookChatReply> ask({
    required String expectedUid,
    required String agentId,
    required String question,
    required String requestId,
  }) async {
    if (question.trim().isEmpty || question.length > 8000) {
      throw FirebaseFunctionsException(
        code: 'invalid-argument',
        message: Loc.tr('errQuestionInvalid'),
      );
    }
    final raw = await _gateway.call('askAgent', {
      'agentId': agentId,
      'question': question.trim(),
      'requestId': requestId,
      'expectedUid': expectedUid,
    });
    return decodeReply(raw, requestId);
  }

  /// Shared validation for normalized replies from either transport.
  static NotebookChatReply decodeReply(Object? raw, String requestId) {
    final invalid = FirebaseFunctionsException(
      code: 'unavailable',
      message: Loc.tr('errAnswerUnreadable'),
    );
    if (raw is! Map ||
        raw['requestId'] != requestId ||
        raw['answer'] is! String ||
        (raw['answer'] as String).trim().isEmpty ||
        (raw['answer'] as String).length > 128000 ||
        raw['citations'] is! List ||
        (raw['citations'] as List).length > 100) {
      throw invalid;
    }
    final citations = <NotebookChatCitation>[];
    final uuid =
        RegExp(r'^[a-fA-F0-9]{8}(?:-[a-fA-F0-9]{4}){3}-[a-fA-F0-9]{12}$');
    for (final ref in raw['citations'] as List) {
      if (ref is! Map ||
          ref['sourceId'] is! String ||
          !uuid.hasMatch(ref['sourceId'] as String) ||
          ref['citationNumber'] is! int ||
          (ref['citationNumber'] as int) < 1 ||
          (ref['citationNumber'] as int) > 1000 ||
          (ref['excerpt'] != null &&
              (ref['excerpt'] is! String ||
                  (ref['excerpt'] as String).length > 4000))) {
        throw invalid;
      }
      citations.add(NotebookChatCitation(
        ref['sourceId'] as String,
        ref['citationNumber'] as int,
        ref['excerpt'] as String?,
      ));
    }
    return NotebookChatReply(
      (raw['answer'] as String).trim(),
      List.unmodifiable(citations),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

/// Data model metadata pelatihan modul AI OpenTurath
class AiLibraryMetadata {
  const AiLibraryMetadata({
    required this.keyName,
    required this.idModul,
    required this.kategori,
    required this.nama,
    required this.namaArab,
    required this.totalKitab,
    required this.totalJilid,
    required this.totalHalaman,
    required this.totalKata,
    required this.rentangMasa,
    this.badgeOtoritas = '',
    this.headlineAplikasi = '',
    this.totalDars,
    this.totalMuhadharah,
  });

  final String keyName;
  final String idModul;
  final String kategori;
  final String nama;
  final String namaArab;
  final int totalKitab;
  final String totalJilid;
  final int totalHalaman;
  final int totalKata;
  final String rentangMasa;
  final String badgeOtoritas;
  final String headlineAplikasi;
  final int? totalDars;
  final int? totalMuhadharah;

  factory AiLibraryMetadata.fromJson(
    String keyName,
    Map<String, dynamic> json,
  ) {
    return AiLibraryMetadata(
      keyName: keyName,
      idModul: _stringValue(json['id_modul']),
      kategori: _stringValue(json['kategori']),
      nama: _stringValue(json['nama_tampilan'] ?? json['nama']),
      namaArab: _stringValue(json['nama_arab']),
      totalKitab: _intValue(json['total_kitab']),
      totalJilid:
          _stringValue(json['total_jilid_fisik'] ?? json['total_jilid']),
      totalHalaman:
          _intValue(json['total_halaman_fisik'] ?? json['total_halaman']),
      totalKata: _intValue(json['total_kata_bersih'] ?? json['total_kata']),
      rentangMasa: _stringValue(json['rentang_masa']),
      badgeOtoritas: _stringValue(json['badge_otoritas']),
      headlineAplikasi: _stringValue(json['headline_aplikasi']),
      totalDars:
          json['total_dars'] == null ? null : _intValue(json['total_dars']),
      totalMuhadharah: json['total_muhadharah'] == null
          ? null
          : _intValue(json['total_muhadharah']),
    );
  }

  static String _stringValue(dynamic value) {
    return value == null ? '' : value.toString().trim();
  }

  static int _intValue(dynamic value) {
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is num) return value.round();

    final cleaned = value?.toString().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '') ?? '';
    return int.tryParse(cleaned) ?? 0;
  }
}

    'tajwid_qiraat': 'assets/data/15_KATALOG_TAJWID_DAN_QIRAAT.json',
    'qawaid_fiqhiyyah': 'assets/data/16_KATALOG_QAWAID_FIQHIYYAH.json',
    'musthalah_hadits':
        'assets/data/17_KATALOG_MUSTHALAH_DAN_ULUMUL_HADITS.json',
    'aqidah': 'assets/data/18_KATALOG_AQIDAH_DAN_USHULUDDIN.json',

    'bibliografi_faharis':

  };

  Map<String, AiLibraryMetadata>? _metadataCache;
  final Map<String, List<OpenTurathBook>> _booksCache = {};

  /// Memuat seluruh metadata modul AI dari assets/data/metadata_training_seluruh_ai.json
  Future<Map<String, AiLibraryMetadata>> loadAllMetadata() async {
    if (_metadataCache != null) return _metadataCache!;

    final jsonString = await rootBundle
        .loadString('assets/data/metadata_training_seluruh_ai.json');
    final decoded = jsonDecode(jsonString);
    if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic> ||
        decoded.values.any((value) => value is! Map<String, dynamic>)) {
      throw const FormatException('Invalid library metadata');
    }
    final result = decoded.map((key, value) => MapEntry(
        key, AiLibraryMetadata.fromJson(key, value as Map<String, dynamic>)));
    _metadataCache = result;
    return result;
  }

  static const Map<String, String> _metadataAlias = {
    'nahwu_sharaf': 'bahasa_arab',
    'tarikh': 'tarikh_sirah',
    'thabaqat_rijal': 'thabaqat_tarajim',
  };

  /// Metadata pustaka milik asisten itu sendiri. Mengembalikan null bila tidak
  /// tercatat; angka pustaka lain tidak pernah dipinjam.
  static AiLibraryMetadata? exactMetadata(
          Map<String, AiLibraryMetadata> all, String agentId) =>
      all[agentId] ?? all[_metadataAlias[agentId]];

  /// Mengambil metadata untuk modul atau asisten tertentu
  Future<AiLibraryMetadata?> getMetadataForModule(String key) async {
    final all = await loadAllMetadata();
    if (all.containsKey(key)) return all[key];

    // Fallback key cleaning
    final cleanKey = key.replaceAll('-', '_').toLowerCase();
    for (final entry in all.entries) {
      if (entry.key == cleanKey ||
          entry.value.idModul.toLowerCase().contains(cleanKey) ||
          cleanKey.contains(entry.key)) {
        return entry.value;
      }
    }

    return exactMetadata(all, cleanKey);
  }

  /// Memuat daftar kitab untuk modul atau asisten tertentu dari katalog JSON
  Future<List<OpenTurathBook>> loadBooksForModule(String moduleKey) async {
    final cleanKey = moduleKey.replaceAll('-', '_').toLowerCase();
    final catalogPath = _moduleToCatalogFile[cleanKey];
    if (catalogPath == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
          moduleKey, 'moduleKey', 'No catalog registered');
    }

    if (_booksCache.containsKey(catalogPath)) {
      return _booksCache[catalogPath]!;
    }

    final jsonString = await rootBundle.loadString(catalogPath);
    final books = OpenTurathBook.decodeList(jsonString);
    _booksCache[catalogPath] = books;
    return books;
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'callable_gateway.dart';
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';
import '../core/product_pricing.dart';

/// PaymentService — checkout Midtrans lewat Cloud Functions.
/// Semua interaksi dengan gateway dan kuncinya terjadi di server; aplikasi
/// tidak pernah menyimpan kunci rahasia.
class PaymentService {
  final CallableGateway _functions = const CallableGateway();

  /// Buat sesi pembayaran checkout resmi melalui Cloud Function createCheckout
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createCheckoutSession({
    required String uid,
    required String agentId,
    required String plan,
    required String planTitle,
    required int amount,
    required String name,
    required String email,
    required String phone,
  }) async {
    try {
      final result = await _functions.call(AppConstants.fnCreatePayment, {
        'uid': uid,
        'agentId': agentId,
        'plan': plan,
        'planTitle': planTitle,
        'amount': amount,
        'expectedAmount': amount,
        'pricingRevision': ProductPricing.revision,
        'name': name,
        'email': email,
        'phone': phone,
      });

      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result as Map);
      return {
        'redirectUrl': data['paymentUrl'] ?? data['redirectUrl'],
        'paymentUrl': data['paymentUrl'] ?? data['redirectUrl'],
        'trxId': data['trxId'] ?? '',
        'invoiceNumber': data['invoiceNumber'] ?? '',
        'status': 'pending',
        'amount': data['amount'],
        'pricingRevision': data['pricingRevision'],
      };
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e) {
      throw Exception('Gagal membuat sesi pembayaran: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Periksa status pembayaran lewat Cloud Function yang menanyakan gateway.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> checkPaymentStatus({
    required String invoiceNumber,
  }) async {
    try {
      final result = await _functions.call(
          AppConstants.fnCheckPaymentStatus, {'invoiceNumber': invoiceNumber});
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(result as Map);
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        'success': false,
        'status': 'ERROR',
      };
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'scoped_json_store.dart';

/// Model Catatan Riset / Bookmark Hasil Pencarian Kitab
class ResearchNote {
  final String id;
  final String agentId;
  final String agentTitle;
  final String title;
  final String excerpt;
  final String? bookTitle;
  final String? bookVolume;
  final String? bookPage;
  final List<String> tags;
  final DateTime createdAt;

  ResearchNote({
    required this.id,
    required this.agentId,
    required this.agentTitle,
    required this.title,
    required this.excerpt,
    this.bookTitle,
    this.bookVolume,
    this.bookPage,
    this.tags = const [],
    required this.createdAt,
  });

  String get citationFormatted {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('"$excerpt"');
    buffer.writeln();
    buffer.write('Sumber: OpenTurath AI ($agentTitle)');
    if (bookTitle != null && bookTitle!.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.write(', Kitab $bookTitle');
      if (bookVolume != null && bookVolume!.isNotEmpty) buffer.write(' Juz $bookVolume');
      if (bookPage != null && bookPage!.isNotEmpty) buffer.write(' Hal $bookPage');
    }
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'id': id,
        'agent_id': agentId,
        'agent_title': agentTitle,
        'title': title,
        'excerpt': excerpt,
        'book_title': bookTitle,
        'book_volume': bookVolume,
        'book_page': bookPage,
        'tags': tags,
        'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory ResearchNote.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => ResearchNote(
        id: map['id'] ?? '',
        agentId: map['agent_id'] ?? '',
        agentTitle: map['agent_title'] ?? '',
        title: map['title'] ?? '',
        excerpt: map['excerpt'] ?? '',
        bookTitle: map['book_title'],
        bookVolume: map['book_volume'],
        bookPage: map['book_page'],
        tags: List<String>.from(map['tags'] ?? []),
        createdAt: DateTime.tryParse(map['created_at'] ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
      );
}

/// Service Penyimpanan Catatan & Bookmark Riset Lokal (Offline-first)
class ResearchNotesService {
  final _store = ScopedJsonListStore<ResearchNote>(
    storage: PreferencesStringStore(), decode: ResearchNote.fromMap,
    encode: (note) => note.toMap(),
  );
  String _key(String? userId) {
    final uid = userId ?? FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    return uid == null || uid.isEmpty ? 'openturath_research_notes_v1' : 'openturath_${uid}_research_notes_v1';
  }
  Future<void> saveNote(ResearchNote note, {String? userId}) {
    final key = _key(userId);
    return _store.update(key, (notes) {
      notes.removeWhere((n) => n.id == note.id);
      notes.insert(0, note);
      return notes;
    });
  }
  Future<void> deleteNote(String noteId, {String? userId}) {
    final key = _key(userId);
    return _store.update(key, (notes) => notes..removeWhere((n) => n.id == noteId));
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

abstract class StringStore {
  Future<String?> read(String key);
  Future<bool> write(String key, String value);
}

class PreferencesStringStore implements StringStore {
  @override
  Future<String?> read(String key) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final value = prefs.get(key);
    if (value is String) return value;
    if (value is List) {
      // Backward compatibility for legacy SharedPreferences stored as List<String>
      final items = <dynamic>[];
      for (final item in value) {
        if (item is String) {
          try {
            items.add(jsonDecode(item));
          } catch (_) {
            items.add(item);
          }
        } else {
          items.add(item);
        }
      }
      return jsonEncode(items);
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> write(String key, String value) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (prefs.containsKey(key) && prefs.get(key) is! String) {
      await prefs.remove(key);
    }
    return prefs.setString(key, value);
  }
}

class ScopedJsonListStore<T> {
  final StringStore storage;
  final T Function(Map<String, dynamic>) decode;
  final Map<String, dynamic> Function(T) encode;
  static final Map<String, Future<void>> _tails = {};

  ScopedJsonListStore({required this.storage, required this.decode, required this.encode});

  Future<R> _locked<R>(String key, Future<R> Function() action) async {
    final previous = _tails[key];
    final done = Completer<void>();
    _tails[key] = done.future;
    try {
      if (previous != null) await previous;
      return await action();
    } finally {
      done.complete();
      if (identical(_tails[key], done.future)) _tails.remove(key);
    }
  }

  Future<List<T>> _read(String key) async {
    final raw = await storage.read(key);
    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return <T>[];
    try {
      final data = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (data is! List) throw const FormatException('Expected a list');
      return data.map((row) {
        if (row is! Map) throw const FormatException('Expected an object');
        return decode(Map<String, dynamic>.from(row));
      }).toList();
    } on Object {
      final digest = sha256.convert(utf8.encode(raw));
      final quarantine = '${key}_corrupt_$digest';
      if (await storage.read(quarantine) != raw && !await storage.write(quarantine, raw)) {
        throw StateError('Cannot preserve damaged saved data');
      }
      return <T>[];
    }
  }

  Future<List<T>> read(String key) => _locked(key, () => _read(key));

  Future<void> replace(String key, List<T> items) {
    final snapshot = List<T>.of(items);
    return _locked(key, () async {
      await _read(key); // Preserve corrupt old bytes before replacing them.
      await _write(key, snapshot);
    });
  }

  Future<void> update(String key, List<T> Function(List<T>) edit) => _locked(key, () async {
    final current = await _read(key);
    await _write(key, edit(current));
  });

  Future<void> _write(String key, List<T> items) async {
    final raw = jsonEncode(items.map(encode).toList());
    if (!await storage.write(key, raw)) throw StateError('Saved data could not be written');
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';

Stream<T?> sessionUserStream<T>({
  required Stream<String?> auth,
  required Future<T?> Function(String) cached,
  required Stream<T?> Function(String) watch,
}) {
  final listeners = <MultiStreamController<T?>>{};
  StreamSubscription<String?>? authSub;
  StreamSubscription<T?>? documentSub;
  var generation = 0;
  var hasValue = false;
  T? last;

  bool current(int token) => token == generation && listeners.isNotEmpty;
  void emit(int token, T? value) {
    if (!current(token)) return;
    hasValue = true;
    last = value;
    for (final listener in listeners.toList()) { listener.add(value); }
  }
  void error(int token, Object value, StackTrace stack) {
    if (!current(token)) return;
    for (final listener in listeners.toList()) { listener.addError(value, stack); }
  }
  Future<void> cancel(StreamSubscription<dynamic>? sub) async {
    try { await sub?.cancel(); } catch (_) { /* Generation already invalidates events. */ }
  }
  Future<void> switchUser(String? uid) async {
    final token = ++generation;
    final previous = documentSub;
    documentSub = null;
    emit(token, null); // Clear prior identity before asynchronous cache lookup.
    await cancel(previous);
    if (!current(token) || uid == null) return;
    try {
      final value = await cached(uid).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
      if (!current(token)) return;
      if (value != null) emit(token, value);
    } catch (_) { /* Continue with the authoritative snapshot stream. */ }
    if (!current(token)) return;
    try {
      documentSub = watch(uid).listen(
        (value) => emit(token, value),
        onError: (Object e, StackTrace stack) => error(token, e, stack),
      );
    } catch (e, stack) { error(token, e, stack); }
  }

  return Stream<T?>.multi((listener) {
    listeners.add(listener);
    if (hasValue) listener.add(last);
    if (listeners.length == 1) {
      authSub = auth.listen((uid) { unawaited(switchUser(uid)); },
        onError: (Object e, StackTrace stack) => error(generation, e, stack));
    }
    listener.onCancel = () async {
      listeners.remove(listener);
      if (listeners.isNotEmpty) return;
      generation++;
      hasValue = false;
      last = null;
      final oldAuth = authSub;
      final oldDocument = documentSub;
      authSub = null;
      documentSub = null;
      await Future.wait([cancel(oldAuth), cancel(oldDocument)]);
    };
  }, isBroadcast: true);
}
```

```dart
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';
import 'device_service.dart';
import 'payment_service.dart';
import 'callable_gateway.dart';

class SubscriptionService {
  final PaymentService _paymentService = PaymentService();

  /// Normalisasi kode voucher: hapus spasi, ubah huruf kapital, hapus tanda strip
  static String normalizeCode(String input) {
    return input.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\s-]'), '');
  }

  static String redeemErrorMessage(String code, [String? serverMessage]) {
    final c = code.toLowerCase().replaceAll('_', '-');
    if (serverMessage != null && serverMessage.isNotEmpty) {
      final lowerMsg = serverMessage.toLowerCase();
      if (lowerMsg.contains('perangkat') || lowerMsg.contains('ponsel')) {
        return serverMessage;
      }
    }
    if (c.contains('not-found')) {
      return 'Kode voucher tidak ditemukan. Periksa kembali penulisan kode Anda.';
    }
    if (c.contains('already-exists') || c.contains('already-used')) {
      return 'Kode ini sudah pernah ditukarkan sebelumnya.';
    }
    if (c.contains('deadline-exceeded') || c.contains('expired')) {
      return 'Masa berlaku kode voucher ini telah berakhir.';
    }
    if (c.contains('failed-precondition')) {
      if (serverMessage != null && serverMessage.contains('ponsel')) {
        return serverMessage;
      }
      return 'Kode voucher ini sudah tidak aktif.';
    }
    if (c.contains('resource-exhausted') || c.contains('quota')) {
      return 'Kuota penukaran untuk kode voucher ini sudah habis.';
    }
    if (c.contains('unauthenticated')) {
      return Loc.tr('redeemSignInFirst');
    }
    if (c.contains('invalid-argument')) {
      return 'Format penulisan kode voucher belum sesuai.';
    }
    if (c.contains('permission-denied')) {
      return Loc.tr('redeemNotForAccount');
    }
    if (c.contains('unavailable')) {
      return Loc.tr('redeemServiceUnavailable');
    }
    return Loc.tr('redeemNotActivated');
  }

  // ── Klaim Kode Redeem Santri (Voucher Akses 7 Hari, dsb) ─────
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> redeemAccessCode(
    String code, {
    DeviceFingerprint? customFingerprint,
  }) async {
    try {
      final normalized = normalizeCode(code);
      final fingerprint =
          customFingerprint ?? await DeviceService().getDeviceFingerprint();
      final data = await const CallableGateway().call('redeemCode', {
        'code': normalized,
        'deviceId': fingerprint.deviceId,
        'deviceModel': fingerprint.model,
        'deviceBrand': fingerprint.brand,
        'isPhysicalDevice': fingerprint.isPhysicalDevice,
      });
      if (data is Map) {
        return Map<String, dynamic>.from(data);
      }
      return {'success': true, 'message': 'Kode akses sudah aktif.'};
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      final serverMsg = e.message;
      if (serverMsg != null &&
          serverMsg.isNotEmpty &&
          (serverMsg.contains('perangkat') || serverMsg.contains('ponsel'))) {
        return {'success': false, 'message': serverMsg};
      }
      return {
        'success': false,
        'message': redeemErrorMessage(e.code, serverMsg)
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        'success': false,
        'message': 'Koneksi bermasalah. Periksa internet Anda lalu coba lagi.'
      };
    }
  }

  // ── Sinkronkan Transaksi GoAkal Secara Otomatis ───────────────
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> syncAkalPurchases() async {
    try {
      final data = await const CallableGateway().call('syncAkalPurchases');
      if (data is Map) {
        return Map<String, dynamic>.from(data);
      }
      return {
        'success': true,
        'synced': <String>[],
        'message': 'Sinkronisasi berhasil.'
      };
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      return {
        'success': false,
        'synced': <String>[],
        'message': e.message ?? 'Gagal menyinkronkan data GoAkal.'
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        'success': false,
        'synced': <String>[],
        'message': 'Gagal menghubungi server. Periksa koneksi internet Anda.'
      };
    }
  }

  // ── Buat sesi pembayaran lewat Cloud Functions ───────
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createPayment({
    required String uid,
    required String agentId,
    required String plan,
    required String name,
    required String email,
    required String phone,
    String? planTitle,
    int? amount,
  }) async {
    final resolvedAmount = amount ?? _getPriceForPlan(plan);
    final resolvedTitle = planTitle ?? _getTitleForPlan(plan);

    return await _paymentService.createCheckoutSession(
      uid: uid,
      agentId: agentId,
      plan: plan,
      planTitle: resolvedTitle,
      amount: resolvedAmount,
      name: name,
      email: email,
      phone: phone,
    );
  }

  // ── Cek status transaksi secara aktif (inquiry gateway via Cloud Function) ──
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> verifyPaymentStatus({
    required String invoiceNumber,
    String? trxId,
  }) async {
    final cleanInvoice = invoiceNumber.trim();
    if (cleanInvoice.isEmpty) {
      return {
        'success': false,
        'status': 'INVALID_INVOICE',
        'message': 'Nomor invoice transaksi tidak valid.'
      };
    }

    // Status ditanyakan server ke gateway; klien tidak pernah memutuskan lunas sendiri.
    final res =
        await _paymentService.checkPaymentStatus(invoiceNumber: cleanInvoice);

    // Validasi ketat respon server Cloud Function: hanya status final yang dianggap lunas
    final rawStatus = (res['status'] ?? '').toString().toUpperCase().trim();
    final isSuccess =
        rawStatus == 'SUCCESS' || rawStatus == 'SETTLED' || rawStatus == 'PAID';
    if (isSuccess) {
      return {
        'success': true,
        'status': 'SUCCESS',
        'data': res,
      };
    }

    return {
      'success': false,
      'status': rawStatus.isNotEmpty ? rawStatus : 'PENDING',
      'data': res,
      if (res['message'] != null) 'message': res['message'],
    };
  }

  // ── Legacy polling helper ────────────────────────────────────

  // ── Stream status user secara real-time ───────────────────────

  int _getPriceForPlan(String plan) {
    switch (plan) {
      case AppConstants.planTholib1m:
        return AppConstants.priceTholib1m;
      case AppConstants.planTholib6m:
        return AppConstants.priceTholib6m;
      case AppConstants.planBahits1y:
        return AppConstants.priceBahits1y;
      default:
        return AppConstants.priceTholib1m;
    }
  }

  String _getTitleForPlan(String plan) {
    switch (plan) {
      case AppConstants.planTholib1m:
        return 'Modul AI (1 Bulan)';
      case AppConstants.planTholib6m:
        return 'Modul AI (6 Bulan)';
      case AppConstants.planBahits1y:
        return 'Modul AI (1 Tahun)';
      default:
        return 'Langganan Modul AI OpenTurath';
    }
  }
}
```
