```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/// TelemetryService: Sistem Pemantauan Crash & Error Senyap (Silent Telemetry)
/// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class TelemetryService {
  TelemetryService._({FirebaseFirestore? firestore, FirebaseAuth? auth})
      : _firestore = firestore,
        _auth = auth;

  static final TelemetryService instance = TelemetryService._();

  final FirebaseFirestore? _firestore;
  final FirebaseAuth? _auth;

  FirebaseFirestore get _db => _firestore ?? FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  FirebaseAuth get _firebaseAuth => _auth ?? FirebaseAuth.instance;

  /// Ring buffer untuk breadcrumbs (maksimal 20 peristiwa terakhir)
  static const int maxBreadcrumbs = 20;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _breadcrumbs = [];

  /// Deduplikasi error (mencegah log flooding untuk error yang berulang dalam 120 detik)
  static const Duration _dedupWindow = Duration(seconds: 120);
  final Map<String, DateTime> _reportedSignatures = {};

  bool _initialized = false;

  /// Inisialisasi global unhandled error handlers
  void init() {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;

    // 1. Flutter Framework Errors (Widget building, layout, etc.)
    final originalOnError = FlutterError.onError;
    FlutterError.onError = (FlutterErrorDetails details) {
      reportError(
        details.exception,
        details.stack,
        context: 'flutter_framework_error',
        severity: 'error',
        extra: {
          'library': details.library,
          'summary': details.summary.toString(),
        },
      );
      if (originalOnError != null) {
        originalOnError(details);
      } else {
        FlutterError.presentError(details);
      }
    };

    // 2. Platform Dispatcher Errors (Async errors, isolates, microtasks)
    PlatformDispatcher.instance.onError = (Object error, StackTrace stack) {
      reportError(
        error,
        stack,
        context: 'unhandled_async_error',
        severity: 'critical',
      );
      return false; // biarkan default handling berjalan
    };

    leaveBreadcrumb('Aplikasi dimulai (Telemetry aktif)',
        category: 'lifecycle');
  }

  /// Rekam jejak interaksi pengguna / sistem ke in-memory ring buffer
  void leaveBreadcrumb(String message, {String category = 'action'}) {
    try {
      final sanitized = sanitizeData(message);
      _breadcrumbs.add({
        'message': sanitized,
        'category': category,
        'timestamp': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      });
      if (_breadcrumbs.length > maxBreadcrumbs) {
        _breadcrumbs.removeAt(0);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Masking data sensitif (password, authorization token, voucher, email)
  String sanitizeData(String input) {
    if (input.isEmpty) return input;
    var sanitized = input;

    // 1. Mask Bearer / Token
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'bearer\s+[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+', caseSensitive: false),
      'Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]',
    );

    // 2. Mask password / apikey / secret / auth
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAllMapped(
      RegExp(
          r'''(password|secret|apiKey|api_key|token|access_token|refreshToken)["':\s=]+[^,\s\n}]+''',
          caseSensitive: false),
      (match) => '${match.group(1)}: "[REDACTED]"',
    );

    // 3. Mask Google SID/HSID/SSID cookies
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAllMapped(
      RegExp(r'(SID|HSID|SSID|APISID|SAPISID)=[^;\s]+', caseSensitive: false),
      (match) => '${match.group(1)}=[REDACTED_COOKIE]',
    );

    // 4. Mask voucher codes bila ada
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAllMapped(
      RegExp(r'''(voucher|code)["':\s=]+[a-zA-Z0-9\-_]{5,20}''',
          caseSensitive: false),
      (match) => '${match.group(1)}: "[REDACTED_CODE]"',
    );

    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAll(
      RegExp(
          r'''[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}'''),
      '[REDACTED_EMAIL]',
    );
    return sanitized;
  }

  /// Mask email pengguna untuk kepatuhan privasi (cth: a***@domain.com)
  String maskEmail(String email) {
    if (email.isEmpty || !email.contains('@')) return '';
    final parts = email.split('@');
    final name = parts[0];
    final domain = parts[1];
    if (name.length <= 2) {
      return '*@$domain';
    }
    return '${name[0]}***${name[name.length - 1]}@$domain';
  }

  /// Buat signature unik untuk deduplikasi error
  String _computeErrorSignature(
      String errorStr, String? context, String? stackTraceStr) {
    final firstThreeLines = (stackTraceStr ?? '')
        .split('\n')
        .where((l) => l.trim().isNotEmpty)
        .take(3)
        .join('|');
    final raw = '${errorStr.trim()}::$context::$firstThreeLines';
    return md5.convert(utf8.encode(raw)).toString();
  }

  /// Kirim error ke Firestore secara senyap (unawaited)
  Future<void> reportError(
    dynamic error,
    dynamic stackTrace, {
    String? context,
    String severity = 'error',
    Map<String, dynamic>? extra,
  }) async {
    try {
      final errorStr = sanitizeData(error?.toString() ?? 'Unknown Error');
      final stackStr = sanitizeData(stackTrace?.toString() ?? '');

      // Cek deduplikasi
      final signature = _computeErrorSignature(errorStr, context, stackStr);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final lastReported = _reportedSignatures[signature];
      if (lastReported != null && now.difference(lastReported) < _dedupWindow) {
        return; // Lewati karena baru saja dilaporkan dalam kurun dedupWindow
      }
      _reportedSignatures[signature] = now;

      // Bersihkan signature lama yang sudah lewat window
      _reportedSignatures
          .removeWhere((_, time) => now.difference(time) > _dedupWindow);

      final user = _firebaseAuth.currentUser;
      // Remote reporting requires an authenticated owner; pre-login errors stay local.
      if (user == null) return;
      final maskedUserEmail = user.email != null ? maskEmail(user.email!) : '';

      final sanitizedExtra = <String, dynamic>{};
      if (extra != null) {
        for (final entry in extra.entries) {
          sanitizedExtra[entry.key] =
              sanitizeData(entry.value?.toString() ?? '');
        }
      }

      final payload = {
        'error':
            errorStr.length > 2000 ? errorStr.substring(0, 2000) : errorStr,
        'context': sanitizeData(context ?? 'general').substring(
            0, sanitizeData(context ?? 'general').length.clamp(0, 300)),
        'severity': severity,
        'stackTrace':
            stackStr.length > 5000 ? stackStr.substring(0, 5000) : stackStr,
        'breadcrumbs': List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(_breadcrumbs),
        'extra': sanitizedExtra,
        'userId': user.uid,
        'userEmail': maskedUserEmail,
        'platform': kIsWeb ? 'web' : Platform.operatingSystem,
        'deviceTimestamp': now.toIso8601String(),
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };

      // Tulis secara senyap ke Firestore koleksi client_error_logs
      unawaited(
        _db.collection('client_error_logs').add(payload).catchError((_) {
          return null as dynamic;
        }),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      // Menjamin TelemetryService tidak pernah melempar exception ke aplikasi
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import '../core/app_platform.dart';
import '../core/platform_release.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:open_filex/open_filex.dart';
import 'package:package_info_plus/package_info_plus.dart';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

enum UpdateStatus {
  idle,
  checking,
  downloading,
  readyToInstall,
  error,
}

class UpdateInfo {
  final String latestVersion;
  final int latestVersionCode;
  final String apkUrl;
  final String releaseNotes;
  final String? sha256Hash;
  final bool isDownloaded;
  final String? localFilePath;
  final double downloadProgress; // 0.0 to 1.0

  const UpdateInfo({
    required this.latestVersion,
    required this.latestVersionCode,
    required this.apkUrl,
    required this.releaseNotes,
    this.sha256Hash,
    this.isDownloaded = false,
    this.localFilePath,
    this.downloadProgress = 0.0,
  });

  UpdateInfo copyWith({
    String? latestVersion,
    int? latestVersionCode,
    String? apkUrl,
    String? releaseNotes,
    String? sha256Hash,
    bool? isDownloaded,
    String? localFilePath,
    double? downloadProgress,
  }) {
    return UpdateInfo(
      latestVersion: latestVersion ?? this.latestVersion,
      latestVersionCode: latestVersionCode ?? this.latestVersionCode,
      apkUrl: apkUrl ?? this.apkUrl,
      releaseNotes: releaseNotes ?? this.releaseNotes,
      sha256Hash: sha256Hash ?? this.sha256Hash,
      isDownloaded: isDownloaded ?? this.isDownloaded,
      localFilePath: localFilePath ?? this.localFilePath,
      downloadProgress: downloadProgress ?? this.downloadProgress,
    );
  }
}

/// UpdateService: Background Auto-Downloader & Instant One-Click Installer
/// - Mengunduh file APK di latar belakang secara diam-diam (silent download) di Android
/// - Di macOS/Windows: Membuka laman unduh rilis desktop via browser eksternal
/// - Dilengkapi mutex unduhan, sanitasi sink I/O, dan verifikasi integritas SHA-256
class UpdateService extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final UpdateService _instance = UpdateService._internal();
  factory UpdateService() => _instance;
  UpdateService._internal();

  UpdateStatus _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
  UpdateStatus get status => _status;

  UpdateInfo? _updateInfo;
  UpdateInfo? get updateInfo => _updateInfo;

  bool get isUpdateReady {
    if (_status != UpdateStatus.readyToInstall || _updateInfo == null) {
      return false;
    }
    if (AppPlatform.isDesktop) {
      // Desktop: siap membuka URL unduhan desktop
      return true;
    }
    return _updateInfo!.isDownloaded && _updateInfo!.localFilePath != null;
  }

  bool _isChecking = false;
  bool _isDownloading = false;

  /// Hitung SHA-256 secara streaming tanpa memuat seluruh file 60MB ke memori RAM (F20)
  static Future<String> _computeFileSha256(File file) async {
    final digest = await sha256.bind(file.openRead()).first;
    return digest.toString();
  }

  /// Memulai pengecekan versi dan unduhan otomatis di background
  Future<void> checkForUpdatesSilently() async {
    if (kIsWeb ||
        (!AppPlatform.isDesktop && !AppPlatform.isAndroid) ||
        _isChecking ||
        _isDownloading) {
      return;
    }
    _isChecking = true;

    try {
      _status = UpdateStatus.checking;
      notifyListeners();

      final packageInfo = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();
      final currentCode = int.tryParse(packageInfo.buildNumber) ?? 0;

      // Ambil konfigurasi versi dari Firestore (collection: app_config, doc: version)
      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('app_config')
          .doc('version')
          .get();

      if (!doc.exists) {
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        _isChecking = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      final data = doc.data()!;
      final release = PlatformRelease.parse(data, defaultTargetPlatform);
      if (release == null) {
        _updateInfo = null;
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }
      final latestCode = release.build;
      final latestVersion = release.version;
      final apkUrl = release.url.toString();
      final releaseNotes = release.notes;
      final sha256Hash = release.sha256;

      // Jika versi di server lebih baru dari versi yang sedang terpasang
      if (latestCode > currentCode && apkUrl.isNotEmpty) {
        _updateInfo = UpdateInfo(
          latestVersion: latestVersion,
          latestVersionCode: latestCode,
          apkUrl: apkUrl,
          releaseNotes: releaseNotes,
          sha256Hash: sha256Hash,
        );

        if (AppPlatform.isDesktop) {
          // macOS / Windows Desktop: tampilkan banner siap update (buka URL)
          _updateInfo = _updateInfo!.copyWith(
            isDownloaded: false,
            downloadProgress: 0.0,
          );
          _status = UpdateStatus.readyToInstall;
          notifyListeners();
          return;
        }

        // Android installs a downloaded file, so the manifest must name the
        // exact binary. A release without a valid SHA-256 is never fetched.
        if (sha256Hash == null || sha256Hash.isEmpty) {
          debugPrint('[UpdateService] Release manifest has no SHA-256; skipped.');
          _updateInfo = null;
          _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
          notifyListeners();
          return;
        }

        // Android: Periksa apakah APK versi tersebut SUDAH pernah terunduh di cache (F44)
        final localFile = await _getLocalApkFile(latestCode);
        bool isCachedValid = false;
        if (await localFile.exists() &&
            (await localFile.length()) > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
          try {
            final cachedSha = await _computeFileSha256(localFile);
            if (cachedSha.toLowerCase() == sha256Hash.toLowerCase()) {
              isCachedValid = true;
            } else {
              debugPrint('[UpdateService] Cached APK hash mismatch; discarded.');
              await localFile.delete();
            }
          } catch (e) {
            debugPrint('[UpdateService] Error checking cached hash: $e');
            try {
              await localFile.delete();
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }

        if (isCachedValid) {
          _updateInfo = _updateInfo!.copyWith(
            isDownloaded: true,
            localFilePath: localFile.path,
            downloadProgress: 1.0,
          );
          _status = UpdateStatus.readyToInstall;
          notifyListeners();
        } else {
          // Belum terunduh atau cache tidak valid: Jalankan silent background download otomatis
          _startSilentDownload(apkUrl, localFile, sha256Hash);
        }
      } else {
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[UpdateService] Error checking updates: $e');
      _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
      notifyListeners();
    } finally {
      _isChecking = false;
    }
  }

  /// Unduh APK di latar belakang tanpa mengganggu user dengan mutex dan try-finally sink
  Future<void> _startSilentDownload(
      String url, File targetFile, String expectedSha256) async {
    if (_isDownloading) return;
    _isDownloading = true;
    // Whole-download ceiling in addition to the per-chunk idle timeout.
    final deadline = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(minutes: 20));
    final tempFile = File('${targetFile.path}.tmp');

    final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 30);
    try {
      _status = UpdateStatus.downloading;
      notifyListeners();

      // Bersihkan file update lama sebelum mulai unduh baru
      await _cleanOldUpdates(targetFile.path);

      final request = await client.getUrl(Uri.parse(url));
      final response = await request.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));

      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      final contentLength = response.contentLength;
      // Bound disk consumption even when the server omits Content-Length.
      const maxDownloadBytes = 256 * 1024 * 1024;
      if (contentLength > maxDownloadBytes) {
        throw const HttpException('Update exceeds download size limit');
      }
      if (await tempFile.exists()) {
        await tempFile.delete();
      }

      final sink = tempFile.openWrite();
      int receivedBytes = 0;

      try {
        await for (final chunk in response.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30))) {
          receivedBytes += chunk.length;
          if (receivedBytes > maxDownloadBytes) {
            throw const HttpException('Update exceeds download size limit');
          }
          if (DateTime.now().isAfter(deadline)) {
            throw const HttpException('Update download exceeded time limit');
          }
          sink.add(chunk);
          if (contentLength > 0) {
            final progress = receivedBytes / contentLength;
            _updateInfo = _updateInfo?.copyWith(downloadProgress: progress);
          }
        }
        await sink.flush();
      } finally {
        await sink.close();
      }

      // Validasi integritas ukuran file
      final tempLength = await tempFile.length();
      if (tempLength < 5 * 1024 * 1024 ||
          (contentLength > 0 && tempLength < contentLength)) {
        debugPrint('[UpdateService] Unduhan tidak lengkap ($tempLength bytes)');
        if (await tempFile.exists()) await tempFile.delete();
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      // SHA-256 wajib cocok dengan manifest app_config/version (F20)
      final calculatedSha256 = await _computeFileSha256(tempFile);
      if (calculatedSha256.toLowerCase() != expectedSha256.toLowerCase()) {
        debugPrint('[UpdateService] SHA256 checksum mismatch; download discarded.');
        if (await tempFile.exists()) await tempFile.delete();
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      // Rename dari temp ke final APK
      if (await targetFile.exists()) {
        await targetFile.delete();
      }
      await tempFile.rename(targetFile.path);

      _updateInfo = _updateInfo?.copyWith(
        isDownloaded: true,
        localFilePath: targetFile.path,
        downloadProgress: 1.0,
      );
      _status = UpdateStatus.readyToInstall;
      notifyListeners();
      debugPrint(
          '[UpdateService] Background download complete: ${targetFile.path}');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[UpdateService] Background download error: $e');
      // A partial file is never reused; remove it so it cannot fill storage.
      try {
        if (await tempFile.exists()) await tempFile.delete();
      } catch (_) {}
      _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
      notifyListeners();
    } finally {
      _isDownloading = false;
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  /// Bersihkan file APK atau file sementara lama di direktori update
  Future<void> _cleanOldUpdates(String currentPath) async {
    try {
      final dir = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
      final updateDir = Directory(p.join(dir.path, 'updates'));
      if (await updateDir.exists()) {
        final list = updateDir.listSync();
        for (final entity in list) {
          if (entity.path != currentPath &&
              (entity.path.endsWith('.apk') || entity.path.endsWith('.tmp'))) {
            try {
              entity.deleteSync();
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Lokasi file APK di penyimpanan privat aplikasi
  Future<File> _getLocalApkFile(int versionCode) async {
    final dir = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
    final updateDir = Directory(p.join(dir.path, 'updates'));
    if (!await updateDir.exists()) {
      await updateDir.create(recursive: true);
    }
    return File(p.join(updateDir.path, 'OpenTurath_v$versionCode.apk'));
  }

  /// Tombol "Pasang Sekarang" dipanggil:
  /// - Android: Langsung buka Package Installer sistem
  /// - Desktop (macOS/Windows): Buka tautan pembaruan langsung di browser
  Future<bool> installNow() async {
    if (!isUpdateReady || _updateInfo == null) return false;
    if (AppPlatform.isDesktop) {
      try {
        return await launchUrl(Uri.parse(_updateInfo!.apkUrl),
            mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      } catch (_) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    if (!AppPlatform.isAndroid) return false;
    final filePath = _updateInfo!.localFilePath;
    if (filePath == null) return false;
    final file = File(filePath);
    if (!await file.exists()) {
      _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
      notifyListeners();
      return false;
    }
    try {
      // The file sat on disk since the download; verify again before handing
      // it to the system installer.
      final expected = _updateInfo!.sha256Hash;
      if (expected == null ||
          (await _computeFileSha256(file)).toLowerCase() !=
              expected.toLowerCase()) {
        await file.delete();
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        return false;
      }
      final result = await OpenFilex.open(filePath,
          type: 'application/vnd.android.package-archive');
      return result.type == ResultType.done;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/app_platform.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_radius.dart';
/// Keeps mobile sheets while giving desktop forms a bounded, centered surface.
Future<T?> showAdaptiveSheet<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  bool isScrollControlled = false,
  Color? backgroundColor,
  ShapeBorder? shape,
  bool useRootNavigator = false,
  bool enableDrag = true,
  bool isDismissible = true,
  bool? showDragHandle,
}) {
  if (!AppPlatform.isDesktop) {
    return showModalBottomSheet<T>(
      context: context,
      builder: builder,
      isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
      backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      shape: shape,
      useRootNavigator: useRootNavigator,
      enableDrag: enableDrag,
      isDismissible: isDismissible,
      showDragHandle: showDragHandle,
    );
  }
  return showDialog<T>(
    context: context,
    useRootNavigator: useRootNavigator,
    barrierDismissible: isDismissible,
    builder: (dialogContext) => Dialog(
      backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      // Dialog sungguhan di desktop: keempat sudut membulat dan isi diklip.
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card)),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) {
        final media = MediaQuery.of(context);
        final height = math.min(760.0, constraints.maxHeight);
        final width = math.min(560.0, constraints.maxWidth);
        final content = MediaQuery(
          data: media.copyWith(size: Size(width, height)),
          child: Builder(builder: builder),
        );
        // Tinggi mengikuti isi sampai batas jendela: lembar pendek tidak
        // menyisakan ruang kosong, lembar panjang tetap bisa digulir.
        return ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: height),
          child: SizedBox(
            width: width,
            child: isScrollControlled
                ? content
                : SingleChildScrollView(child: content),
          ),
        );
      }),
    ),
  );
}

/// Pegangan seret di puncak lembar bawah. Di desktop lembar tampil sebagai
/// dialog yang tidak bisa diseret, jadi pegangan tidak digambar.
class SheetGrabber extends StatelessWidget {
  const SheetGrabber({super.key, this.top = 0, this.bottom = 0});

  final double top;
  final double bottom;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (AppPlatform.isDesktop) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Container(
      width: 36,
      height: 4,
      margin: EdgeInsets.only(top: top, bottom: bottom),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Theme.of(context)
            .colorScheme
            .onSurfaceVariant
            .withValues(alpha: 0.3),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class _AgentMultiTabRoomState extends State<AgentMultiTabRoom> {
  final AgentSessionManager _sessionManager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
  final BookmarkService _bookmarkService = BookmarkService();
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();

  Future<void> _copyActiveConversation(AgentSessionTab session) async {
    final owner = _authService.currentUser?.uid;
    if (owner == null) return;
    final controller = session.webController;
    if (!_nativeChat && controller == null) return;
    try {
      final result = _nativeChat
          ? session.chatMessages
              .map((message) => [message.text, ...message.citations].join('\n'))
              .join('\n\n')
          : await controller!.evaluateJavascript(
              source:
                  'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.conversation() : ""',
            );
      final text = result is String ? result.trim() : '';
      if (_authService.currentUser?.uid != owner) return;
      if (text.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) AppSnackBar.warning(context, AppCopy.noConversationToCopy);
        return;
      }
      final formatted = text;
      // 1. Simpan langsung ke Catatan (Bookmarks)
      final bookmark = copiedAnswerBookmark(formatted, session.agent);
      await _bookmarkService.addBookmark(bookmark, userId: owner);
      if (_authService.currentUser?.uid != owner) return;

      // 2. Salin ke clipboard perangkat
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: formatted));

      if (mounted) {
        OTMotion.success();
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.conversationCopied);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.copyFailed);
    }
  }
```
