import 'dart:io' show Platform;
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/app_platform.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_motion.dart';
import 'ot_arch_motion.dart';

/// "Gema lengkung": lengkung runcing logo diulang sebagai lapisan bersarang,
/// seperti pintu yang makin dalam. Cahaya di dasar bernapas pelan dan
/// merambat dari lapisan terdalam ke luar. Tanpa teks, tanpa ikon.
class ArchEchoCanvas extends StatefulWidget {
  const ArchEchoCanvas({super.key, this.compact = false});

  /// Kanvas pendek (ponsel): lengkung dipotong oleh tepi bawah kanvas.
  final bool compact;

  @override
  State<ArchEchoCanvas> createState() => _ArchEchoCanvasState();
}

class _ArchEchoCanvasState extends State<ArchEchoCanvas>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  // Urutan masuk: lapisan terbangun dari yang terdalam, lalu cahaya naik.
  late final AnimationController _intro = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: OTMotion.loginGlowEndMs));
  late final AnimationController _clock =
      AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: const Duration(hours: 1));
  late final AppLifecycleListener _lifecycle;
  bool _still = false;

  bool get _underTest =>
      !kIsWeb && Platform.environment.containsKey('FLUTTER_TEST');

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _lifecycle = AppLifecycleListener(onStateChange: (_) => _sync());
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _still = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) || _underTest;
    if (_still) {
      _intro.value = 1;
    } else if (_intro.status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
      _intro.forward();
    }
    _sync();
  }

  /// Berjalan hanya saat jendela aktif dan gerak tidak dikurangi.
  void _sync() {
    final state = WidgetsBinding.instance.lifecycleState;
    final isDesktop = AppPlatform.isDesktop;
    final active = isDesktop ||
        state == null ||
        state == AppLifecycleState.resumed ||
        state == AppLifecycleState.inactive;
    if (_still || !active) {
      _clock.stop();
    } else if (!_clock.isAnimating) {
      _clock.repeat();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _lifecycle.dispose();
    _intro.dispose();
    _clock.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: Listenable.merge([_clock, _intro]),
        builder: (context, _) => CustomPaint(
          size: Size.infinite,
          painter: _ArchEchoPainter(
            // Saat diam, pakai satu bingkai yang representatif.
            seconds: _still ? 2.6 : _clock.value * 3600,
            introMs: _intro.value * OTMotion.loginGlowEndMs,
            compact: widget.compact,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ArchEchoPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _ArchEchoPainter(
      {required this.seconds, required this.introMs, required this.compact});

  final double seconds;
  final double introMs;
  final bool compact;

  static const _layers = 7;
  static const _breath = 13.0; // detik per napas cahaya
  static const _lag = 0.085; // jeda rambat antarlapisan (bagian satu napas)

  /// Gelombang halus 0..1 dengan puncak yang lebih lama daripada sinus.
  static double _wave(double phase) {
    final s = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(phase * 2 * math.pi);
    return s * s * (3 - 2 * s);
  }

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final top = size.height * (compact ? 0.12 : 0.085);
    final bottom = size.height * (compact ? 1.25 : 0.84);
    // Titik hilang: lapisan mengecil ke arah sini, seperti lorong.
    final vanish = size.height * (compact ? 0.62 : 0.40);
    final width =
        math.min(size.width * (compact ? 0.56 : 0.78), (bottom - top) * 0.74);
    final centerX = size.width / 2;
    final t = seconds / _breath;

    // Cahaya di ujung lorong, di belakang semua lapisan.
    final glow = _wave(t);
    final glowIn = OTMotion.curve
        .transform((introMs / OTMotion.loginGlowEndMs).clamp(0.0, 1.0));
    final glowCenter = Offset(centerX, vanish + (bottom - vanish) * 0.10);
    final glowRadius = width * 0.46;
    canvas.drawCircle(
      glowCenter,
      glowRadius,
      Paint()
        ..shader = ui.Gradient.radial(
          glowCenter,
          glowRadius,
          [
            Color.fromRGBO(255, 255, 255, (0.06 + 0.06 * glow) * glowIn),
            OTColors.surfaceLight.withValues(alpha: 0.00),
          ],
        ),
    );

    // Dari luar ke dalam; lapisan terdalam menyala lebih dulu.
    for (var i = 0; i < _layers; i++) {
      final depth = i / (_layers - 1); // 0 luar .. 1 dalam
      final pulse = _wave(t - (_layers - 1 - i) * _lag);
      final enter = OTMotion.curve.transform(
          ((introMs - (_layers - 1 - i) * OTMotion.loginLayerStaggerMs) /
                  OTMotion.loginLayerDurationMs)
              .clamp(0.0, 1.0));
      if (enter == 0) continue;
      final scale = (1 - depth * 0.74) *
          (1 + 0.012 * (pulse - 0.5)) *
          (0.94 + 0.06 * enter);
      final w = width * scale;
      final rect = Rect.fromLTRB(
        centerX - w / 2,
        vanish - (vanish - top) * scale,
        centerX + w / 2,
        vanish + (bottom - vanish) * scale,
      );

      // Tiap lapisan memudar ke bawah agar tidak ada garis lantai.
      Shader fade(double alpha) => ui.Gradient.linear(
            rect.topCenter,
            rect.bottomCenter,
            [
              Color.fromRGBO(255, 255, 255, alpha),
              Color.fromRGBO(255, 255, 255, alpha),
              OTColors.surfaceLight.withValues(alpha: 0.00),
            ],
            const [0.0, 0.5, 1.0],
          );

      canvas.drawPath(
        otArchPath(rect),
        Paint()
          ..style = PaintingStyle.fill
          ..shader = fade((0.018 + 0.016 * pulse) * enter),
      );
      canvas.drawPath(
        otArchPath(rect, open: true),
        Paint()
          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
          ..strokeWidth = 1
          ..shader = fade((0.07 + 0.03 * depth + 0.09 * pulse) * enter),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_ArchEchoPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.seconds != seconds ||
      oldDelegate.introMs != introMs ||
      oldDelegate.compact != compact;
}

/// Satu angka pustaka sebagai pil: angka tegas, satuan redup.
class LibraryStat {
  const LibraryStat(this.value, this.unit);
  final String value;
  final String unit;

  /// Angka pustaka yang benar-benar tercatat; yang kosong tidak ditampilkan.
  static List<LibraryStat> from(AiLibraryMetadata? metadata) {
    if (metadata == null) return const [];
    final number = NumberFormat.decimalPattern(Loc.language);
    final volumes = RegExp(r'^\s*([\d.,]+\+?)\s*jilid', caseSensitive: false)
        .firstMatch(metadata.totalJilid)
        ?.group(1);
    return [
      if (metadata.totalKitab > 0)
        LibraryStat(number.format(metadata.totalKitab), Loc.tr('unitBooks')),
      if (volumes != null) LibraryStat(volumes, Loc.tr('unitVolumes')),
      if (metadata.totalHalaman > 0)
        LibraryStat(number.format(metadata.totalHalaman), Loc.tr('unitPages')),
      if ((metadata.totalMuhadharah ?? 0) > 0)
        LibraryStat(
            number.format(metadata.totalMuhadharah), Loc.tr('unitLectures')),
    ];
  }
}

/// Kartu asisten di grid: nama dan angka pustaka di tengah; satu ketukan

/// One bibliographic identity, shared by the collection and canonical catalogs.
class BookIdentityCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const BookIdentityCard(
      {super.key,
      required this.title,
      required this.author,
      required this.facts,
      required this.onTap,
      this.deathLabel});
  final String title, author;
  final List<String> facts;
  final String? deathLabel;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  bool get hasAuthorDate => RegExp(r'[0-9٠-٩]').hasMatch(author);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, box) {
        final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
        final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(dark),
            muted = OTColors.textSecondary(dark);
        final rtl = answerDirection(title) == TextDirection.rtl;
        final identity = Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text(title,
                  textDirection: answerDirection(title),
                  textAlign: rtl ? TextAlign.right : TextAlign.left,
                  maxLines: box.hasBoundedHeight ? 3 : null,
                  overflow: box.hasBoundedHeight
                      ? TextOverflow.ellipsis
                      : TextOverflow.visible,
                  style: rtl
                      ? ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
                          fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
                          height: 1.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: ink)
                      : OTTypography.screenTitle(color: ink)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(author,
                  textDirection: answerDirection(author),
                  textAlign: answerDirection(author) == TextDirection.rtl
                      ? TextAlign.right
                      : TextAlign.left,
                  maxLines: box.hasBoundedHeight ? 2 : null,
                  overflow: box.hasBoundedHeight
                      ? TextOverflow.ellipsis
                      : TextOverflow.visible,
                  style: answerDirection(author) == TextDirection.rtl
                      ? ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
                          fontSize: OTFontSize.s16, height: 1.5, color: muted)
                      : OTTypography.caption(color: muted)),
            ]);
        final factsView = Wrap(
            alignment: rtl ? WrapAlignment.end : WrapAlignment.start,
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              for (final fact in facts)
                Container(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(dark),
                        borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder),
                    child: Text(fact,
                        textDirection: answerDirection(fact),
                        style: OTTypography.caption(color: muted))),
            ]);
        final dateView = deathLabel != null && !hasAuthorDate
            ? Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                child: Text(deathLabel!,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    style: OTTypography.caption(color: muted)))
            : const SizedBox.shrink();
        final textIdentity = Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [identity, dateView]);
        return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: box.hasBoundedHeight ? 0 : 12),
            child: OTBentoTile(
              onTap: onTap,
              semanticLabel: '$title, $author',
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    textIdentity,
                    if (facts.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Divider(height: 1, color: OTColors.borderSubtle(dark)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      factsView,
                    ],
                  ]),
            ));
      });
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Natural-height reading cards: two across when both reading width and text
/// scaling permit it. A large-text reader always receives one full-width card.
int bookReadingColumns(BuildContext context, double width) =>
    width >= 800 && MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(16) < 24 ? 2 : 1;

Widget bookReadingRow(BuildContext context, int row, int columns, int count,
    IndexedWidgetBuilder builder) {
  final first = row * columns;
  if (columns == 1) return builder(context, first);
  return Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
    Expanded(child: builder(context, first)),
    const SizedBox(width: 16),
    Expanded(
        child: first + 1 < count
            ? builder(context, first + 1)
            : const SizedBox.shrink()),
  ]);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../models/book_model.dart';
import 'book_identity_card.dart';

/// Item baris naskah kanonikal dengan desain minimalis terinspirasi dari lembar informasi Google Camera (Pixel EXIF card).
/// Monokrom murni, tanpa aksen biru, dengan tipografi Arab proporsional dan strip metadata horizontal rapi.
class BookRowItem extends StatelessWidget {
  const BookRowItem({
    super.key,
    required this.book,
    required this.onTap,
    this.searchQuery,
  });

  final CanonicalBookPresentation book;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final String? searchQuery;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    // Format jilid bersih tanpa duplikasi kata
    String? formattedVolumes;
    if (book.volumesDescription != null &&
        book.volumesDescription!.trim().isNotEmpty &&
        book.volumesDescription!.trim() != '-') {
      final v = book.volumesDescription!.trim();
      formattedVolumes = (v.contains('جزء') ||
              v.contains('مجلد') ||
              v.contains('jilid') ||
              v.contains('Jilid'))
          ? v
          : Loc.tr('volumeCount', [v]);
    } else if (book.volumesCount != null && book.volumesCount! > 0) {
      formattedVolumes = Loc.tr('volumeCount', ['${book.volumesCount}']);
    }

    final pages = book.pagesDescription?.trim();
    final pageLabel = pages == null || pages.isEmpty || pages == '-'
        ? null
        : RegExp(r'^[0-9٠-٩.,،\s]+$').hasMatch(pages)
            ? Loc.tr('pageCount', [pages])
            : pages;
    final facts = [
      if (formattedVolumes != null) formattedVolumes,
      if (pageLabel != null) pageLabel
    ];

    final hasDeathYear =
        book.verifiedDeathYearHijri != null && book.verifiedDeathYearHijri! > 0;

    return BookIdentityCard(
      title: book.titleArabic,
      author: book.authorArabic,
      facts: facts.take(2).toList(),
      deathLabel: hasDeathYear
          ? Loc.tr('deathYear', ['${book.verifiedDeathYearHijri}'])
          : null,
      onTap: onTap,
    );
  }
}

import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/agent_session_manager.dart';
import '../services/browser_companion_chat_service.dart';
import '../services/notebook_chat_controller.dart';
import 'notebook_backend_chat_tab.dart';

class BrowserCompanionChatTab extends StatefulWidget {
  const BrowserCompanionChatTab({super.key, required this.session});
  final AgentSessionTab session;
  @override
  State<BrowserCompanionChatTab> createState() => _BrowserCompanionChatTabState();
}

class _BrowserCompanionChatTabState extends State<BrowserCompanionChatTab> {
  late final NotebookChatController _chat;
  String? _error;
  bool _starting = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _chat = NotebookChatController(agentId: widget.session.agent.id,
        currentUid: () => FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid,
        service: BrowserCompanionChatService());
    BrowserCompanionChatService.runtime.addListener(_changed);
    unawaited(_start());
  }

  void _changed() { if (mounted) setState(() {}); }

  Future<void> _start() async {
    if (_starting) return;
    setState(() { _starting = true; _error = null; });
    try {
      await BrowserCompanionChatService.start();
    } catch (_) {
      _error = 'Penghubung memerlukan akun Google, aplikasi desktop, dan Google Chrome yang sudah disiapkan.';
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _starting = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    BrowserCompanionChatService.runtime.removeListener(_changed);
    // The child owns and disposes its supplied chat controller.
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(children: [
    ListTile(dense: true,
      leading: Icon(BrowserCompanionChatService.runtime.connected
          ? Icons.check_circle_outline : Icons.link_outlined, size: 20),
      title: Text(_error ?? (BrowserCompanionChatService.runtime.connected
          ? 'Penghubung Chrome tersambung'
          : 'Menunggu penghubung Google Chrome')),
      subtitle: BrowserCompanionChatService.runtime.connected
          ? Text(Loc.tr('companionSameAccountHint'))
          : null,
      trailing: BrowserCompanionChatService.runtime.connected ? null
          : TextButton(onPressed: _starting ? null : _start,
              child: Text(_starting ? 'Menghubungkan…' : 'Coba lagi'))),
    Expanded(child: NotebookBackendChatTab(
        session: widget.session, controller: _chat)),
  ]);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../core/app_platform.dart';

class DesktopShortcuts extends StatelessWidget {
  const DesktopShortcuts(
      {super.key,
      required this.child,
      this.onFind,
      this.onCloseTab,
      this.onNewTab,
      this.onSettings,
      this.onReload,
      this.onEscape});
  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onFind,
      onCloseTab,
      onNewTab,
      onSettings,
      onReload,
      onEscape;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!AppPlatform.isDesktop) return child;
    final bindings = <ShortcutActivator, VoidCallback>{};
    void bind(LogicalKeyboardKey key, VoidCallback? callback) {
      if (callback == null) return;
      bindings[SingleActivator(key, control: true, includeRepeats: false)] =
          callback;
      bindings[SingleActivator(key, meta: true, includeRepeats: false)] =
          callback;
    }

    bind(LogicalKeyboardKey.keyF, onFind);
    bind(LogicalKeyboardKey.keyW, onCloseTab);
    bind(LogicalKeyboardKey.keyT, onNewTab);
    bind(LogicalKeyboardKey.comma, onSettings);
    bind(LogicalKeyboardKey.keyR, onReload);
    if (onEscape != null) {
      bindings[const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.escape)] = onEscape!;
    }
    return CallbackShortcuts(
        bindings: bindings, child: Focus(autofocus: true, child: child));
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../services/desktop_webview_runtime.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';

class DesktopWebViewGate extends StatefulWidget {
  const DesktopWebViewGate(
      {super.key, required this.builder, this.externalUrl, this.onClose});
  final WidgetBuilder builder;
  final Uri? externalUrl;
  final VoidCallback? onClose;
  @override
  State<DesktopWebViewGate> createState() => _DesktopWebViewGateState();
}

class _DesktopWebViewGateState extends State<DesktopWebViewGate> {
  bool _busy = false;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final problem = DesktopWebViewRuntime.problem;
    if (problem == null) return widget.builder(context);
    return Center(
        child: ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 480),
      child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text(problem, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
              if (widget.externalUrl != null)
                TextButton(
                    onPressed: () async {
                      try {
                        if (!await launchUrl(widget.externalUrl!,
                            mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication)) {
                          throw StateError('Browser unavailable');
                        }
                      } catch (_) {
                        if (context.mounted) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                              SnackBar(
                                  content:
                                      Text(Loc.tr('browserOpenFailed'))));
                        }
                      }
                    },
                    child: Text(Loc.tr('continueInBrowser'))),
              if (widget.onClose != null)
                TextButton(
                    onPressed: widget.onClose, child: Text(Loc.tr('close'))),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () async {
                    try {
                      final opened = await launchUrl(
                        Uri.parse(
                            'https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/'),
                        mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                      );
                      if (!opened) throw StateError('Browser unavailable');
                    } catch (_) {
                      if (context.mounted) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(
                              content: Text(Loc.tr('browserOpenFailed'))),
                        );
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  child: Text(Loc.tr('downloadWebView2'))),
              TextButton(
                  onPressed: _busy
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          setState(() => _busy = true);
                          await DesktopWebViewRuntime.prepare();
                          if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
                        },
                  child: Text(_busy
                      ? 'Memeriksa…'
                      : 'Coba kembali setelah pemasangan')),
            ],
          )),
    ));
  }
}

import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_expressive.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/hijri_date_utils.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../core/scholarly_fonts.dart';
import 'tahawwulat_hero.dart';

/// Both dates always use one clock snapshot; refresh at midnight and resume.
class DualCalendar extends StatefulWidget {
  const DualCalendar({super.key, this.date});
  final DateTime? date;
  @override
  State<DualCalendar> createState() => _DualCalendarState();
}

class _DualCalendarState extends State<DualCalendar>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  Timer? timer;
  late DateTime now;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    refresh();
  }

  void refresh() {
    now = widget.date ?? DateTime.now();
    timer?.cancel();
    if (widget.date == null) {
      final next = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day + 1);
      timer = Timer(next.difference(now), () {
        if (mounted) setState(refresh);
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(DualCalendar old) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(old);
    if (old.date != widget.date) refresh();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed && mounted) setState(refresh);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    timer?.cancel();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final color = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface;
    Widget part(
        String label, ({int day, String month, int year, String era}) date) {
      return SizedBox(
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
            Text(label,
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                    color: color.withValues(alpha: .7))),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text('${date.day}',
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.calendarDay,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: color)
                    .copyWith(
                        fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()])),
            Text(date.month,
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                    color: color,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            Text('${date.year} ${date.era}',
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                    color: color.withValues(alpha: .7))),
          ]));
    }

    return Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: OTColors.surface(
                Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTExpressive.panelRadius)),
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          Row(children: [
            const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined, size: 18),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
                child: Text(reviewCopy('Kalender', 'التقويم', 'Calendar'),
                    style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                        color: color.withValues(alpha: .7)))),
            IconButton(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                tooltip: reviewCopy(
                    'Metode kalender', 'طريقة التقويم', 'Calendar method'),
                icon: Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                    size: 18,
                    semanticLabel: reviewCopy(
                        'Metode kalender', 'طريقة التقويم', 'Calendar method')),
                onPressed: () => showDialog<void>(
                    context: context,
                    builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
                          title: Text(reviewCopy('Metode kalender',
                              'طريقة التقويم', 'Calendar method')),
                          content: Text(reviewCopy(
                              'Tanggal Hijriah menggunakan perhitungan tabular, bukan penetapan rukyat. Tanggal mengikuti waktu lokal perangkat.',
                              'يُحسب التاريخ الهجري حسابياً ولا يمثل إثبات الرؤية. يتبع التقويم الوقت المحلي للجهاز.',
                              'Hijri dates use tabular calculation, not a moon-sighting determination. Dates follow local device time.')),
                          actions: [
                            TextButton(
                                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                                child: Text(MaterialLocalizations.of(context)
                                    .closeButtonLabel))
                          ],
                        ))),
          ]),
          LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, box) {
            final h = part(reviewCopy('Hijriah', 'هجري', 'Hijri'),
                HijriDateUtils.hijriParts(now));
            final g = part(reviewCopy('Masehi', 'ميلادي', 'Gregorian'),
                HijriDateUtils.gregorianParts(now));
            if (MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(16) >= 24) {
              return Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [h, const Divider(height: 24), g]);
            }
            return Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
              Expanded(child: h),
              SizedBox(
                  height: 88,
                  child: VerticalDivider(
                      width: 24,
                      color: OTColors.border(
                          Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark))),
              Expanded(child: g)
            ]);
          }),
        ]));
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_motion.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/hijri_date_utils.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../services/agent_session_manager.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_radius.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'tahawwulat_hero.dart';

/// Dialog aktivasi eksklusif berlayar penuh / luas untuk penukaran kode perdana atau voucher santri.
/// Menampilkan piagam digital berestetika tinta monokrom dengan kontras tinggi.
class ExclusiveActivationDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final String serviceTitle;
  final int durationDays;
  final DateTime? expiryDate;
  final String? agentId;

  const ExclusiveActivationDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.serviceTitle,
    required this.durationDays,
    this.expiryDate,
    this.agentId,
  });

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String serviceTitle,
    required int durationDays,
    DateTime? expiryDate,
    String? agentId,
  }) {
    OTMotion.success();
    return showGeneralDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      barrierLabel: 'ExclusiveActivation',
      barrierColor: OTColors.shadow.withValues(alpha: 0.78),
      transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
      pageBuilder: (ctx, anim1, anim2) => ExclusiveActivationDialog(
        serviceTitle: serviceTitle,
        durationDays: durationDays,
        expiryDate: expiryDate,
        agentId: agentId,
      ),
      transitionBuilder: (ctx, anim1, anim2, child) {
        final curve =
            CurvedAnimation(parent: anim1, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic);
        return BackdropFilter(
          filter: ImageFilter.blur(
            sigmaX: 14 * curve.value,
            sigmaY: 14 * curve.value,
          ),
          child: FadeTransition(
            opacity: curve,
            child: ScaleTransition(
              scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.94, end: 1.0).animate(curve),
              child: child,
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _handleStartStudy(BuildContext context) {
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    Navigator.of(context).pop();

    // Jika ada agent spesifik yang diaktifkan, buka langsung tab studinya
    if (agentId != null && agentId!.isNotEmpty) {
      final matched =
          AgentModel.defaultAgents.where((a) => a.id == agentId).firstOrNull;
      if (matched != null) {
        AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(matched);
      }
    } else {
      // Default: buka Fikih Syafi'i atau agen pertama
      final defaultAgent = AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere(
        (a) => a.id == 'fiqh_syafii' || a.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat',
        orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
      );
      AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(defaultAgent);
    }

    // Jika dialog dipanggil dari dalam layar Langganan, tutup layar langganan agar langsung ke ruang telaah
    final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
    if (navigator.canPop()) {
      navigator.pop(true);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(dark),
        muted = OTColors.textSecondary(dark);
    final expiry = expiryDate ??
        (durationDays > 0
            ? DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: durationDays))
            : null);
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: OTColors.surface(dark),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
      title: Row(children: [
        Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded, color: ink),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
            child: Text(
                reviewCopy(
                    'Akses telah aktif', 'تم تفعيل الوصول', 'Access is active'),
                style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: ink))),
      ]),
      content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
                serviceTitle.startsWith('AI ')
                    ? serviceTitle
                    : 'AI $serviceTitle',
                style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: ink)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
                expiry == null
                    ? reviewCopy(
                        'Tanpa batas waktu', 'دون حد زمني', 'No time limit')
                    : '${reviewCopy('Berlaku hingga', 'صالح حتى', 'Valid until')} ${HijriDateUtils.formatMasehiOnly(expiry.toLocal())}',
                style: OTTypography.body(color: muted)),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
                reviewCopy(
                    'Anda dapat membuka AI dan menyimpan hasil telaah ke Catatan.',
                    'يمكنك فتح الذكاء الاصطناعي وحفظ نتائج الدراسة في الملاحظات.',
                    'You can open the AI and save study results to Notes.'),
                style: OTTypography.body(color: muted)),
          ]),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: Text(MaterialLocalizations.of(context).closeButtonLabel)),
        FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => _handleStartStudy(context),
            child: Text(Loc.tr('openAssistant'))),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/app_config.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../core/scholarly_fonts.dart';

class LanguageSwitcher extends StatelessWidget {
  const LanguageSwitcher({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    return PopupMenuButton<String>(
      tooltip: Loc.tr('language'), initialValue: Loc.language,
      icon: const Icon(Icons.translate_rounded, size: 22),
      onSelected: (language) async {
        try {
          await AppConfig.setLocale(language);
        } catch (_) {
          // The chosen language remains active even if local persistence fails.
        }
      },
      itemBuilder: (_) => Loc.languageNames.entries.map((entry) =>
        CheckedPopupMenuItem(value: entry.key, checked: entry.key == Loc.language,
          child: Text(entry.value, style: entry.key == 'ar' ? ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(height: 1.85) : null, textDirection: entry.key == 'ar' ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr)),
      ).toList(),
    );
  }
}

/// LegalDocumentSheet: Modal lembar kebijakan hukum dan identitas OpenTurath.
/// Mengadopsi prinsip desain "The Quiet Scholar" dengan keterbacaan tinggi,
/// tipografi terpadu, dan pembagian pasal yang lapang.
class LegalDocumentSheet extends StatelessWidget {
  final LegalDocumentId documentId;
  const LegalDocumentSheet({super.key, required this.documentId});
  static Future<void> showTermsOfService(BuildContext context) =>
      _show(context, LegalDocumentId.terms);
  static Future<void> showPrivacyPolicy(BuildContext context) =>
      _show(context, LegalDocumentId.privacy);
  static Future<void> showRefundPolicy(BuildContext context) =>
      _show(context, LegalDocumentId.refund);
  static Future<void> showAiGuideline(BuildContext context) =>
      _show(context, LegalDocumentId.guideline);
  static Future<void> showContactSupport(BuildContext context) =>
      _show(context, LegalDocumentId.contact);
  static Future<void> _show(BuildContext context, LegalDocumentId id) =>
      showAdaptiveSheet(
          context: context,
          isScrollControlled: true,
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          builder: (ctx) => LegalDocumentSheet(documentId: id));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final document = LocalizedLegal.resolve(documentId);
    final title = document.title, subtitle = document.subtitle;
    final sections = document.sections;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    return Directionality(
        textDirection: Loc.isArabic ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr,
        child: Container(
          height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.85,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: surface,
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                top: Radius.circular(OTRadius.sheet)),
            border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
          ),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 16, 24, 24),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // Drag Handle
              const Center(child: SheetGrabber(bottom: 16)),

              // Header Row
              Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          title,
                          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            color: textPrimary,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        Text(
                          subtitle,
                          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                            color: textSecondary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                        size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                    splashRadius: 20,
                    tooltip: Loc.tr('close'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Divider(height: 1, color: border),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // Scrollable Sections
              Expanded(
                child: ListView.separated(
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  itemCount: sections.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (context, index) =>
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final sec = sections[index];
                    final icon = AdabIcons.forSection(sec.id);
                    final heading = Text(sec.title,
                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            color: textPrimary));
                    final content = Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          if (icon != null)
                            Row(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                                children: [
                                  ExcludeSemantics(
                                      child: Container(
                                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                              color: OTColors.surface(isDark),
                                              borderRadius:
                                                  OTRadius.cardBorder),
                                          child: Icon(icon,
                                              size: 22, color: textPrimary))),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                                  Expanded(child: heading),
                                ])
                          else
                            heading,
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          Text(LocalizedLegal.displayBody(sec.content),
                              semanticsLabel: sec.content,

                                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,

                    return icon == null
                        ? Padding(

                    backgroundColor: textPrimary,

                ),

  }

import 'adaptive_sheet.dart';
import 'app_loader.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/app_copy.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_radius.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_spacing.dart';
import '../core/navigation_guard.dart';
import '../core/routes.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/book_model.dart';
import '../services/canonical_library_service.dart';
import '../services/open_turath_catalog_repository.dart';
import '../screens/book_library_editorial_screen.dart';
import '../models/open_turath_book.dart';
import 'apple_interactive_wrapper.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';

/// Opens the Canonical Research Library as a dedicated full-screen scholarly catalog route.
/// Eliminates sheet-on-sheet anti-pattern per Apple HIG.
Future<void> showResearchLibrary(
  BuildContext context, {
  AgentModel? agent,
}) async {
  await Navigator.of(context).push(MaterialPageRoute<void>(
      builder: (_) => _CatalogCollectionLoader(agent: agent)));
}

class _CatalogCollectionLoader extends StatefulWidget {
  const _CatalogCollectionLoader({this.agent});
  final AgentModel? agent;
  @override
  State<_CatalogCollectionLoader> createState() =>
      _CatalogCollectionLoaderState();
}

class _CatalogCollectionLoaderState extends State<_CatalogCollectionLoader> {
  late Future<({List<OpenTurathBook> books, AiLibraryMetadata? metadata})>
      _load = _fetch();
  Future<({List<OpenTurathBook> books, AiLibraryMetadata? metadata})>
      _fetch() async {
    final key = widget.agent?.id ?? 'fiqh_syafii';
    final repo = OpenTurathCatalogRepository.instance;
    final metadata = await repo.getMetadataForModule(key);
    final books = await repo.loadBooksForModule(key);
    return (books: books, metadata: metadata);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => FutureBuilder(
      future: _load,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final data = snapshot.data;
        if (data != null) {
          return OpenTurathBookLibraryPage(
              books: data.books,
              metadata: data.metadata,
              collectionName: Loc.text(widget.agent?.title ??
                  data.metadata?.nama ??
                  Loc.tr('libraryShort')));
        }
        return Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(title: Text(Loc.tr('libraryShort'))),
            body: Center(
                child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                      if (snapshot.hasError) ...[
                        Text(Loc.tr('catalogFailure'),
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        FilledButton(
                            onPressed: () => setState(() => _load = _fetch()),
                            child: Text(Loc.tr('retryCatalog'))),
                      ] else ...[
                        const AppLoader(),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        Text(Loc.tr('loadingReferences')),
                      ],
                    ]))));
      });
}

class ResearchLibrarySheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const ResearchLibrarySheet({super.key, this.agent});

  final AgentModel? agent;

  @override
  State<ResearchLibrarySheet> createState() => _ResearchLibrarySheetState();
}

class _ResearchLibrarySheetState extends State<ResearchLibrarySheet> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final CanonicalLibraryService _service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _allBooks;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _filteredBooks;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;
  String? _selectedEra;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
    _searchController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.removeListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    if (_allBooks == null) return;
    setState(() {
      _filteredBooks = _service.filterBooks(
        _allBooks!,
        _searchController.text,
        eraFilter: _selectedEra,
      );
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final List<CanonicalBookPresentation> books;
      if (widget.agent != null) {
        books = await _service.loadCatalogForAgent(widget.agent!);
      } else {
        books = await _service.loadSyafiiCatalog();
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allBooks = books;
        _filteredBooks = books;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.catalogLoadFailed;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _showEditionDetails(CanonicalBookPresentation book) {
    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
      context,
      AppRoutes.bookDetail,
      arguments: book,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);

    final title = widget.agent != null
        ? 'Kitab rujukan ${widget.agent!.title}'
        : 'Kitab rujukan Mazhab Syafi\'i';

    return DraggableScrollableSheet(
      initialChildSize: 0.85,
      minChildSize: 0.5,
      maxChildSize: 0.95,
      builder: (ctx, scrollController) {
        return Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: canvas,
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                top: Radius.circular(OTRadius.sheet)),
            border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
          ),
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // Drag handle
              const Center(child: SheetGrabber()),

              // Header
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: OTSpacing.lg, vertical: OTSpacing.xs),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            title,
                            style: OTTypography.corpusTitle(color: textPrimary)
                                .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s18),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                          if (_allBooks != null)
                            Text(
                              '${_filteredBooks?.length ?? 0} dari ${_allBooks!.length} kitab rujukan',
                              style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: textSecondary),
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              // Search field
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: OTSpacing.lg, vertical: OTSpacing.sm),
                child: TextField(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: Loc.tr('librarySearchHint'),
                    hintStyle: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                        size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                    suffixIcon: _searchController.text.isNotEmpty
                        ? IconButton(
                            icon: Icon(Icons.clear_rounded,
                                size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                            onPressed: () => _searchController.clear(),
                          )
                        : null,
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: surface,
                    contentPadding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: border, width: 0.8),
                    ),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: border, width: 0.8),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xs),

              // Content
              Expanded(
                child: _isLoading
                    ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                    : _errorMessage != null
                        ? Center(
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.xl),
                              child: Column(
                                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                children: [
                                  Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined,
                                      size: 48, color: textSecondary),
                                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),
                                  Text(
                                    _errorMessage!,
                                    style:
                                        OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary),
                                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.base),
                                  OutlinedButton(
                                    onPressed: _loadData,
                                    child: Text(Loc.tr('tryAgain')),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          )
                        : _filteredBooks == null || _filteredBooks!.isEmpty
                            ? Center(
                                child: Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.xl),
                                  child: Column(
                                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                    children: [
                                      Icon(
                                        Icons.search_off_rounded,
                                        size: 40,
                                        color: textSecondary,
                                      ),
                                      const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
                                      Text(
                                        _searchController.text.isNotEmpty
                                            ? 'Tidak ada kitab yang cocok dengan pencarian'
                                            : 'Katalog naskah sedang disiapkan.',
                                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                        style: OTTypography.body(
                                            color: textSecondary),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              )
                            : ListView.separated(
                                controller: scrollController,
                                physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
                                  vertical: OTSpacing.sm,
                                ),
                                itemCount: _filteredBooks!.length,
                                separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                itemBuilder: (ctx, index) {
                                  final item = _filteredBooks![index];
                                  return CanonicalBookTile(
                                    book: item,
                                    onOpenEdition: () =>
                                        _showEditionDetails(item),
                                  );
                                },
                              ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Bibliographical book tile adhering strictly to Audit Specification 6.4.
class CanonicalBookTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const CanonicalBookTile({
    super.key,
    required this.book,
    required this.onOpenEdition,
  });

  final CanonicalBookPresentation book;
  final VoidCallback onOpenEdition;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    final latinAuthor = book.authorLatin;

    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      label: '${book.titleArabic}, ${book.authorArabic}',
      child: AppleInteractiveWrapper(
        onTap: onOpenEdition,
        pressedScale: 0.98,
        hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.light,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
        child: Material(
          color: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
            side: BorderSide(color: border, width: 0.8),
          ),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                // Arabic title
                Text(
                  book.titleArabic,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                  style:
                      OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s20,
                    height: 1.6,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  ),
                ),
                if (book.titleLatin != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    book.titleLatin!,
                    style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: textPrimary),
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 8),

                // Author
                Text(
                  latinAuthor ?? book.authorArabic,
                  textDirection: latinAuthor == null
                      ? TextDirection.rtl
                      : TextDirection.ltr,
                  textAlign:
                      latinAuthor == null ? TextAlign.right : TextAlign.left,
                  style: latinAuthor == null
                      ? OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textSecondary)
                          .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s16)
                      : OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
                ),

                if (book.verifiedDeathYearHijri != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(
                    'w. ${book.verifiedDeathYearHijri} H',
                    style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
                  ),
                ],

                if (book.compactLabels.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 6,
                    runSpacing: 4,
                    children: book.compactLabels.map((lbl) {
                      return Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
                          border: Border.all(
                              color: border.withValues(alpha: 0.5), width: 0.6),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          lbl,
                          style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary)
                              .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s11),
                        ),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
                ],

                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Keterangan kitab',
                      style: OTTypography.button(color: accent)
                          .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s12),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 4),
                    Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
                        size: 10, color: accent),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Opt-in controls for native pages; never used by the AI room.
class NativePress extends StatefulWidget {
  const NativePress({super.key, required this.child, this.onTap, this.label});
  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final String? label;
  @override
  State<NativePress> createState() => _NativePressState();
}

class _NativePressState extends State<NativePress> {
  bool _pressed = false;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final reduce = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    return Semantics(
      label: widget.label,
      button: widget.onTap != null,
      child: AnimatedScale(
        scale: _pressed && !reduce ? .985 : 1,
        duration: reduce ? Duration.zero : const Duration(milliseconds: 140),
        curve: const Cubic(.16, 1, .3, 1),
        child: Material(
          type: MaterialType.transparency,
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: widget.onTap,
            onHighlightChanged: (value) => setState(() => _pressed = value),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
            child: widget.child,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class NativeLoading extends StatefulWidget {

class _NativeLoadingState extends State<NativeLoading> {
  Timer? _timer;
  bool _slow = false;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _timer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 8), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _slow = true);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Semantics(
      liveRegion: true,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [

          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(widget.label ?? NativeCopy.text('loading'),
              style: NativeType.meta(dark), textAlign: TextAlign.center),
          if (_slow) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(NativeCopy.text('slow'),
                style: NativeType.meta(dark), textAlign: TextAlign.center)
          ],
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class NativeEntrance extends StatelessWidget {
  const NativeEntrance({super.key, required this.child});
  final Widget child;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) return child;
    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween(begin: 0, end: 1),
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
      curve: const Cubic(.16, 1, .3, 1),
      builder: (_, value, child) => Opacity(
          opacity: value.clamp(0, 1),
          child: Transform.translate(
              offset: Offset(0, 8 * (1 - value)), child: child)),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

  late AnimationController _breathingController;
  late Animation<double> _breathingAnimation;

  bool _canSend = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _breathingController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1800),
    )..repeat(reverse: true);

    _breathingAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.35, end: 0.90).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _breathingController, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
    );

    _textController.addListener(_onTextChanged);
  }

  void _onTextChanged() {
    final canSend =
        _textController.text.trim().isNotEmpty && !widget.isGenerating;
    if (canSend != _canSend) {
      setState(() => _canSend = canSend);
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(NativeTurathChatView oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    _canSend = _textController.text.trim().isNotEmpty && !widget.isGenerating;
    if (widget.messages.length != oldWidget.messages.length ||
        (widget.messages.isNotEmpty &&
            oldWidget.messages.isNotEmpty &&
            widget.messages.last.text != oldWidget.messages.last.text)) {
      if (!_scrollController.hasClients ||
          _scrollController.position.extentAfter < 96) {
        _scrollToBottom();
      }
    }
  }

  void _scrollToBottom() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
        _scrollController.animateTo(
          _scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
          curve: Curves.easeOut,
        );
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _breathingController.dispose();
    _textController.removeListener(_onTextChanged);
    _textController.dispose();
    _scrollController.dispose();
    _focusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _handleSend() {
    final text = _textController.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || widget.isGenerating) return;
    _textController.clear();
    setState(() => _canSend = false);
    widget.onSend(text);
    _scrollToBottom();
  }

  Future<void> _copyMessage(String text) async {
    if (text.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text.trim()));
    if (mounted) {
      OTMotion.light();
      AppSnackBar.success(context, Loc.tr('textCopied'));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _bookmarkMessage(
    String answer, {
    List<AnswerCitation> citations = const [],
  }) async {
    if (answer.trim().isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final bookmark = copiedAnswerBookmark(answer.trim(), widget.agent,
          citations: citations);
      await _bookmarkService.addBookmark(bookmark);
      if (mounted) {
        OTMotion.light();
        AppSnackBar.success(context, Loc.tr('savedSuccess'));
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.warning(context, Loc.tr('saveFailed'));
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final surfaceSubtle = OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return Container(
      color: canvas,
      child: Center(
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 800),
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // ── 1. Timeline Obrolan ──
              Expanded(
                child: widget.messages.isEmpty
                    ? _buildEmptyState(
                        textPrimary, textSecondary, surfaceSubtle, border)
                    : ListView.builder(
                        controller: _scrollController,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),
                        itemCount: widget.messages.length +
                            (widget.isGenerating ? 1 : 0),
                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          if (index == widget.messages.length) {
                            return _buildBreathingIndicator(textSecondary);
                          }
                          final msg = widget.messages[index];
                          return msg.isUser
                              ? _buildUserBubble(
                                  msg, surfaceSubtle, border, textPrimary)
                              : _buildAssistantMessage(msg, textPrimary,
                                  textSecondary, border, isDark);
                        },
                      ),
              ),

              // ── 2. Floating Pill Input Bar ──
              _buildInputBar(
                canvas,
                surface,
                border,
                textPrimary,
                textSecondary,
                accent,
                isDark,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEmptyState(
    Color textPrimary,
    Color textSecondary,
    Color surfaceSubtle,
    Color border,
  ) {
    return Center(
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Text(
              widget.agent.title,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                color: textPrimary,
                letterSpacing: -0.3,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              Loc.tr('chatPurpose'),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 28),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
              children: [
                _buildPromptChip(
                    'Syarah & Istinbath', surfaceSubtle, border, textPrimary),
                _buildPromptChip('Takhrij & Kedudukan Hadits', surfaceSubtle,
                    border, textPrimary),
                _buildPromptChip('Tinjauan Mazhab Syafi\'i', surfaceSubtle,
                    border, textPrimary),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPromptChip(
    String label,
    Color bg,
    Color border,
    Color textPrimary,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        _textController.text = label;
        _handleSend();
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: bg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
          border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
            fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
            color: textPrimary,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildUserBubble(
    TurathChatMessage msg,
    Color bg,
    Color border,
    Color textPrimary,
  ) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: Align(
        alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(
            maxWidth: (MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width < 800
                    ? MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width
                    : 800) *
                0.82,
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: bg,
              borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(
                topLeft: Radius.circular(OTRadius.card),
                topRight: Radius.circular(OTRadius.card),
                bottomLeft: Radius.circular(OTRadius.card),
                bottomRight: Radius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
              ),
              border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
            ),
            child: Text(
              msg.text,
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                height: 1.5,
                color: textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAssistantMessage(
    TurathChatMessage msg,
    Color textPrimary,
    Color textSecondary,
    Color border,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24),
      child: Align(
        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Konten Teks Jawaban (Aliran Naskah Terbuka)
            ScholarlyAnswer(
                text: msg.text, ink: textPrimary, muted: textSecondary),

            if (msg.citations.isNotEmpty)
              ExpansionTile(
                title: Text(Loc.tr('sourceReferences')),
                tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                children: [
                  for (final citation in msg.citations)
                    Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                        child: Align(
                            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                            child: SelectableText(citation))),
                ],
              ),

            const SizedBox(height: 10),

            // Action Bar Bawah (Salin, Bookmark)
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: [
                TextButton.icon(
                  icon: Icon(Icons.content_copy_rounded,
                      size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                  label: Text(Loc.tr('copyAnswerAction')),
                  onPressed: () =>
                      _copyMessage([msg.text, ...msg.citations].join('\n\n')),
                ),
                TextButton.icon(
                  icon: Icon(Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
                      size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                  label: Text(Loc.tr('saveAnswerMenu')),
                  onPressed: () => _bookmarkMessage(
                      [msg.text, ...msg.citations].join('\n\n'),
                      citations: msg.references),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBreathingIndicator(Color textSecondary) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8, bottom: 20),
      child: FadeTransition(
        opacity: _breathingAnimation,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
          child: Text(
            Loc.tr('preparingAnswer'),
            style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
              color: textSecondary,
              letterSpacing: -0.1,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInputBar(
    Color canvas,
    Color surface,
    Color border,
    Color textPrimary,
    Color textSecondary,
    Color accent,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 16),
      color: canvas,
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
            border: Border.all(
              color: _focusNode.hasFocus ? accent.withAlpha(160) : border,
              width: 1.2,
            ),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: OTColors.shadow.withAlpha(isDark ? 50 : 12),
                blurRadius: 18,
                offset: const Offset(0, 4),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: TextField(
                  controller: _textController,
                  focusNode: _focusNode,
                  maxLines: 4,
                  minLines: 1,
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                    color: textPrimary,
                  ),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: Loc.tr('askQuestionHint'),
                    hintStyle: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                      fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                      color: textSecondary,
                    ),
                    filled: false,
                    border: InputBorder.none,
                    enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                    focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                    disabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                    isDense: true,
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                  ),
                  onSubmitted: (_) => _handleSend(),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              IconButton.filled(
                tooltip: Loc.tr('sendQuestion'),
                onPressed: _canSend ? _handleSend : null,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_upward_rounded, size: 20),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
