import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown/flutter_markdown.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart' show Bidi;
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'native_theme.dart';
import '../core/design/native_design.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../core/design/ot_motion.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import '../services/bookmark_service.dart';

class NoteEditorSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final BookmarkModel? item;
  final ValueChanged<BookmarkModel>? onSaved;
  final bool fullScreen;
  final BookmarkService? bookmarkService;

  const NoteEditorSheet({
    super.key,
    this.item,
    this.onSaved,
    this.fullScreen = false,
    this.bookmarkService,
  });

  static Future<BookmarkModel?> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    BookmarkModel? item,
    BookmarkService? bookmarkService,
  }) {
    return Navigator.of(context).push<BookmarkModel>(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        fullscreenDialog: true,
        builder: (_) => NativeTheme(
            child: Scaffold(
          body: SafeArea(
              child: NoteEditorSheet(
            item: item,
            fullScreen: true,
            bookmarkService: bookmarkService,
          )),
        )),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<NoteEditorSheet> createState() => _NoteEditorSheetState();
}

class _NoteEditorSheetState extends State<NoteEditorSheet> {
  late final TextEditingController _titleController;
  late final TextEditingController _bodyController;
  bool _isPreview = false;
  bool _hasChanges = false;
  bool _isSavingDraft = false;
  bool _draftSaved = false;
  bool _draftRestored = false;
  bool _draftFailed = false;
  bool _restoringDraft = false;
  bool _closing = false;
  bool _allowPop = false;
  bool _noteSaved = false;
  int _draftRevision = 0;
  Future<void> _pendingDraftWrite = Future<void>.value();
  Timer? _autoSaveDebounce;
  late final BookmarkService _bookmarkService;
  late final String? _draftOwnerId;

  String get _draftKey => _draftOwnerId == null
      ? 'openturath_draft_note_${widget.item?.id ?? 'new'}'
      : 'openturath_${_draftOwnerId}_draft_note_${widget.item?.id ?? 'new'}';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _bookmarkService = widget.bookmarkService ?? BookmarkService();
    _draftOwnerId = _bookmarkService.currentUserId;
    _titleController = TextEditingController(text: widget.item?.title ?? '');
    _bodyController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.item?.fullAnswer ?? widget.item?.arabicExcerpt ?? '',
    );
    _textDirection = Bidi.detectRtlDirectionality(_bodyController.text) ||
            (_bodyController.text.isEmpty && Loc.isArabic)
        ? TextDirection.rtl
        : TextDirection.ltr;

    _titleController.addListener(_scheduleAutoSave);
    _bodyController.addListener(_scheduleAutoSave);

    _loadDraft();
  }

  Future<void> _loadDraft() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (!mounted || _hasChanges || _submitting || _closing) return;
      final raw = prefs.getString(_draftKey);
      if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return;
      final map = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (map is! Map<String, dynamic>) return;

      final draftTitle = map['title'] as String? ?? '';
      final draftBody = map['body'] as String? ?? '';
      final savedAt = DateTime.tryParse(map['savedAt'] as String? ?? '');
      if (widget.item != null &&
          savedAt != null &&
          !savedAt.isAfter(widget.item!.effectiveTime)) {
        return;
      }

      final initialTitle = widget.item?.title ?? '';
      final initialBody =
          widget.item?.fullAnswer ?? widget.item?.arabicExcerpt ?? '';

      // Only restore if draft has different/more recent content
      if ((draftTitle != initialTitle || draftBody != initialBody) &&
          (draftTitle.isNotEmpty || draftBody.isNotEmpty || savedAt != null)) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _restoringDraft = true;
            _titleController.text = draftTitle;
            _bodyController.text = draftBody;
            _restoringDraft = false;
            _textDirection = Bidi.detectRtlDirectionality(draftBody) ||
                    (draftBody.isEmpty && Loc.isArabic)
                ? TextDirection.rtl
                : TextDirection.ltr;
            _draftRestored = true;
            _hasChanges = true;
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _scheduleAutoSave() {
    if (_restoringDraft || _submitting || _closing) return;
    setState(() {
      _hasChanges = true;
      _draftSaved = false;
      _draftRestored = false;
      _draftFailed = false;
      _draftRevision++;
    });
    _autoSaveDebounce?.cancel();
    _autoSaveDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 1500), () {
      unawaited(_saveDraft());
    });
  }

  Future<bool> _saveDraft({bool showStatus = true}) async {
    // Capture before awaiting: later edits queue behind this exact snapshot.
    final revision = _draftRevision;
    final snapshot = jsonEncode({
      'title': _titleController.text,
      'body': _bodyController.text,
      'savedAt': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
    });
    if (showStatus && mounted) setState(() => _isSavingDraft = true);
    final write = _pendingDraftWrite.then((_) async {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (!await prefs.setString(_draftKey, snapshot)) {
        throw StateError('Draft could not be written');
      }
    });
    // Keep the queue usable after a failed write; report failure to its caller.
    _pendingDraftWrite = write.catchError((Object _) {});
    try {
      await write;
      if (showStatus && mounted && revision == _draftRevision) {
        setState(() {
          _isSavingDraft = false;
          _draftSaved = true;
          _draftFailed = false;
        });
      }
      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      if (showStatus && mounted && revision == _draftRevision) {
        setState(() {
          _isSavingDraft = false;
          _draftFailed = true;
        });
      }
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _close() async {
    if (_closing || _submitting) return;
    setState(() => _closing = true);
    _autoSaveDebounce?.cancel();
    final saved = !_hasChanges || await _saveDraft();
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (!saved) {
      setState(() => _closing = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(NativeCopy.text('saveFailed'))),
      );
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _allowPop = true);
    Navigator.pop(context);
  }

  TextDirection _textDirection = TextDirection.ltr;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _autoSaveDebounce?.cancel();
    // A parent can remove the route without invoking its normal back handler.
    if (!_noteSaved && !_closing && _hasChanges) {
      unawaited(_saveDraft(showStatus: false));
    }
    _titleController.dispose();
    _bodyController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _applyDirection(TextDirection dir) {
    final selection = _bodyController.selection;
    final text = _bodyController.text;

    if (selection.isValid && !selection.isCollapsed) {
      final selectedText = text.substring(selection.start, selection.end);
      final marker = dir == TextDirection.rtl ? '\u200F' : '\u200E';
      final replaced = text.replaceRange(
        selection.start,
        selection.end,
        '$marker$selectedText',
      );
      _bodyController.text = replaced;
      _bodyController.selection = TextSelection(
        baseOffset: selection.start,
        extentOffset: selection.start + marker.length + selectedText.length,
      );
    }
    setState(() => _textDirection = dir);
    OTMotion.selection();
    _scheduleAutoSave();
  }

  void _applyFormat(String prefix, String suffix,
      {String defaultText = 'teks'}) {
    final text = _bodyController.text;
    final selection = _bodyController.selection;

    if (text.isEmpty) {
      _bodyController.text = '$prefix$defaultText$suffix';
      _bodyController.selection = TextSelection(
        baseOffset: prefix.length,
        extentOffset: prefix.length + defaultText.length,
      );
      OTMotion.selection();
      _scheduleAutoSave();
      return;
    }

    if (selection.start < 0 || selection.end < 0) {
      final newText = '$text$prefix$defaultText$suffix';
      _bodyController.text = newText;
      _bodyController.selection = TextSelection(
        baseOffset: text.length + prefix.length,
        extentOffset: text.length + prefix.length + defaultText.length,
      );
      OTMotion.selection();
      _scheduleAutoSave();
      return;
    }

    final selectedText = text.substring(selection.start, selection.end);
    final insertText = selectedText.isEmpty ? defaultText : selectedText;
    final replaced = text.replaceRange(
      selection.start,
      selection.end,
      '$prefix$insertText$suffix',
    );

    _bodyController.text = replaced;
    _bodyController.selection = TextSelection(
      baseOffset: selection.start + prefix.length,
      extentOffset: selection.start + prefix.length + insertText.length,
    );
    OTMotion.selection();
    _scheduleAutoSave();
  }

  Future<void> _saveNote() async {
    if (_bookmarkService.currentUserId != _draftOwnerId) {
      await _saveDraft();
      throw StateError('The note owner changed while editing');
    }
    final title = _titleController.text.trim();
    final body = _bodyController.text.trim();

    if (title.isEmpty && body.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(Loc.tr('ui_4ccf3c2529'))),
      );
      return;
    }

    final effectiveTitle = title.isNotEmpty
        ? title
        : (body.length > 50 ? '${body.substring(0, 50)}...' : body);

    final item = widget.item;
    final BookmarkModel updated;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    if (item != null) {
      updated = item.copyWith(
        title: effectiveTitle,
        fullAnswer: body,
        updatedAt: now,
      );
    } else {
      updated = BookmarkModel(
        id: 'note_${now.millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
        title: effectiveTitle,
        agentId: 'catatan_mandiri',
        agentTitle: 'Catatan Pribadi',
        fieldName: 'Catatan Pribadi',
        fieldId: 'general',
        arabicExcerpt: '',
        fullAnswer: body,
        bookReference: '',
        pageNumber: '',
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
        documentKind: BookmarkDocumentKind.personalNote,
        verificationStatus: BookmarkVerificationStatus.notApplicable,
      );
    }

    await _bookmarkService.addBookmark(updated, userId: _draftOwnerId);

    _noteSaved = true;
    _autoSaveDebounce?.cancel();
    // Drain all writes before removing the draft so autosave cannot recreate it.
    await _pendingDraftWrite;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.remove(_draftKey);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (!mounted) return;
    widget.onSaved?.call(updated);
    OTMotion.success();
    setState(() => _allowPop = true);
    Navigator.pop(context, updated);
  }

  bool _submitting = false;
  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_submitting || _closing) return;
    _autoSaveDebounce?.cancel();
    setState(() => _submitting = true);
    try {
      await _saveNote();
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(content: Text(NativeCopy.text('saveFailed'))));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _submitting = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final media = MediaQuery.of(context);
    return PopScope<BookmarkModel>(
        canPop: _allowPop,
        onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
          if (!didPop) unawaited(_close());
        },
        child: Container(
          height: widget.fullScreen ? double.infinity : media.size.height * .92,
          color: NativeColors.canvas(dark),
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(
              bottom: widget.fullScreen ? 0 : media.viewInsets.bottom),
          child: Column(children: [
            Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                child: Column(children: [
                  Row(children: [
                    IconButton(
                        tooltip: NativeCopy.text('back'),
                        onPressed: _submitting || _closing ? null : _close,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded)),
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                            Loc.text(widget.item == null
                                ? 'Catatan baru'
                                : 'Edit catatan'),
                            style: NativeType.title(dark, size: 22))),
                    FilledButton(
                        onPressed: _submitting || _closing ? null : _submit,

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/agent_session_manager.dart';
import '../services/notebook_chat_controller.dart';
import 'native_turath_chat_view.dart';

/// Prototype chat surface: no NotebookLM WebView, browser launch or Google login.
class NotebookBackendChatTab extends StatefulWidget {
  const NotebookBackendChatTab(
      {super.key, required this.session, this.controller, this.accountChanges});
  final AgentSessionTab session;
  final NotebookChatController? controller;
  final Stream<String?>? accountChanges;

  @override
  State<NotebookBackendChatTab> createState() => _NotebookBackendChatTabState();
}

class _NotebookBackendChatTabState extends State<NotebookBackendChatTab> {
  late final NotebookChatController _chat;
  StreamSubscription<String?>? _auth;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _chat = widget.controller ??
        NotebookChatController(
            agentId: widget.session.agent.id,
            currentUid: () => FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid);
    _chat.synchronizeOwner();
    _chat.addListener(_changed);
    _auth = (widget.accountChanges ??
            FirebaseAuth.instance.authStateChanges().map((user) => user?.uid))
        .listen((_) => _chat.synchronizeOwner());
  }

  void _changed() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    widget.session.chatMessages
      ..clear()
      ..addAll(_chat.messages);
    widget.session.isGenerating = _chat.isGenerating;
    setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _auth?.cancel();
    _chat.removeListener(_changed);
    _chat.dispose();
    widget.session.chatMessages.clear();
    widget.session.isGenerating = false;
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(children: [
        if (_chat.error != null)
          Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Text(
                _chat.error!,
                key: const ValueKey('native-chat-error'),
                style: TextStyle(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error),
              )),
        Expanded(
            child: NativeTurathChatView(
          agent: widget.session.agent,
          messages: _chat.messages,
          isGenerating: _chat.isGenerating,
          onSend: _chat.send,
        )),
      ]);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../core/design/ot_motion.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import 'openturath_brand.dart';

/// Lengkung runcing logo: dua busur bertemu di puncak. Versi [open] tidak
/// menggambar garis lantai. Bentuk yang sama dipakai `motion/src/spec.ts`.
Path otArchPath(Rect rect, {bool open = false}) {
  final shoulder = rect.top + rect.height * 0.40;
  final path = Path()
    ..moveTo(rect.left, rect.bottom)
    ..lineTo(rect.left, shoulder)
    ..cubicTo(
        rect.left,
        rect.top + rect.height * 0.19,
        rect.center.dx - rect.width * 0.2,
        rect.top + rect.height * 0.075,
        rect.center.dx,
        rect.top)
    ..cubicTo(rect.center.dx + rect.width * 0.2, rect.top + rect.height * 0.075,
        rect.right, rect.top + rect.height * 0.19, rect.right, shoulder)
    ..lineTo(rect.right, rect.bottom);
  if (!open) path.close();
  return path;
}

/// Bagian 0..1 dari rentang [from]..[to] milidetik, dilunakkan [curve].
double _phase(double ms, int from, int to, Curve curve) =>
    curve.transform(((ms - from) / (to - from)).clamp(0.0, 1.0));

Path _segment(Path path, double from, double to) {
  final metric = path.computeMetrics().first;
  return metric.extractPath((from * metric.length).clamp(0.0, metric.length),
      (to * metric.length).clamp(0.0, metric.length));
}

/// Pembuka aplikasi: garis lengkung ditulis, tanda logo muncul di dalamnya,
/// tiga gema merambat ke luar, lalu wordmark naik. Diputar sekali.
class OTSplashIntro extends StatefulWidget {
  const OTSplashIntro({super.key, required this.ink});

  final Color ink;

  @override
  State<OTSplashIntro> createState() => _OTSplashIntroState();
}

class _OTSplashIntroState extends State<OTSplashIntro>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller =
      AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: OTMotion.splashTotal)
        ..forward();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final still = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    const total = OTMotion.splashTotalMs;
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _controller,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final ms = still ? total.toDouble() : _controller.value * total;
        final mark = _phase(ms, OTMotion.splashMarkStartMs,
            OTMotion.splashMarkEndMs, OTMotion.curve);
        final word = _phase(ms, OTMotion.splashWordStartMs,
            OTMotion.splashWordEndMs, OTMotion.curve);
        return Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              width: 92,
              height: 112,
              child: Stack(
                clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                children: [
                  Positioned.fill(
                    child: CustomPaint(
                        painter: _SplashArchPainter(ms: ms, ink: widget.ink)),
                  ),
                  Positioned(
                    left: 22,
                    top: 46,
                    child: Opacity(
                      opacity: mark,
                      child: Transform.scale(
                        scale: 0.9 + 0.1 * mark,
                        child: OpenTurathMark(size: 48, color: widget.ink),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 28),
            Opacity(
              opacity: word,
              child: Transform.translate(
                offset: Offset(0, (1 - word) * OTMotion.splashWordShift),
                child: Text(
                  'OpenTurath',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: OTTypography.brandLogo(color: widget.ink)
                      .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s36, letterSpacing: -0.6),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _SplashArchPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _SplashArchPainter({required this.ms, required this.ink});

  final double ms;
  final Color ink;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final outline = otArchPath(Offset.zero & size, open: true);
    final origin = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height * 0.62);

    for (var i = 0; i < OTMotion.splashEchoCount; i++) {
      final start =
          OTMotion.splashEchoStartMs + i * OTMotion.splashEchoStaggerMs;
      final t = (ms - start) / OTMotion.splashEchoDurationMs;
      if (t <= 0 || t >= 1) continue;
      final scale = 1 + (0.45 + 0.4 * i) * OTMotion.sheetCurve.transform(t);
      final peak = 0.34 - 0.08 * i;
      final alpha = t < 0.13 ? peak * t / 0.13 : peak * (1 - (t - 0.13) / 0.87);
      canvas
        ..save()
        ..translate(origin.dx, origin.dy)
        ..scale(scale)
        ..translate(-origin.dx, -origin.dy)
        ..drawPath(
          outline,
          Paint()
            ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
            ..strokeWidth = 1 / scale
            ..color = ink.withValues(alpha: alpha),
        )
        ..restore();
    }

    final drawn = _phase(ms, OTMotion.splashDrawStartMs,
        OTMotion.splashDrawEndMs, OTMotion.curve);
    if (drawn > 0) {
      canvas.drawPath(
        _segment(outline, 0, drawn),
        Paint()
          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
          ..strokeWidth = 1.5
          ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
          ..color = ink,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_SplashArchPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.ms != ms || oldDelegate.ink != ink;
}

/// Tanda memuat layar penuh: logo diam, satu cahaya menyusuri garis lengkung.
/// [progress] 0..1 untuk satu putaran.
class OTArchLoader extends StatelessWidget {
  const OTArchLoader({super.key, required this.progress, required this.ink});

  final double progress;
  final Color ink;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      width: 72,
      height: 88,
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          Positioned.fill(
            child: CustomPaint(
                painter: _LoaderArchPainter(progress: progress, ink: ink)),
          ),
          Positioned(
              left: 17, top: 36, child: OpenTurathMark(size: 38, color: ink)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LoaderArchPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _LoaderArchPainter({required this.progress, required this.ink});

  final double progress;
  final Color ink;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final outline = otArchPath(Offset.zero & size, open: true);
    final stroke = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 1.5
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
    canvas.drawPath(outline, stroke..color = ink.withValues(alpha: 0.12));
    const sweep = OTMotion.loaderSweep;
    final head = progress * (1 + sweep);
    canvas.drawPath(_segment(outline, head - sweep, head), stroke..color = ink);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_LoaderArchPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.progress != progress || oldDelegate.ink != ink;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_motion.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_spacing.dart';
import 'apple_interactive_wrapper.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_radius.dart';

/// Animasi masuk yang tenang: memudar sambil naik beberapa piksel.
/// [index] memberi jeda berurutan antar-ubin. Tanpa timer, jadi aman di tes,
/// dan otomatis nonaktif bila pengguna meminta gerak dikurangi.
class OTReveal extends StatefulWidget {
  const OTReveal(
      {super.key, this.index = 0, this.delayMs, required this.child});

  final int index;

  /// Jeda eksplisit; bila diisi, menggantikan jeda dari [index].
  final int? delayMs;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<OTReveal> createState() => _OTRevealState();
}

class _OTRevealState extends State<OTReveal>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  static const _base = 360;
  static const _stagger = 45;

  late final AnimationController _controller;
  late final Animation<double> _progress;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final delay = widget.delayMs ?? widget.index.clamp(0, 8) * _stagger;
    final total = _base + delay;
    _controller = AnimationController(
        vsync: this, duration: Duration(milliseconds: total));
    _progress = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Interval(delay / total, 1, curve: OTMotion.curve),
    );
    _controller.forward();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) return widget.child;
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _progress,
      child: widget.child,
      builder: (context, child) => Opacity(
        opacity: _progress.value,
        child: Transform.translate(
          offset: Offset(0, (1 - _progress.value) * 10),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Memudarkan konten setiap kali [active] berubah menjadi true.
/// Dipakai untuk pergantian tab agar halaman tidak meluncur melewati tab lain.
class OTActiveFade extends StatefulWidget {
  const OTActiveFade({super.key, required this.active, required this.child});

  final bool active;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<OTActiveFade> createState() => _OTActiveFadeState();
}

class _OTActiveFadeState extends State<OTActiveFade>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller =
      AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: OTMotion.normal, value: 1);
  late final Animation<double> _progress =
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: OTMotion.curve);

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(OTActiveFade oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.active && !oldWidget.active) _controller.forward(from: 0);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) return widget.child;
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _progress,
      child: widget.child,
      builder: (context, child) => Opacity(
        opacity: _progress.value,
        child: Transform.translate(
          offset: Offset(0, (1 - _progress.value) * 6),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Ubin bento: sudut 16, garis tipis, tanpa bayangan. Garis menegas saat
/// kursor di atasnya. [inverse] dipakai untuk satu ubin fokus per layar.
class OTBentoTile extends StatefulWidget {
  const OTBentoTile({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.inverse = false,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.base),
    this.semanticLabel,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final bool inverse;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
  final String? semanticLabel;

  static const double radius = OTRadius.card;

  @override
  State<OTBentoTile> createState() => _OTBentoTileState();
}

class _OTBentoTileState extends State<OTBentoTile> {
  bool _hovered = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final interactive = widget.onTap != null;
    final background = widget.inverse
        ? OTColors.inverseSurface(isDark)
        : OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = widget.inverse
        ? (isDark ? OTColors.border(isDark) : background)
        : (_hovered && interactive
            ? OTColors.borderStrong(isDark)
            : OTColors.border(isDark));

    final tile = AnimatedContainer(
      duration: OTMotion.fast,
      curve: OTMotion.curve,
      padding: widget.padding,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _hovered && interactive && !widget.inverse
            ? OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark)
            : background,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTBentoTile.radius),
        border:
            Border.all(color: _hovered && interactive ? border : background),
      ),
      child: widget.child,
    );
    if (!interactive) return tile;

    return MouseRegion(
      onEnter: (_) => setState(() => _hovered = true),
      onExit: (_) => setState(() => _hovered = false),
      child: AppleInteractiveWrapper(
        onTap: widget.onTap,
        pressedScale: 0.985,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTBentoTile.radius),
        semanticLabel: widget.semanticLabel,
        child: tile,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Kartu dua sisi yang berbalik saat diketuk. Tanpa animasi bila gerak dikurangi.
class OTFlipCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const OTFlipCard({
    super.key,
    required this.front,
    required this.back,
    this.semanticLabel,
  });

  final Widget front;
  final Widget back;
  final String? semanticLabel;

  @override
  State<OTFlipCard> createState() => _OTFlipCardState();
}

class _OTFlipCardState extends State<OTFlipCard>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 420));
  late final Animation<double> _turn =
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic);

  void _toggle() {
    OTMotion.selection();
    final showBack = _controller.value < 0.5;
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _controller.value = showBack ? 1 : 0;
    } else if (showBack) {
      _controller.forward();
    } else {
      _controller.reverse();
    }
  }

  /// Posisi kursor di atas kartu, -1..1 pada tiap sumbu; nol saat di luar.
  Offset _lean = Offset.zero;
  static const _maxLean = 0.07; // sekitar 4 derajat

  void _follow(PointerEvent event) {
    final box = context.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;
    if (box == null || !box.hasSize) return;
    final local = box.globalToLocal(event.position);
    setState(() => _lean = Offset(
          (local.dx / box.size.width * 2 - 1).clamp(-1.0, 1.0),
          (local.dy / box.size.height * 2 - 1).clamp(-1.0, 1.0),
        ));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final still = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      label: widget.semanticLabel,
      child: MouseRegion(
        cursor: SystemMouseCursors.click,
        onHover: still ? null : _follow,
        onExit: (_) => setState(() => _lean = Offset.zero),
        child: GestureDetector(
          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
          onTap: _toggle,
          child: TweenAnimationBuilder<Offset>(
            tween: Tween<Offset>(end: _lean),
            duration: OTMotion.fast,
            curve: OTMotion.curve,
            builder: (context, lean, _) => AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _turn,
              builder: (context, _) {
                final angle = _turn.value * 3.141592653589793;
                final showBack = _turn.value >= 0.5;
                return Transform(
                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                  transform: Matrix4.identity()
                    ..setEntry(3, 2, 0.0012)
                    // Kartu miring mengikuti kursor, lalu berbalik saat diketuk.
                    ..rotateX(-lean.dy * _maxLean)
                    ..rotateY(lean.dx * _maxLean + angle),
                  child: showBack
                      ? Transform(
                          alignment: Alignment.center,
                          transform: Matrix4.identity()
                            ..rotateY(3.141592653589793),
                          child: widget.back,
                        )
                      : widget.front,
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Jarak judul [AppBar]: rapat ke tombol kembali; tanpa tombol kembali,
/// judul sejajar dengan tepi isi halaman.
double otTitleSpacing(BuildContext context) =>
    (ModalRoute.of(context)?.canPop ?? false) ? 0 : 20;

/// PaymentCheckoutSheet: In-App Modal Pembayaran dengan Deteksi Otomatis

class _PaymentCheckoutSheetState extends State<PaymentCheckoutSheet> {
  final SubscriptionService _subService = SubscriptionService();

  InAppWebViewController? _webController;
  Timer? _pollTimer;
  StreamSubscription<QuerySnapshot>? _txSubscription;
  double _loadProgress = 0.0;
  bool _isChecking = false;
  bool _isSuccess = false;
  int _pollAttempts = 0;
  bool _isShowingConfirmDialog = false;
  bool _hasPopped = false;
  final _completion = CheckoutCompletion();
  BuildContext? _confirmationContext;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // 1. Real-time Firestore Listener: mendeteksi instan saat status berubah jadi 'success' (< 1s)
    final currentUid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    if (widget.invoiceNumber.isNotEmpty && currentUid != null) {
      _txSubscription = FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection(AppConstants.colTransactions)
          .where('uid', isEqualTo: currentUid)
          .where('invoice_number', isEqualTo: widget.invoiceNumber)
          .limit(1)
          .snapshots()
          .listen(
        (snap) {
          if (snap.docs.isNotEmpty) {
            final data = snap.docs.first.data() as Map<String, dynamic>?;
            final status = (data?['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (status == 'paid' || status == 'success') {
              _triggerSuccess();
            }
          }
        },
        onError: (_) {
          // Jika query ditolak atau gagal, biarkan fail-safe polling tetap berjalan
        },
      );
    }

    // 2. Active inquiry polling setiap 2 detik sebagai fail-safe
    _pollTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 5), (_) {
      _checkPaymentStatus();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pollTimer?.cancel();
    _txSubscription?.cancel();
    _webController = null;
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _triggerSuccess() async {
    if (_isSuccess || _hasPopped || !mounted) return;
    _pollTimer?.cancel();
    _txSubscription?.cancel();
    setState(() {
      _isSuccess = true;
    });

    // Beri jeda 2.2 detik agar pengguna menikmati animasi sukses
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2200));
    await _completion.finish(
      dismissConfirmation: () {
        final dialogContext = _confirmationContext;
        if (dialogContext != null &&
            dialogContext.mounted &&
            ModalRoute.of(dialogContext)?.isCurrent == true) {
          Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(false);
        }
      },
      closeCheckout: () {
        if (mounted &&
            !_hasPopped &&
            ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == true) {
          _hasPopped = true;
          Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
        }
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _checkPaymentStatus() async {
    if (_isChecking || _isSuccess || _hasPopped || !mounted) return;
    if (widget.invoiceNumber.isEmpty) return;

    _pollAttempts++;
    // F33: Batas maksimal polling 150 kali (5 menit) agar tidak memboroskan sumber daya
    if (_pollAttempts > 60) {
      _pollTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    _isChecking = true;
    try {
      final res = await _subService.verifyPaymentStatus(
        invoiceNumber: widget.invoiceNumber,
        trxId: widget.trxId,
      );

      if (res['status'] == 'SUCCESS' && res['success'] == true) {
        _triggerSuccess();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Polling background gagal sementara, lanjut ke tick berikutnya
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        _isChecking = false;
      }
    }
  }


  Future<bool> _handleWillPop() async {
    if (_isSuccess || _hasPopped) return false;
    if (_isShowingConfirmDialog) return false;

    _isShowingConfirmDialog = true;
    final confirmationDone = Completer<void>();
    _completion.confirmation = confirmationDone.future;
    try {
      final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
      final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (ctx) {
          _confirmationContext = ctx;
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor:
                isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard)),
            title: Text(
              Loc.tr('ui_56a2f9f730'),
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: isDark
                    ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark
                    : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight,
              ),
            ),
            content: Text(
              Loc.tr('ui_85f60bf7af'),
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                color: isDark
                    ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark
                    : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight,
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                child: Text(
                  Loc.tr('ui_5bcbc797a7'),
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    color: isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                child: Text(
                  Loc.tr('close'),
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    color: OTColors.destructive(isDark),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      );

      return !_isSuccess && (confirm ?? false);
    } finally {
      _confirmationContext = null;
      _isShowingConfirmDialog = false;
      confirmationDone.complete();
      _completion.confirmation = null;
    }
  }

  /// OT-F005: Destination allowlist ketat untuk WebView transaksi pembayaran
  bool _isAllowedPaymentDestination(Uri uri) {
    if (uri.scheme != 'https') return false;

    final host = uri.host.toLowerCase();

    // Domain aplikasi OpenTurath
    if (host == 'openturath.id' ||
        host.endsWith('.openturath.id') ||
        host == 'openturath-ai.web.app' ||
        host == 'open-turath.web.app' ||
        host == 'open-turath.firebaseapp.com' ||
        host == 'openturath.ai' ||
        host.endsWith('.openturath.ai')) {
      return true;
    }

    // Domain resmi payment gateway DOKU & sandbox
    if (host == 'doku.com' ||
        host.endsWith('.doku.com') ||
        host == 'doku.id' ||
        host.endsWith('.doku.id')) {
      return true;
    }

    // Platform checkout resmi GoAkal & Midtrans
    if (host == 'goakal.com' ||
        host.endsWith('.goakal.com') ||
        host == 'midtrans.com' ||
        host.endsWith('.midtrans.com') ||
        host == 'veritrans.co.id' ||
        host.endsWith('.veritrans.co.id')) {
      return true;
    }

    // Partner perbankan & e-wallet resmi untuk pembayaran QRIS / VA / Direct Debit
    if (host.endsWith('.bca.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.mandiri.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.bri.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.bni.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.cimbniaga.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.permata.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.gopay.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.shopeepay.co.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.ovo.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.dana.id') ||
        host.endsWith('.linkaja.id')) {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  static const Set<String> _allowedExternalPaymentSchemes = {
    'gojek',
    'gopay',
    'shopeepay',
    'shopee',
    'ovo',
    'dana',
    'linkaja',
    'bca',
    'bankmandiri',
    'brimo',
    'bnicall',
    'cimbclicks',
  };

  /// Validasi ketat skema eksternal untuk deep-linking e-wallet / perbankan
  bool _isAllowedExternalScheme(Uri uri) {
    final scheme = uri.scheme.toLowerCase();
    if (_allowedExternalPaymentSchemes.contains(scheme)) {
      return true;
    }
    // Tolak mentah-mentah skema berbahaya
    if (scheme == 'javascript' ||
        scheme == 'file' ||
        scheme == 'content' ||
        scheme == 'data' ||
        scheme == 'about') {
      return false;
    }
    // Izinkan skema intent hanya jika spesifik untuk pembayaran perbankan/e-wallet
    if (scheme == 'intent') {
      final str = uri.toString().toLowerCase();
      return str.contains('scheme=gojek') ||
          str.contains('scheme=shopeepay') ||
          str.contains('scheme=ovo') ||
          str.contains('scheme=dana') ||
          str.contains('scheme=linkaja') ||
          str.contains('scheme=bca') ||
          str.contains('scheme=mandiri') ||
          str.contains('scheme=bri') ||
          str.contains('scheme=bni');
    }
    return false;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DesktopWebViewGate(
        builder: _buildContent,
        externalUrl: _isAllowedPaymentDestination(Uri.parse(widget.paymentUrl))
            ? Uri.parse(widget.paymentUrl)
            : null,
        onClose: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(false),
      );

                                    Text(
                                      Loc.tr('ui_9218f901c4'),
                                      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                                        letterSpacing: 0.3,
                                        color: textSecondary,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),

                            // Tombol Cek Manual / Refresh
                            IconButton(
                              onPressed: _isChecking
                                  ? null
                                  : () {
                                      _webController?.reload();
                                      _checkPaymentStatus();
                                    },
                              icon: _isChecking
                                  ? const SizedBox(
                                      width: 16,
                                      height: 16,
                                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                          strokeWidth: 2),
                                    )
                                  : Icon(Icons.sync_rounded,
                                      size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                              tooltip: Loc.tr('ui_1c93ce4af4'),
                            ),
                            // Close Button
                            IconButton(
                              onPressed: () async {
                                final shouldPop = await _handleWillPop();
                                if (shouldPop &&
                                    context.mounted &&
                                    !_hasPopped) {
                                  _hasPopped = true;
                                  Navigator.of(context).pop(false);
                                }
                              },
                              icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                  size: 22, color: textSecondary),
                              tooltip: Loc.tr('close'),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),

                  // Linear Progress Bar saat memuat halaman WebView
                  if (_loadProgress < 1.0)
                    LinearProgressIndicator(
                      value: _loadProgress,
                      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                      color: accent,
                      minHeight: 2.5,
                    ),



                  // WebView gateway pembayaran
                  Expanded(
                    child: InAppWebView(
                      gestureRecognizers: <Factory<OneSequenceGestureRecognizer>>{
                        Factory<OneSequenceGestureRecognizer>(
                          () => EagerGestureRecognizer(),
                        ),
                      },
                      webViewEnvironment: DesktopWebViewRuntime.environment,
                      initialUrlRequest:
                          URLRequest(url: WebUri(widget.paymentUrl)),
                      initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
                        javaScriptEnabled: true,
                        domStorageEnabled: true,
                        databaseEnabled: true,
                        sharedCookiesEnabled: true,
                        thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
                        cacheEnabled: true,
                        clearCache: false,
                        clearSessionCache: false,
                        useHybridComposition: false,
                        disableVerticalScroll: false,
                        disableHorizontalScroll: false,
                        supportZoom: false,
                        builtInZoomControls: false,
                        displayZoomControls: false,
                        mixedContentMode:
                            MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
                        allowFileAccess: false,
                        allowContentAccess: true,
                        javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically: true,
                        supportMultipleWindows: true,
                        forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
                        transparentBackground: false,
                        userAgent: AppPlatform.isDesktop
                            ? AppConstants.desktopSafariUserAgent
                            : AppConstants.chromeMobileUserAgent,
                      ),
                      onWebViewCreated: (controller) {
                        _webController = controller;
                      },
                      onCreateWindow: (controller, createWindowAction) async {
                        final targetUrl = createWindowAction.request.url;
                        if (targetUrl != null) {
                          await controller.loadUrl(
                            urlRequest: URLRequest(url: targetUrl),
                          );
                          return true;
                        }
                        return false;
                      },
                      onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) {
                        if (mounted) {
                          setState(() {
                            _loadProgress = progress / 100.0;
                          });
                        }
                      },
                      shouldOverrideUrlLoading:
                          (controller, navigationAction) async {
                        final webUri = navigationAction.request.url;
                        if (webUri == null) {
                          return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                        }

                        final uri = Uri.tryParse(webUri.toString());
                        if (uri == null) return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;

                        // Deep links untuk aplikasi perbankan atau e-wallet (GoPay, ShopeePay, dsb.)
                        if (uri.scheme != 'http' && uri.scheme != 'https') {
                          if (_isAllowedExternalScheme(uri)) {
                            try {
                              await launchUrl(uri,
                                  mode: AppPlatform.isDesktop
                                      ? LaunchMode.externalApplication
                                      : LaunchMode
                                          .externalNonBrowserApplication);
                            } catch (e) {
                              debugPrint(
                                  '[PaymentCheckout] Gagal membuka external payment app: $e');
                            }
                          } else {
                            debugPrint(
                                '[PaymentCheckout] External scheme ditolak karena tidak masuk allowlist: ${uri.scheme}');
                          }
                          return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                        }

                        if (!_isAllowedPaymentDestination(uri)) {
                          debugPrint(
                              '[PaymentCheckout] Navigation to untrusted destination rejected: $webUri');
                          return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                        }

                        final urlStr = uri.toString().toLowerCase();

                        // Intersep jika gateway mengarah ke callback URL sukses
                        if (urlStr.contains('openturath-ai.web.app') ||
                            urlStr.contains('callback') ||
                            urlStr.contains('finish') ||
                            urlStr.contains('checkout-success') ||
                            urlStr.contains('success')) {
                          _checkPaymentStatus();
                          return NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW;
                        }

                        return NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW;
                      },
                      onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
                        if (mounted) {
                          setState(() => _loadProgress = 1.0);
                        }

                        final urlStr = url?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
                        if (urlStr.contains('openturath-ai.web.app') ||
                            urlStr.contains('checkout-link') ||
                            urlStr.contains('success')) {
                          _checkPaymentStatus();
                        }

                        // Pastikan overflow scroll di body/html aktif
                        try {
                          await controller.evaluateJavascript(source: """
                            (function() {
                              document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'auto';
                              document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
                            })();
                          """);
                        } catch (_) {}

                        // Deteksi instan jika halaman gateway menampilkan halaman Payment Successful
                        try {
                          final isPaidDom =
                              await controller.evaluateJavascript(source: """
                            (function() {
                              var text = (document.body ? document.body.innerText : '') || '';
                              if (text.includes('Payment Successful') || 
                                  text.includes('Pembayaran Berhasil') || 
                                  text.includes('Berhasil!')) {
                                return true;
                              }
                              return false;
                            })();
                          """);
                          if (isPaidDom == true) {
                            _checkPaymentStatus();
                          }
                        } catch (_) {}
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              // ── 2. Celebratory Success Overlay ──
              if (_isSuccess)
                _CelebratorySuccessView(
                  surfaceColor: surfaceColor,
                  textPrimary: textPrimary,
                  textSecondary: textSecondary,
                  accent: accent,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CelebratorySuccessView extends StatelessWidget {
  final Color surfaceColor;
  final Color textPrimary;
  final Color textSecondary;
  final Color accent;

  const _CelebratorySuccessView({
    required this.surfaceColor,
    required this.textPrimary,
    required this.textSecondary,
    required this.accent,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      builder: (context, opacity, child) {
        return Opacity(
          opacity: opacity,
          child: Container(
            color: surfaceColor,
            width: double.infinity,
            height: double.infinity,
            child: Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 32),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    // Spring bounce scale for the checkmark badge
                    TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 750),
                      curve: Curves.elasticOut,
                      builder: (context, scale, _) {
                        return Transform.scale(
                          scale: scale,
                          child: Container(
                            width: 88,

                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: OTColors.borderStrongLight

                              Icons.check_rounded,
                              size: 50,

                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 28),
                    // "Alhamdulillah!" with fade-up
                    TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                      builder: (context, value, _) {
                        return Opacity(
                          opacity: value.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                          child: Transform.translate(
                            offset: Offset(0, (1.0 - value) * 16),
                            child: Text(
                              Loc.tr('ui_28654608b2'),
                              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                fontSize: OTFontSize.s26,
                                letterSpacing: -0.5,
                                color: textPrimary,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    // "Pembayaran Berhasil Diverifikasi"
                    TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600),
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                      builder: (context, value, _) {

                          child: Transform.translate(

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../core/product_pricing.dart';

class PromoPrice extends StatelessWidget {
  const PromoPrice({super.key, required this.amount, required this.regularAmount,
    this.period = '', this.compact = false, this.display = false, this.foregroundColor,
    this.secondaryColor});
  final int amount;
  final int regularAmount;
  final String period;
  final bool compact;
  /// Harga utama layar: satu kali per layar, untuk paket unggulan.
  final bool display;
  final Color? foregroundColor;
  final Color? secondaryColor;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final saving = regularAmount > 0
        ? ((regularAmount - amount) * 100 / regularAmount).round()
        : 0;
    final foreground = foregroundColor ?? OTColors.textPrimary(dark);
    final secondary = secondaryColor ?? OTColors.textSecondary(dark);
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      if (regularAmount > amount) Text(ProductPricing.rupiah(regularAmount),
        semanticsLabel: Loc.tr('normalPrice', [ProductPricing.rupiah(regularAmount)]),
        style: OTTypography.caption(color: secondary)
          .copyWith(decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough)),
      Wrap(crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center, spacing: 6, children: [
        Directionality(textDirection: TextDirection.ltr, child: Text(ProductPricing.rupiah(amount),
          style: OTTypography.price(color: foreground).copyWith(fontSize: compact ? OTFontSize.s18 : display ? OTFontSize.s36 : OTFontSize.s26))),
        Text(period, style: OTTypography.caption(color: secondary)),
      ]),
      if (regularAmount > amount && !compact) Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
        child: Text('${Loc.tr('launchOffer')} · ${Loc.tr('saving', ['$saving'])}',
          style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: secondary))),
    ]);
  }
}

import '../widgets/adaptive_sheet.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_radius.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_spacing.dart';
import '../services/subscription_service.dart';
import 'app_loader.dart';
import 'exclusive_activation_dialog.dart';

class RedeemCodeSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onSuccess;

  const RedeemCodeSheet({
    super.key,
    this.onSuccess,
  });

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, {VoidCallback? onSuccess}) {
    return showAdaptiveSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => RedeemCodeSheet(onSuccess: onSuccess),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<RedeemCodeSheet> createState() => _RedeemCodeSheetState();
}

class _RedeemCodeSheetState extends State<RedeemCodeSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _codeController = TextEditingController();
  final SubscriptionService _subscriptionService = SubscriptionService();
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String? _inlineError;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _codeController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _humanizeErrorMessage(String raw) {
    final lower = raw.toLowerCase().replaceAll('_', '-');
    if (lower.contains('perangkat') || lower.contains('ponsel')) {
      return raw;
    }
    if (lower.contains('not-found')) {
      return 'Kode voucher tidak ditemukan. Periksa kembali penulisan kode Anda.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('already-exists') || lower.contains('already-used')) {
      return 'Kode ini sudah pernah ditukarkan sebelumnya.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('resource-exhausted') || lower.contains('quota')) {
      return 'Kuota penukaran untuk kode voucher ini sudah habis.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('deadline-exceeded') || lower.contains('expired')) {
      return 'Masa berlaku kode voucher ini telah berakhir.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('failed-precondition')) {
      return 'Kode voucher ini sudah tidak aktif.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('invalid-argument')) {
      return 'Format penulisan kode voucher belum sesuai.';
    }
    return raw;
  }

  Future<void> _handleRedeem() async {
    final code = _codeController.text.trim();
    if (code.isEmpty) {
      setState(() => _inlineError = 'Masukkan kode voucher');
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _inlineError = null;
    });

    final result = await _subscriptionService.redeemAccessCode(code);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _isLoading = false);

    final success = result['success'] == true;
    final message = (result['message'] as String?) ??
        (success
            ? 'Akses berhasil diaktifkan'
            : 'Kode tidak valid atau sudah kedaluwarsa');

    if (success) {
      final serviceTitle = (result['serviceTitle'] as String?) ??
          "Kajian Fikih Syafi'i: Al-Muhaqqiq";
      final durationDays = (result['durationDays'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 7;
      final expiryRaw = result['expiry'] as String?;
      final expiryDate = expiryRaw != null ? DateTime.tryParse(expiryRaw) : null;
      final agentId = (result['entitlementKey'] as String?) ?? 'fiqh_syafii';

      final nav = Navigator.of(context);
      widget.onSuccess?.call();
      nav.pop();

      ExclusiveActivationDialog.show(
        nav.context,
        serviceTitle: serviceTitle,
        durationDays: durationDays,
        expiryDate: expiryDate,
        agentId: agentId,
      );
    } else {
      setState(() => _inlineError = _humanizeErrorMessage(message));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bottomInset = MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom;
    final bgSurface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final borderColor = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: bottomInset),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: bgSurface,
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(OTRadius.dialog)),
          border: Border.all(color: borderColor, width: 0.8),
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 20),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            const Center(child: SheetGrabber()),
            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.base),
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Expanded(child: Text(
                  Loc.tr('ui_6f8fc6f8d5'),
                  style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                )),
                IconButton(
                  icon:
                      Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              Loc.tr('ui_75edf97617'),
              style: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary)
                  .copyWith(fontSize: OTFontSize.s12),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),
            TextField(
              controller: _codeController,
              enabled: !_isLoading,
              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
              inputFormatters: [
                FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r'[a-zA-Z0-9\-_]')),
                LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(25),
              ],
              onChanged: (_) {
                if (_inlineError != null) setState(() => _inlineError = null);
              },
              style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                letterSpacing: 1.2,
              ),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: Loc.tr('ui_259e2d8b2c'),
                hintStyle: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary).copyWith(
                  letterSpacing: 0,
                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                ),
                errorText: _inlineError,
                errorStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: OTFontSize.s12),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: canvas,
                contentPadding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: borderColor, width: 0.8),
                ),
                enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: borderColor, width: 0.8),
                ),
                focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: textPrimary, width: 1.2),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.lg),
            SizedBox(
              height: 48,
              child: FilledButton(
                onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _handleRedeem,
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: textPrimary,
                  foregroundColor: canvas,
                  elevation: 0,
                ),
                child: _isLoading
                    ? AppLoader(dotSize: 6, color: canvas)
                    : Text(
                        Loc.tr('ui_6f8fc6f8d5'),
                        style: OTTypography.button(color: canvas),
                      ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
          ],
        )),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown/flutter_markdown.dart';
import '../core/answer_direction.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_spacing.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_radius.dart';
import '../core/scholarly_fonts.dart';

/// One shared reading surface for chat and saved answers. Paragraphs retain
/// Markdown and their own base direction; embedded images cannot make requests.
class ScholarlyAnswer extends StatelessWidget {
  const ScholarlyAnswer(
      {super.key, required this.text, required this.ink, required this.muted});
  final String text;
  final Color ink;
  final Color muted;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          for (final block in answerDisplayBlocks(text))
            if (block.trim().isNotEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: OTSpacing.md),
                child: Directionality(
                  textDirection: answerDirection(block),
                  child: MarkdownBody(
                    data: isolateArabicPhrases(block),
                    selectable: true,
                    sizedImageBuilder: (config) => Text(config.alt ?? ''),
                    styleSheet: MarkdownStyleSheet(
                      p: answerDirection(block) == TextDirection.rtl
                          ? ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
                              fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
                              height: 1.85,
                              color: ink)
                          : ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s16,
                                  height: 1.7,
                                  color: ink)
                              .copyWith(
                                  fontFamilyFallback: const ['NativeArabic']),
                      strong:
                          TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: ink),
                      h1: OTTypography.pageTitle(color: ink),
                      h2: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: ink),
                      h3: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: ink),
                      blockquote: OTTypography.body(color: muted),
                      blockquoteDecoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(
                              Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs)),
                      blockquotePadding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.base),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
        ],
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../core/scholarly_fonts.dart';
import 'apple_interactive_wrapper.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_radius.dart';

/// Each entry describes the assistant's scholarly remit and source material.
class SpecialistCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const SpecialistCard({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    this.scopeLabel,
    this.referenceLabel,
    this.fieldId,
    required this.onOpen,
    this.titleArabic,
    this.emoji,
    this.icon,
    this.statusLabel,
    this.onOpenLibrary,
  });

  final String title;
  final String? scopeLabel;
  final String? referenceLabel;
  final String? fieldId;
  final String? titleArabic;
  final String? emoji;
  final IconData? icon;
  final String? statusLabel;
  final VoidCallback? onOpen;
  final VoidCallback? onOpenLibrary;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final ink = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final muted = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final reference = referenceLabel?.trim();
    final displayTitle = Loc.isArabic && (titleArabic?.isNotEmpty ?? false)
        ? titleArabic!
        : Loc.text(title);

    return AppleInteractiveWrapper(
      onTap: onOpen,
      pressedScale: 0.99,
      hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.light,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
      child: Material(
        color: OTColors.surface(isDark),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
          side: BorderSide(color: border),
        ),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(20, 16, 20, 16),
          child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      displayTitle,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s18,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (reference != null &&
                        reference.isNotEmpty &&
                        onOpenLibrary != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 7),
                      Text(
                        reference,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                          fontSize: OTFontSize.s11,
                          color: muted,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                    if (statusLabel?.isNotEmpty ?? false) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 5),
                      Text(statusLabel!,
                          style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                              fontSize: OTFontSize.s11, color: muted)),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_expressive.dart';

/// Generated illustration; textual controls supply the accessible equivalent.
class TahawwulatArtwork extends StatelessWidget {
  const TahawwulatArtwork({super.key, this.blendEdges = true});
  final bool blendEdges;
  static const asset = 'assets/images/tahawwulat-sculpture-v2.png';
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final image = Image.asset(asset,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        excludeFromSemantics: true,
        filterQuality: FilterQuality.medium);
    return AspectRatio(
        aspectRatio: 1,
        child: blendEdges
            ? ShaderMask(
                blendMode: BlendMode.dstIn,
                shaderCallback: (rect) => const LinearGradient(
                        begin: Alignment.centerLeft,
                        end: Alignment.centerRight,
                        colors: [
                          OTExpressive.transparent,
                          OTExpressive.white,
                          OTExpressive.white,
                          OTExpressive.transparent
                        ],
                        stops: [
                          0,
                          .14,
                          .86,
                          1
                        ]).createShader(rect),
                child: ShaderMask(
                    blendMode: BlendMode.dstIn,
                    shaderCallback: (rect) => const LinearGradient(
                            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                            colors: [
                              OTExpressive.transparent,
                              OTExpressive.white,
                              OTExpressive.white,
                              OTExpressive.transparent
                            ],
                            stops: [
                              0,
                              .14,
                              .86,
                              1
                            ]).createShader(rect),
                    child: image))
            : ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTExpressive.compactHeroRadius), child: image));
  }
}

/// Low-contrast architectural curves keep the reading area calm.
class TahawwulatHeroSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const TahawwulatHeroSurface(
      {super.key,
      required this.child,
      required this.padding,
      required this.radius});
  final Widget child;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
  final double radius;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
      child: ColoredBox(
          color: OTExpressive.hero,
          child: Stack(children: [
            const Positioned.fill(
                child: ExcludeSemantics(
                    child: CustomPaint(painter: _QuietFoldsPainter()))),
            Padding(padding: padding, child: child),
          ])));
}

class _QuietFoldsPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _QuietFoldsPainter();
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      final path = Path()
        ..moveTo(size.width * (.32 + i * .13), -40)
        ..cubicTo(
            size.width * .92,
            size.height * .10,
            size.width * .18,
            size.height * .74,
            size.width * (1.02 + i * .08),
            size.height * 1.15);
      canvas.drawPath(
          path,
          Paint()
            ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
            ..strokeWidth = 30 + i * 20
            ..color = OTExpressive.white.withValues(alpha: .014 + i * .006));
      canvas.drawPath(
          path,
          Paint()
            ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
            ..strokeWidth = 1
            ..color = OTExpressive.white.withValues(alpha: .03));
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _QuietFoldsPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
