```dart
/// The generated sculpture has textual choices and keyboard-accessible sectors.
class TahawwulatDiagram extends StatefulWidget {
  const TahawwulatDiagram(
      {super.key, this.interactive = false, this.inverse = false});
  final bool interactive;
  final bool inverse;
  @override
  State<TahawwulatDiagram> createState() => _TahawwulatDiagramState();
}

class _TahawwulatDiagramState extends State<TahawwulatDiagram> {
  int selected = 3;
  static const arabic = ['الإيمان', 'الإسلام', 'الإحسان', 'علامات الساعة'];
  static const labels = ['Iman', 'Islam', 'Ihsan', 'Tanda-tanda kiamat'];
  static const english = ['Faith', 'Islam', 'Ihsan', 'Signs of the Hour'];
  static const explanations = [
    'Keyakinan kepada Allah, malaikat, kitab, rasul, hari akhir, dan takdir.',
    'Ibadah dan syariat dalam kehidupan seorang muslim.',
    'Beribadah kepada Allah dengan kesadaran dan kejernihan batin.',
    'Membaca perubahan zaman dalam kerangka Fikih Tahawwulat Al-Habib Abu Bakar Al-Adni bin Ali Al-Masyhur.',
  ];
  static const explanationsArabic = [
    'الإيمان بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر والقدر.',
    'العبادة والشريعة في حياة المسلم.',
    'عبادة الله بحضور القلب وصفاء الباطن.',
    'قراءة تحولات الزمان في إطار فقه التحولات عند الحبيب أبي بكر العدني بن علي المشهور.',
  ];
  static const explanationsEnglish = [
    'Belief in Allah, the angels, scriptures, messengers, the Last Day, and divine decree.',
    "Worship and religious practice in a Muslim's life.",
    'Worshipping Allah with awareness and clarity of heart.',
    'Reading changing times through the Fiqh Tahawwulat framework of Al-Habib Abu Bakar Al-Adni bin Ali Al-Masyhur.',
  ];
  String label(int i) => Loc.isArabic
      ? arabic[i]
      : Loc.language == 'en'
          ? english[i]
          : labels[i];
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final ink = widget.inverse
        ? OTExpressive.white
        : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface;
    final artwork = TahawwulatArtwork(blendEdges: widget.inverse);
    return Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
      if (!widget.interactive)
        Semantics(
            image: true,
            label: List.generate(4, label).join(', '),
            child: artwork)
      else
        AspectRatio(
            aspectRatio: 1,
            child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, box) {
              final half = box.maxWidth / 2;
              return Stack(children: [
                Positioned.fill(child: artwork),
                for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++)
                  Positioned(
                      left: i == 0 || i == 3 ? 0 : half,
                      top: i < 2 ? 0 : half,
                      width: half,
                      height: half,
                      child: Semantics(
                          button: true,
                          selected: selected == i,
                          label: label(i),
                          child: TextButton(
                              style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                  overlayColor: OTExpressive.white,
                                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                                          OTExpressive.panelRadius))),
                              onPressed: () => setState(() => selected = i),
                              child: AnimatedContainer(
                                duration:
                                    MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
                                        ? Duration.zero
                                        : const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                                        OTExpressive.panelRadius),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                        width: 2,
                                        color: selected == i
                                            ? OTExpressive.white
                                            : OTExpressive.transparent)),
                                child: Align(
                                    alignment: Alignment.topRight,
                                    child: selected == i
                                        ? const Padding(
                                            padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                            child: Icon(
                                                Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                                color: OTExpressive.white,
                                                size: 24))
                                        : null),
                              )))),
              ]);
            })),
      if (widget.interactive) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++)
                ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(label(i)),
                    selected: selected == i,
                    onSelected: (_) => setState(() => selected = i))
            ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Semantics(
            liveRegion: true,
            child: Text(
                Loc.isArabic
                    ? explanationsArabic[selected]
                    : Loc.language == 'en'
                        ? explanationsEnglish[selected]
                        : explanations[selected],
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                textDirection:
                    Loc.isArabic ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr,
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s16, height: 1.6, color: ink))),
      ],
    ]);
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/sub_agent_model.dart';
import '../services/open_turath_catalog_repository.dart';
import 'assistant_grid_card.dart';
import 'tahawwulat_hero.dart';
import 'tahawwulat_ai_picker.dart';
import 'tahawwulat_introduction_sheet.dart';

class TahawwulatFlagshipCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const TahawwulatFlagshipCard(
      {super.key,
      required this.agent,
      required this.isSubscribed,
      required this.onOpenMain,
      required this.onOpenSubAgent,
      this.onOpenLibrary,
      this.onOpenIntroduction,
      this.metadata});
  final AgentModel agent;
  final bool isSubscribed;
  final VoidCallback onOpenMain;
  final void Function(SubAgentModel) onOpenSubAgent;
  final VoidCallback? onOpenLibrary;
  final VoidCallback? onOpenIntroduction;
  final AiLibraryMetadata? metadata;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Loc.watch(context);
    final subs = agent.subAgents ?? const <SubAgentModel>[];
    void choose() => TahawwulatAiPicker.show(context,
        agents: subs, onSelect: onOpenSubAgent);
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: [
      TahawwulatHero(
          onOpen: choose,
          onOpenLibrary: onOpenLibrary,
          onIntroduction: onOpenIntroduction ??
              () => TahawwulatIntroductionSheet.show(context,
                  agent: agent,
                  onSelectSubAgent: onOpenSubAgent,
                  onOpenMain: choose),
          facts: LibraryStat.from(metadata)
              .map((s) => '${s.value} ${s.unit}')
              .toList()),
    ]);
  }
}
```

```dart
                      fontSize: wide ? OTFontSize.s36 : OTFontSize.s26,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      height: 1.15,
                      color: OTExpressive.white)),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              if (facts.isNotEmpty)
                Wrap(spacing: 16, runSpacing: 8, children: [
                  for (final fact in facts)
                    Text(fact,
                        style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                            color: OTExpressive.whiteMuted))
                ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Wrap(spacing: 12, runSpacing: 12, children: [
                FilledButton(
                    onPressed: onOpen,
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: OTExpressive.white,
                        foregroundColor: OTExpressive.hero,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 24, vertical: 16)),
                    child: Text(reviewCopy('Buka AI Fikih Tahawwulat',
                        'افتح فقه التحولات', 'Open Fiqh Tahawwulat'))),
                if (onOpenLibrary != null)
                  SizedBox.square(
                      dimension: 48,
                      child: IconButton.filledTonal(
                          tooltip: Loc.tr('viewReferences'),
                          onPressed: onOpenLibrary,
                          style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor:
                                  OTExpressive.white.withValues(alpha: .12),
                              foregroundColor: OTExpressive.white),
                          icon: Icon(Icons.auto_stories_outlined,
                              semanticLabel: Loc.tr('viewReferences')))),
                TextButton(
                    onPressed: onIntroduction,
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: OTExpressive.white,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 16, vertical: 16)),
                    child: Text(reviewCopy('Mengenal Fikih Tahawwulat',
                        'تعرّف على فقه التحولات', 'About Fiqh Tahawwulat'))),
              ]),
            ]);
        return TahawwulatHeroSurface(
            padding: EdgeInsets.all(wide ? 32 : 24),
            radius:
                wide ? OTExpressive.heroRadius : OTExpressive.compactHeroRadius,
            child: wide
                ? Row(children: [
                    Expanded(flex: 3, child: text),
                    const SizedBox(width: 24),
                    const Expanded(
                        flex: 2,
                        child: Center(
                            child: SizedBox(
                                width: 280,
                                child: TahawwulatDiagram(inverse: true))))
                  ])
                : Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                        text,
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        const Center(
                            child: SizedBox(
                                width: 180,
                                child: TahawwulatDiagram(inverse: true)))
                      ]));
      });
}
```

```dart
/// Modal interaktif komprehensif untuk mengenal disiplin ilmu Fikih Tahawwulat.
/// Menampilkan teks penjelasan mendalam, komparasi peradaban, serta flowchart minimalis & elegan
/// yang ramah layar sentuh (The Quiet Scholar design system - strictly monokrom minimalis).
class TahawwulatIntroductionSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final AgentModel? agent;
  final void Function(SubAgentModel subAgent)? onSelectSubAgent;
  final VoidCallback? onOpenMain;

  /// Halaman baca penuh (desktop): daftar isi di sisi, kolom baca 680.
  final bool asPage;

  /// Bagian yang dibuka pertama; 0 menampilkan semuanya.
  final int initialSection;

  const TahawwulatIntroductionSheet({
    super.key,
    this.agent,
    this.onSelectSubAgent,
    this.onOpenMain,
    this.asPage = true,
    this.initialSection = 0,
  });

  /// Desktop: halaman baca penuh. Ponsel: lembar bawah.
  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    AgentModel? agent,
    void Function(SubAgentModel subAgent)? onSelectSubAgent,
    VoidCallback? onOpenMain,
  }) {
    if (AppPlatform.isDesktop) {
      return Navigator.of(context).push<void>(PageRouteBuilder<void>(
        transitionDuration: OTMotion.normal,
        reverseTransitionDuration: OTMotion.fast,
        pageBuilder: (ctx, _, __) => TahawwulatIntroductionSheet(
          agent: agent,
          onSelectSubAgent: onSelectSubAgent,
          onOpenMain: onOpenMain,
          asPage: true,
        ),
        transitionsBuilder: (_, animation, __, child) => FadeTransition(
          opacity: CurvedAnimation(parent: animation, curve: OTMotion.curve),
          child: child,
        ),
      ));
    }
    return showAdaptiveSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      enableDrag: true,
      builder: (ctx) => TahawwulatIntroductionSheet(
        agent: agent,
        onSelectSubAgent: onSelectSubAgent,
        onOpenMain: onOpenMain,
        asPage: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<TahawwulatIntroductionSheet> createState() =>
      _TahawwulatIntroductionSheetState();
}

class _TahawwulatIntroductionSheetState
    extends State<TahawwulatIntroductionSheet> {
  final ScrollController _scrollController = ScrollController();

  /// Bab pada halaman majalah: (label, judul) berurutan, dan jangkar gulirnya.
  final List<(String, String)> _chapters = [];
  final Map<String, GlobalKey> _chapterKeys = {};
  late int _selectedTabIndex =
      widget.asPage ? 0 : widget.initialSection.clamp(0, _tabs.length - 1);

  static const List<String> _tabs = [
    "Semua",
    "Pengertian & dalil",

    super.dispose();

  void _scrollToTop() {
    if (_scrollController.hasClients) {

        0,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

    final page = widget.asPage;

    void select(int idx) {

    // Ponsel dan jendela sempit: bagian sebagai baris chip.
    final chips = SingleChildScrollView(
      scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 4),
      child: Row(
        children: List.generate(_tabs.length, (idx) {
          final isSelected = _selectedTabIndex == idx;
          return Padding(

    if (page) {
      // Halaman majalah: sampul, daftar isi bernomor, lalu bab demi bab
      // dalam satu gulungan. Tanpa panel samping.
      _chapters.clear();
      final sections = _sections(context, isDark);
      final viewport = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
      final roomy = viewport.width >= 760;
      const onCover = OTColors.onInverseSurface;

      final cover = Padding(
          padding:
              EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(roomy ? 32 : 16, 64, roomy ? 32 : 16, 24),
          child: TahawwulatHeroSurface(
            padding: EdgeInsets.all(roomy ? 32 : 24),
            radius: roomy
                ? OTExpressive.heroRadius
                : OTExpressive.compactHeroRadius,
            child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, box) {
              final heading = Column(

                  children: [

      Widget contentsEntry(int index) {

      final half = (_chapters.length / 2).ceil();

            // Garis kemajuan baca di tepi atas.
            Positioned(

                animation: _scrollController,
                builder: (context, _) {
                  final position = _scrollController.hasClients &&
                          _scrollController.position.hasContentDimensions
                      ? _scrollController.position
                      : null;
                  final progress =
                      position == null || position.maxScrollExtent <= 0
                          ? 0.0
                          : (position.pixels / position.maxScrollExtent)
                              .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                  return Align(
                    alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                    child: FractionallySizedBox(
                      widthFactor: progress,
                      child: Container(height: 2, color: textPrimary),
                    ),

            ),
            // Tombol kembali mengambang di atas sampul.

    }

    return Container(

      decoration: BoxDecoration(

      child: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(20, 12, 12, 8),

              children: [

                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          chips,

        ],

    );
  }

  /// Isi naskah sesuai bagian yang dipilih.
  List<Widget> _sections(BuildContext context, bool isDark) {
    return [

Al-Habib Abu Bakar Al-Adni bin Ali Al-Masyhur (1366–1444 H / 1947–2022 M), ulama Hadhramaut, menyusunnya menjadi satu disiplin ilmu tersendiri: Fikih Tahawwulat (فِقْهُ التَّحَوُّلَاتِ).",

        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        _buildBodyText(
          "Secara bahasa, al-fiqh berarti pemahaman yang mendalam, sedangkan at-tahawwulat adalah bentuk jamak dari tahawwul: perubahan atau peralihan keadaan.\n\nSecara istilah, Fikih Tahawwulat didefinisikan sebagai:",

        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),

          quote:

          source: "Al-Habib Abu Bakar Al-Adni bin Ali Al-Masyhur",
          isDark: isDark,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _buildBodyText(

Yang kedua menundukkan syariat pada tren zaman. Fikih Tahawwulat menjaga syariat tetap utuh sambil menuntun cara membaca perubahan zaman dengan petunjuk Nabi ﷺ.",

            number: "01",

                "Ibadah lahiriah, rukun fi'li, halal-haram & muamalah baku sepanjang masa.",
            isDark: isDark,

                "Pondasi keyakinan pada Allah, malaikat, kitab, rasul & takdir azali.",
            isDark: isDark,
            isHighlight: false,
          ),
          _buildConnectorLine(isDark),
          _buildPillarTile(
            number: "03",
            title: "Al-Iḥsān (الإِحْسَان)",
            discipline: "Tasawuf & Akhlak (Aṡ-Ṡawābit)",

                "Penyucian jiwa (tazkiyatun nufūs), muraqabah hati & keluhuran adab batin.",

            isHighlight: false,
          ),
          _buildConnectorLine(isDark),
          _buildPillarTile(
            number: "04",
            title: "Fikih Tahawwulat (فِقْهُ التَّحَوُّلَاتِ)",

  Widget _buildPillarTile({
    required String number,
    required String title,
    required String discipline,
    required String desc,
    required bool isDark,
    required bool isHighlight,
  }) {
    final borderColor = isHighlight
        ? (isDark ? OTColors.borderDark : OTColors.borderLight)
        : OTColors.border(isDark);
    final bgColor = isHighlight
        ? (isDark ? OTColors.surfaceSubtleDark : OTColors.textPrimaryDark)
        : (isDark ? OTColors.surfaceDark : OTColors.surfaceLight);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bgColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
        border: Border.all(color: borderColor, width: isHighlight ? 1.2 : 0.8),
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 26,
            height: 26,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isDark
                  ? OTColors.borderSubtleDark
                  : OTColors.borderSubtleLight,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.xs),
            ),
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            child: Text(
              number,
              style: ScholarlyFonts.jetBrainsMono(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                color: textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      title,
                      style: ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Text(
                  discipline,
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: textSecondary,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Text(
                  desc,
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                    color: textSecondary,
                    height: 1.5,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

      ),
      (
        aspect: "Teknologi & AI",
        before:
            "Terbelah ekstrem: menolak total sebagai bid'ah atau menelan mentah-mentah hingga hilang adab.",
        after:
            "Kaidah Al-Ightinām: merebut teknologi dan AI untuk khidmat ilmu turats secara selamat."

      (
        aspect: "Gaya Dakwah",
        before:
            "Suka memvonis dan mencaci; menganggap masyarakat sebagai lawan yang harus dihantam.",
        after:

      ),
      (
        aspect: "Fitnah Politik",
        before:
            "Fanatik buta golongan dan mengeksploitasi ayat agama untuk politik praktis.",

        aspect: "Keluarga",
        before:

      (

        before: "Mudah panik dan cemas karena ramalan kiamat yang viral.",

    return Container(

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildFiveAiRoomsList(BuildContext context, bool isDark) {
    final subAgents = widget.agent?.subAgents ?? const <SubAgentModel>[];

    const rooms = [
      _AiRoomItem(
        number: "01",
        name: "Al-Muhaqqiq",
        arabic: "المُحَقِّق",
        role: "Penjaga Teks Matan & Ibarah",
        desc:
            "Verifikasi redaksi Arab asli mualif, mencocokkan kutipan matan, serta rujukan presisi ke nama kitab, jilid, dan nomor halaman.",
        subAgentId: "fiqh_tahawwulat_muhaqqiq",
      ),
      _AiRoomItem(
        number: "02",
        name: "Al-Bayan",
        arabic: "البَيَان",
        role: "Pensyarah Konsep & Istilah Baru",
        desc:
            "Menjelaskan istilah yang rumit (mustalahat mubtakarah) dengan bahasa yang mudah, perumpamaan, dan peta konsep.",
        subAgentId: "fiqh_tahawwulat_bayan",
      ),
      _AiRoomItem(
        number: "03",
        name: "Al-Mukhtabir",
        arabic: "المُخْتَبِر",
        role: "Ujian Nalar & Kaji Kasus Interaktif",
        desc:
            "Teman diskusi dan penguji pemahaman; menyajikan studi kasus agar nalar tetap lurus dan tidak mencocok-cocokkan.",
        subAgentId: "fiqh_tahawwulat_mukhtabir",
      ),
      _AiRoomItem(
        number: "04",
        name: "Al-Habib",
        arabic: "الحَبِيب",
        role: "Arsip Muhadharah & Sentuhan Ruhani",
        desc:
            "Menyajikan isi ribuan jam ceramah penyusun: nasihat yang menenangkan dan bimbingan adab tazkiyatun nufus.",
        subAgentId: "fiqh_tahawwulat_habib",
      ),
      _AiRoomItem(
        number: "05",
        name: "Al-Khatib",
        arabic: "الخَطِيب",
        role: "Penyusun Materi Khutbah & Dakwah",
        desc:
            "Menyusun bahan khutbah Jumat, panduan dakwah di masa krisis, dan materi tabligh tematik yang menyejukkan.",
        subAgentId: "fiqh_tahawwulat_khatib",
      ),
    ];

    return Column(
      children: rooms.map((room) {
        final matchingSub = subAgents.firstWhere(
          (s) => s.id == room.subAgentId,
          orElse: () => SubAgentModel(
            id: room.subAgentId,
            name: room.name,
            nameArabic: room.arabic,
            description: room.desc,
            descriptionArabic: room.arabic,
            emoji: '📖',
            badge: room.role,
          ),
        );

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
          child: Row(children: [
            Expanded(
              child: FilledButton.tonal(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark),
                  foregroundColor: OTColors.textPrimary(isDark),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                ),
                onPressed: widget.onSelectSubAgent == null
                    ? null
                    : () {
                        Navigator.of(context).pop();
                        widget.onSelectSubAgent!(matchingSub);
                      },
                child: Text(Loc.isArabic ? room.arabic : room.name,
                    style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(fontSize: OTFontSize.s18)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: Loc.isArabic ? 'عن المساعد' : 'Tentang AI',
              onPressed: () => showDialog<void>(
                  context: context,
                  builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
                        title: Text(room.role),
                        content: Text(room.desc),
                        actions: [
                          TextButton(
                              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                              child: Text(Loc.isArabic ? 'إغلاق' : 'Tutup'))
                        ],
                      )),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded),
            ),
          ]),
        );
      }).toList(),
    );
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // CLOSING CARD
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildClosingCard(BuildContext context, bool isDark) {
    final borderColor = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? OTColors.surfaceDark : OTColors.surfaceLight,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
        border: Border.all(
          color: borderColor,
          width: 0.8,
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Text(
                "Harapan dan doa penutup",
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: textPrimary,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            "Teknologi di OpenTurath hadir sebagai khadim, pelayan ilmu: memudahkan istilah yang sulit dan membuka akses, agar warisan ini dapat dipelajari dengan mudah, jernih, dan beradab.",
            style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              color: textSecondary,
              height: 1.45,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            "Semoga setiap huruf ibarah yang dikaji menjadi amal jariyah yang pahalanya mengalir tanpa putus ke haribaan mualif: "
            "Al-Musnid Al-`Allāmah Al-Habib Abu Bakar Al-Adni bin Ali Al-Masyhur, para guru beliau, dan seluruh kaum Muslimin hingga hari Kiamat. Āmīn.",
            style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
              color: textPrimary,
              height: 1.4,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Helper Widgets ──
  Widget _buildSectionHeader(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String tag,
    required String title,
    required String arabic,
  }) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    if (widget.asPage) {
      _chapters.add((tag, title));
      final number = _chapters.length.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
      return Padding(
        key: _chapterKeys.putIfAbsent(tag, GlobalKey.new),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 72, bottom: 8),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Divider(height: 1, color: OTColors.border(isDark)),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
              textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
              children: [
                Text(
                  number,
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s36,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                    letterSpacing: -2,
                    height: 1,
                    color: OTColors.textTertiary(isDark),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 14),
                // "Bab N" tidak diulang: nomor besar sudah menjadi urutannya.
                if (!tag.startsWith('Bab'))
                  Text(
                    tag,
                    style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                        color: OTColors.textTertiary(isDark)),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            Text(
              title,
              style: ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s36,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                letterSpacing: -0.9,
                height: 1.12,
                color: textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              arabic,
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s22,
                height: 1.6,
                color: textSecondary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    // Jarak di atas tiap bab agar pergantian bab terasa.
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: widget.asPage ? 24 : 12),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            tag,
            style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              color: OTColors.textTertiary(isDark),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
            title,
            style: ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
              fontSize: widget.asPage ? OTFontSize.s26 : OTFontSize.s22,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              letterSpacing: -0.4,
              height: 1.2,
              color: textPrimary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
            arabic,
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            style: ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
              fontSize: widget.asPage ? OTFontSize.s18 : OTFontSize.s16,
              color: textSecondary,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBodyText(String text, bool isDark) {
    return Text(
      text,
      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
        fontSize: widget.asPage ? OTFontSize.s16 : OTFontSize.s14,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        height: widget.asPage ? 1.75 : 1.6,
        color: OTColors.textPrimary(isDark).withValues(alpha: 0.84),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildQuoteCard(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String quote,
    required String source,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textTertiary = OTColors.textTertiary(isDark);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? OTColors.surfaceDark : OTColors.canvasLight,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
        // Garis di sisi kanan: sisi awal teks Arab.
        border: Border(
          right: BorderSide(color: textPrimary, width: 2.5),
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Text(
            quote,
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            textAlign: TextAlign.right,
            style: ScholarlyFonts.scheherazadeNew(
              fontSize: widget.asPage ? OTFontSize.s22 : OTFontSize.s18,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              height: 1.8,
              color: textPrimary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            "— $source",
            style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              color: textTertiary,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildConnectorLine(bool isDark) {
    return Center(
      child: Container(
        width: 1.5,
        height: 12,
        color: OTColors.border(isDark).withValues(alpha: 0.7),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../services/update_service.dart';
import '../core/scholarly_fonts.dart';
import '../core/localization.dart';

import 'package:openturath_ai/core/design/ot_typography.dart';
class UpdateReadyBanner extends StatelessWidget {
  const UpdateReadyBanner({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final updateService = UpdateService();

    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: updateService,
      builder: (context, _) {
        if (!updateService.isUpdateReady) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        final isDesktop = !kIsWeb && !Platform.isAndroid && !Platform.isIOS;
        final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
        final surface =
            isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
        final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
        final textPrimary =
            isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
        final textSecondary =
            isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;
        final info = updateService.updateInfo;
        final version = info?.latestVersion ?? '';

        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
            border: Border.all(
              color: border,
              width: 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark
                    ? AppTheme.borderDark
                    : AppTheme.pillSecondaryBgLight,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.system_update_rounded,
                  color: OTColors.textPrimary(isDark),
                  size: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      isDesktop
                          ? Loc.tr('updateBannerTitleDesktop', [version])
                          : Loc.tr('updateBannerTitleMobile', [version]),
                      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      isDesktop
                          ? Loc.tr('updateBannerDescDesktop')
                          : Loc.tr('updateBannerDescMobile'),
                      style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                        color: textSecondary,
                      ),
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  final opened = await updateService.installNow();
                  if (!opened && context.mounted) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                      content: Text(
                          Loc.tr('updateReadyOpenFailed')),
                    ));
                  }
                },
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: OTColors.accent(isDark),
                  foregroundColor: OTColors.onAccent(isDark),
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                  minimumSize: const Size(64, 36),
                  elevation: 0,
                ),
                child: Text(
                  isDesktop
                      ? Loc.tr('updateBannerActionDesktop')
                      : Loc.tr('updateBannerActionMobile'),
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class UpdateReadyDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final UpdateService updateService;

    super.key,

  });

  static Future<void> show(
      BuildContext context, UpdateService updateService) async {
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      barrierColor: OTColors.shadow.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
      builder: (ctx) => UpdateReadyDialog(updateService: updateService),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface =
        isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
    final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
    final textPrimary =
        isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
    final textSecondary =
        isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;
    final isDesktop = !kIsWeb && !Platform.isAndroid && !Platform.isIOS;
    final info = updateService.updateInfo;
    final version = info?.latestVersion ?? '';
    final releaseNotes = info?.releaseNotes ??
        Loc.tr('updateReadyDefaultNotes');

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
        side: BorderSide(color: border, width: 1),
      ),
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            // Ikon Lencana Pembaharuan Hening
            Container(
              width: 56,
              height: 56,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: isDark
                    ? AppTheme.borderDark
                    : AppTheme.pillSecondaryBgLight,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                Icons.system_update_rounded,
                color: OTColors.textPrimary(isDark),
                size: 26,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Judul Pembaruan
            Text(
              isDesktop
                  ? Loc.tr('updateReadyTitleDesktop')
                  : Loc.tr('updateReadyTitleMobile'),
              style: ScholarlyFonts.newsreader(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s20,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: textPrimary,
              ),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),

            // Nomor Versi
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color:
                    isDark ? OTColors.surfaceSubtleDark : OTColors.borderSubtleLight,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusPill),
              ),
              child: Text(
                Loc.tr('updateReadyVersion', [version]),
                style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                  fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: textSecondary,
                  letterSpacing: 0.2,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // Penjelasan Status Unduhan
            Text(
              isDesktop
                  ? Loc.tr('updateReadyDescDesktop')
                  : Loc.tr('updateReadyDescMobile'),
              style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                height: 1.5,
                color: textSecondary,
              ),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Catatan Rilis Ringkas
            if (releaseNotes.isNotEmpty) ...[
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark
                      ? OTColors.surfaceDark
                      : OTColors.surfaceSubtleLight,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: border.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                    width: 0.5,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  releaseNotes,
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s12,
                    color: textSecondary,
                    height: 1.4,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 3,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
            ],

            // Tombol Aksi Pasang & Muat Ulang
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 46,
              child: FilledButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  final opened = await updateService.installNow();
                  if (!context.mounted) return;
                  if (opened) {
                    Navigator.of(context).pop();
                  } else {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                      content: Text(
                          Loc.tr('updateReadyOpenFailed')),
                    ));

                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(

                  foregroundColor: OTColors.onAccent(isDark),
                  elevation: 0,
                ),
                child: Text(
                  isDesktop
                      ? Loc.tr('updateReadyActionDesktop')
                      : Loc.tr('updateReadyActionMobile'),
                  style: ScholarlyFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),

            // Tombol Nanti Saja
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,

              child: TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                style: TextButton.styleFrom(

                    fontSize: OTFontSize.s14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,

    );
  }
}
```
